title: General Merchandise Dept Mgr - Hartland Twp, MI
description:
As a family company, we serve people and communities. When you work at Meijer, you’re provided with career and community opportunities centered around leadership, personal growth and development. Consider joining our family – take care of your career and your community!

Meijer Rewards

  • Weekly pay

  • Scheduling flexibility

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid education assistance

  • Team member discount

  • Development programs for advancement and career growth

Please review the job profile below and apply today!

Are you seeking to join a thriving organization? Do you possess a fervent dedication to nurturing tomorrow's leaders? We are on the lookout for an exceptional General Merchandise Dept Manager to Join Meijer to support our Hartland Twp, MI Store location.

The General Merchandise Dept Manager is responsible for overall team member engagement for those in span of care. You will be responsible for driving recognition, feedback and coaching, performance management, training and development, and succession planning. Direct Leads and Team Leaders, while ultimately being accountable for area operations and financials (shrink, productivity, safety, scheduling & forecasting staffing needs, and team member and customer conflict resolution). The General Merchandise Dept Manager will work to identify and implement process improvements as well as serve as a steward of the Meijer culture.

A career at Meijer offers more than just a paycheck. We provide a wide range of benefits designed to support a positive work-life balance, ensuring that you can thrive both personally and professionally:

- Get Paid Weekly
- Medical/Dental/Vision/401K (effective on Start Date - Leaders Only)
- 3 Weeks of Paid Days Off (effective on Start Date - Leaders Only)
- Tuition Free and Reimbursement Education Assistance (effective on Start Date)
- Child and Adult Care Assistance
- Team Member Discount
-...and Much More!!!


What You’ll be Doing:

  • Engages with team members in span of care to ensure they are receiving appropriate onboarding, training and development, and coaching and feedback to be successful in all they do.
  • Identifies talent and engages in career discussions to support overall store staffing and ensure a diversified talent pipeline strategy for team member as well as leadership roles.
  • Involvement in candid discussions with team members to ensure Meijer standards are upheld and team members have the ability to grow within the organization.
  • Accountability for area operations and financial results by overseeing the execution of corporate plans to ensure all services and products are effectively managed in order to maximize sales and productivity ultimately owning budget line items in the P&L.
  • Drives safety and compliance throughout the store in addition to overall condition management as well as responsibility for following all compliance procedures in the store.
  • Ensures the Team Leaders and Leads are providing guidance and assigning daily work assignments for team members as well as any training needs.
  • This job profile is not meant to be all inclusive of the responsibilities of this position; may perform other duties as assigned or required.

What You Bring with You (Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 4+ years of retail/grocery or customer service experience.
  • Progressive leadership experience preferred.
  • A passion to provide industry leading service.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with team members in a way that provides clear and precise direction.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial and statistical information and use that information to make informed decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead an organization that practices working safely at all times.
  • Demonstrates proactive/creative thinking and applies it to the business.
  • A thorough understanding of seasonal and diverse merchandising which leads to meeting the needs of our customers/community and gaining sales and market share.
  • A strong business acumen.
  • An innovative attitude to help Meijer set the industry standard.
  • A commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where all team members and vendors feel valued and supported.

Serviceorienteret Disponent til GLS Express - Aalborg


Har du lyst til at være en del et engageret team, der koordinerer optimale ekspresløsninger for de mange kunder, der benytter Danmarks førende udbyder af ekspres-, kurer- og distributionskørsel?




Serviceorienteret Disponent til GLS Express - Aalborg

Har du lyst til at være en del et engageret team, der koordinerer optimale ekspresløsninger for de mange kunder, der benytter Danmarks førende udbyder af ekspres-, kurer- og distributionskørsel?



Så er det måske dig, der skal være vores nye disponent. Sammen med to passionerede kolleger vil du hver dag være med til at løse et stort puslespil i en spændende virksomhed i vækst.



Kvalitet, deadlines og super kundeservice

Som disponent i GLS Express A/S Aalborg håndterer du mange forskellige opgaver hver dag. Vi er løsningsorienterede af natur og tilpasser os de indkomne opgaver samtidig med, at vi holder fast i det gode købmandskab. Du indgår i et team med en stor kontaktflade til kolleger, kunder og chauffører, når du navigerer mellem de forskellige ordrer på mail og telefon, og koordinerer bilernes ture rundt på de danske og europæiske veje. 



Vi arbejder med fælles dialog og inputs til de daglige opgaver, men stoler også på, at du selvstændigt kan løse opgaverne. Du får stor frihed til selv at finde de gode, lønsomme og - ikke mindst - hurtige løsninger.  



På en almindelig arbejdsdag kommer du til at beskæftige dig med: 



	
Planlægning af ruter og disponering af ture i både vores kurér- og distributionssegmenter

	
Kommunikation med kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere

	
Håndtering af administrative opgaver tilhørende den daglige operation

	
Tilbudsgivning på ad hoc ture og andre projekter i dagligdagen

	
Godkendelse af fakturering til kunder og afregning til samarbejdspartnere

	
Terminalhåndtering i et kortere tidsrum på daglig basis, hvor vi tilsikrer at chaufførerne scanner og sorterer efter fastlagte procedurer




Udover at servicere dine egne, lokale kunder hjælper du også dine gode kolleger i teamet med at løse små og store opgaver, så alle vores kunder er glade og tilfredse.



Du er erfaren, har et godt overblik - og højt humør

Du har allerede erfaring som kørselsassistent, kørselsleder eller speditør og er vant til at planlægge hurtigt og effektivt. Det vigtigste er imidlertid din indstilling til jobbet. Nogle af dine bedste kvaliteter er et højt energiniveau, overblik og selvstændighed.



Vi søger efter dig, der både kan og vil. Dig, der kan træffe en her-og-nu beslutning og formår at holde flere opgaver i gang på samme tid. Dig, der stadig har overskud til at sende et smil gennem telefonen, når det går stærkt og altid er klar til at hjælpe dine kunder og kolleger. IT-mæssigt er du generelt godt kørende, med et godt kendskab til Microsoft programmer.



Sådan kommer din hverdag til at se ud

På kontoret i Aalborg arbejder du tæt sammen din leder og én anden disponent. Hverdagen er kendetegnet ved at balancere og prioritere hasteopgaver, ind mellem opgaver med lange deadlines. 

Vi er ærlige og direkte i vores tilgang, samtidig med at vi værner om det gode samarbejde og den stærke holdånd. Arbejdstiden ligger i tidsrummet mellem kl. 07.00-17.00.



Er det vigtigt for dig, er det vigtigt for os

Vi tror på, at mennesker gør forskellen. Vi sætter mennesket først - både når det gælder vores medarbejdere og vores kunder. Derfor stræber vi efter at skabe en hverdag, hvor du føler dig tryg, hørt og som en vigtig del af fællesskabet.



Du kan bl.a. forvente:





Klar til at tage næste skridt?

Send dit CV og besvar venligst screeningsspørgsmålene senest d. 7. september 2026. Vi tillader os at holde samtaler løbende og lukker processen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.



Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Supervisor, Dennis Sørensen på +45 25 24 11 74. Det vil også være Dennis, som du vil referere til i hverdagen.



Forventet opstart vil være 1. november 2026 eller efter anden aftale.



Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.
















  
  Share



  
  Share



  
  Post



  
  Email



  
  Share




  










Hvorfor vælge GLS?



Vi tænker i muligheder: Hos GLS baner innovative løsninger vejen for en gnidningsfri kundeoplevelse. Vi søger altid nye måder at være på forkant i det konkurrenceprægede og globale marked for pakkedistribution.



Forbinder globalt, påvirker lokalt: Når du bliver en del af GLS, tilslutter du dig en virksomhed, der forbinder verden. Men vi nøjes ikke med at skabe globale forbindelser - vi tager også ansvar lokalt og engagerer os i de samfund, hvor vi er til stede.



Miljøbeskyttelse: Hos GLS tager vi ansvar for vores påvirkning af verden omkring os. Gennem vores koncernstrategi, Climate Protect, arbejder vi på at minimere vores miljøaftryk og inspirere til positive forandringer på tværs af vores internationale netværk.



Vores kultur: Hos GLS tror vi på, at mennesker i trivsel skaber de bedste resultater. Vi værner om en kultur, hvor omsorg, samarbejde og innovation går hånd i hånd. Her bliver gode ideer til virkelighed, der skaber en mærkbar forskel og giver anledning til at fejre vores succeser.

   Supply Chain Teamleder 
 
 Supply Chain teamleder, Supply Chain til Nettos hovedkontor i Køge 

 Vil du være med til at sikre varer på hylderne og udvikle en afdeling med fokus på både mennesker såvel som resultater? Trives du i et travlt miljø, hvor du også skal du sikre, at det høje niveau opretholdes og udvikles for alle vores dygtige medarbejdere? 

 Sagde du ja til ovenstående, kan du være kandidaten vi søger til stillingen som Supply Chain teamleder i vores Supply Chain afdeling. 

 Jobbet: 

 Som Supply Chain teamleder vil du spille en central rolle i at optimere vores forsyningskæde og sikre, at vores kunder altid har adgang til de produkter, de har brug for. Du skal trives med at sidde med ledelsesmæssige såvel som operationelle opgaver. Du vil, i samarbejde med dit team, arbejde tæt sammen med vores leverandører, logistikpartnere og interne stakeholdere, for at sikre en effektiv og bæredygtig forsyningskæde. 

 Din afdelings vigtigste opgave er at sikre, at vores spotvarer er til rådighed for vores kunder i vores 580 Netto butikker i Danmark. Det er vigtigt, at du kan sikre en struktureret og effektiv arbejdsgang for dig og dine medarbejdere, samt sikre, at fastlagte KPI’er efterleves. Du skal kunne trives i en omskiftelig og travl hverdag, hvor kravene er høje til kvalitet og overholdelse af deadlines. 

 Som leder har du en åben, ærlig og konstruktiv kommunikationsstil. Du er en synlig leder, som formår at gå forrest og skabe tætte relationer til dine medarbejdere, samt samarbejdet med stakeholders, både internt og eksternt. 

 Sammen med dit team skal du sikre varens vej fra internationale og nationale leverandører til vores butikker. Det vil sige, at du skal sikre rettidige leveringer fra leverandør til lager og fra lager til butik. 

 Teamet: 

 Du vil skulle stå i spidsen for Supply Chain Allocation teamet, som er bemandet med 5 Supply Chain Coordinators. Stemningen er præget af godt humør og en uformel omgangstone samt fokus på at levere i høj kvalitet uge efter uge, også når tempoet skues ekstra op omkring højtider. 

 Dine kompetencer: 
 
 Det falder dig naturligt at gå forrest, tage ansvar og sikre, at opgaven følges til dørs 

 Du er drevet af at opnå resultater sammen med dine medarbejdere, med fokus på butikkerne, og samtidig balancere interne interesser 

 Du er stærk i din stakeholder management, forstår vigtigheden af godt samarbejde og har stor integritet 

 Du har en analytisk og struktureret tilgang til opgaverne med fokus på kontinuerlige forbedringer 

 Du tager nye udfordringer med gåpåmod og målet for øje 

 Du sætter en ære i at overholde deadlines og levere kvalitet. Din afdelings effektivitet skal kunne mærkes helt ud på butiksgulvet til kunderne i vores butikker 

 Du er en holdspiller der tænker "vi" frem for "jeg" og som trives i et uformelt miljø 

 Dine kommunikative evner er veludviklede og du er flydende i skrift og tale på både dansk og engelsk 

 Du kan lide fastlagte procedurer og målbare KPI’er 
 
 Din baggrund: 

 Vi forestiller os, at du er Supply Chain-uddannet og/eller har erfaring med Supply Chain Management, varedisponering, eller har haft leverandørkontakt. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling, gerne inden for FMCG eller en større virksomhed, hvor der er mange interessenter og hvor kompleksiteten og vigtigheden i at overholde processerne er stor. 

 Vi tilbyder: 
 
 Et job, hvor resultatet af din indsats er vigtig for at kunderne får den bedste indkøbsoplevelse i vores butikker, og hvor du er med til at præge processer og arbejdsgange i vareflowet til Danmarks største og bedst kendte brand. 

 Gode, professionelle medarbejdere og kolleger i et godt team, hvor vi løfter i flok og sammen sikrer, at vi når målet - hver gang. 

 Træning og udvikling efter behov 

 Individuelt aftalt løn, gode ansættelsesvilkår og gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling - samt en række personalegoder som f.eks. rabatordninger i Bilka, føtex, Netto og Salling. 
 
 Er du interesseret? 

 Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Goodsflow, Netto Danmark, Martin Vedelsparre på telefon 6155 1725. 
 Så send os din ansøgning med CV hurtigst muligt og senest 23. august 2026.
 Ansøgninger behandles løbende.

description:
Make a Difference on Your Own Schedule and Terms!

Hiring Per Diem Registered Dietitians for Virtual Visits!

EmVenio Research provides quality, clinical trial visits for various Sponsors and CROs. We're the only company that hires, trains, certifies, tests, and manages our own Registered Dietitians. Our mission is to bring clinical trial visits to subjects wherever they may be to increase convenience and compliance with study protocols.

Be part of a team who fully embrace our values and key behaviors!

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Computer Vision (C++) (R5197)
description:
Job Description

Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed defense‑tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software and V‑BAT and X‑BAT aircraft. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia‑Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

This role is for a Computer Vision C++ Engineer to support the development of real‑time perception capabilities for Shield AI's autonomous systems.

The Computer Vision Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and integrating advanced computer vision algorithms into high-performance C++ software pipelines. The role will focus on building custom perception capabilities from the ground up, with an emphasis on real-time performance, reliability, and deployment in edge compute environments. This position is required to increase the team's capacity and technical depth in real-time computer vision, image processing, and applied machine learning.

The successful candidate will bring strong C++ software engineering skills, experience developing high-performance or real-time systems, and a deep understanding of computer vision fundamentals. They should be capable of translating research concepts into deployable software and comfortable working on bespoke algorithms rather than relying only on existing libraries. Experience with areas such as visual SLAM, visual odometry, target tracking, feature detection and matching, 3D reconstruction, state estimation, sensor fusion, or real-time mapping would be highly valuable.

The role will also support the development of tracking and spatial perception pipelines for autonomous systems, including applications such as visual localization, motion estimation, scene reconstruction, landmark tracking, map building, and perception‑assisted navigation. Familiarity with SLAM frameworks, probabilistic estimation, optimization, bundle adjustment, feature-based and direct methods, and deployment of real-time perception algorithms into C++ edge environments would be beneficial. Candidates with a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, Computer Vision, Autonomous Systems, or a related field would be well aligned with the technical needs of the team, though strong applied industry experience is also highly relevant.

Required qualifications:
  • Degree in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • Deep proficiency in C++, with proven experience developing software in high-performance, real-time environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom computer vision algorithms from scratch, rather than exclusively applying existing libraries.
  • Solid foundational understanding of computer vision, image processing, and machine learning principles.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, performance optimization, and version control.
  • Proven ability to own technical work from ambiguous requirements through algorithm design, implementation, integration, and delivery.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary cross-functional teams, including AI experts, robotics engineers, and optical engineers, to deliver reliable edge solutions.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with object detection, target tracking, 3D reconstruction, SLAM, camera calibration, or behaviour analysis.
  • Background in automated video surveillance or other related real-time vision systems.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard vision toolkits, such as OpenCV.
  • Exposure to deep learning methodologies for image classification, recognition, or sequence modelling.
  • Practical experience integrating deep learning models into broader computer vision systems for real-time deployment scenarios.
  • Previous experience in the Defence sector, autonomous unmanned systems, or similar mission-critical domains.

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check.

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Brænder du for værtskab, salg og gode gæsteoplevelser? Og har du lyst til at arbejde på en af Danmarks mest unikke arbejdspladser? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som butiksassistent i museumsbutikken i Den Gamle By.

Den Gamle By er en spændende og pulserende arbejdsplads centralt placeret i Aarhus. I museumsbutikken ønsker vi at give vores gæster en god oplevelse, der supplerer deres museumsbesøg. Vores sortiment afspejler både museets samlinger og temaer samt dansk håndværk fra egne værksteder.

Som butiksassistent bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor gæsteservice, salg og formidling er centrale opgaver. Din hverdag vil blandt andet bestå af salg, gæstekontakt, varemodtagelse, lagerarbejde, vareopstillinger og formidling, både i museumsbutikken og i vores historiske butikker.

Museumsbutikken har 6 fastansatte og 25 timelønnede medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe gode oplevelser for vores mange gæster.   


Vi forestiller os, at du:



Gerne er faguddannet inden for detailhandel


Prioriterer god og professionel service og har lyst til at formidle historierne bag Den Gamle Bys produkter og samlinger


Er en positiv og løsningsorienteret holdspiller, der tager ansvar og bidrager til et godt samarbejde og en humoristisk omgangstone


Har en god fysik, arbejder struktureret og trives med praktiske og varierede arbejdsopgaver


Trives i en travl hverdag, hvor butikken er fyldt med glade gæster i alle aldre og fra mange lande


Har interesse for salg og varepræsentation og motiveres af at skabe stærke og inspirerende vareudstillinger


Kan servicere vores gæster på dansk og engelsk - og meget gerne også på tysk


Kan arbejde hver anden eller tredje weekend samt på enkelte helligdage, da Den Gamle By har åbent 365 dage om året





Vi tilbyder



En alsidig stilling på en unik og historisk arbejdsplads


Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet, kommunikation og godt sammenhold er i fokus


En arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver og kontakt til gæster fra hele verden


Gode personaleforhold med kantineordning, pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring m.fl.



 


Vilkår og spørgsmål

Stillingen er en fast stilling på 30 timer ugentligt. Arbejdstiden vil variere fra uge til uge afhængigt af sæsonen og ligger primært i tidsrummet 9.00-18.00 og i få sæsoner fra 9.00-21.00. 

Aftenvagter og overarbejde skal forventes i museets travle perioder, der især indebærer skolernes sommerferie og juleperioden fra midten af november til starten af januar. 

Vi tilbyder løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til OPO under Industriens Overenskomst. 
Tiltrædelse 1. november 2026. 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder for butikker Klaus Koldsgaard på mail kkd@dengamleby.dk eller på tlf. 4185 0862. På grund af sommerferie besvares henvendelser først fra tirsdag den 25. august. 

Da stillingen indebærer kontakt med børn og unge, er ansættelsen betinget af, at der indhentes en børneattest i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning og med dit skriftlige samtykke. 



Ansøgning og ansættelsesproces

I stedet for en traditionel ansøgning beder vi dig skrive en kort og motiveret ansøgning, hvor du besvarer spørgsmålene nedenfor.



Hvorfor søger du netop denne stilling, og hvordan ser du, at du kan bruge dine kompetencer i Den Gamle By?


Beskriv, hvordan du arbejder med vareudstillinger og visuel merchandising.


Du vil blive en del af et team med få faste kollegaer og mange timelønnede kollegaer, der primært er studerende. Hvad er vigtigt for dig i samarbejdet med dine forskellige kollegaer?


Den Gamle By er et museum, hvor god service og korrekt historisk formidling går hånd i hånd. Hvad kendetegner god formidling og service for dig?


Hvad gør du dig af tanker om at stillingen er på 30 timer og om variationen i timetal hen over året?   



 


Dine svar og dit CV skal sendes via QuickApply på Jobindex senest søndag den 6. september 2026. 

Du kan ansøge via linket her:

Engageret og serviceminded butiksassistent til museumsbutikken i Den Gamle By (30 timer) | Jobannonce | Jobindex

Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler onsdag den 16. og torsdag den 17. september 2026.

Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved alle punkter i opslaget for at søge stillingen. Hvis du kan se dig selv i jobbet og mener, at dine erfaringer og kompetencer kan bidrage til Den Gamle By, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.  




Den Gamle By er et nationalt museum og også lokalmuseum for Aarhus. Museet besøges årligt af over en halv million gæster, heraf mange fra udlandet. Museet har godt 200 årsværk, som består af mange forskellige faggrupper. Og så har Den Gamle By de maksimale 3 stjerner i Guide Michelin.

                                            Produktionsleder til TV 2 Sport
                    
                    
                    

                        
Vil du være med til at sikre, at nogle af Danmarks største sportsproduktioner bliver planlagt og eksekveret med overblik, kvalitet og fremdrift? Som produktionsleder i TV 2 Sport spiller du en central rolle i at få vores mange produktioner til at hænge sammen - både redaktionelt, produktionelt og økonomisk.
Teamet
Du bliver en del af vores engagerede Produktionsplanlægning i TV 2 Sport, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe de bedste rammer - både for vores produktioner og for vores kolleger, der hver dag får live-sport til at lykkes.

Vi arbejder i et miljø med højt tempo og mange samtidige produktioner, hvor planlægning, overblik og samarbejde er afgørende for, at tingene spiller - også når noget ændrer sig undervejs. Samtidig er vi et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og har en uformel tone i hverdagen.

Vi er et team, der:

arbejder struktureret og med høj faglighed

lægger vægt på tydelig kommunikation og forventningsafstemning

tager ansvar for, at både planlægning og samarbejde fungerer i praksis

er nysgerrige på hinandens perspektiver og hjælper hinanden på tværs

Du vil samarbejde bredt på tværs af TV 2 - herunder Produktion, Økonomi, PLAY og Marketing - og med eksterne partnere.
Rollen
Som produktionsleder er din opgave at skabe overblik samt sikre eksekvering og fremdrift i vores produktioner. Du omsætter beslutninger til konkret planlægning og sikrer, at alle ved, hvad der skal ske - og hvem der gør hvad.

Dine primære opgaver er at:

skabe overblik og koordinere produktioner - herunder faciliteter, teknik, rejser og setup

sikre tydelig kommunikation og opfølgning med nøglepersoner

afklare ressourcebehov og koordinere med vagtplan

arbejde med budgetter og økonomi i produktionerne

samle tråde og sikre, at beslutninger bliver ført ud i handling

Primært arbejdssted: Odense (med aktivitet i resten af landet).
Din profil
Vi søger en produktionsleder, der trives med ansvar, samarbejde med mange interessenter og høj kompleksitet - og som motiveres af at få tingene gennemført i praksis.

Du:

har erfaring med planlægning og koordinering af produktioner og events

kommunikerer tydeligt og skaber fremdrift på tværs

arbejder struktureret og følger op på aftaler

arbejder relationelt og er nysgerrig på andre - og anvender det til at skabe godt samarbejde og fremdrift

har god teknisk forståelse

kan omsætte redaktionelle behov og ønsker til konkrete løsninger

har forståelse for økonomi og prioritering af ressourcer

Som person er du proaktiv, løsningsorienteret og god til at skabe overblik - også når der er travlt. Du trives i tæt samarbejde, møder andre med en positiv og nysgerrig tilgang og tager ansvar for, at samarbejdet fungerer i praksis.
Om TV 2 som arbejdsplads
TV 2 er Danmarks kommercielle public service virksomhed. Vores opgave er at begejstre, oplyse og forbinde - at skabe indhold, der samler danskerne på tværs af TV 2 Play, tv2.dk og vores kanaler. Vi er ejet af den danske stat og leverer public service på kommercielle vilkår.

Som moderne virksomhed arbejder vi hver dag for at gøre public service personlig - med målet om at samle alle - en for en i en tid med ændrede medievaner og skarp international konkurrence. Hos os bliver du del af en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, fleksible rammer og respekt i samarbejdet, og vi arbejder målrettet med trivsel, ligestilling og inklusion. Vi har kontorer på Kvægtorvet i Odense og på Teglholmen i København.
Søg stillingen
Stillingen er tidsbegrænset og løber fra 1/10-2026 - 01/09 2027.

Du sender din ansøgning med CV via formularen nedenunder. Vi holder løbende samtaler og lukker stillingen, når den rigtige kandidat er fundet.

Grib muligheden - vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

D’ANGLETERRE IS LOOKING FOR AN EXPERIENCED CHEF FOR OUR ROOM SERVICE KITCHEN

Are you passionate about hospitality & luxury service? Do you have the desire to be part of an ambitious & motivated kitchen team in a privileged environment? 
If so, we would like to hear from you.
We are looking for a kitchen chef with not only a high level of experience but also a dynamic, pragmatic, and flexible approach with a highly developed sense of luxurious service. 

WE OFFER
A professional work environment where we always strive to provide our guests with a personalized, stylish, and elegant experience of international standard. We are a young dynamic team with high ambitions and room for development. We are dedicated to our guests, our colleagues, and our workplace. We offer a healthy work environment & culture where you will work with colleagues from all over the world. Through our internal d’Anglecademy you will be trained in various programs to give you the best possible circumstances for growth and success.

ABOUT THE JOB
As our Room Service Chef, you will primarily be in charge of preparing the dishes from our room service and Lobby menu and ensure that all our guests receive their order in a timely manner and according to their preferences. When time allows, you will also help our Michelin Chefs in various preparations and cooking tasks and therefore be part of creating the Michelin experience for our Marchal Guests. This role offers great opportunity to develop both professional and personal in an environment where no days are alike.

WE EXPECT
You have a passion for cuisine with attention to details, and you can make things happen. You have experience as a chef and strive when working in a fast-paced environment. Most important, you are a team player who will join a committed and motivated team where each member is valued and reliable. Ideally you can start as soon as possible.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (AI-Assisted Testing)

Location: Hangzhou, China

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who we are looking for

State Street is seeking an innovative and technically strong Senior Associate, Agentic Quality Engineering to help design, develop, and operationalize AI Agent capabilities that transform how quality engineering activities are performed across the software delivery lifecycle.

This role will focus on building QA-focused AI Agent skills, developing reusable agent capabilities, creating domain-specific knowledge assets, and enabling project teams to adopt Agentic Engineering practices at scale.

The successful candidate will combine expertise in Quality Engineering with emerging AI technologies to build intelligent solutions that improve productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes.

Why this role is important to us

As State Street accelerates adoption of Agentic AI and AI-assisted software delivery, Quality Engineering is evolving from execution-focused testing into an intelligent, AI-enabled engineering discipline.

This role will help bridge AI innovation and practical delivery by transforming quality engineering knowledge, processes, and best practices into reusable AI agent capabilities that can be leveraged across engineering teams and strategic programs.

You will play a key role in helping define how AI agents are built, evaluated, governed, and successfully adopted within real-world delivery environments.

What you will be responsible for

Agent Skill Development

  • Design and develop reusable AI Agent skills supporting Quality Engineering activities.

  • Transform testing methodologies, quality standards, and engineering practices into executable agent capabilities.

  • Create and maintain agent instructions, prompts, workflows, and knowledge assets.

  • Improve agent reasoning quality, response accuracy, and task execution effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to identify opportunities for agent automation and augmentation.

Agentic Solution Enablement

  • Configure and customize AI agent capabilities to support project delivery needs.

  • Partner with delivery teams to integrate agent solutions into existing SDLC processes.

  • Drive adoption of Agentic Engineering practices across multiple teams and applications.

  • Support implementation of intelligent workflows involving multiple agents and engineering tools.

Knowledge Engineering

  • Develop and curate quality engineering knowledge repositories to improve agent grounding and performance.

  • Structure testing frameworks, standards, playbooks, and best practices into reusable knowledge assets.

  • Continuously improve knowledge quality, discoverability, and governance.

AI Evaluation & Quality Assurance

  • Establish methods to evaluate agent effectiveness, accuracy, reliability, and business value.

  • Validate AI-generated outputs against engineering standards and project requirements.

  • Identify and address quality risks associated with AI-generated content and decisions.

  • Support responsible AI adoption through transparency, traceability, and governance controls.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Explore emerging Agentic AI technologies and industry best practices.

  • Experiment with new agent frameworks, orchestration approaches, and automation opportunities.

  • Contribute to organizational AI strategy and capability development.

  • Share learnings and enable broader adoption across the engineering organization.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong presentation and storytelling abilities

  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new technologies

  • Ability to translate complex AI concepts into practical business solutions

  • Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences

  • Continuous learning mindset and passion for innovation

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or related technical disciplines.

  • Experience working in Agile software delivery environments.

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle and quality engineering practices.

  • Experience Agent Development on Github Copilot/MS Copilot/Google Vertex

Preferred Technical Skills

Experience with several of the following:

  • Generative AI platforms and tools

  • Large Language Models (LLMs)

  • Prompt Engineering

  • Python

  • Knowledge Base Design

  • Workflow Automation

  • API Integration

  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

  • Test Automation Frameworks

Preferred Experience

  • Developing or configuring AI agents for enterprise use cases.

  • Building domain-specific AI skills and reusable automation assets.

  • Applying AI solutions within software delivery or quality engineering environments.

title: Postityöntekijä, Kirkkonummi
description:
We at Posti take care of a smoother flow of everyday life for you, companies and society while building a more sustainable future for us all with a diverse pool of professionals from mail deliverers and warehouse workers to artificial intelligence experts. As a large company, the range of possibilities we offer is huge – also internationally. Overall, we have 13,000 experts across the Nordics and Baltics. Join us to create the future Posti!

Tule postityöntekijäksi Kirkkonummelle!

Postinjakajan työ on vaihtelevaa ja liikkuvaa ulkotyötä. Toimitat kirjeet ja paketit asiakkaille perille saakka ja olet jakelureitilläsi Postin näkyvin edustaja. Jakajamme palvelevat päivittäin lähes kaikkia suomalaisia kotitalouksia ja yrityksiä. Työssä yhdistyvät reipas tekeminen sekä luotettavat ja ystävälliset asiakaskohtaamiset. Työskentelet erilaisilla alueilla, kuten maaseudulla ja taajamissa joten varauduthan liikkumaan myös kerrostalojen portaikoissa.

Tarvittaessa työ voi sisältää myös kuljetusvuoroja, joissa kuljetetaan rullakoita ja paketteja. Aiempi kokemus vastaavanlaisista kuljetustehtävistä katsotaan tällöin eduksi.

Työvälineet: Käytössäsi on Postin auto, joten sinulla tulee olla vähintään kaksi vuotta voimassa ollut B-ajokortti ja kyky ajaa takalaitanostimella varustettua suurempaa pakettiautoa

Työvuorot: Työt sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiville. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen 38,25h/viikko.

Työaika ja työsuhde: Työsuhde on määräaikainen ja työtä on tarjolla 27.9.2026 saakka.

Palkka: 13,14€/tunti (alkaen). Palkka riippuu postialan kokemusvuosista ja tehtävästä ja määräytyy Viestinvälitys- ja logistiikka-alan työehtosopimuksen P-liitteen mukaisesti

Odotamme sinulta

  • Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

  • Reipasta ja itsenäistä työotetta

  • Viihtyvyyttä ulkotyössä säästä riippumatta

  • Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja suomen kielen taitoa

  • B-ajokorttia sekä vähintään kahden vuoden ajokokemusta

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä pääset osaksi yritystä, jonka toiminta vaikuttaa miljoonien ihmisten jokapäiväiseen elämään. Olemme kasvaneet kansainväliseksi logistiikan moniosaajaksi ja toimimme myös Pohjoismaissa ja Baltiassa. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta teknologiaa, ja olemme edelläkävijöitä kestävämmän tulevaisuuden rakentamisessa.

Edistämme monimuotoista ja yhdenvertaista työelämää. Kaikki esihenkilömme käyvät läpi Välittävä johtaja -koulutuksen, ja yhdessä rakennamme välittävää työkulttuuria. Työturvallisuus on meille tärkeä osa jokapäiväistä toimintaamme ja sen jatkuva kehittäminen on myös osoitus siitä, että välitämme.

Tulisitko sinä meidän työkaveriksi? Jätäthän hakemuksesi järjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pikaisesti, mutta viimeistään 17.8.2026 mennessä. Haastattelemme potentiaalisia hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

Arvostamme työyhteisössä monimuotoisuutta, yhdenvertaisuutta ja mukaan ottamista. Toivomme hakijoita erilaisista taustoista, kuten eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

title: Ohjaaja, Sosionomi AMK, Lastenkoti Esko, Lahti
description:
Rohkeus | Sitoutuminen | Luottamus | Vaikuttavuus | Vastuullisuus

SOS-Lapsikylän Perhepalvelut Ruori Oy, on valtakunnallinen lastensuojelu- ja perhetyön asiantuntija vuosikymmenien kokemuksella. Olemme ansainneet yritykselle Yhteiskunnallinen Yritys- sekä Avainlippu-merkit, koska teemme yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellistä ja vaikuttavaa työtä. Tervetuloa mukaan!

Haemme nyt Perhepalvelut Ruorin lastenkoti Eskoon yhtä

OHJAAJAA, vakituiseen työsuhteeseen 1.9.2026 lähtien tai sopimuksen mukaan

Esko on lastensuojelun laadukasta palvelua tarjoava erityistason laitosyksikkö 12–17-vuotiaille lapsille ja nuorille. Yksikössä pyritään elämään normaalia ja turvallista arkea, jota rytmittävät asiakkaiden henkilökohtaiset viikkosuunnitelmat. Yksikkö on erikoistunut työskentelemään päihteillä ja psyykkisesti oireilevien lasten kanssa. Yksikössä lapselle tarjotaan vahvaa aikuisen tukea. Omaohjaajatyö on tärkeä osa yksikön kuntouttavaa arkea. Ohjaajat rakentavat lapsen kanssa turvallista vuorovaikutussuhdetta, jossa on mahdollisuus jakaa omia ajatuksiaan ja toiveitaan.

Tietoa tehtävästä

Ohjaajan tehtävässä olet tärkeässä roolissa osana moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Työtehtäviin kuuluu nuoren omaohjaajuuden prosessista vastaaminen yhdessä omaohjaajaparin sekä muun työryhmän kanssa. Omaohjaajuuteen sisältyy nuoren hoito- ja kasvatussuunnitelman laatiminen yhteistyössä verkoston kanssa ja sen toteuttaminen arjessa, nuoren kokonaistilanteen arviointi erilaisten kartoitusten ja keskusteluiden avulla sekä saadun tiedon raportointi työryhmälle ja muulle verkostolle. Lisäksi työhön kuuluu yhteisön arjen tehtävien ohjaamista ja nuorten rinnalla kulkemista

Tehtävässä noudatetaan jaksotyöaikaa (115 h/3vk) ja se sisältää myös ilta-, yö- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Mahdollisuus paikallisen sopimuksen avulla tehdä pitkiä vuoroja.

Mitä me haemme?

Tehtävä edellyttää sosiaalialan korkeakoulututkintoa. Odotamme sinulta hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä kohdata kaikki ihmiset, niin lapset kuin aikuisetkin, kunnioittavasti ja ystävällisesti. Tehtävässä pitää kyetä toimimaan lapsilähtöisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti.

Arvostamme psykiatrista ja lastensuojelun kokemusta ja esim. nepsy-, trauma-, perhetyö- ja päihdetyöosaamista. Työ edellyttää ajokorttia ja hygieniapassia. Eduksi katsomme myös käydyn lääkehoidon koulutuksen.

Mitä me tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen, vastuullisen ja innostavan työn uudistuvassa ja kasvavassa lastensuojelun asiantuntijaorganisaatiossa. Pääset osaksi noin 300 työntekijän muodostamaa SOS-Lapsikylän Ruoria, jossa työn keskiössä on aina lapsen paras. Meillä on kannustava ja kehitysmyönteinen työilmapiiri ja tuemme työntekijöidemme ammatillista kehittymistä.

Työmme laatu on meille tärkeää ja panostamme siihen myös johtamisessa ja perehdytyksessä. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme työterveyshuollon Heltissä, toiveitasi huomioivan työvuorosuunnittelun, säännöllisen työnohjauksen, yhteiset kehittämis- ja työhyvinvointipäivät, Epassi-edun sekä vapaa-ajan vakuutuksen. Eskon arjessa työskentelet tiiviisti yhdessä lähiesihenkilön kanssa ja esihenkilöt panostavat arjen henkilöstöjohtamiseen.

Lisätietoja:

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Eskon vastaava ohjaaja Roni Ylönen, p. 0503417229, roni.ylonen@perhepalvelutruori.fi tai yksikön johtaja Minna Juopperi, p. 044 793 7963, minna.juopperi@perhepalvelutruori.fi. Hae tehtävää 23.8.2026 mennessä verkkosivuillamme osoitteessa https://perhepalvelutruori.rekrytointi.com/paikat/?o=A_A&jid=73 . Hakulomake löytyy sivun alaosasta. Haastattelemme hakijoita myös hakuajalla ja tehtävät pyritään täyttämään heti sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä, joten toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian!

Tehtävään valittavan tulee esittää rikosrekisteriote: Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002.

Perhepalvelut Ruori Oy

Perhepalvelut Ruori Oy on SOS-Lapsikylän kokonaan omistama lastensuojelupalveluita tuottava yhteiskunnallinen yritys, jolla on useiden vuosikymmenien vaikuttava historia Suomessa. Ruorin toiminnan tuotot ohjataan SOS-Lapsikylän kautta yhteiskunnallisen hyvän, lasten ja perheiden hyväksi.

title: Sælger til JYSK Tåstrup
description:
OM JYSK

Vi tror på, at vores medarbejdere er nøglen til vores succes. Derfor stræber vi efter at tilbyde udvikling og muligheder på alle niveauer. Siden vores grundlægger, Lars Larsen, åbnede sin første butik i Danmark i 1979, har JYSK udvidet sin globale tilstedeværelse med butikker og webshops i lande over hele verden.

Vores tre grundlæggende værdier i JYSK – Købmand, Kollega og Korpsånd – udtrykker den adfærd og holdning, vi kan forvente af hinanden. Vi har tillid til hinanden og tror på empowerment og frihed under ansvar. Vi sætter også en ære i at belønne engagement og en stor indsats blandt vores medarbejdere. Med den rette indstilling er mulighederne i JYSK mange.

JYSK ønsker at inkludere alle uanset alder, køn, race, seksuel orientering, fysiske og psykiske handicaps, etnicitet og erfaring. Sammen sikrer vi en inkluderende kultur, der opmuntrer, støtter og hylder vores medarbejders forskelligheder. Vi tror på, at sammensætningen af vores unikke personligheder og talenter gør os til et stærkere team.

title: SPRZEDAWCA  / SPRZEDAWCZYNI JYSK Racibórz (5200 PLN)
description:
Odkryj inny wymiar pracy w handlu. Dołącz do JYSK!

Szukasz pracy, w której dużo się dzieje, ludzie grają do jednej bramki, a Twoje pomysły naprawdę mają znaczenie? Lubisz działać i wspólnie osiągać cele? Chcesz się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i szybko brać na siebie kolejne wyzwania?

Świetnie - być może właśnie na Ciebie czekamy!

CO NA CIEBIE CZEKA?

  • Możliwości rozwoju i jasne ścieżki kariery. Dowiedz się więcej tutaj.
  • Wynagrodzenie i premie powiązane z efektami Twojej pracy oraz wynikami zespołu.
  • Konkursy sprzedażowe i dodatkowe akcje z atrakcyjnymi nagrodami.
  • Elastyczny grafik i zespół, który wie, że poza pracą też jest życie.
  • 20% rabatu pracowniczego na zakup produktów we wszystkich sklepach JYSK i spółkach Lars Larsen Group - również na produkty objęte promocją.
  • Atrakcyjne benefity, m.in.: prywatna opieka medyczna, finansowe świadczenia świąteczne, karta Multisport, wspólne integracje i wydarzenia.
  • Stabilne miejsce pracy, w firmie o skandynawskiej kulturze organizacyjnej, opartej na współpracy i wzajemnym szacunku.
  • Nagrody jubileuszowe - doceniamy osoby, które rozwijają się razem z nami.

CZYM BEDZIESZ SIĘ ZAJMOWAĆ?

  • Obsługa klientów z wykorzystaniem wiedzy o produktach.
  • Wspólna realizacją celów sprzedażowych i budowanie wyników wraz z zespołem.
  • Dbanie o spójny, atrakcyjny wyglądu sklepu.
  • Praca operacyjna z zespołem - dostawy, towarowanie, organizacja sklepu.

SZUKAMY OSÓB, KTÓRE:

  • są zorientowane na sprzedaż, realizację wyników oraz wysoką jakość obsługi klienta,
  • budują pozytywne relacje, są otwarte na współpracę i dobrze odnajdują się w pracy z ludźmi,
  • potrafią wspierać i rozwijać zespół poprzez komunikację, feedback i codzienne zaangażowanie,
  • wykazują inicjatywę i energię do działania,
  • dobrze odnajdują się środowisku, w którym dużo się dzieje i jest wiele wyzwań,
  • mają gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach otwarcia sklepu, w tym w soboty oraz niedziele handlowe,
  • cenią różnorodność, elastyczność w wykonywanych zadaniach.

Poznaj jednego z naszych Sprzedawców i dowiedz się, jakim pracodawcą jesteśmy tutaj.

UWAŻASZ, ŻE TO PRACA WŁAŚNIE DLA CIEBIE? Aplikuj już dziś!

O NAS

W JYSK ludzie są w centrum wszystkiego, co robimy. To ich energia, zaangażowanie i współpraca napędzają nasz rozwój. Dlatego tworzymy środowisko, w którym można się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i budować swoją ścieżkę kariery krok po kroku, w swoim tempie.
Nasza historia sięga 1979 roku, kiedy Lars Larsen otworzył pierwszy sklep w Danii. Od tego czasu rozwinęliśmy się w międzynarodową sieć obecna w wielu krajach, w tym w Polsce, gdzie mamy już ponad 340 sklepów oraz nowoczesne centrum dystrybucji, które wspiera sprawne funkcjonowanie całej sieci. Rozwijamy zarówno sprzedaż stacjonarną, jak i kanały online, pozostając blisko klientów i ich codziennych potrzeb.
Naszą kulturę definiują trzy wartości: Kupiec, Kolega i Duch Firmy. Przekładają się one na codzienną pracę: odpowiedzialność za wyniki, współpracę w zespole oraz zaangażowanie.
W JYSK stawiamy na środowisko oparte na zaufaniu, szacunku i rozwoju. Wspieramy się nawzajem i dajemy przestrzeń do nauki, niezależnie od miejsca startu.
Jesteśmy organizacją otwartą na różnorodność. Cenimy ludzi bez względu na wiek, tożsamość płciową, orientację seksualną, sprawność, pochodzenie, doświadczenie czy sposób myślenia. Wierzymy, że różne perspektywy, talenty i doświadczenia wzmacniają nasze zespoły i pozwalają nam działać lepiej każdego dnia.

Chcesz uzyskać więcej informacji, odwiedź naszą stronę kariera JYSK.

Dowiedz się, w jaki sposób przetwarzamy Twoje dane osobowe w naszej Polityce Prywatności.

Job Description

ABOUT WOLTERS KLUWER Wolters Kluwer N.V. (AEX: WKL) is a global leader in information services and solutions for professionals in the health, tax and accounting, risk and compliance, finance and legal sectors. We help our customers make critical decisions every day by providing expert solutions that combine deep domain knowledge with specialized technology and services. Wolters Kluwer reported 2023 annual revenues of €5.6 billion. The company, headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, serves customers in over 180 countries, maintains operations in over 40 countries and employs 23,000+ people worldwide. For more information about our solutions and organization, visit www.wolterskluwer.com, follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Wolters Kluwer U. S. Corporation and all of its subsidiaries, divisions, and customer/business units is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Job Description:

Associate Director (Data Science and AI Platform Intelligence) Financial & Corporate Compliance (FCC) is a division of Wolters Kluwer that provides a broad spectrum of solutions, services and expertise to legal, finance, risk and compliance professionals and small business owners to help manage myriad governance, risk and compliance challenges in dynamic markets and regulatory environments, globally. FCC Solutions serves more than 350,000 customers in more than 150 countries, including 70% of Fortune 500 companies, 92% of the world's top banks, 90% of the Am Law 100 and more than 300,000 small businesses. The division has a global footprint, with workforce in 28 countries. Our clients include corporate legal departments, insurers, small businesses, financial services companies, brand professionals, underwriters, governments and compliance and risk professionals Role: Associate Director – Data Science and AI Platform Intelligence is responsible for ensuring the delivery, quality, and impact of data science, analytics, and AI capabilities across diverse products and platforms. This role emphasizes leveraging data-driven strategies to enhance operational efficiency, inform strategic decision-making, and position the Data and Analytics (DnA) organization for sustained growth and competitive advantage. We are looking for an AI leader to drive Platform Intelligence and AI-enabled structured data capabilities across enterprise platforms. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science, Product Management, and Domain Intelligence, responsible for shaping content to transform regulatory, customer, and market requirements into scalable, machine-first solutions that drive innovation and excellence across the organization. Primary

Accountabilities:
•Lead the development of intelligent frameworks and architectures that integrate data science, AI, and ML, enhancing overall product capabilities.
•Create advanced, cloud-based systems for classifying content using AI/ML techniques, improving discoverability and standardization across products.
•Oversee governance of the content lifecycle, ensuring consistency and mapping integrity across platforms through data-driven insights.
•Collaborate with product leadership to embed AI-driven content intelligence into the product roadmap and align it with business objectives.
•Implement AI and ML methods for enriching metadata and improving content classification, transforming raw data into actionable insights.
•Utilize cloud-based tools to streamline workflows for content ingestion, validation, enrichment, and delivery, ensuring scalability and efficiency.
•Serve as a strategic liaison between product teams, data science, engineering, and domain experts to align technical execution with business goals.
•Develop and apply agentic AI frameworks that empower autonomous decision-making within products, enhancing user engagement and experience.
•Mentor and lead ops support and enablement teams, fostering skills in product design, structured content modeling, and the execution of AI-driven workflows for high-quality outcomes for DnA organization.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university or equivalent working experience.
• Master's degree from an accredited college or university preferred
• 15+ years in product, engineering, or technical leadership
• Superior engineering/architecture fluency
• Systems thinking and ability to scale product quality in AI Driven workflows
• Exceptional abilities in operating and managing complex/matrix team structures

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: Portfolio Solutions Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Portfolio Solutions Specialist to join our team. This will be a hybrid role based in O’Fallon, MO, Chicago, IL, Alpharetta, GA or New York, NY.

Your Team

Join our dynamic Portfolio Solutions team in North America, where we manage and oversee complex delegated authority portfolios across multiple lines of business. Our team partners closely with underwriting, operations, finance, legal, compliance, and reinsurance stakeholders to support the onboarding, governance, monitoring, and profitability oversight of sophisticated MGA programs.

We are focused on building scalable operational frameworks, delivering executive-level portfolio insights, and supporting the continued growth of complex delegated authority business across North America.

The Impact You Will Have

Reporting to the Regional Head of Portfolio Solutions and Delegated Authority in North America, this role will play a critical role in supporting highly complex, multi-line delegated authority programs.

This position is responsible for supporting onboarding activities, monitoring portfolio performance, managing operational timelines and governance requirements, and assisting with executive-level reporting and profitability oversight.

The ideal candidate brings strong project management capability, delegated authority experience, operational discipline, and an understanding of underwriting operations, portfolio monitoring, and risk mitigation concepts.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include

Complex Program & Portfolio Oversight

  • Support onboarding and ongoing management of highly complex delegated authority facilities across multiple lines of business
  • Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across internal and external stakeholders
  • Monitor onboarding progress, operational readiness, and governance requirements for new MGA facilities
  • Track portfolio activity, performance metrics, and operational milestones across assigned programs

Portfolio Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Support ongoing monitoring of portfolio profitability, premium activity, claims trends, and operational performance
  • Assist with development of executive-level reporting and portfolio dashboards
  • Identify emerging concerns, operational gaps, or reporting inconsistencies and escalate appropriately

Stakeholder & Compliance Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with underwriting, operations, finance, legal, compliance, claims, and external
  • MGA partners
  • Drive follow-up actions and maintain accountability across multiple stakeholders
  • Support collection and tracking of compliance requirements, due diligence items, onboarding materials, and governance documentation

Operational Coordination

  • Support coordination of bordereaux submissions and operational reporting processes
  • Partner with operations and data teams to support booking and reporting activities
  • Help manage evolving operational complexities across multi-line facilities

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 5–7+ years of insurance industry experience
  • Strong understanding of delegated authority structures and MGA/carrier relationships
  • Understanding of underwriting operations, portfolio monitoring, and risk mitigation concepts
  • Experience supporting complex, multi-line insurance programs preferred
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating across underwriting, operations, compliance, finance, and external partners
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
  • Excel and reporting experience preferred
  • Ability to utilize AI tools to support day-to-day tasks, improve efficiency, and contribute to data-driven decision-making.

The annualized base pay range for this role is $78,909 to $119,255 for O’Fallon, MO, $ 107,913 - $132,236 for Chicago & Alpharetta and $101,364 - $153,200 for New York. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

title: Operations - Client Account Services - Associate
description:
Help clients start strong in global custody by making onboarding smooth, accurate, and on time. You’ll play a key role in converting new and incremental wins into live, operating custody accounts. You’ll work closely with partners across relationship coverage, client service, onboarding, transitions, and local market agents. If you enjoy operational ownership, problem-solving, and stakeholder management, you’ll find meaningful impact and growth here. Your work will directly support client satisfaction, risk management, and scalable service delivery.

As a Client Account Services Associate in Client Account Services, you execute custody account openings and coordinate market documentation to enable new and expanding client relationships. You’ll capture business requirements, manage timelines and dependencies, and ensure high-quality setup across systems and local market partners. You’ll help identify and resolve issues early to keep deliverables on track and aligned to agreed service levels. You’ll also contribute to reporting and continuous improvement that strengthens execution, controls, and client experience.

We support clients across Australia, New Zealand, and Asia (excluding Japan) through account opening, documentation coordination, and change activity such as restructures, launches, transitions, and exits. Priorities can shift with client activity, so you’ll work in a flexible team environment that values clear communication, strong execution discipline, and continuous improvement.

Job responsibilities

  • Coordinate and govern the set-up of custody account openings for new and incremental business, ensuring accurate setup and timely completion
  • Coordinate market and tax documentation requirements to support account activation across relevant jurisdictions
  • Partner with relationship coverage, client service, onboarding, and transitions teams to confirm requirements and deliver to agreed service levels
  • Liaise with local agents and service providers to progress documentation, clarify requirements, and resolve blockers
  • Track milestones, dependencies, and timelines to keep work progressing and stakeholders aligned
  • Respond to account opening and documentation inquiries with clear, solution-oriented communication
  • Update account reference data to maintain high data quality and operational readiness
  • Maintain procedure documentation to reflect current processes and control expectations
  • Identify risks, issues, and process gaps early, escalating appropriately and proposing practical improvements
  • Contribute to reporting on key performance indicators and key risk indicators for stakeholders and leaders

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 5 years of experience in global custody, fund services, or securities services operations with direct account opening exposure
  • Demonstrated knowledge of custody account structures and market documentation requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent requests with competing deadlines and changing priorities
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including clear written and verbal communication with senior internal and external partners
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational risk, investigate issues, and drive timely resolution
  • Experience tracking service level commitments and delivering work to agreed timelines and quality standards
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience coordinating onboarding activities across Australia, New Zealand, and Asia (excluding Japan) markets
  • Familiarity with custody account opening workflows, controls, and documentation standards across omnibus and segregated models
  • Proficiency using AI and generative AI tools to improve business processes while adhering to data privacy, risk, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with local agents and third-party service providers to progress documentation and resolve exceptions
  • Experience contributing to operational reporting, including defining and improving key performance and risk indicators
  • Exposure to custody platforms or account opening tools used in large financial institutions

title: Revenue and Receivables Officer
description:
Transform lives, every single day

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, support and strategy to make it happen. We’re a respected not-for-profit that has been serving those in need for more than 170 years.

Every year, we help thousands of people through aged care, community services and mission programs. Join Anglicare's Finance Operations team and play a key role in ensuring accurate revenue processing, outstanding customer service and strong financial controls that support our aged care and community services.

Be welcomed into a compassionate, respectful and purpose-driven team where we don't just talk about values—we live them.

Your Opportunity

As our Revenue and Receivables Officer, you will support the delivery of accurate, timely and compliant end-to-end revenue and receivables processes. Working closely with residents, clients, families, operational leaders and internal stakeholders, you'll help manage client accounts, process payments and fees, support debtor management activities and contribute to a positive customer experience.

This is an excellent opportunity for an accounts receivable professional who enjoys working in a collaborative environment where attention to detail, customer focus and teamwork are highly valued.

With integrity and resilience, you will:

  • Manage client and resident account administration, including account setups, fee adjustments, transfers and departures.

  • Process receipting, fee generation and account transactions accurately and within required timeframes.

  • Monitor accounts, investigate discrepancies and assist with resolving outstanding account issues.

  • Support debtor follow-up activities and contribute to the reduction of aged debt in line with Anglicare policies.

  • Assist with month-end and year-end processing, reconciliations and reporting while maintaining compliance with legislative and organisational requirements.

  • Deliver responsive, high-quality service to residents, clients, families and internal stakeholders.

What you'll bring

You are a customer-focused finance professional who prides yourself on accuracy, organisation and delivering outstanding service. You enjoy building positive relationships, solving problems and working collaboratively to achieve team goals.

You also share our values of Integrity, Justice, Compassion and Excellence and demonstrate them in the way you work every day.

You will also need:

  • Previous experience in accounts receivable, invoicing, billing, client account management or a similar finance-related role.

  • A minimum of 2 years' relevant experience.

  • Intermediate Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when processing financial transactions and reconciliations.

  • Sound understanding of accounts receivable processes and debtor management.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage professionally with residents, clients, families and internal stakeholders.

Ideally, you will also have:

  • Experience working in aged care, health, community services or a large, complex organisation.

  • Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures and compliance requirements.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate and resolve account discrepancies.

  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues during busy periods.

Why Anglicare?

For 170 years Anglicare has been serving those in need - providing care to older people and services to the vulnerable. Today we employ 6,000 staff and are blessed to serve alongside 1,500 volunteers. We provide meaningful opportunities and choice, both for the individuals and communities we support and the dedicated people here who make it happen.

At Anglicare, you’ll get the security, stability and opportunities that come with a strong, well-established organisation that’s ready for the future. You’ll belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds. You will also be supported to gain new knowledge, deepen your experience and expertise, and shape a rewarding career.

On top of that, here are just some of the tangible benefits you will enjoy in a career with us:

  • Flexible work options to get the most out of work and life

  • Increase your take-home pay with salary packaging

  • Ongoing professional development and leadership training to advance your career

  • Exclusive discounts to over 400 retailers

  • Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport with discounts to over 800 gyms for you and your family

Are you ready for a career that means more?

To apply for this role, please click the ‘Apply’ button. All applicants will receive a response.

Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While we are guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others, and we value the diverse perspectives they bring.

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds.

Disclaimer: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Application Close Date: September 06, 2026

title: Solutions Architecture Vice President
description:
Solutions Architecture, Vice President

Location: Irvine, California

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who we are looking for

The Vice President, Solutions Architecture for IMS West is a senior technology leadership role responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end technology architecture strategy supporting IMS West applications, platforms, infrastructure, and client-facing capabilities. This individual serves as the primary architecture leader across strategic initiatives, modernization programs, operational resiliency efforts, client remediation programs, cloud transformation, and regulatory-driven technology change.

The role partners closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Production Management, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Business Leadership, and external strategic clients to ensure technology solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, supportable, and aligned with business objectives.

The VP, Solutions Architecture provides technical leadership across the full application and infrastructure lifecycle while driving modernization, simplification, platform standardization, cloud adoption, observability, automation, and control maturity

What you will be responsible for

Architecture Strategy & Governance

  • Define and maintain the IMS West technology architecture roadmap aligned with business, operational, and regulatory priorities.

  • Establish target-state architectures spanning applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, integration, networking, security, and operational tooling.

  • Serve as the lead architecture authority for IMS West modernization and transformation initiatives.

  • Ensure compliance with State Street architecture standards, governance frameworks, and enterprise technology principles.

  • Lead architecture reviews, design councils, and governance forums for strategic technology investments.

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, HEAT, and Architecture Review Boards to drive solution approvals and risk management.

Solution Design Leadership

  • Provide end-to-end architecture leadership for complex business, client, operational, and infrastructure initiatives.

  • Develop architecture patterns, reference architectures, technical standards, and reusable design frameworks.

  • Review and approve solution designs for strategic programs, large-scale changes, and high-risk implementations.

  • Ensure architecture decisions appropriately balance resiliency, performance, cost, supportability, security, and speed to market.

  • Drive application rationalization and platform simplification initiatives.

IMSW Modernization & Transformation

  • Lead architecture efforts supporting:

    • Cloud migrations and cloud-native adoption

    • Data center exit and infrastructure modernization initiatives

    • Application modernization programs

    • Technical debt reduction

    • Platform consolidation efforts

    • Automation and observability programs

    • Operational resilience initiatives

  • Define strategic technology direction for critical IMS West applications and supporting services.

Operational Resilience & Risk Management

  • Partner with Production Management and Engineering leaders to strengthen system resiliency.

  • Drive architecture improvements that reduce operational risk and eliminate single points of failure.

  • Incorporate lessons learned from incidents, outages, audit findings, and regulatory reviews into future-state designs.

  • Ensure architecture solutions support recoverability, monitoring, observability, availability, and cyber resiliency objectives.

  • Support internal audit, regulatory, and control remediation initiatives.

Client & Business Engagement

  • Work directly with executive business stakeholders and strategic clients to translate business requirements into technology solutions.

  • Support client-facing technology discussions, architecture reviews, remediation programs, and transformation initiatives.

  • Provide executive-level communication regarding architecture strategy, risks, dependencies, and investment priorities.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leadership.

Engineering Partnership & Delivery Enablement

  • Partner with engineering and delivery teams to ensure architecture designs are effectively implemented.

  • Guide development teams on architecture best practices and engineering standards.

  • Drive adoption of automation, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, AI-enabled operations, and modern engineering practices.

  • Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across the IMS West organization.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of solution architects and technical specialists.

  • Establish architecture operating model, governance processes, and design review practices.

  • Build organizational architecture capability across IMS West.

  • Influence senior leaders across GTS, IMSW, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Engineering organizations.

  • Create an architecture culture focused on innovation, simplification, resiliency, and operational excellence.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of solution architects and technical specialists.

  • Establish architecture operating model, governance processes, and design review practices.

  • Build organizational architecture capability across IMS West.

  • Influence senior leaders across GTS, IMSW, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Engineering organizations.

  • Create an architecture culture focused on innovation, simplification, resiliency, and operational excellence.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

12+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.

  • 5+ years in architecture leadership, chief architect, enterprise architect, or solutions architecture roles.

  • Experience leading architecture for large-scale financial services or regulated environments.

  • Proven track record delivering enterprise modernization and transformation programs.

  • Strong experience with mission-critical production environments and operational risk management.

Technical Expertise

  • Enterprise Architecture

  • Cloud Architecture (AWS preferred)

  • Distributed Systems Design

  • API and Integration Architecture

  • Infrastructure and Platform Architecture

  • Cybersecurity Architecture

  • Data Architecture

  • Resiliency and Disaster Recovery

  • Observability and Monitoring Platforms

  • DevSecOps and CI/CD

  • Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Technology Governance and Architecture Review Processes

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking

  • Executive Presence

  • Client Relationship Management

  • Influencing Across Matrix Organizations

  • Risk-Based Decision Making

  • Organizational Leadership

  • Communication and Storytelling

  • Change Leadership

Success Measures

The VP, Solutions Architecture will be measured on:

  • Reduction of architecture-related operational risk

  • Modernization and simplification progress

  • Technology debt reduction

  • System resiliency improvements

  • Cloud transformation outcomes

  • Architecture governance effectiveness

  • Delivery quality and implementation success

  • Control and audit maturity

  • Client satisfaction and stakeholder confidence

  • Engineering productivity and platform adoption

Salary Range:

$125,000 - $226,250 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Director, Core Infrastructure Engineering
description:
Director, Core Infrastructure Engineering

Location: BENGALURU, KARNATAKA, India

Leads a multple teams to implement strategies for the architecture and delivery of interdependent, scalable distributed systems that meet organizational and customer demands. Orchestrates cross-group optimization for high‑throughput, large‑scale data processing; aligns stakeholders on scalability requirements; and oversees elastic designs and effective use of data plane platforms. Provides strategic oversight for fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable architectures, sets direction for partition‑aware design choices, and leads initiatives to harden networks via load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting. Establishes expectations for formal verification and peer reviews, and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across the department. Drives KPI and telemetry strategies; directs creation of complex dashboards and alerting for proactive health assurance; and ensures functional/correctness validation, data replication, and synchronization meet organizational needs. Guides organization‑wide incident management and operational readiness, eliminating customer maintenance windows and ensuring consistent SOPs. Provides strategic security guidance (encryption, access controls), oversees remediation and compliance documentation, and sponsors automation (IaC) and change‑management alignment so systems can be safely patched, updated, and rolled back at scale.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
