title: Wealth Advisor - PNC Wealth Management
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Wealth Advisor in PNC Wealth Management, you will be based in Illinois.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Consults on investment and insurance strategies, as well as the development of financial plans for clients. Grows and retains an investment and insurance book of business. Owns the client experience, efficiently handling sales and service, identifying sales and/or executing opportunities and making referrals to internal business partners as appropriate.
  • Acquires, expands and maintains client relationships through business development and client networking. Grows client loyalty and share of wallet through an exceptional client experience. Applies product and procedural knowledge to solve client problems appropriately and efficiently.
  • Develops and implements investment and insurance strategies for clients. Determines the best products to support such strategies. Presents sound financial recommendations and guidance to clients. Establishes individual financial plans based on client financial needs and objectives. Monitors financial plans and recommends changes as needed.
  • Actively and regularly coaches and educates internal business partners to identify investment opportunities. Drives investment education and visibility among internal business partners. Shows urgency with activities and leads by example. Has regular and effective communication with internal and external partners to build strong relationships that drive referral activity.
  • Regularly meets with internal business partners to communicate and review business results and pipeline management. Meets service level agreements on lead and referral follow up. Adheres to all applicable laws, regulations, policies and guidelines.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Preferred Skills

Client Prospecting, Client Relationship Building, Credit Risk Analysis, Customer Engagement, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Investment Banking, Public Speaking, Relationship Building, Relationship Management

Coaching Others, Customer Experience Management., Customer Retention, Effective Communications, Interpersonal Relationships, Managing Multiple Priorities, Prospecting., Sales Tasks And Activities, Selling.

title: Senior Scientist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Department Lead


Your role and responsibilities:

You will be a member of the ABB India Corporate Research Center (INCRC), at the ABB Innovation Center (AIC) located in Bangalore, India. INCRC researchers perform high-end research on diverse topics to develop cutting-edge technologies for ABB’s global businesses to propel the organization towards a productive and sustainable future. We collaborate with other ABB corporate research centers, R&D units, and academic institutes. The position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, global, and creative environment, collaborating with a wide range of experience and expertise. You will work in applied research projects, developing innovative Control and Artificial Intelligence technologies toward building intelligent autonomous systems for the Industry, Transport, and Infrastructure sectors.


The work model for the role is Onsite


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Requirements gathering and identification of use cases to aim towards fully autonomous process plants, and minimizing expert interventions in designing, deploying, and maintaining advanced control applications

  • Evaluation of the state-of-the-art Control and Artificial Intelligence approaches and/ or development of a new approach for identified use cases.

  • Development of a proof of concept, prototypes, and support in pilot evaluation and productization of solutions.

  • Contribute to building and managing the laboratory setup for experimental research

  • Communication of project results to Technical experts and Management.

  • Creation of Intellectual property (invention disclosures) and publications in scientific journals and conferences.

  • Travel to customer sites and ABB locations on a need basis.


Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Ph.D. in Chemical/ Control/ Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Mechanical engineering with a strong publication and patent record, with a minimum of 7 years of experience; industrial research experience is preferred.

  • Experience in the development of model-based or model-free controllers, such as Model Predictive Control, Approximate Dynamic Programming, and Reinforcement Learning

  • Knowledge of operation and control in the process industry e.g., Oil and Gas, Pulp and Paper, Metals, etc, is preferred.

  • Good knowledge of Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Supervised and unsupervised learning, Multivariate statistics, Time-series analysis, Signal Processing, and related areas.

  • Experience in the usage of Machine learning for the development of predictive maintenance, diagnosis, and monitoring solutions.

  • Proficiency in Matlab and Python programming languages.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English with internal and external partners, including the academic community.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Senior BD Manager – Security Risk Consulting
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes has an exciting opportunity for a commercially driven and technically credible Senior BD Manager – Security Risk Consulting to join our Middle East Security team. The role will be technically competent and will lead market development and opportunity conversion for our Security Risk Consulting services, while supporting selected project delivery and mobilisation activities.

This is a Business development led position requiring strong security consulting credibility , rather than a generalist sales role. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of security risk consulting and operational security with sufficient knowledge of physical and electronic security design to recognise client needs, shape appropriate solutions and engage credibly with senior stakeholders.

The role is expected to devote approximately 70–80% of time to business development, client engagement and responses to opportunities, with a primary focus on Security Risk Consulting identifying and supporting opportunities across the wider security service. The remaining time will normally support project delivery, particularly security risk assessments, strategies, operational reviews and the early mobilisation of newly awarded commissions. The balance may vary in response to market and project demands.

Based in Riyadh , Saudi Arabia, the position reports to the Regional Security Director – Middle East& India and will work closely with the Head of Security Risk Consulting – Middle East, the wider security team, regional business development colleagues and relevant Jensen Hughes specialists and although based in KSA, the role will cover the overall Middle East region.

Role Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Growth (typically 70–80%)

  • Develop and execute a focused market plan for Security Risk Consulting, while identifying opportunities for the wider security service aligned with Jensen Hughes capabilities, aligned with regional growth priorities ,agreed revenue objectives and the wider Jensen Hughes service offerings.
  • Identify, qualify and develop leads across government and quasi-government entities, major developers and operators, critical infrastructure, financial services, hospitality, transportation, ports and logistics, facilities management and other priority sectors.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, security leaders, risk and resilience teams, operators and strategic partners.
  • Maintain a qualified opportunity pipeline, capturing plans and accurate records within the company’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system; providing clear monthly reporting on activity, progress, conversion, risks and required support.
  • Lead or coordinate client meetings, capability presentations, workshops, market briefings and targeted thought-leadership activities that generate credible follow-on opportunities .
  • Shape clear, commercially viable service offerings, including fixed-scope and tailored solutions covering security, threat and risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, security strategies ,security and resilience reviews , operational security audits, protective security reviews , crisis and emergency management frameworks, procedures, training, exercises and implementation support.
  • Lead responses to expressions of interest, pre-qualifications, requests for proposals and direct client enquiries, preparing or coordinating technically accurate methodologies, scopes, programmes, resource plans, assumptions, exclusions, deliverables and fee inputs.
  • Collaborate across security risk consulting, security design, fire and life safety, resilience and other specialist teams to develop integrated solutions.

Technical Consulting and Project Mobilisation (typically 20–30%)

  • Support or lead selected assignments within the candidate’s competence, particularly security threat and risk assessments, vulnerability assessments , security strategies, operational and protective security reviews, policy and procedure development, crisis and emergency preparedness, workshops, training and exercises.
  • When newly awarded work cannot immediately be transferred to the full delivery team, establish and mobilise the commission by confirming scope, programme, information requirements, stakeholder interfaces, resourcing and quality controls.
  • Where required, act as the initial project lead, facilitate kick-off activities and progress early deliverables until the designated project team is in place and an orderly, documented handover has been completed.
  • Provide practical advice across operational, physical and technology security controls, drawing in appropriately qualified specialists for matters outside the role’s direct competence.
  • Undertake client and site engagements across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East region, including workshops, assessments, presentations and senior stakeholder briefings.
  • Prepare concise, evidence-based reports and recommendations that are proportionate to the client’s risk, operating environment, applicable requirements and capacity for implementation.
  • Contribute lessons learned, reusable methods, proposal content, fee benchmarks and market insight to strengthen the consistency and scalability of the regional Security Risk Consulting offering.

Role Requirements

  • Minimum 7 years’ experience in Business Development - security risk management, operational security, resilience or security consulting, including substantial senior client facing advisory and/or consultancy experience, along with a bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of professional qualifications and senior-level experience.
  • Proven success in identifying, shaping, proposing and winning professional security risk consulting work.
  • Strong knowledge of Security Threat and Risk Assessment (STRA),vulnerability assessment , security strategy, operational and protective security audits and reviews, governance, crisis and emergency planning, training and exercises.
  • Working knowledge of physical protection, electronic security systems and security design principles.
  • Strong understanding of the Saudi Arabian market, client environment and stakeholder landscape, supported by relevant experience and a credible professional network.
  • Strong Client Management skills and Business Development Client facing and work winning mindset Established set of Contacts an advantage but not essential
  • Professional fluency in English is required, Arabic language capability is highly desirable, with strong proposal writing, reporting, presentation, facilitation and negotiation skills.
  • Sound commercial judgement, including the ability to develop realistic scopes, resource plans and fee inputs and ability to identify delivery or contractual risks.
  • Dynamic, self-motivated and collaborative, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and travel regularly across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East.

Why You Should Join Jensen Hughes

  • You will have the opportunity to build a strategically important Security Risk Consulting offering while supporting the wider growth of our security business in one of the region’s most active and influential markets.
  • You will work directly with senior clients and market-leading organizations, supported by an established international consultancy and security specialists across the Middle East and wider Jensen Hughes network.
  • The role offers genuine ownership of market development while retaining meaningful involvement in technically interesting client work.
  • Career progression opportunities through a well-defined development framework that outlines expectations, growth pathways, and promotion criteria.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Kiwibot:

Kiwibot is at the forefront of robotic delivery solutions, transforming urban logistics with autonomous technology. Our mission is to make last-mile delivery efficient, sustainable, and accessible. We are a data-driven company, and our Data Team is crucial to our success, enabling intelligent decision-making, optimizing robot performance, and supporting our rapid growth.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our dynamic Data Team. This critical role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining our robust data architecture and pipelines, ensuring data quality, and providing essential data support for our AI and Robotics initiatives. The ideal candidate will be an end-to-end data professional, capable of leading complex projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and upholding the highest standards of data governance and security.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Pipeline Development & Management:

    • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and real-time data processing (e.g., MQTT/Kafka data ingestion).

    • Manage and optimize our data warehousing solutions, primarily Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient data storage, querying, and cost-effectiveness.

    • Implement and maintain data quality assertions across all data pipelines to ensure data integrity from source to consumption.

    • Develop and integrate new data sources into our existing data ecosystem.

    • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues, ensuring minimal disruption to data availability.

  • Data Support:

    • Collaborate closely with company teams to understand their data needs and develop tailored data solutions.

    • Design and implement data workflows to support machine learning workflows

    • Contribute to the development of data-driven insights that improve robot autonomy and performance.

  • Data Architecture & Infrastructure:

    • Contribute to the design and evolution of our overall data architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.

    • Implement and adhere to best practices for data modeling, schema design, and data governance.

    • Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred) to deploy and manage data services.

    • Knowledge of spatial data wrangling and best practices for warehousing and consumption.

  • Monitoring, Reporting & Dashboards:

    • Develop and maintain monitoring solutions for data pipeline health and performance.

    • Ensure data consistency and accuracy in reporting tools.

  • Team Collaboration & Leadership:

    • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions.

    • Mentor junior team members and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the data team.

    • Take ownership of projects from conception to deployment, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.

Technical Skills & Qualifications:

  • Required:

    • Strong proficiency in Python for data engineering and scripting.

    • Extensive experience with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).

    • Proven expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage,, Cloud Functions.

    • Experience designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL/ELT data pipelines.

    • Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow,).

    • Experience with real-time data processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, MQTT).

    • Understanding of data modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, Kimball).

    • Familiarity with version control systems (Git/GitHub).


  • Plus:

    • Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines and MLOps principles.

    • Knowledge of AI Agents for internal product development.

    • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

Exposure to companies KPIs and OKRs among other performance metrics.

title: Data & AI Architect
description:
Job Description

InfoCentric is one of the largest Australian-owned specialist Data Consultancies, specialising in Cloud Data Platforms, Analytics and AI. At InfoCentric, we deliver leading solutions in Data Strategy and Advisory, Cloud Data Platforms, Artificial Intelligence, GenAI, and Business Analytics and Insights to Australia’s largest organisations.

About the role:

We are looking for a Data & AI Architect – Core Data Platform & Data Science Enablement to join our team in Melbourne, Australia.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Designing and architecting scalable, enterprise‑grade data platforms supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning, and data science workloads
  • Leading the evolution of core data platforms to support current and future data science and AI initiatives
  • Defining enterprise data architecture patterns, standards, and governance frameworks
  • Collaborating with Data Scientists, Engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
  • Designing and optimising enterprise data models within Snowflake environments
  • Supporting the integration, migration, and consolidation of data assets into Enterprise Data Platforms (EDP)
  • Establishing best practices across data modelling, governance, integration, and lifecycle management
  • Supporting optimisation and measurement model use cases across analytics and data science domains
  • Providing architectural leadership across modern cloud data ecosystems
About you:

To be successful in this role, you'll need:

  • Proven experience as a Data Architect delivering modern enterprise data platforms
  • Strong experience with Snowflake
  • Experience designing cloud­-based solutions on Azure and/or AWS
  • Strong data modelling expertise, including dimensional modelling methodologies
  • Experience with ERwin or similar data modelling tools
  • Deep understanding of Kimball modelling principles and data warehousing concepts
  • Experience in architecting platforms that support analytics, machine learning, and data science workloads
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences
  • Experience designing scalable, secure, and governed data platforms
You'll be at an advantage if you also have:
  • A Data Science background
  • Experience supporting optimisation, predictive analytics, and measurement modelling initiatives
  • Knowledge of Data Vault methodologies
  • Experience with Databricks and dbt (preferred)
  • Knowledge of data quality, observability, monitoring, and governance frameworks
  • Exposure to AI and Agentic AI initiatives
Core Technologies
  • Snowflake
  • Azure (preferred) or AWS
  • dbt
  • Databricks
  • ERwin (or equivalent data modelling tools)
About us:

At InfoCentric, our employees are the heart of our business. We have had many employees start their careers with us and grow into positions of responsibility. We are at the forefront of Data Platforms, Analytics and AI, driving innovation and delivering smart solutions for our clients.

Our core values reflect what's important to us:

Realise Opportunity
  • We'll cover the cost of your training and certifications in the latest tools and technologies, including AWS, Azure, Snowflake, and AI
  • You'll work with industry leaders and gain experience in complex Data Platforms and AI projects from the start
  • You'll gain mentorship and collaboration from industry leaders
Thrive Together & Embrace Diversity
  • Receive genuine recognition for work and valued behaviour
  • Regular social events to connect. Previous events include private cinema screenings, bubble soccer, minigolf, bowling, and social drinks
  • Be part of embracing and celebrating team diversity
  • Work alongside and collaborate with experienced technical professionals in Data Platforms, AI, and GenAI
Think Big Picture
  • Work flexibly to balance family, life, and career
  • Create impact and positive change for the team and business
  • Drive process improvement and innovation
  • Contribute to shaping the future of enterprise data and AI platforms

To find out more, check out our LinkedIn Life Page or www.infocentric.com.au.

Applications

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we will contact you if you are successful. We thank you for your interest in InfoCentric and for working with us. If you're unsuccessful for this role, we will keep your details and reach out to you regarding any suitable opportunities in the future.

title: Senior Quality Automation Specialist
description:
Senior Quality Automation Specialist, AVP

Location: Quincy, Massachusetts

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who we are looking for

We are seeking a Senior Quality Automation Specialist, AVP, with 8+ years of intensive, hands-on automation engineering experience and a proven track record of designing, building, scaling, and maintaining enterprise-grade automation solutions. This is a specialist engineering role focused exclusively on automation delivery along with coordination activities.

The candidate must demonstrate deep expertise across Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, API and service automation, SoapUI/RestAssured, CI/CD-integrated execution, Service Virtualization, AWS, and AI-assisted automation engineering. Strong Banking and Payments domain experience is mandatory, including the ability to convert complex transaction workflows and operational controls into resilient automated validation solutions.

The role requires substantial on-ground automation development in addition to coordinating automation/functional work delivered by the India team. The successful candidate will work closely with the SQA team and the lead located in India while aligning automation backlogs, dependencies, technical standards, execution progress, and delivery outcomes.

Why this role is important to us

Automation is critical to improving release speed, repeatability, platform resilience, and engineering productivity across business-critical Banking and Payments applications. This role will strengthen scalable UI, API, service, data, and intelligent automation capabilities while reducing repetitive validation effort through reusable frameworks, CI/CD execution, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

What you will be responsible for

Intensive Automation Engineering

  • Design, develop, debug, and maintain scalable enterprise automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, API, Service Virtualization and Tricentis Tosca.

  • Build robust, reusable automated solutions for complex web, service, API, data, and end-to-end Banking and Payments workflows.

  • Write high-quality automation code and reusable libraries using Java and/or Python, applying object-oriented design, clean-code principles, exception handling, logging, and configuration management.

  • Develop page-object, data-driven, keyword-driven, modular, and hybrid framework components appropriate to application architecture and delivery needs.

  • Engineer stable automated suites with effective waits, synchronization, reusable locators, recovery logic, parallel execution, cross-browser execution, and environment-independent configuration.

  • Diagnose flaky automation, execution failures, framework bottlenecks, and test-data dependencies, and implement permanent engineering solutions.

  • Maintain automation assets through application and service changes while continuously improving execution speed, stability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • 90% responsible for performing hands-on automation scripting, code review participation, technical troubleshooting, test-data setup, execution analysis, and evidence generation on a regular basis.

API and Service Automation

  • Design and implement comprehensive REST and SOAP API automation using SoapUI, ReadyAPI, REST Assured, Postman, Newman, Karate, and equivalent enterprise-approved tools.

  • Create automated coverage for request and response payloads, schemas, headers, authentication, authorization, status codes, error handling, business rules, and service-level data integrity.

  • Automate API workflows using OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, certificates, session tokens, and other applicable enterprise authentication mechanisms.

  • Develop reusable API clients, service-object layers, payload builders, assertion libraries, environment configurations, and automated data setup and cleanup utilities.

  • Implement contract and schema validation using OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, JSON Schema, XML Schema, and consumer-driven contract approaches such as Pact where applicable.

  • Automate chained and stateful service workflows, asynchronous processing, callbacks, queues, batch interfaces, file-based services, and upstream/downstream dependencies.

  • Use service virtualization and mocking tools such as WireMock or equivalent solutions to automate testing when dependent services are unavailable or constrained.

  • Develop automated API performance and reliability checks using JMeter or equivalent tools where appropriate to the engineering scope.

  • Integrate API suites with Maven or Gradle builds, source control, reporting solutions, and CI/CD pipelines for unattended and parallel execution.

Tricentis Tosca Automation

  • Design and maintain Tosca modules, reusable test-step blocks, templates, test data, execution lists, recovery scenarios, and distributed execution configurations.

  • Apply Tosca model-based automation practices to complex web, API, and enterprise Banking workflows.

  • Optimize Tosca workspaces, reusable assets, synchronization, test-data management, and execution performance to support maintainable enterprise-scale automation.

  • Integrate Tosca automated execution with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise reporting mechanisms.

Selenium Automation

  • Develop and enhance Selenium automation frameworks using Java or Python with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, Maven, or Gradle as applicable.

  • Implement reusable page objects, component libraries, utility layers, data providers, reporting, screenshot capture, retry controls, and parallel execution capabilities.

  • Integrate Selenium suites with Selenium Grid, cloud or enterprise browser infrastructure, source control, pipeline execution, and reporting tools.

  • Apply resilient locator strategies and synchronization techniques to modern dynamic web applications.

AI-Assisted Automation Engineering

  • Use approved AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and enterprise AI assistants to accelerate automation code generation, refactoring, documentation, test-data creation, and maintenance.

  • Apply prompt-engineering and iterative-validation techniques to generate effective automation assets while ensuring all AI-generated content is technically reviewed, secure, explainable, and maintainable.

  • Use AI-assisted approaches to identify automation candidates, improve scenario coverage, analyze failures, detect flaky patterns, optimize scripts, and accelerate root-cause analysis.

  • Evaluate emerging AI-enabled automation capabilities and implement practical improvements that measurably increase automation productivity, coverage, stability, or execution speed.

CI/CD and Automation Operations

  • Integrate UI, API, service, and Tosca automation suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms.

  • Configure scheduled, event-driven, pipeline-gated, parallel, and distributed automated execution across environments.

  • Implement automated reporting, logs, dashboards, failure classification, evidence capture, and quality gates for rapid and traceable execution analysis.

  • Manage automation configuration, secrets, dependencies, test data, environment parameters, and version-controlled assets in compliance with enterprise engineering standards.

Banking and Payments Automation

  • Apply deep Banking and Payments knowledge to automate account servicing, payment initiation, validation, authorization, transaction processing, approvals, entitlements, posting, settlement, reconciliation, returns, exceptions, and status-tracking workflows.

  • Translate complex Banking business rules, transaction lifecycles, operational controls, cut-off considerations, and data dependencies into reusable automated validation solutions.

  • Build automation for high-volume, high-risk, and business-critical payment scenarios, including positive, negative, boundary, error-path, and recovery conditions.

  • Validate automated outcomes across UI, API, service, message, file, and database layers without creating separate manual testing responsibilities.

India Automation Delivery Coordination

  • Coordinate the automation backlog, work allocation inputs, technical dependencies, execution schedules, and delivery tracking with the India-based SQA team and SQA Lead.

  • Facilitate technical alignment across automation engineers on common frameworks, coding standards, reusable components, tool usage, and CI/CD integration.

  • Consolidate automation progress, execution results, blockers, risks, and dependency updates for relevant stakeholders.

  • Support effective handoffs and collaboration across time zones while remaining directly accountable for substantial hands-on automation engineering deliverables.

  • This coordination is on ground hands on delivery-focused

What we value

Mandatory Technical Expertise

  • 8+ years of intensive hands-on test automation engineering experience, supported by a proven track record of delivering and maintaining enterprise automation solutions.

  • Advanced hands-on expertise in Selenium WebDriver and strong experience building Java based automation frameworks along with Service Virtualization skills.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca, including model-based automation, reusable modules, test-data management, recovery scenarios, and distributed execution.

  • Advanced API and service automation experience using multiple tools and frameworks, including SoapUI, ReadyAPI, REST Assured, Postman, Newman, Karate, and equivalent technologies.

  • Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, schemas, authentication, service virtualization, mocking, and database validation.

  • Strong experience with automation-oriented tools and libraries such as TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, Maven, Gradle, Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Selenium Grid, WireMock, Pact, JMeter, and reporting frameworks.

  • Demonstrated experience integrating automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and operating unattended, parallel, scheduled, and distributed execution.

  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to create, enhance, refactor, debug, and maintain automated solutions.

  • Strong SQL knowledge for automated data setup, validation, reconciliation, and cleanup.

  • Strong debugging, coding, framework-design, execution-analysis, and problem-solving capabilities.

Mandatory Banking and Payments Expertise

  • Deep practical knowledge and experience in Banking and Payments is mandatory.

  • Strong understanding of payment and transaction lifecycles, account servicing, entitlements, approvals, posting, settlement, reconciliation, returns, exceptions, and operational controls.

  • Proven ability to convert complex Banking and Payments requirements into executable automation architecture, reusable scenarios, and reliable validations.

Professional Competencies

  • Automation-first, engineering-focused mindset with strong ownership of hands-on technical deliverables.

  • Ability to independently design solutions, write automation code, troubleshoot complex failures, and complete deliverables with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication and coordination skills for working closely with the India-based SQA team, SQA Lead, developers, product partners, and globally distributed stakeholders.

  • Strong focus on measurable automation outcomes, including coverage, reliability, maintainability, execution speed, and reduction of repetitive effort.

Education and Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

  • 8+ years of relevant automation engineering experience in enterprise application environments.

  • Proven delivery experience across Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, API/service automation, SoapUI/ReadyAPI, CI/CD, and AI-assisted automation.

  • Strong Banking and Payments domain experience is mandatory; experience in regulated financial-services environments is preferred.

  • Relevant Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, API automation, cloud, DevOps, or AI certifications are advantageous.

What success looks like

  • Deliver stable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions across UI, API, service, data, and Banking and Payments workflows.

  • Expand automation coverage and reduce execution time and repetitive effort through reusable frameworks and CI/CD-integrated automation.

  • Improve automation reliability by reducing flaky execution, strengthening failure diagnostics, and resolving framework or environment bottlenecks.

  • Demonstrate measurable productivity gains through responsible adoption of AI-assisted automation engineering.

  • Ensure effective coordination and predictable delivery of India-based automation work while maintaining strong personal hands-on contribution.

Additional requirements

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document automation architecture, execution results, technical issues, and delivery status.

  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with the India-based SQA organization and globally distributed technology partners.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage concurrent automation priorities, dependencies, and technical deliverables.

  • Comfortable working in a release-driven, high-visibility environment with a strong focus on automation outcomes.

  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to ramp up quickly and contribute through hands-on automation development with minimal supervision.

Work Requirement

  • 4 days in office, Hybrid

  • Core collaboration hours align with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Occasional flexibility may be required to support globally distributed teams.

title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a software engineer to build and evolve a large-scale Application Performance Monitoring (APM) platform. This role works across backend services, streaming data pipelines, telemetry agents, infrastructure, query capabilities, and user experience to help customers understand and improve the performance and reliability of their applications.

You will develop and maintain Java microservices and Apache Flink applications that ingest, process, store, query, and present high-volume observability data. The APM platform operates at substantial scale, processing millions of spans per minute while maintaining low latency, reliability, data quality, and cost efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain core APM repositories, shared platform capabilities, APIs, and operational tooling.
  • Build scalable query-engine capabilities for traces, spans, metrics, logs, and service topology data.
  • Design and operate Flink-based streaming ingestion pipelines that validate, enrich, transform, aggregate, and route telemetry.
  • Lead and support the transition from relational database storage to OCI Log Analytics, including data migration, infrastructure migration, schema evolution, compatibility, and operational continuity.
  • Define and manage telemetry schemas, versioning, data contracts, migrations, and data-quality controls.
  • Build and maintain application monitoring agents and instrumentation with low runtime overhead and reliable configuration.
  • Develop APM UI experiences for exploring telemetry, diagnosing incidents, configuring monitoring and alerts, and visualizing traces, dependencies, and performance trends.
  • Deploy and operate cloud-native services using OCI components, including OCI Streaming and Kubernetes/OKE.
  • Partner directly with customers to understand analysis requirements, troubleshoot product and query issues, and optimize queries for successful, performant use of the APM product.
  • Improve reliability, scalability, observability, security, and cost efficiency across the platform.

Qualifications

  • Strong Java software-engineering experience, especially building distributed microservices.
  • Hands-on experience developing Apache Flink applications and streaming data pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of OCI services, particularly OCI Streaming and Kubernetes/OKE.
  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, schema evolution, and data or infrastructure migrations.
  • Familiarity with OCI Log Analytics or comparable log analytics and observability platforms.
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry and modern monitoring technologies, including distributed tracing, metrics, logs, instrumentation, and observability data models.
  • Experience designing and operating high-throughput systems, ideally involving telemetry, event streams, or millions of events per minute.
  • Ability to work effectively across backend systems, data engineering, infrastructure, agents, UI development, and customer-facing technical problem solving.

title: Therapeutic Medical Physicist (TMP)
description:
Overview

Ansible Government Solutions, LLC (Ansible) is currently recruiting a Therapeutic Medical Physicist to provide onsite services to eligible beneficiaries of the Northport VA Medical Center located at 79 Middleville Rd, Northport, NY 11768. Standard clinic hours are typically Monday - Friday 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM. If you accept employment with Ansible, you must also acknowledge that any assigned schedule is subject to change at the direction of either Ansible or its customers.

Ansible Government Solutions, LLC (Ansible) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Federal customers with solutions in many arenas. Our customers face wide-ranging challenges in the fields of national security, health care, and information technology. To address these challenges, we employ intelligent and committed staff who take care of our customers’ success as if it is their own.

Responsibilities
  • Provide therapeutic medical physics services to radiation oncology patients.
  • Collaborate with Radiation Oncologists on treatment planning and radiation delivery.
  • Support advanced treatment modalities including:
    • IMRT
    • IGRT
    • SRS
    • SRT
    • SBRT
    • VMAT
    • HDR/LDR brachytherapy
  • Participate in peer review of all treatment plans before treatment initiation.
  • Review and modify treatment plans throughout the course of therapy as needed.
  • Attend and participate in weekly peer review conferences and chart rounds.
  • Design, optimize, and evaluate radiation treatment plans.
  • Perform radiation dose calculations and monitor unit (MU) calculations.
  • Ensure independent review of treatment calculations.
  • Generate dose-volume histograms (DVHs).
  • Define organs at risk (OARs) and dose constraints.
  • Validate treatment planning system accuracy.
  • Model radiation beams and oversee treatment planning software functionality.
  • Perform and oversee:
    • Daily QA
    • Monthly QA
    • Annual QA
    • Machine calibrations
    • Radiation safety testing
  • Calibrate all available radiation beams.
  • Conduct periodic equipment performance evaluations.
  • Maintain compliance with ACR, ASTRO, AAPM, NRC, and VA standards.
  • Coordinate annual TLD measurements and third-party calibration reviews.
  • Maintain documentation for all QA activities
  • Support radiation oncology treatment planning systems and connected equipment.
  • Monitor:
    • ARIA Record & Verify
    • Eclipse Treatment Planning System
    • SRS/SRT/IGRT systems
  • Manage system updates, backups, troubleshooting, and connectivity issues.
  • Act as liaison with facility informatics staff.
Qualifications
  • Master's degree in Medical Physics or related field
  • Board Certification in Medical Physics or Therapeutic Medical Physics by the American Board of Radiology (ABR)
  • Minimum 2 years continuous therapeutic medical physics experience within the last 3 years
  • 2 years QA procedure experience
  • 1 year experience in an ACR-accredited radiation oncology environment
  • 1 year experience with Varian Linear Accelerators (IX and Trilogy)
  • 1 year IGRT experience including Cone Beam CT
  • 1 year Eclipse Treatment Planning System experience
  • 1 year ARIA Record & Verify System experience
  • Experience independently planning:
    • 2D/3D Conformal
    • IMRT
    • VMAT
    • SRS
    • SRT
    • SBRT
  • 1 year IMRT QA experience using MapCheck I/II or equivalent
  • 1 year Siemens Somatom CT Simulator experience (or equivalent)
  • Experience in a healthcare system with ACR or APEx certification preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
  • Proficiency in computer systems and networking related to radiation oncology
  • Ability to pass a government background check and complete required VA training

All candidates must be able to:

  • Sit, stand, walk, lift, squat, bend, twist, and reach above shoulders during the work shift
  • Lift up to 50 lbs from floor to waist
  • Lift up to 20 lbs
  • Carry up to 40 lbs a reasonable distance
  • Push/pull with 30 lbs of force

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Laatuinsinööri Anfran Etelä-Suomen työmaille
description:
Anfra työnantajana

Anfra on Suomessa ja Pohjois-Ruotsissa toimiva, yli 250 ammattilaista työllistävä ja monipuolisesti palveleva betoni- ja infrarakentaja. Keskeisintä osaamistamme ovat paikallavalettavat betonirakenteet, rakennesuunnittelu sekä infrarakentaminen teollisuuden, yritysten ja julkisen puolen hankkeisiin. Erikoisalaamme ovat teollisuusrakentaminen sekä energiarakentamisen infra.

Rakennusalaa rohkeasti uudistavana, innovatiivisena ja voimakkaasti kasvavana yrityksenä tarjoamme osaajillemme laajasti kehittymismahdollisuuksia. Sujuvan työarkemme takana on matala hierarkia, moderni johtaminen ja ketterät toimintatavat. Johtamis-, laatu- ja ympäristösertifikaatit luovat pohjan vastuulliselle toiminnalle arjessamme. Anfralaisen tunnistat arvoistamme - hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito, jotka ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistämme toimistolla ja työmaalla.

Meillä Anfralla muutos ei ole poikkeus – se on kasvun tuoma normaali ja anfralaisia innostava tila. Kasvamme kovaa vauhtia, ja se näkyy: projektit lisääntyvät, tavat uudistuvat, roolit elävät. Täällä et tule tekemään samaa päivästä ja vuodesta toiseen, vaan opit, sopeudut ja kehityt jatkuvasti kanssamme. Emme hae täydellisyyttä, vaan rohkeutta tarttua uuteen uteliaasti – siten rakennamme yhdessä joka päivä piirun verran parempaa Anfraa.


Tule laatuinsinööriksi Etelä-Suomen työmaillemme!


Mikä homma?

Haemme Etelä-Suomen työmaillemme laatuinsinööriä. Työssäsi edistät kokonaisvaltaisesti projektien laatutavoitteiden täyttymistä vastaten laadunhallintaan liittyvistä asioista projektien toteutusvaiheissa. Työtä tehdään Anfran joukkueen ohella tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaan ja aliurakoitsijoiden kanssa. Saat työhösi hyvän startin Anfran kattavalla perehdytyksellä ja HSEQ-organisaation tuella.

Työ on kokoaikainen. Työn aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtävään ajateltu palkkaraami on noin 3500-4500 €/kk. Voit tutustua lisäksi hyviin arkea tukeviin työsuhde-etuihimme urasivuiltamme.


Mitä kaipaamme sinun työkalupakkiin?

Sinulla on jo aiempaa kokemusta infra-/rakennusalan työmaiden laatuasioiden hoitamisesta, ja valmiuksia toiminnan tavoitteelliseen kehittämiseen. Koulutustaustaltasi olet työtehtäviin soveltuva. Sinulla on näppärät IT-taidot, joiden avulla raportoinnin ja dokumentoinnin tehtävät hoituvat jouhevasti, ja hyppäät rohkeasti Anfran mukaan rakennusalan digitalisaation eturintamaan. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen kansainvälisiin toimijoihin liittyvien projektien laadunhallinnan tehtävistä.

Nautit yksityiskohtien parissa työskentelystä, sillä tässä tehtävässä tarkkuus on avain menestykseen. Kansainväliset tilaajamme arvostavat tinkimätöntä laatua, joten huolellinen työskentelytapasi pääsee oikeuksiinsa ja tuottaa tuloksia, joista voimme olla aidosti ylpeitä.

Kommunikoit suullisesti ja kirjallisesti suomen lisäksi sujuvasti myös englannin kielellä.

Olet kehittymishaluinen tiimipelaaja, ja Anfran arvot hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito kuvaavat myös sinun toimintatapojasi. Arki kasvavassa yhtiössä ja hyvässä joukkueessamme on vauhdikasta ja palkitsevaa, joten uskomme että sinäkin viihdyt kanssamme, mikäli innostut tekemisen meiningistä sekä sopivasta itsesi haastamisesta.

Suhtaudut uteliaasti uusiin toimintatapoihin ja sytyt kasvun tuomista mahdollisuuksista, ollen myös sinnikäs haasteenpaikoissa. Sinulla on jatkuva halu oppia uutta ja kyky pysyä muutoksen kyydissä pelottomasti - sillä se minkä opit eilen, voi olla huomenna jo vanhentunutta tietoa. Ennen kaikkea koet merkityksellisenä saada jättää ammattitaitoisen kädenjälkesi Anfran kehittymiseen.


Kiinnostuitko tulemaan anfralaiseksi?

Voit hakea mukaan Anfran joukkueeseen urasivujemme kautta!

Haemme uusia anfralaisia pitkin syystalvea ja ensimmäiset uudet projektit alkavat pian, joten tutustumme uusiin hakijoihin rullaavasti. Täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.


Rekryprosessimme etenee seuraavasti:

  1. Ilmaise kiinnostuksesi anfralaiseksi jättämällä meille hakemus urasivujemme kautta simppelillä hakusysteemillämme (katso jos et usko!)
  2. Rekrytointiammattilaisten lisäksi hyödynnämme rekrytointiprosessissamme automatiikkaa ja tekoälyä. Jos perusasiat mätsäävät, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä tutustumiskeskustelun merkeissä.
  3. Jatkoon valitut henkilöt pääsevät esittelemään itseään lisää sinulle sopivana hetkenä henkilöarviointien kautta (itsenäisesti tehtävät persoonallisuusarviointi ja kykytestit)
  4. Näiden pohjalta meillä onkin jo mukavasti lisätietoja, ja kutsumme sopivia henkilöitä jatkotapaamisiin tutustelemaan Anfran tiimiläisten kanssa ja kuulemaan lisää meiningistämme
  5. Kaikki natsaa? Ei muuta kun kättä päälle ja mukaan Anfran huippuun joukkueeseen!

Mikäli sinulla jäi kysyttävää, voit olla yhteydessä sähköpostitse kehitysjohtaja Marko Liukkoon marko.liukko@anfra.fi tai henkilöstöjohtaja Tuomo Hilliahoon tuomo.hilliaho@anfra.fi.

Työmahdollisuus vielä pähkinänkuoressa:

  • Laatuinsinöörin positio Anfran Kempeleen toimistolla.
  • Sinulla on kokemusta laadunhallinnan tehtävistä.
  • Olet kehittymishaluinen tiimipelaaja, ja Anfran arvot hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito kuvaavat myös sinun toimintatapojasi.
  • Tehtävään ajateltu palkkaraami on 3500-4500 €/kk luokkaa. Työnantaja vastaa mahdollisiin komennuksiin liittyvistä majoituksista sekä korvauksista. Voit tutustua lisäksi hyviin arkea tukeviin työsuhde-etuihimme urasivuiltamme.

title: Alminde-Viuf Fællesskole søger en dygtig og engageret lærer til dansk og matematik i indskolingen
description:
Da en af vores dygtige lærere rykker teltpælene op og flytter nordpå, søger vi en dygtig og engageret lærer, der har lyst til at være en vigtig del af vores indskoling.
Vi søger en lærer, der kan varetage undervisningen i bl.a. dansk og matematik i 1. klasse – evt. suppleret med andre relevante fag som f.eks. musik. Stillingen er en fast stilling på 37 timer og hvor du vil få en central rolle som klasselærer i den ene 1. klasse og dermed være med til at skabe en tryg, inspirerende og udviklende hverdag for vores elever.
Du er drevet af visionen om det gode børneliv og vil i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger fortsat arbejde for at skabe lige deltagelsesmuligheder for alle elever – med fokus på, at alle børn gør det bedste, de kan.

Alminde-Viuf Fællesskole

”Fremtidens kompetencer – Vores skole”

Vi er en skole, hvor både medarbejdere og elever trives og udfordres i et trygt og fagligt fællesskab med højt til loftet. Vi vægter at møde hinanden med hjælpsomhed og en god omgangstone.
Skolen bygger på værdierne fællesskab, faglighed, respekt, ansvarlighed og engagement i alle relationer – hvad enten det er i forhold til elever, forældre, kolleger, samarbejdspartnere i lokalområdet eller ledelsen.
Vi arbejder for almen dannelse, så vores børn og unge bliver aktive medborgere i samfundet – lokalt, nationalt og globalt.
Som medarbejder på Alminde-Viuf Fællesskole bliver du en del af en velfungerende skole med stærk forankring i lokalsamfundet. Skolen er placeret i skøn natur midt mellem Almind og Viuf. Vi har ca. 430 elever fra 0.–9. årgang og 50 ansatte.

Faglige forventninger til dig som vores nye kollega

Vi forventer, at du:

  • har lyst til at arbejde med de yngste elever og brænder for deres læring, trivsel og udvikling

  • er fagligt velfunderet og engageret i undervisningen i dansk og matematik

  • arbejder varieret og praksisnært og formår at tilpasse undervisningen til elevernes forskellige forudsætninger

  • har blik for både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet

  • indgår engageret og professionelt i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger, ledelse og forældre

  • ser forældresamarbejdet som en vigtig del af klasselæreropgaven

  • har styr på klasserumsledelse og vægter relationsarbejdet højt

Vi arbejder i klasseteams, og du vil blive en del af et tæt samarbejdende team i indskolingen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En arbejdsplads med stort fokus på trivsel og arbejdsmiljø

  • Mentorordning, så du får en god opstart på skolen

  • Engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger og en god stemning

  • En skole, hvor der er plads til idéer, engagement og faglig udvikling

Praktiske oplysninger

Tiltrædelse: 1. okober 2026 eller gerne før
Løn: Efter gældende overenskomst.

Nærmere oplysninger

Kontakt SFO- og indskolingsleder Mie Møller på 20 34 73 50

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning med relevante bilag, så vi har den senest mandag d. 24. august
Vi afholder samtaler tirsdag eller onsdag.

Alle stillinger er fuldtidsstillinger medmindre andet er angivet. Kolding Kommune opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen. Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.

title: Bliv den personalekonsulent, som ledere ringer til, når de har brug for kvalificeret sparring.
description:
Hvis du motiveres af at omsætte komplekse regler til gode løsninger, skabe tryghed i svære personalesager og samtidig være med til at udvikle fremtidens løn- og personaleområde, så har vi en spændende stilling til dig.

I Løn og Personale bliver du en central faglig sparringspartner for ledere på tværs af Kolding Kommune. Her får du både ansvar, indflydelse og dygtige kolleger, der – ligesom dig – brænder for høj faglighed, samarbejde og udvikling.

Hos os løser vi hver dag opgaver, der har stor betydning for ledere og medarbejdere i hele Kolding Kommune. Vi rådgiver om løn- og personaleforhold, understøtter ledere i personaleprocesser og sikrer, at regler, overenskomster og aftaler omsættes til løsninger, der både er juridisk korrekte og fungerer i praksis.

Samtidig er vi optagede af at udvikle vores opgaveløsning. Vi arbejder målrettet med at optimere og ensrette arbejdsgange og processer, så vi understøtter organisationen endnu bedre. Derudover er vi i gang med at etablere Den Fælles Organisationsplatform – en ny fælles platform for medarbejder- og organisationsdata, som bliver en vigtig del af vores arbejde fremover.

Derfor søger vi en personalekonsulent, som både har lyst til at være en stærk faglig sparringspartner for kommunens ledere og bidrage aktivt til den fortsatte udvikling af vores afdeling.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af Løn og Personale i Koncernøkonomi og får en central rolle i rådgivningen af ledere på tværs af Kolding Kommune.

Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner, der rådgiver om løn- og personaleforhold, understøtter rekrutteringer og bidrager til, at personaleprocesser gennemføres professionelt og i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning, overenskomster og aftaler.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med arbejdssted på Ålegården 1, 1. sal i Kolding. Vi forventer, at du kan tiltræde den 1. november 2026.

Dine opgaver

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du både løser de daglige driftsopgaver og bidrager til udviklingen af fremtidens løsninger. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • rådgive og sparre med ledere om løn- og personalemæssige forhold

  • vejlede ledere gennem rekrutteringsprocesser – fra stillingsopslag til ansættelse

  • udarbejde og kvalificere lønaftaler, herunder lokal- og forhåndsaftaler

  • beregne lønpuljer og understøtte lederne i de årlige lønforhandlinger

  • bidrage til håndtering af omplaceringer og større afskedsprocesser i tæt samarbejde med HR's personalejurister

  • udvikle, optimere og ensrette arbejdsgange og processer på løn- og personaleområdet

  • sikre høj kvalitet i administrationen og korrekt sagsbehandling i overensstemmelse med gældende regler, overenskomster og lovgivning.

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har en relevant administrativ uddannelse, HK, administrationsøkonom eller lign. Gerne erfaring fra løn- og personaleområdet – måske fra en politisk styret organisation.

Derudover håber vi, at du:

  • arbejder analytisk, struktureret og har fokus på kvalitet

  • trives med at rådgive og samarbejde med ledere

  • kan omsætte regler og aftaler til klar og brugbar rådgivning

  • skaber tillid gennem din faglighed og din samarbejdsform

  • har lyst til at bidrage til udvikling og forbedring af arbejdsgange og processer.

Det kan du glæde dig til

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med 24 engagerede og dygtige kolleger, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Vi har mange forskellige opgaver, og vores hverdag er præget af både drift og udvikling. Prioriteringer kan ændre sig, men vi løser opgaverne i fællesskab og hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.

Vi tror på, at høj faglighed, humor og et godt arbejdsmiljø hænger sammen. Derfor prioriterer vi sparring, kompetenceudvikling og et arbejdsliv med plads til fleksibilitet.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • fleksordning

  • mulighed for én ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag

  • frugt- og sundhedsordning.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse på baggrund af stillingens indhold og dine kvalifikationer.

Hvis du bliver indkaldt til samtale, vil du i den forbindelse, skriftligt få oplyst stillingens lønniveau.

title: Branch Operations Lead - Simi Valley Market - Simi Valley, CA and Surrounding Areas
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Branch Operations Lead in a Chase Branch, you'll be at the heart of our branch operations, working closely with the Branch Manager, branch employees, and our team of experts. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our clients' financial transactions are handled with precision and care, all while adhering to our policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Your leadership will ensure that our branch not only meets but exceeds control expectations, setting a positive tone for everyone who walks through our doors.

Job responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Branch Manager to create a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere in the branch, ensuring every client enjoys an exceptional experience and feels part of a dynamic community.
  • Greet clients warmly as they enter the branch, making them feel valued and appreciated. Demonstrate genuine care and concern during interactions, assisting with transactions, managing lobby flow, and scheduling meetings to build trusted relationships.
  • Engage clients with clear, polite communication to understand and help them effectively. Anticipate their needs while checking them into the waiting queue, ensuring a smooth visit.
  • Lead branch operations, including managing cash devices like the cash vault and ATM. Resolve any client issues quickly and effectively, paying attention to detail and striving for consistency while adhering to all bank policies and procedures.
  • Introduce clients to our friendly branch team, who collaborate to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity. Work together to build lasting relationships and assist with any specialized financial needs, elevating the client experience.
  • Simplify clients' banking experience by sharing self-service options, allowing them to access their accounts anytime, day or night.
  • Work closely with the Branch Manager to support all aspects of branch operations, including maintaining high standards for loss control, compliance, and audits, ensuring the branch operates smoothly and securely.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You take pride in adhering to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.
  • You are committed to maintaining a keen eye for detail and staying organized, which helps you juggle multiple tasks effectively.
  • You are proud of your leadership skills and operational proficiency, ensuring transaction accuracy while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
  • You have a strong passion for educating the branch team and partners, helping them stay connected and informed.
  • You excel at building meaningful connections and engaging with clients, always ready to educate them and refer them to our team of experts when needed.
  • You have 1+ years of retail banking experience.
  • You have a high school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent.
  • You have the ability to work branch hours including weekends and evenings.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You have 6+ months of Associate Banker (Teller) experience.
  • You have a college degree or military equivalent.
Training and Travel Requirement
  • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.
  • You’ll need to be able to travel as required for in-person training and meetings.

FEDERAL DEPOSIT INSURANCE ACT:
This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

title: Hallintopäällikkö
description:
Kiteen kaupunki hakee määräaikaiseen viransijaisuuteen
HALLINTOPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ
monipuoliseen ja vastuulliseen asiantuntijatehtävään kaupungin hallintokeskukseen.

Hallintopäällikkö työskentelee talousjohtajan suorassa alaisuudessa ja kuuluu kaupungin johtoryhmään. Hallintopäällikkö toimii talousjohtajan sijaisena ja on itsenäisessä asemassa oleva työnantajan edustaja. Hallintopäällikkö tuottaa kaupungin keskushallinnon lainopillisia ja hallinnollisia asiantuntijapalveluja sekä osallistuu kaupungin päätöksenteon valmisteluun.

Keskeisiin työtehtäviin kuuluvat kaupunginhallituksen, kaupunginvaltuuston ja kaupunginhallituksen alaisten toimielinten esityslista- ja pöytäkirjaprosessin koordinointi, hallinnollinen valmistelu sekä päätöksenteon laillisuuden ja hyvän hallinnon toteutumisen varmistaminen.

Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisia lainopillisia asiantuntijatehtäviä, kuten hallinto-oikeudellista neuvontaa, päätöksenteon ja päätösvalmistelun tukemista, sopimusasioiden valmistelua sekä muiden juridisten kysymysten selvittämistä ja ratkaisemista. Tehtävään kuuluu myös valmius- ja varautumisasioiden sekä vaalien koordinointi.

Tehtävän menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja, hyvää kirjallista ilmaisukykyä sekä kykyä omaksua laajoja asiakokonaisuuksia.

Viransijaisuus täytetään ajalle 1.9.2026 - 30.9.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Viransijaisuuden kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto. Arvostamme kokemusta kunnallishallinnosta, hallinto-oikeudellisista tehtävistä ja päätösvalmistelusta sekä hyvää lainopillista osaamista. Tehtävän menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää oma-aloitteista työotetta ja kykyä itsenäiseen asiantuntijatyöhön.

Valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan.
Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa.
Kiteen kaupunki on savuton työpaikka.

title: Personal Banking Advisor
description:
What's the role?

A Personal Banking Advisor at Westpac is a professional who assists customers with their banking needs, offering tailored advice and solutions. They help with tasks like opening accounts, managing finances, and providing guidance on Westpac's products and services. Their role is customer-focused, aiming to build strong relationships and ensure a positive banking experience.

What do I need?

  • Thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments with variety in daily tasks.
  • Proven experience in meeting and exceeding KPI targets while delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Passion for building and maintaining strong customer relationships to support sales and banking needs.
  • Strong communication skills and excellent time management.
  • A willingness to learn and grow professionally.
  • Shifts will be Monday to Friday from 8:30am – 4:30pm

No banking experience? No problem. At Westpac, we’re committed to your success from day one. You will receive comprehensive training on our banking products and services and our supportive team will provide hands-on guidance and resources to help you master everything you need to flourish in your new role. We’re here to empower you with the knowledge and skills to thrive and advance your career with us!

Our Promise to You

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac Group the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • A variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.

Create Your Future Today

To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button.

We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page, under the ‘Diversity, Sustainability and Flexibility’ section.

We may close this job advertisement earlier than the advertised closing date if suitable candidates are identified. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: [Spoon] 일본 UA·그로스 마케터 (5년 이상)
description:
About

=====

글로벌 오디오 ​콘텐츠 ​플랫폼, ​Spoon을 함께 ​만들어가실
일본 UA·그로스 ​마케터를 ​지금 찾고 ​있어요

=====

Spoon 서비스는요,
• 누구나 목소리로 콘텐츠를 만들고, 팬과 실시간으로 소통할 수 있는 오디오 소셜 콘텐츠 플랫폼이에요.
• 한국·일본·대만 등 글로벌 시장에서 서비스를 운영하며 지속적으로 성장하고 있습니다.
• 최근 귀로 듣는 AI 오디오 소설 ‘PodNovel’을 새롭게 선보이며 콘텐츠 영역을 확장하고 있습니다.
• Spoon 즐기러 가기: https://www.spooncast.net/kr

Responsibilities

[Spoon Growth Marketing 팀을 ​소개합니다]
Spoon Growth Marketing ​팀은 ​브랜드, 콘텐츠, ​UA, ​CRM을 ​연결해 스푼의 성장을 ​만들어가는 ​팀이에요. 우리는 유저가 ​스푼을 ​처음 ​발견하는 순간부터 서비스 ​안에서 즐거운 ​경험을 ​시작하고 다시 ​찾아오게 되는 ​과정까지 ​함께 설계해요. 브랜드의 ​목소리를 만들고, ​시장에 맞는 메시지를 찾고, 유입 이후의 경험까지 연결하는 일을 합니다.

• 시장 맞춤형 전략: 한국, 일본, 대만 등 각 시장의 유저와 문화를 이해하고 그에 맞는 메시지와 채널 전략을 빠르게 실험해요.
• 데이터 기반 성장: 실행 결과를 바탕으로 더 나은 성장 방식을 찾고, 스푼의 가치를 각 시장에 맞는 방식으로 전하고 있어요.

[주요 업무 - 주로 이런 업무를 수행해요]
한국 본사에서 일본 시장의 UA·그로스 마케팅을 담당하며, 일본 현지 팀과 긴밀하게 협업해 일본 유저의 성장을 직접 만들어낼 분을 모십니다.

1. 일본 UA·그로스 마케팅 전략 수립 및 실행
• Meta, Google, TikTok, X(Twitter) 등 주요 디지털 채널의 유료 광고 캠페인을 기획·집행·최적화해요.
• 일본 시장의 핵심 KPI(설치, 가입, 활성 유저, ROAS 등) 달성을 위해 주도적으로 예산을 배분하고 성과를 관리해요.
• 신규 채널 발굴과 A/B 테스트 운영을 통해 UA 효율을 극대화해요.

2. 일본 시장 특화 소재 기획 및 크리에이티브 개선
• 일본의 문화와 SNS 트렌드를 바탕으로 광고 소재의 핵심 메시지(미닝팩터)를 발굴하고 방향성을 정의해요.
• 현지 유저에게 실제로 반응하는 소재 콘셉트를 기획하고 검증해요.
• 소재 성과 데이터를 분석하여 지속적으로 크리에이티브를 개선하고 인사이트를 축적해요.

3. 광고 대행사 핸들링 및 파트너십 관리
• 일본 광고 대행사와의 실무 커뮤니케이션을 하며 캠페인 방향 가이드를 명확히 제시해요.
• 주기적인 대행사 성과 점검과 피드백을 통해 퀄리티를 관리하며, 필요시 신규 대행사 발굴 및 비딩을 주도해요.

4. 데이터 분석 및 그로스 전략 제안
• 캠페인 성과 데이터(CTR, CPI, ROAS, LTV 등)를 분석하여 실행 가능한 인사이트를 도출해요.
• Attribution Tool(Adjust, AppsFlyer 등)을 활용해 유입 이후의 유저 행동을 분석하고 그로스 퍼널을 최적화해요.
• 일본의 SNS·콘텐츠·라이브 플랫폼 트렌드를 모니터링하여 그로스 전략을 제안해요.

Requirements

• 5년 이상의 UA·그로스 마케팅 실무 경험이 있으신 분 (유료 광고 기획·집행·최적화 경험 필수)
• Meta Ads, Google Ads 등 주요 디지털 광고 플랫폼을 직접 운영해 본 경험이 있으신 분
• Adjust, AppsFlyer 등 Attribution Tool을 능숙하게 활용하며, 데이터 기반으로 캠페인과 퍼널을 개선해 본 경험이 있으신 분
• 일본 문화와 현지 트렌드에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로, 현지 광고 소재의 방향성을 스스로 정의할 수 있는 분
• 광고 소재의 핵심 메시지(미닝팩터)를 발굴하고 크리에이티브 인사이트로 연결할 수 있는 분
• 비즈니스 레벨 이상의 일본어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분

Preferred

• 일본 시장을 타겟으로 한 모바일 앱, 엔터테인먼트, 콘텐츠 플랫폼 UA·그로스 마케팅 경험이 있으신 분
• 일본의 최신 SNS 트렌드 및 크리에이터 문화에 대한 높은 이해도가 있으신 분
• 광고 에이전시와의 협업 및 프로젝트 매니징 경험이 있으신 분
• GA4, Tableau 등 데이터 분석 및 시각화 툴 활용 경험이 있으신 분
• AI 툴을 활용해 소재 기획, 리서치, 실무 효율을 개선해 본 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

[스푼랩스는 어떻게 일하나요? 여기에 답이 있어요]

Work Hard. Win Together.
밤낮을 넘어 치열히, 원팀으로 끝까지.

완벽보다 속도, 고민보다 실행.
스푼랩스는 빠르게 시도하고, 실패는 안고 다시 달립니다.
결국 답에 닿을 때까지 몰입합니다.

밤낮을 넘는 긴 몰입의 시간,
끝없는 시도와 수정으로 답에 다가섭니다.
속도는 빠르고, 기준은 높고, 불확실성은 큽니다.
누군가에게 이곳은 버거울 수 있지만,
우리는 그 안에서 치열하게 성장하며 한 걸음 더 나아갑니다.

더 멀리 나아가기 위해
앞서가되 독주하지 않고,
함께할 때 더 단단하기에
서로를 믿고 배우며, 겸손하게 성장합니다.

우리는 '편한 일'을 약속하지 않습니다. '압도적 성장'을 약속합니다.
단순한 일이 아닌, 내 인생과 세상을 바꾸는 전력 질주의 무대.
몰입과 끈기로 성장할 준비가 된 사람을 환영합니다.

• 스푼랩스 공식 홈페이지 - https://www.spoonlabs.com/kr/
• 스푼랩스 문화 블로그 - https://brunch.co.kr/@spoonlabs#articles
• 스푼랩스 테크 블로그 - https://medium.com/spoontech
• 스푼랩스 링크드인 - https://www.linkedin.com/company/spoonlabs/
• 스푼랩스 인스타그램 - https://www.instagram.com/spoonlabs_careers/

=====

[몰입하고, 성장할 수 있도록 이런 제도가 준비되어 있어요]

[성장을 위한 제도] 끊임없이 도전하고 더 나은 결과를 만들어내는 구성원을 위해
• 월 10만원 한도의 자기계발비 지원
• 월 20만원 한도의 일본어, 영어, 한국어 외국어 학습비 지원
• AWS re:Invent, Digital Marketing Summit, MAU Conference 등 업무 관련 국내외 교육 및 세미나 참석 지원
• 우리 같이 공부해요! 사내 스터디 모임 지원
• 사내 도서관 운영 및 신청 도서 구매
• 입사자와 추천자 모두 후한 보상을! 사내 직원 추천 제도
우리는 빠르게 배우고, 더 나은 방향으로 스스로 성장하는 사람들이 함께 모인 팀입니다.

[일하는 방식] 몰입과 실행의 밀도를 높이기 위해
• 해외 법인에서 근무하는 오피스 익스체인지 프로그램
• 창의적 몰입을 위한 워케이션 프로그램
• 오전 8시~10시 사이 자유롭게 출근하는 자율출근제
• 열심히 일하고 안전하게 퇴근해야죠. 야근 식비 및 택시비 지원
• 월요일은 4시간의 몰입을! 더욱 집중해서 몰입하는 주 4.5일제
우리는 더 깊이, 함께 몰입할 수 있는 환경을 선택합니다.

[함께하는 팀을 위한 환경] 치열하게 일한 만큼, 서로를 챙기기 위해
• 든든히 드세요. 아침 식사 제공 및 점심 식비 지원
• 함께해 주셔서 감사해요! 근속 기간별 리프레시 휴가 및 휴가비 지원
• 에너지는 항상 충전되어야 하니까. 무제한 카페테리아 운영
• 생일을 진심으로 축하합니다. 생일자를 위한 반반차 휴가
• 개개인의 일상에도 진심을 담아, 경조 휴가 및 경조비 지원
• 개인 근무 일정에 맞게 알아서 사용하는 휴가/반반차 제도
• 무엇보다 건강이 우선이죠. 연 1회 종합건강검진 제공
• 강남역 역세권의 깔끔하고 세련된 사무실
• 힘들 땐 잠시 쉬어요. 고급 안마의자, 게임기, 다트, 탁구대 구비
치열하게 일한 만큼, 재충전도 중요하니까. 우리는 일하는 순간뿐 아니라, 그 사이사이도 함께 고민합니다.

title: Bliv en del af 7-Eleven familien som butiksassistent
description:
Bliv en del af 7-Eleven familien som Butiksassistent

Er du en energisk og engageret person, der trives i et dynamisk miljø, hvor ingen dage er ens? Har du lyst til at være en del af et globalt brand, hvor der er højt til loftet og masser af plads til personlig og faglig udvikling? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye butiksassistent hos 7-Eleven!

Om jobbet

Som butiksassistent hos 7-Eleven på Fælledvej 27 kommer du til at spille en central rolle i at skabe gode oplevelser for vores kunder.

Din dag vil være fyldt med alsidige opgaver, hvor du blandt andet vil stå for:

  • Kundebetjening: Sikre en imødekommende og professionel service, der får vores kunder til at føle sig velkomne.

  • Tilberedning af fødevarer: Herunder mad, bageri og frisksmurte produkter. Du får lov til at bruge dine hænder og lærer hvordan vi sikrer høj kvalitet på vores produkter.

  • Trimning og vareopfyldning: Gøre butikken præsentabel ved at holde hylderne fyldte, så produkterne opleves indbydende.

  • Rengøring: Bidrage til et rent og hygiejnisk butiksmiljø med fokus på fødevaresikkerhed.

Hvad vi forventer af dig

Vi leder efter en medarbejder, der elsker at have mange bolde i luften, og som er optaget af at skabe den bedst mulige oplevelse for vores gæster.

Du trives med en hverdag, hvor tingene til tider kan gå stærkt, og hvor det er vigtigt at holde hovedet koldt og altid at have et smil på læben.

Derfor skal du vælge 7-Eleven

  1. Højt til loftet og konkret feedback: Vi tilbyder et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til at tænke nyt og forbedre sig, og hvor du som medarbejder bliver set og hørt.

  2. Plads til udvikling: Hos os vil du få mulighed for at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt, og vi støtter dig på rejsen.

  3. Unge kollegaer: Bliv en del af et ungt og dynamisk team, hvor arbejdsglæde og sammenhold er i fokus.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du klar til at blive en del af vores spændende arbejdsplads? Send din ansøgning og CV via mail direkte til Købmand Pelle Garly senest den 31. august 2026.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og glæder os til en spændende opstart. Dato for opstart aftales efter ansættelse, men vil som udgangspunkt være hurtigst muligt.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Pelle Garly på pelle.garly@7-eleven.dk

Stillingen er både ledig som fuldtids- og deltidsbeskæftigelse, så vi er fleksible i forhold til dine behov.

Grib chancen og bliv en del af 7-Eleven – hvor hver dag bringer nye muligheder!

Målet er klart – vi vil være dem i "klassen”, der sætter standarderne inden for convenience og vi skal motivere til vinderkultur!

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Vi tilbyder muligheden for at blive en del af et godt team af gode og glade kollegaer, ansvar og afvekslende opgaver.

Stillingen vil indebære vagter i tidsrummet 08:00-16:00, 16:00-23:00, 22:00-04:00.

Kontrakten der tilbydes er på 15 timer, men der vil være mulighed for merarbejde.

Vi holder døgnåbent 365 dage om året, og juleaften og nytårsaften går således på skift og du skal forvente at arbejde den ene eller den anden dag.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold reguleres af butiksoverenskomsten samt særbestemmelser aftale med HK Handel.

Samtaler afholdes: Løbende
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale, dog senest 31/8/2026

Arbejdssted: Fælledvej 27, 2200 KBH N
Kontaktinformation: pelle.garly@7-eleven.dk

Med 184 butikker i Danmark har 7-Eleven manifesteret førerpositionen i conveniencesektoren, og med mere end 50.000 butikker i 116 lande er 7-Eleven verdens største convenience- og franchisekæde. Læs mere på eller .

title: Therapist - Outpatient Treatment Center
description:
Montare Behavioral Health is currently looking for Associate Therapists for its Mental Health and Substance Use PHP/IOP program in Encino!

The Therapist carries a diverse caseload and provides comprehensive counseling and therapeutic services including individual, group and family therapy, crisis intervention, and after care planning for clients receiving mental health and substance use treatment.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Responsible for individual, group and family counseling sessions
  • Conducts client psychosocial and risk assessments, develops and monitors the implementation of individualized treatment plans, carries out the client intake process, and is available to solve any pertinent issues.
  • Provide effective crisis management and intervention.
  • Collaborates with treatment team comprised of clinical staff, including the clinical director, program director and counselors.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of client care through charting and documenting client progress and provide service referrals when needed.
  • Maintain professional relationships with the staff, clients, families and visitors.
  • Perform any other duties as needed.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree from accredited social work, marriage and family therapy or psychology program.
  • Registration with State of California Board of Behavioral Health as an active associate or licensed therapist with number.
  • Experience in a residential or outpatient treatment facility preferred.
  • Able to work in a fast paced setting, under pressure while maintaining open and proper communication.
  • Ability to relate harmoniously with staff and clients of diverse ethnic and economic backgrounds
  • Good computer skills. Ability to navigate an Electronic Health Records System. Kipu experience a plus.
  • Demonstrate professionalism and strong boundaries with clients, their families, staff and visitors.

Hiring Requirements:

  1. Hiring is contingent upon completion of a Background Check, TB test, and clearance on a drug screen and pre-employment physical. Current First Aid and CPR certification or willing to obtain upon hire.
  2. For the mental health program additional requirements include receiving DOJ/FBI fingerprint clearance or an exemption and a submission of a signed Criminal Record Statement (LIC 508).

title: Pension Funds Analyst - Financial Institutions Services Team
description:
What you’ll do / Specialized Competencies

Audit Planning & pre-engagement, Substantive Testing and Audit Finalising activities which include and not limited to:

  • Identify operational & financial risks.
  • ABCOTDs.
  • Risk Assessment of the clients’ operating environment.
  • Analyse client financial statements.
  • Assess fraud risk.
  • Identify and design substantive audit procedures.

Experience

Technical Competencies:

  • Ability to multitask and meet deadlines.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Good communication skills- both with clients and staff members.
  • Time management.
  • Admin oriented.
  • Analytical.

Behavioural Competencies:

  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to make rational decisions.
  • Quick turnaround time.
  • Follow through and completion of tasks from beginning to end.
  • Highly adaptable – ability to react to situations and adjust change.
  • Ability to communicate with individuals on all levels.
  • Ability to work in a relatively structured environment.
