title: Teammate Apparel
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

Sport inspires us. Innovation drives us. Come Win With Us at DICK’S Sporting Goods as part of a team that redefines what’s possible.

Whether you live for sport or cozy fashion, you’ll love building your career at DICK’S. It’s more than a job — it’s a chance to be part of a team where you’re welcomed, supported, and empowered from day one. In our stores, you’ll make a real difference by delivering exceptional experiences to athletes of all abilities. If you’re coachable, accountable, collaborative, and trustworthy, this is the place for you. Win with us every time you step onto the floor.

Create an engaging and confidence-building shopping experience by helping athletes find the right apparel for performance and everyday life. As a Teammate – Apparel, you will deliver strong service, merchandise expertise, and contribute to a team-first environment. Bring style, comfort, and performance together for every athlete.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Greet everyone (Teammates and Athletes) and proactively approach athletes to understand their needs and support their shopping experience by providing helpful, accurate product knowledge and customer service.
  • Uphold company merchandising and presentation standards by following established floor sets, signage requirements, price changes, inventory presentation and replenishment standards, etc.
  • Promote company programs (i.e., customer loyalty program participation, warranty sales, private label credit card enrollment, etc.).
  • Adhere to established policies and procedures related to safety, loss prevention and standard operating procedures, as well as to laws and guidelines of external governing entities, including those of the Federal ATF.
  • Create an inclusive store environment where everyone (Teammates & Athletes) feels welcome, safe, and is treated with respect.
  • Take an all-hands-on-deck approach to support the team across the store. Performs other tasks as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent

VIRTUAL REQUIREMENTS:

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.

  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.

  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

Targeted Pay Range: $12.50 - $19.50. Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, location, experience and position offered. The actual hourly rate will equal or exceed the required minimum wage applicable to the job location.DICK'S Sporting Goods complies with all state paid leave requirements. We also offer a generous suite of benefits. To learn more, visit www.benefityourliferesources.com.

title: Terminalarbetare och Budbilschaufför sökes i Luleå
description:
TERMINALARBETARE OCH BUDBILSCHAUFFÖR INSTABEE LULEÅ (DELTID)

Instabox Luleå behöver förstärka sin arbetsstyrka och söker just nu duktiga terminalarbetare och budbilschaufförer till sin terminal.

OM INSTABOX

Instabox är ett tech/logistik företag som vill förändra branschen för en smartare och fossilfri framtid. Det ska vara okrångligt att handla på nätet och därför erbjuder Instabox ett snabbt och smidigt leveransalternativ, allt för att göra vardagen enklare. Instabox startade i Stockholm 2015 och finns nu runt om i Norden samt Tyskland.

UPPDRAGSBESKRIVNING

Som terminalarbetare/chaufför arbetar du i Instabox terminal där det inkommer tusentals paket som skall lastas om, sorteras och skickas ut för leverans. Arbetet består av både maskinell och manuell sortering i olika grad och beror på var du arbetar. Även utkörning av paket. Häri ligger att säkerställa att verksamheten fortskrider utan hinder genom att noggrant se till så att gods kommer in och ut ur terminalen enligt tidtabell. Arbetet passar dig som studerar på minst 50%, alternativt har ett annat jobb på minst 50%.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Sortering - Scanning - Plockning - Budbilskörning

OBS! Notera att du i denna tjänst kommer att behöva hantera även lådor med alkohol.

VAD FÖRVÄNTAS AV DIG

Som terminalarbetare/chaufför trivs du med ett tempofyllt, ansvarsfullt och utmanande arbete. Arbetet innehåller en hel del tunga moment och sker i ett högt tempo, vilket innebär att god fysik är en förutsättning. Även förmåga att hantera IT-hjälpmedel är bra egenskaper. Att du upplevs som positiv och professionell är viktigt – Instabox förväntar sig god service och hög kvalitet. Som person är du punktlig, noggrann och sprider en positiv stämning omkring dig. Du är en naturlig problemlösare och älskar utmaningar.

ARBETSTID

Du förväntas kunna jobba ca 3 dagar/vecka måndag - fredag. Arbetstiderna kan variera men är oftast 06:00-10:00 eller 06:00-15:00.

OBS! Du behöver ha tillgång till bil för att kunna ta dig till terminalen.

KRAV

  • Du måste ha fyllt 18 år
  • B-körkort
  • God förståelse för Microsoft Office
  • Goda datorkunskaper
  • Stark lagspelare
  • God fysik
  • Goda språkkunskaper i svenska eller engelska (skriftligt och verbalt)
  • Du är studerande eller har annan sysselsättning (annat jobb) på minst 50%
  • Bakgrundskontroll – Nolltolerans mot förekommande i brottsregister

MERITERANDE

  • Erfarenhet av liknande arbete

ANSTÄLLNINGSFORM

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning (deltid vid behov).

title: Wealth Advisor - PNC Wealth Management
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a(n) [position title] within PNC's [name of division] organization, you will be based in [city/state location of position].PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Consults on investment and insurance strategies, as well as the development of financial plans for clients. Grows and retains an investment and insurance book of business. Owns the client experience, efficiently handling sales and service, identifying sales and/or executing opportunities and making referrals to internal business partners as appropriate.
  • Acquires, expands and maintains client relationships through business development and client networking. Grows client loyalty and share of wallet through an exceptional client experience. Applies product and procedural knowledge to solve client problems appropriately and efficiently.
  • Develops and implements investment and insurance strategies for clients. Determines the best products to support such strategies. Presents sound financial recommendations and guidance to clients. Establishes individual financial plans based on client financial needs and objectives. Monitors financial plans and recommends changes as needed.
  • Actively and regularly coaches and educates internal business partners to identify investment opportunities. Drives investment education and visibility among internal business partners. Shows urgency with activities and leads by example. Has regular and effective communication with internal and external partners to build strong relationships that drive referral activity.
  • Regularly meets with internal business partners to communicate and review business results and pipeline management. Meets service level agreements on lead and referral follow up. Adheres to all applicable laws, regulations, policies and guidelines.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Client Prospecting, Client Relationship Building, Credit Risk Analysis, Customer Engagement, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Investment Banking, Public Speaking, Relationship Building, Relationship Management

Competencies

Coaching Others, Customer Experience Management., Customer Retention, Effective Communications, Interpersonal Relationships, Managing Multiple Priorities, Prospecting., Sales Tasks And Activities, Selling.

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

FINRA Series 7 and 66 (or 63,65) required. Life and Health Insurance required.

Pay Transparency

Base Salary: $70,125.00 – $116,875.00Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.

Application Window

Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 08/09/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit .

Disability Accommodations Statement

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.


At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)


PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history.

California Residents

Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

title: M365 Purview Engineer
description:
Collaboration Services M365 Purview Engineer, Assistant Vice President

Location: Krakow, Poland

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who we are looking for

State Street is looking for an M365 Purview Engineer to become part of our Collaboration Services team. We are looking for an engineer with deep experience in Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Defender solution suites that also has experience with other M365 applications including Exchange, Teams and SharePoint. Working with your tower lead as well as with various tower leads, engineers & operations team members, the M365 Purview engineer will be primarily responsible requirement gathering, solution engineering, documentation and support for Purview and Defender solutions across the enterprise. This person will need to support end user communities for the solutions in Purview and Defender.

What you will be responsible for

As the Collaboration Services M365 Purview Engineer you will

  • Contributing to and documenting technical standards.
  • Work with and help support business units that are direct users of the solutions.
  • Work directly with M365 application engineers to assist their integrations to Purview and Defender.
  • Provide technical support to the Collaboration Services operations team.
  • Provide technical documentation for operations
  • Provide support to key business units like legal, records management, privacy and cyber security to support their usage.
  • Contribute to the data governance initiatives
  • Prepare for, and take part in, internal audit activities
  • Work with your Tower lead on product roadmap and future state planning
  • Working across towers to continuously evaluate and improve our data governance and data security postures.
  • Provide L5 support in the event of major incidents.
  • Work to reduce tech debt; routinely look for and offer up rationalization proposals
  • Document implementation steps for solutions like records management and data lifecycle management.
  • Create User guides for solutions that end users interact with.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Deep knowledge and experience with multiple Purview/Defender solution and fundamental understanding of all of them.
  • Knowledge about Unified Communications / Collaboration industry standards & trends
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, M365 application suite, conditional access policies, Microsoft Teams, Azure B2B and external collaboration
  • Ability to work independently as well as lead others toward a common goal.
  • Energetic self-starter who is a detailed and organized critical thinker and problem solver
  • Understanding that good documentation is fundamentally important
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills

Note: The role requires a minimum of three days per week working from the office

Minimum Salary:​

zł182,004 Annual

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.​

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.​

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.​

​

We Offer:​

  • Permanent contract from day one​

  • Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)​

  • Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children)​

  • Premium life insurance package and private pension plan​

  • Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs​

  • Opportunities to volunteer your time to company-driven initiatives, employee networks or organizations of your choice​

  • Variety of well-being programs​

  • Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Software Developer
description:
Software Developer 3

Location: Nashville, TN, United States

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the future of cloud for enterprises. We combine the speed, ownership, and innovation mindset of a start-up with the scale, security, and customer focus of one of the world’s leading enterprise technology companies.

OCI provides the opportunity to build and operate large-scale, highly available cloud services in a globally distributed, multi-tenant environment. Our services power mission-critical workloads for customers tackling some of the world’s most complex business and technology challenges. Engineers at OCI have deep technical ownership and broad business impact, designing and operating systems that form the foundation of modern cloud infrastructure.

Our team owns one of OCI’s foundational control-plane storage services. The service provides a strongly consistent, highly available, transactional key-value store used by OCI services to persist and manage critical control-plane metadata. It is a tier-0 platform service that supports core OCI services across regions and realms, with strict transaction semantics, predictable performance goals, scalable data-plane architecture, streaming, garbage collection, cost-based throttling, and ongoing evolution of its storage and data models. The team’s mission is to simplify how OCI service teams build reliable control planes by abstracting database complexity while enforcing safe, consistent, and scalable access patterns.

We are looking for hands-on, senior technical leaders with deep expertise and passion for distributed systems, databases, storage infrastructure, transaction processing, and highly available services. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will help define and build the next generation of OCI control-plane storage. You will work on challenging problems such as read/write scalability, strict serializability, multi-version concurrency control, data-plane architecture, operational automation, performance isolation, resiliency, and global service growth.This is an opportunity to influence the architecture of a critical OCI platform service, mentor engineers, drive large technical initiatives, and build systems that directly impact the reliability and scalability of Oracle Cloud. The team is growing, the technical challenges are deep, and the work is central to OCI’s ability to operate cloud services safely at massive scale.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

The team owns a tier-0 distributed storage service that serves as the metadata backbone for OCI control-plane services. Our mission is to provide safe, strongly consistent, highly available, and predictable storage primitives that allow OCI services to build reliable cloud-scale control planes without directly managing database complexity. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive the next generation of architecture, including scalable data-plane design, predictable read performance, cost-aware throttling, operational excellence, and resilient service evolution across OCI regions.

title: [헤트라스] 북미 마케팅 파트장급
description:
About

[Story of hetras]
헤트라스는 2021년에 설립된 라이프스타일 브랜드입니다.
우리는 기교 부리지 않은 향으로 본연의 힘을 깨우는 리추얼을 만듭니다.
지속 가능한 내일을 위해 안전하고 건강한 원료 기반의 제품군을 선보이며, 대한민국을 넘어 유럽·미주·홍콩·일본 등 글로벌 온·오프라인 리테일을 통해 전 세계 소비자와 만남으로써 브랜드의 가능성을 무한히 넓혀가고 있습니다.

서울의 안국 오프라인 매장을 시작으로 더욱 감각적이고 미학적인 헤트라스만의 브랜드 경험을 함께 만들어갈 재능 넘치는 인재들의 참여를 기다립니다.
창의적이고 유연한 마인드, 건강한 에너지를 지닌 사람들과 후각을 통해 사적인 추억이 스며드는 공감각적인 매력을 함께 느끼며 브랜드의 가능성을 넓혀가는 동시에 우리의 일상을 더 특별하고 가치있게 만들어가고 싶습니다.

우리는 자연으로부터 지속 가능한 삶에 대한 고찰의 답을 찾기에 내 몸을 위한 최우선의 정직한 제품, 무수히 많은 색, 감정을 담고 있는 향기 그리고 삶에 영감이 되는 다양한 시각의 메시지로 전달되는 완성도 높은 브랜드 경험의 힘을 믿습니다.

자연스레 스며들어 일상적이지만 존재감은 뚜렷한 브랜드, 우리는 '헤트라스' 입니다.
• 자사 홈페이지 : www.hetras.co.kr

Responsibilities

[쑥쑥컴퍼니의 북미 마케팅 파트장급 담당자는?]
북미 시장에 맞는 마케팅을 기획하고 실행하며, 다양한 채널을 통해 소비자와 브랜드를 연결하고 브랜드 성과를 만들어가는 역할을 수행합니다.

[합류하시면 이런 일을 하실 거에요]
• 북미 채널별 최적화 마케팅 기획 및 운영
• 북미 인플루언서 협업 마케팅 전략 수립 및 파트너십 관리
• 미국 향 광고 소재 기획·집행을 통한 매체별 전환 광고 최적화
• 북미 시장·소비자·콘텐츠 트렌드 분석을 통한 소구점 발굴 및 개선안 도출

Requirements

[이런 분과 함께 성장하고 싶어요]
• 3년 이상의 뷰티 또는 소비재 산업에서 북미 마케팅 경험을 보유하신 분
• 팀 리딩 또는 중간 관리자로서 업무를 핸들링 해보신 분
• 구매 전환형 콘텐츠에 대한 이해도와 기획 역량이 높으신 분
• 데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 마케팅 전략을 수립할 수 있는 분

Preferred

[이런 경험이 있으시다면 더욱 좋아요]
• 비즈니스 레벨 이상의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
• TikTok Shop, Amazon 등 주요 이커머스 채널에 대한 트렌드를 빠르게 캐치하시는 분
• 북미 인플루언서 커뮤니티 및 네트워크에 강점이 있으신 분
• 팀 리딩 경험 또는 북미 시장에서 브랜드 또는 채널 성장을 주도적으로 이끌어보신 분
• 국내 마케팅에서 해외 마케팅 업무 영역을 확장하고 싶으신 분

Benefits

Benefits (복리후생)
• 해외여행 항공권 지원 (연 1회 200만원 한도)
• 자사 제품 할인 제도 운영 (40% 이상)
• 유연한 휴가 사용 (연차, 반차, 반반차)
• 생일 휴가 지원
• 명절 선물 및 개인 경조사비 제공
• 반려견 동반 출근 가능
• 팀 회식비 지원
• 사내 스낵바 운영

Condition (근무조건 및 환경)
• 근무 시간 : 월~금, 09:30~18:30 (점심시간 12:30~13:40)
• 근무 장소 : 본사 단독 사옥 (서울 서초구 사평대로55길 82-7)
• 근무 형태 : 정규직 (수습기간 3개월, 급여 100% 지급)

Vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende




Vi tilbyder


Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du:

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 151,52 kr. i timen som faglært og 142,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst fra HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit motiverede CV!

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. Vi værdsætter vores medarbejderes mangfoldighed og fremmer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor hver enkelt føler sig velkommen og respekteret. Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.

Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
   




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

title: Technology Service Owner
description:
Create your best future and join Westpac as a Technology Service Owner.

What’s the role?

Ready to shape the future of Business Lending technology?

As Technology Service Owner, you'll lead a portfolio of critical applications that power Business Lending while helping drive one of the bank's most exciting transformation agendas. From digital replatforming and platform modernisation through to emerging technologies and engineering uplift, you'll have the opportunity to influence both strategy and execution.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll partner closely with engineers, architects, business stakeholders and senior technology leaders to deliver resilient, scalable and customer focused solutions. You'll lead a team of engineers and system analysts, guide technical decision making, and help create an environment where innovation thrives.

Based in Sydney / Warrane, Gadigal Country, this is a permanent hybrid role with an expectation of 2 to 3 days per week in our Barangaroo office.

What do I need?

• Strong technical background in software engineering, solution design or architecture within large scale enterprise environments.

• Experience working across modern technology stacks, APIs, microservices, cloud platforms and system integrations.

• Ability to provide technical guidance and influence engineering decisions across complex technology landscapes.

• Strong people leadership skills with experience coaching teams and building capability.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage confidently with senior technology and business leaders.

Why join us?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

• Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee only mortgage rates
• Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave
• Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank
• Lots of opportunities to give back to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives

Create your future today

To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button

We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page, under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.

 Oplysning om indsamling af dine personoplysninger:

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.


Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.


Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.


Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.


Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.


Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.


Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

Ansøg

Få et forspring i entreprenørbranchen og kom i praktik som projektleder hos airteam.

Er du nysgerrig på at finde ud af, hvordan et projekt på tegnebrættet bliver til en realitet på byggepladsen? Har du interesse for teknisk ventilation og projektledelse, og er du i gang med en uddannelse som maskin- eller bygningsingeniør, bygningskonstruktør eller maskinmester? 

I airteam er vi på udkig efter studerende, der ønsker en praktikplads som projektleder i en af vores 9 afdelinger i Danmark.

Vi søger løbende praktikanter. Praktikperioden kan vare mellem 10 og 20 uger alt afhængig af, hvilken uddannelse du er i gang med.

Prøv kræfter med en projektleders opgaver:

Hos airteam får du rig mulighed for at styrke din faglige værktøjskasse. Du vil indgå på lige fod med vores erfarne projektledere, som dagligt udvikler komplekse indeklimaløsninger til f.eks. hoteller, hospitaler, industri, boliger og kontorbygninger m.fl.

Praktikperioden er lærende og udviklende for dig, der har interesse i:

projektledelse, økonomi- og byggestyring på entrepriser

projektering og beregning af tekniske ventilationsløsninger

kvalitetssikring, tidsstyring og indkøb

beregning af tilbud

kommunikation med entreprenører, rådgivere, brugere, leverandører og underentreprenører

I vores udvælgelse af hvem der skal have en praktikplads, lægger vi vægt på, at du:

læser en relevant uddannelse

er interesseret i at udvikle dine kompetencer

har en positiv, serviceminded og grundig tilgang til løsning af enhver opgave

arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og detaljeorienteret

Om at være i praktik hos airteam:

På vores hjemmeside airteam.dk, kan du læse om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos airteam. Du kan også læse om, hvad nogle af vores praktikanter har arbejdet med under deres praktikperiode hos os.

Praktikanter inviteres med på introdage på hovedkontoret i Viby på lige fod med øvrige medarbejdere. 

Kontakt og ansøgning:

Har du spørgsmål til praktikforløbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner Lotte Malberg på mobil 4199 0221. Det er vigtigt, at du i din ansøgning anfører, hvor i landet du ønsker at komme i praktik.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtale med relevante ansøgere.

Vi er klar til at modtage en spændende ansøgning fra dig, hvor du fortæller os, hvorfor det lige netop er dig, der skal have en af vores praktikpladser. 

Upload ansøgning og evt. CV gennem via "ansøg" knappen nedenfor.

title: Security – Armed Response Officer
description:
The Protective Services Officer – 2 (PSO2) is an armed security professional primarily assigned to a designated security zone containing one or more controlled entry points. PSO2 maintains a continuous armed presence within the assigned zone and is responsible for access control, screening operations, deterrence, and prevention of unauthorized entry.

PSO2 personnel focus on monitoring controlled areas, detecting prohibited items, verifying credentials, and maintaining a visible and professional security presence. Their primary responsibility is to maintain an armed presence at, or in close proximity to, their assigned entrance to ensure consistent access control and screening. As a secondary function, PSO2 personnel may conduct limited roving within their assigned zone-based area. While they may respond to incidents when directed or when immediate action is required, they must return to their primary entrance post upon completing the response.

This position requires vigilance, procedural compliance, and the ability to maintain controlled access environments while upholding Forbes Five-Star service standards.

Essential Duties

  • Maintain a continuous armed presence within an assigned security zone containing one or more entry points.
  • Monitor and control access to designated areas to deter, detect, and intercept potential threats.
  • Conduct visual inspections of individuals and property entering controlled areas.
  • Enforce established screening and access control procedures in accordance with department policy.
  • Confiscate restricted items or initiate proper check-in procedures as required.
  • Provide medical assistance when required.
  • Respond to calls for service when directed or when immediate action within the assigned zone is required; return to assigned security zone upon resolution.
  • Provide limited support during executive protection operations when a PSO3 is unavailable, returning immediately to the assigned zone and not assuming PSO3‑level responsibilities, as directed by management.
  • Prepare accurate and detailed incident reports in accordance with departmental standards.
  • May perform the essential duties of PSO1 classification when operationally necessary.
  • Any other duties assigned by management.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Four (4) years of experience obtained from any combination of law enforcement, military service, or relevant armed security. Candidates with law enforcement or military backgrounds are strongly preferred.
  • High school graduate or equivalent required; college graduate preferred.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Nevada Carrying Concealed Weapon (CCW) permit or HR 218 certification (or ability to obtain within six months).
  • Nevada Gaming Registration.
  • Alcohol Awareness (AES) Card.
  • First Aid certification.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
  • CPR certification.
  • Valid Nevada Driver’s License.

Training & Compliance

  • Successful completion of firearms, defensive tactics, and use-of-force training.
  • Successful completion of pre-hire physical fitness and psychological evaluation.
  • Must be 21 years of age or older.

Core Competencies

  • Ability to maintain vigilance and alertness within a designated security zone.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow established screening and access control procedures.
  • Must possess strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to accurately recall, articulate, and document incident details in written and verbal formats.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently and professionally; additional languages are helpful.
  • Working knowledge of basic computer programs (Word, Excel, Outlook, and incident reporting systems).

title: ERP Business Analyst - Tax Management
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The ERP Tax Management team acts as a technical partner, managing digital solutions for indirect tax, direct tax, and transfer pricing. This multi-cultural, dynamic group leverages a mix of complementary skills to navigate and implement new tax mandates across the globe. Their primary mission is to design standardized global templates that provide a consistent digital framework for the entire organization. Simultaneously, they must remain agile enough to adapt these templates to meet unique local requirements for different affiliates. By bridging the gap between tax law and IT systems, they ensure seamless compliance across all international entities. They are responsible for the end-to-end delivery of technical mandates that protect the company's global financial position.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will be a key driver in our digital tax transformation, ensuring our global operations remain compliant and efficient. Your mission is to bridge the gap between complex tax laws and innovative IT systems within a dynamic team environment.

  • Design Automated Logic: You will analyze intricate business requirements to design and deliver advanced automated tax determination logic within SAP S/4HANA using condition techniques.

  • Drive Cross-Module Integration: You will ensure seamless integration of tax requirements across SD, MM, and FI modules to maintain consistent tax treatment throughout the entire supply chain.

  • Lead Digital Reporting: You will support the technical setup for local statutory requirements, focusing on high-impact areas like real-time reporting and e-invoicing (e.g., SDI, CFDI).

  • Manage Tax Engines: You will configure and maintain critical interfaces between SAP and external tax engines such as ONESOURCE or Sovos for real-time, accurate rate calculations.

  • Bridge Business and IT: You will act as the primary liaison, translating complex global tax laws into clear, actionable functional specifications for technical teams.

  • Ensure System Quality: You will lead comprehensive end-to-end testing cycles, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

  • Mitigate Global Risk: You will proactively resolve complex production issues where tax calculations or e-invoice submissions fail in high-volume transaction environments.

  • Foster Innovation: You will contribute to the evolution of our global standardized templates, balancing consistency with the agility needed for local affiliate requirements.

Who you are

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives on the intersection of technology and finance. You bring a meticulous approach to compliance and a passion for optimizing digital frameworks.

  • Experienced Professional: You possess a minimum of 8+ years of hands-on implementation experience, including at least two full project lifecycles as an SAP SD/MM functional consultant.

  • Academic Foundation: You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or an equivalent field of study.

  • Tax Subject Matter Expert: You have expert knowledge of SAP Indirect Tax (VAT/GST) setup, with deep experience in complex EU tax rules within large MNC environments.

  • Technical Troubleshooter: You possess strong ABAP debugging skills, allowing you to effectively troubleshoot complex tax calculation and interface issues.

  • Regulatory Tech Specialist: You have experience implementing e-invoice submission frameworks; familiarity with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) is a significant plus.

  • Collaborative Communicator: You demonstrate excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across a multi-cultural environment.

  • Language Proficient: You are fluent in English (written and verbal), which is essential for our global collaboration and documentation. #RDT2026

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Pune. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Østdanmark - uopfordret (timelønnede) hos Kongsvang
description:
Østdanmark - uopfordret (timelønnede) hos Kongsvang





  




















































































Vil du være en del af Kongsvang teamet i Østdanmark?
Søg uopfordret i Næstved, Slagelse, Ringsted/Køge, Helsingør, Holbæk, Kalundborg og København-området.




I Kongsvang er vi konstant på udkig efter nye, dygtige kollegaer, som vil være med til at løfte servicebranchens kvalitet og ydelser samt gøre en stor forskel for de arbejdspladser, som vi hver dag løser serviceopgaver for. 




Dertil søger vi løbende kvalificerede:

Servicemedarbejdere: Vores servicemedarbejderes primære arbejdsopgave er at sørge for en ren helhed hos kunden - gennem daglig rengøring af eget område og egenkontrol heraf. Som en af hverdagens helte er du som servicemedarbejder således med til at opretholde og højne Kongsvangs serviceniveau - og dermed sikre høj kundetilfredshed.

Kvalitetsassistenter: Vores kvalitetsassistenters vigtigste opgave er, udover daglig rengøring af eget område, at sikre den rene helhed og have fokus på den samlede kvalitet hos kunden. Som kvalitetsassistent har du derfor daglig kontakt med servicemedarbejderne samt kundes kontaktperson på stedet. Kvalitetsopfølgning er således en fast del af dit arbejde.

Tilsynsassistenter: Vores tilsynsassistenters vigtigste opgave er at levere kvalitetsbevidst og ordentlig rengøring samt at føre tilsyn af eget og kollegaers arbejde. Som tilsynsassistent agerer du "højre hånd" for din nærmeste leder og udvalgte kunder, hvor du dels har manuelt rengøringsarbejde og dels ugentlig tilsynstid. Du står derfor for den daglige ledelse - og det er dit ansvar at sørge for en ren helhed hos kunden og herved sikre en høj kundetilfredshed.




Hvem er du? 


Selvstændig, kvalitetsbevidst og ordentlig i dit arbejde


Præsentabel i dit ydre og serviceminded


Kan arbejde alene og i teams med andre


Stabil, loyal og fleksibel


Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk og/eller som minimum engelsk


Kan fremvise straffeattest og børneattest


Rengøringserfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav


Skriv gerne, hvis du før har arbejdet med tilsynsopgaver eller lignende





Hvad kan vi tilbyde?


Deltid eller fuldtid, primært i morgentimerne (fra kl.05.00 og frem) eller eftermiddags/aftentimerne (fra kl.14.00 og frem).


Rengøringsarbejde under ordnede arbejdsforhold


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst


En god og ordentlig introduktion til arbejdet


Kursus i forbindelse med din opstart


Sundhedsordning i forbindelse med medlemskab af Pension Danmark


Mulighed for ansvarsopgaver med tilsyn og ledelse af teams





Fristet?  

Så send os din ansøgning og bliv en del af vores jobbank. Husk at tydeliggøre i hvilket geografisk område du søger. Vi kontakter dig, hvis/når der er et match mellem dine ønsker og en ledig stilling. 




Søg nu




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!













































Kongsvang Cleaning & Facility A/S er mere end bare en rengøringsvirksomhed - vi er en multikulturel arbejdsplads med hjerte og handlekraft. Vi brænder for at skabe de bedste arbejdsbetingelser for vores medarbejdere og levere førsteklasses serviceløsninger til vores kunder. Hos os bliver du en del af en dynamisk arbejdsplads, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, trivsel og faglig udvikling højt.

Vores medarbejdere er hverdagens helte, fordi de hver dag gør en forskel med en støvsuger, klud og et smil. De er vores vigtigste ressource, og vi er utrolig stolte af vores medarbejdere, der repræsenterer mange forskellige nationaliteter, baggrunde og faggrupper. Uanset om du er ny eller erfaren i branchen hjælper vi dig godt i gang med rengøringsfagligt kursus og personlig oplæring på din arbejdsplads. Vi hjælper også gerne med danskundervisning, hvis sproget driller.

Vores mål er ikke kun at levere effektiv rengøring, men at gøre en forskel i samfundet, for vores medmennesker og for en mere bæredygtig fremtid.




























































































Tag dit næste karriereskridt med Kongsvang












































Om Kongsvang
Kongsvang Cleaning & Facility A/S er en dansk, ejerledet servicevirksomhed grundlagt i 1998. Vi tilbyder Business-to-Business (B2B) serviceydelser til offentlige og private erhvervskunder i hele Danmark. Med mere end 27 års erfaring og et stærkt fokus på ordentlighed, ansvarlighed og kvalitet har vi opbygget en position som en af Danmarks førende servicevirksomheder.




Vi ønsker at være både den bedste serviceleverandør og en attraktiv arbejdsplads. Derfor udfører vi alle rengøringsopgaver med egne uddannede og oplærte medarbejdere - uden brug af underleverandører. Vi sikrer, at alle vores medarbejdere arbejder under ordentlige forhold i overensstemmelse med danske overenskomster, med fokus på fair løn og et sundt arbejdsmiljø. Gennem uddannelse, tydelige karrieremuligheder og gratis danskundervisning hjælper vi vores medarbejdere med at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt, så de kan føle sig hjemme på både arbejdspladsen og i samfundet.




Hos os handler det om mere end rengøring - vi lægger vægt på ordentlighed, samfundsansvar og bæredygtighed i alt vi foretager os. Vi ønsker, at vores arbejde skal skabe værdi for vores kunder, medarbejdere og samfundet. Derfor arbejder vi med respekt for miljøet, social ansvarlighed og høj kvalitet i alle processer.




































Svanemærket rengøringsservice
Kongsvang er certificeret Svanemærket Rengøringsservice, hvilket betyder, at vi tager vores miljømæssige ansvar alvorligt. Vi arbejder målrettet for at reducere vores miljøaftryk gennem ansvarlige indkøb, genanvendelige materialer og grønne initiativer. Vores ambition er at gøre den grønne omstilling til en konkret og håndgribelig del af hverdagen - både for os selv og vores kunder.
















Flad organisationsstruktur
Hos Kongsvang er medarbejderudvikling en kerneværdi, og derfor har vi en transparent karrierestige, stort fokus på passioneret og synlig ledelse, og plads til store visioner. Mange af vores ledere har startet deres karrierejse som servicemedarbejder, og taget deres viden og erfaring med sig hele vejen til toppen. Og netop derfor er det ikke unormalt at ens leder afløser ved sygdom eller at man bliver oplært af direktøren selv.
















Mangfoldig er en styrke
Vores medarbejdere repræsenterer 70 nationaliteter og taler mange forskellige sprog. Vi er bredt sammensat af forskellige baggrunde - og det er vi stolte af!

title: Equipment Technician (Electrical)
description:
An experienced pharmaceutical/medical device Electrician is required to carry out planned/unplanned maintenance across, Implants manufacturing and packaging. You will work as part of a strong multi-disciplined team of Fitters, Electricians, Process and Mechatronic Engineers. We have a strong emphasis on identifying opportunities for improvements and efficiency. Our primary objective is the consistent supply of safe, first class product to our customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Carry out planned/unplanned maintenance on manufacturing, filling and packaging equipment, using a Reliability-Centred Maintenance (RCM) approach.
  • Troubleshooting and fault finding of automatic, semi-automatic and batch manufacturing equipment, optimizing operation by Continuous Improvement and Root Cause Problem Solving (RCPS) techniques. Ensure all equipment is repaired to the highest standards.
  • Support equipment projects from design to installation.
  • Identify opportunities for improvements and efficiencies and compliance to all site Quality, Environmental, Health and Safety requirements, training and regulations.
  • Assist with ‘On Call’ duties.
  • Maintain up to date Training through eLMS.
  • Prompt updates to Maximo system controlling reordering of stock parts.
  • Engage with vendors and parts suppliers to source non stock parts.
  • As part of Maintenance Excellence Program (MEP), take responsibity for completing Maximo to the highest standards, this includes completion of Work Orders for instances of downtime with all relevant data. Report to include time down, corrective action, preventative action going forward and parts used.
  • National Craft Senior Trades Electrical qualification is essential to be considered for this job.
  • A minimum of 4 years’ maintenance and troubleshooting experience in a highly automated pharmaceutical or similar regulated environment (Automation, Robotics, Packaging Operations, Automated Inspection)
  • Clear understanding and experience of maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical or mechanical, instrumentation and automation systems. This includes PLCs and HMI, pick-and-place robotics, control pneumatics, IPCs and PC-based tools, Vision systems, VSDs and Servo-drives, SCADA .
  • Proficient on Maximo to manage maintenance requisitions and spare parts control.
  • Willingness to work on set shift pattern and to travel to equipment vendors as required.
  • Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Be flexible in this position and be prepared to undertake other work that may be assigned to you from time to time, which may be outside the area of your normal duties.

title: Associate - Recruiting
description:
Drive impactful talent acquisition for Firmwide Functions by delivering strategic recruitment solutions and building high-performing teams.

Job Summary

As a Senior Associate - Recruiting within Firmwide Functions/Corporate - Risk Management, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for roles across departments. You will partner closely with business leaders to deliver strategic talent acquisition solutions, drive candidate engagement, and support broader talent management initiatives. Your ability to build strong relationships, provide consultative guidance, and deliver a diverse slate of candidates will be key to your success.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the recruitment process from sourcing to offer acceptance for Firmwide Functions roles - Risk management Business, ranging from Analyst to Vice President level.
  • Conduct requirement intake meetings with hiring managers, advising on recruitment best practices, controls, and policies.
  • Identify, evaluate, and present qualified candidates, adjusting strategies based on feedback and market trends.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, influencing hiring decisions and managing expectations throughout the process.
  • Educate candidates on career opportunities, firm culture and benefits to ensure successful offer closures.

title: Lähihoitaja, kotihoito
description:
Etsimme nyt lähihoitajia Helsingin kotihoidon tiimeihin. Meillä pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tukemaan heidän hyvää arkeaan, toimintakykyään sekä mahdollisuutta asua kotona turvallisesti mahdollisimman pitkään. Työskentelet osana osaavaa ja välittävää työyhteisöä.

Tarjolla on useita vakituisia tehtäviä eri puolilla Helsinkiä. Voit kertoa hakemuksessasi, millä alueella tai missä tiimissä haluaisit ensisijaisesti työskennellä.

Haemme lähihoitajia tällä hetkellä vakituisiin työsuhteisiin seuraaviin tiimeihin:

Eteläinen kotihoitoyksikkö
Viiskulma 1 (Hietaniemenkatu 9, 00100 Helsinki) - työskentelyalueena Kamppi ja Jätkäsaari.

Kaakkoinen kotihoitoyksikkö
Herttoniemi 2 (Laivalahdenkatu 2, 00880 Helsinki) - työskentelyalueena Kulosaari ja Herttoniemen ranta. Manuaaliajokortti on pakollinen.

Koillinen kotihoitoyksikkö
Malmi 2 (Soidinkuja 4-6 A, 3krs. 00700 Helsinki) - työskentelyalueena Malmi.
Pukinmäki 1 (Pukinmäenaukio 2, 00720 Helsinki) - työskentelyalueena Savela ja Pukinmäki.

Pohjoinen kotihoitoyksikkö
Maunula 1 (Suursuonlaita 3 B, 2 krs., 00630 Helsinki) - työskentelyalueena Maunula, Pirkkola, Pakila. Manuaaliajokortti on pakollinen.

Jos sinua kiinnostaa jokin muu alue kuin tällä hetkellä avoinna olevat tiimit, kerro siitä hakemuksessasi tai ota rohkeasti yhteyttä. Rekrytointitarpeet voivat muuttua myös hakuaikana.

Millaisesta työstä on kyse?

Työ kotihoidossa on liikkuvaa, vaihtelevaa ja itsenäistä. Kohtaat asiakkaat heidän omissa kodeissaan. Työpäivä alkaa ja päättyy työpisteeltä, josta siirryt asiakkaiden luokse. Asiakkaiden luokse liikutaan kävellen, pyörällä, autolla tai julkisilla kulkuneuvoilla. Työtä tehdään viikon jokaisena päivänä aamu- ja iltavuoroissa klo 7-21.30 välillä.

Asiakkaitamme ovat iäkkäät, toipilaat, monisairaat ja vammaiset henkilöt, jotka tarvitsevat hoivaa ja huolenpitoa fyysisen ja/tai psyykkisen toimintakyvyn heikkenemisen vuoksi. Tehtävämme on mahdollistaa turvallinen ja omannäköinen elämä asiakkaan omassa kodissa.

Kotihoidon tiimeissä työskentelet pääasiassa saman alueen asiakkaiden parissa, mikä mahdollistaa pitkäjänteisten hoitosuhteiden rakentamisen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

asiakkaiden toimintakyvyn ja kuntoutumisen tukeminen
perushoito ja avustaminen arjen tilanteissa
lääke- ja haavahoidot sekä muut sairaanhoidolliset tehtävät
vastuuhoitajana toimiminen omille asiakkaillesi
kirjaaminen Apotti-asiakastietojärjestelmään
yhteistyö moniammatillisessa tiimissä ja omaisten kanssa

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn Helsingin kaupungilla
kattavan ja yksilöllisen perehdytyksen
laajat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet
vaihtelevan työn ja mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi eri tavoin
Helsingin kaupungin monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten lounasedun ja Epassi Flexin (liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaetu, enintään 550 €/vuosi työsuhteen pituuden mukaan), henkilöstöliikunnan palvelut sekä henkilöstökassan
mahdollisuuden hakea Auroranlinnan vuokra-asuntoa - kaupungin työntekijät ovat asukasvalinnassa etusijalla

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

olet laillistettu lähihoitaja
voit työskennellä aamu- ja iltavuoroissa (klo 7-21.30 välillä), myös viikonloppuisin
työskentelet itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti asiakkaiden kodeissa
kohtaat asiakkaat arvostavasti ja kannustat heitä ylläpitämään toimintakykyään
työ edellyttää hyvää fyysistä toimintakykyä ja kykyä toimia vaihtelevissa tilanteissa
sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja toimit luontevasti osana tiimiä
haluat sitoutua työhön kotihoidossa ja kehittää osaamistasi pitkäjänteisesti

Lisäksi luemme eduksi:

työkokemuksen kotihoidosta
Apotti- ja Rai-osaamisen
B-luokan ajokortin, ajotaidon manuaalivaihteisella autolla sekä valmiuden liikkua työssä myös polkupyörällä

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Täytä hakemus suomeksi, käsittelemme vain suomeksi täytetyt hakemukset. Olemme sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse, kun hakemuksesi on käsitelty.

Kysymme hakulomakkeessa kahden suosittelijan yhteystiedot, joihin olemme tarvittaessa yhteydessä rekrytointiprosessin aikana.

Kelpoisuusehto:

Lähihoitajan tutkinto ja rekisteröityminen Lupa- ja valvontaviraston ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin (ent. Valvira)

Suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito (vähintään taso B2.1)

Ennen valintapäätöstä hakijan on esitettävä työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä ja huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus. Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään LOP/LOVe LOP -lääkeluvan suorittamista hyväksytysti. Lääkeluvat suoritetaan työsuhteen alussa, ja niiden tulee olla hyväksytysti suoritettuina viimeistään koeajan päättyessä.

Valitun henkilön on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

title: Ledsager søges til kvinde i Haslev
description:
Ledsager søges til en ung kvinde på 27 år i Haslev

Borger har Downs Syndrom. Hun har sprog, men hun gentager sig selv rigtig meget. Hendes udtale kan også være svær at forstår, men det bliver lettere jo bedre man lærer hende at kende. Hun er tålmodig ift. at få folk til at forstå hende. Ledsager skal kommunikere klart (f.eks. sige ja/nej og være fastholdende i dette). Hun har ikke pengeforståelse og skal støttes ved betalinger, når I er ude. Hun trives i stabilitet og forudsigelighed. Hun bor på bosted.

Hun ønsker ledsagelse til hyggelige ture såsom cafébesøg - shoppingture - biografen.

Der er bevilliget 15 timer om måneden.
Borger vil gerne ud ca. 1-2 gange om måneden. Vagtens længde afhænger af aktiviteten, men det er vigtigt at have tydlige rammer for længden af vagten, så borger ved hvad hun kan forvente.

Aftaler laves i samarbejde med borgers kontaktperson.

I kommer rundt med flextrafik eller på gåben, alt efter hvor turen går hen.

Der søges en ledsager, som kan sætte nogle gode rammer for turene og hygge om borger.

Stillingen som ledsager er en deltidsstilling.
Ledsageordningen bruges altid til selvvalgte aktiviteter uden for borgers bolig.
Borger afholder alle udgifter i forbindelse med ledsagelsen.

Timeløn:
Hverdage: Ca. 170 kr.
Lørdag: Ca. 180 kr.
Søndag: Ca. 190 kr.
Lønnen varierer i forhold til, hvor i landet borger bor.

Stillingen skal søges via din profil på www.duos.dk og har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan ledsageteamet kontaktes på tlf. 36 34 81 28.

title: Cabin Crew
description:
Make the World Your Home

At Etihad, we believe in the power of people to create extraordinary experiences. As the national airline of the United Arab Emirates and one of the world’s fastest-growing airlines, we proudly connect Abu Dhabi to over 100 destinations worldwide.

Cabin Crew at Etihad: More Than a Job

With plans to double our fleet by 2030, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our award-winning Cabin Crew team. At Etihad, this is more than a job it’s a lifestyle, a community, and an opportunity to be part of something bigger, with clear, structured career progression.

Our Cabin Crew are at the heart of everything we do. They are ambassadors of genuine hospitality, delivering exceptional service while upholding the highest safety standards. No two days are ever the same; each flight is a chance to create moments that matter and be part of stories that span continents.

We’re searching for passionate, service-driven individuals who truly care about people and go the extra mile to make every guest feel valued. If you’re safety-conscious, customer-focused, and excited to connect with people from around the world, you could be exactly who we’re looking for.

At Etihad, you’ll join a diverse and inclusive family representing over 145 nationalities. We create an environment where you can thrive, with continuous learning, internal career opportunities, and the chance to contribute to meaningful sustainability initiatives shaping the future of aviation.

Competitive Tax-Free Salary & Allowances

Competitive Salary: starting salary with additional pay for flight hours and layovers: up to AED 10,000/month* depending on roster.

Fast-Track Career Progression: we recognise and reward great performance:

  • Economy → Business Class (from 12 months)
  • Business Class → Cabin Senior (from 12 months)
  • Cabin Senior → Cabin Manager (from 24 months)

*Timelines depend on individual performance and business needs.

Exceptional Lifestyle Benefits:

  • Fully furnished shared accommodation in Abu Dhabi (gym included) with options for independent-living allowances.
  • Free, reliable transport between residence, training and the airport.
  • Worldwide medical and insurance coverage fully paid by Etihad.
  • Company-provided uniform and world-class training.
  • 30 days annual leave (post-probation).
  • One free annual ticket home.
  • Generous friends and family travel benefits.

Minimum Requirements

To join our cabin crew team, you will need to meet the following minimum requirements:

  • Minimum age: 21 years old
  • Minimum height: 163 cm (no reach test required)
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are a plus)
  • High standard of personal grooming (no visible tattoos or piercings; one earring per lobe permitted for females)
  • Clean criminal record and ability to travel without restrictions
  • Willingness to serve alcohol (including during Ramadan) and comply with UAE & GCAA requirements
  • Ability to swim with a flotation device

Upcoming events

If you believe you have what it takes and are excited to fast‑track your application, we’d love to meet you in person! Submit your application and join us at one of our upcoming events:

  • 18 August - Budapest, Hungary, Hotel: Barceló Budapest
  • 26 August - Vienna, Austria, Hotel: Hotel Imperial, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Vienna

If you’re not available on these dates, don’t worry — we have additional events coming up throughout the year dates to be announced soon! In Q3, we will also be visiting Budapest, Rome, Madrid, Istanbul, Paris, Moscow, Frankfurt, Brussels, Manchester and many more.

Apply now.

We look forward to meeting you and supporting you in the next step of your journey. Please feel free to join us if it feels right for you — the choice is entirely yours. Rest assured, we will continue to review your application online as usual.

Etihad is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our home in Abu Dhabi, our Cabin Crew connect people and cultures across five continents, delivering world-class service and unforgettable experiences on every journey. As part of our Journey 2030 ambition to expand our network and grow our fleet, we’re creating exciting opportunities for our people to develop, travel and thrive. Join us and make the world your home with Etihad.

To learn more visit

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Senior Software Design Quality Engineer (Remote)
description:
Sr SW Design Quality Engineer

Location: Remote - United States

Remote Type: Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Job Description

*This is NOT a test role*

The Senior Software Design Assurance (Sr Software Design Quality) Engineer provides technical support and guidance to Software teams to ensure conformance to software development process and other applicable safety and quality system regulation and standards (e.g. IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).

This role will be responsible for various aspects of Software Design Assurance with a focus on product improvement, new product development, and defect prevention. This position will interface with different cross functional groups (Software Engineering, Software Test, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Project

managers, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, and others). A positive attitude is important while working in a fast-paced environment and dealing with shifting priorities.

*This is NOT a test role*

Where you come in:

  • You will actively participate as a core member of the R&D Quality Assurance Engineering team, supporting software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, and AI/ML‑enabled systems.

  • You will provide hands‑on technical guidance to cross‑functional teams on IEC 62304, 21 CFR 820, and other applicable global regulations for software‑as‑a‑service, data, and AI‑driven products.

  • You will lead the effective application, compliance, and continuous improvement of software development and validation practices for distributed systems, cloud services, and data platforms.

  • You will drive pre‑market risk management deliverables, including Software Hazard Analysis (SHA), design FMEA, and risk controls related to cloud infrastructure, data processing, and AI/ML functionality.

  • You will guide Software Design and Test teams on software design assurance activities such as requirements traceability, software configuration management, tool validation, and integration of cloud and data services.

  • You will review and approve software design control deliverables associated with cloud‑hosted services, data pipelines, and AI/ML components to ensure regulatory compliance and product quality.

  • You will support post‑market activities related to software anomalies, model behavior, data quality issues, risk assessments, and CAPA activities, as applicable.

  • You will author, review, and maintain technical documentation including Design History Files, SOPs, protocols, and reports for cloud‑based and AI/ML‑enabled systems.

  • You will assess change control activities related to infrastructure, data, or model changes to ensure no adverse impact to product performance and to maintain a compliant state.

  • You will effectively communicate plans, progress, risks, and design assurance considerations to cross‑functional teams and senior leadership.

What makes you successful:

• Nice to have: AI/ML experience or ASQ CSQE certification.

  • You bring strong experience in software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, API, and service‑oriented systems in a regulated environment.

  • You have demonstrated hands‑on knowledge of IEC 62304, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and their application to software‑as‑a‑service and data‑driven products.

  • Your proficiency includes applying software design assurance principles across the SDLC, including requirements analysis, architecture and design reviews, implementation oversight, integration, and verification.

  • You have experience performing and reviewing software risk management activities, including Software Hazard Analysis (SHA), design FMEA, and change impact assessments for cloud, data, and AI/ML components.

  • You are skilled at reviewing and approving software design control deliverables to ensure traceability, risk control implementation, and regulatory compliance.

  • You have experience supporting software configuration management, tool validation, and integration of cloud services, data pipelines, and platform components.

  • You communicate effectively with cross‑functional partners and can clearly present design assurance, risk, and compliance topics to technical teams and senior leadership.

What you’ll get: (this section should not be modified)

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 5-15%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 5-8 years related experience or Master’s degree and 2-5 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 0-2 years experience

Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option
