Projektleder til udviklingsporteføljen - vær med til at drive forandring og sikre stærk eksekvering i Sinal
Brænder du for at skabe fremdrift og sikre struktur, governance og de gode samarbejdsrelationer? Får du energi af at skabe fremdrift i komplekse projekter, hvor du sætter retning, driver beslutninger og engagerer stakeholders? Har du lyst til at udfordre og støtte forretningen, når projekter skal løftes fra idé til implementering?


Bliv en del af et dedikeret team med viljen til at lykkes
Som en del af afdelingen Projekt og Porteføljestyring er du med til at bygge bro mellem strategi, processer og de mennesker, der driver projekterne frem. Du indgår i et team bestående af 7 kollegaer, som sammen har ansvar for udviklingsporteføljen i Sinal. Teamet er forankret under Strategi og arbejder tæt på forretningen.


Vi har en kultur, hvor vi kan udfordre hinanden fagligt, sparre på tværs og giver plads til, at du kan sætte dit eget præg på opgaverne. Her får du både frirum og ansvar, samtidig med at du indgår i et team, hvor samarbejde, tillid og stærke relationer er en vigtig del af hverdagen. 


Din hverdag hos os
Du bliver ansvarlig for at drive projekter fra idé til eksekvering med fokus på fremdrift, struktur og klare beslutningsprocesser. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig ambassadør for vores projektstandarder og governance-modeller, som du skal hjælpe med at forankre i forretningen. 


Dine primære opgaver bliver at:



Drive udviklingsprojekter fra idé til implementering ved at skabe tydelig eksekveringskraft gennem nedbrydning af projekter i klare del leverancer


sikre løbende fremdrift, struktur og stærkt ejerskab.


Sikre governance, struktur og overholdelse af standarder i projekterne


Forankre templates, processer og metodikker i organisationen


Skabe stærke relationer og arbejde proaktivt med stakeholder management


Navigere i organisatoriske behov og udfordringer på tværs af Sinal


Sikre disciplin og struktur i projekterne og i samarbejdet med forretningen



Du vil blive tilknyttet vores hovedkontor i Silkeborg. 


Projektleder med evne til at engagere, udfordre og sætte retning
Vi forestiller os, at du har 3-5 års erfaring som projektleder, hvor du har drevet projekter fra start til slut og trives i en eksekverende hverdag. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med tekniske projekter, da du kommer til at arbejde på tværs af organisationen og forankre løsninger bredt i forretningen. Vi ser gerne, at du er Prince2 certificeret, da vores projektmetoder er inspireret herfra. Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende, det vigtigste er dit mindset, din drivkraft.


Som person falder det dig naturligt at drive fremdrift og skabe overblik. Du tager initiativ, følger op og får tingene til at ske, samtidig med at du prioriterer de gode relationer i hverdagen. Du er nysgerrig på dine stakeholders, og du går konstruktivt ind i dialoger, hvor holdninger skal udfordres eller afstemmes. Du har en selvstændig og proaktiv tilgang til dit arbejde, hvor du ikke er bange for at tænke kreativt eller udfordre eksisterende løsninger.


Da Sinal beskæftiger sig med kritisk infrastruktur, kan der i rekrutteringsforløbet være behov for at foretage et baggrundstjek af dig. 


Baggrundstjek kan omfatte validering af din identitet, fremvisning af straffeattest, indhentelse af referencer samt validering af dit eksamensbevis. Du informeres, hvis dette bliver relevant og forud for igangsættelse. 


Vil du være en del af fællesskabet? 
Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt Manager, Emmely Mi Nguyen, på tlf.: +45 93993164 eller via mail til emmngu@sinal.dk. 


Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge jobbet. Vi tager jobannoncen ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.


Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

                
    
                

            

        

    

    
    

        

        

    

    
    

        

Med mere end 1 million adresser er Sinal Danmarks største fibernet. Vi dækker størstedelen af Jylland, og dele af Fyn og Sjælland, med energieffektive og fremtidssikrede fiberforbindelser.



Vi forbinder ikke bare adresser og postnumre - vi forbinder mennesker, idéer og muligheder. Vores kultur er drevet af passion, teknologisk ekspertise og et solidt fællesskab, hvor vi har en urokkelig ambition om at forme den stærkeste digitale fremtid. Som en stolt del af Norlys-koncernen og med et værdibaseret ejerskab, der forener samfundsbevidste investorer og engagerede andelshavere, skaber vi forbindelser, der gør en forskel.



Vores knap 700 medarbejdere i Silkeborg, Kolding, Aalborg og Sønderborg arbejder hver dag for at forbinde danskerne med hinanden.

                             Jobbeskrivelse 
                         
                        
 Er du interesseret i en stilling,
hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og gøre en reel forskel for
kunderne? Så kan det være, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig her
hos os. Seriøst! 


 Hos Q8 bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi
passer på hinanden og sørger for, at du trives i dit arbejde. Når du har det
godt, kan du give kunderne den bedste oplevelse - og det er præcis det, vi
brænder for. Vores gode samarbejde internt er samtidig med til at drive den
udvikling, vi som virksomhed er i fuld gang med. Q8 står nemlig midt i en
spændende transformation, hvor vi arbejder aktivt med at reducere vores
klimapåvirkning. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så bliv en del af Q8 familien. 


  


 Hvad kommer du til at lave? 


 Som salgsassistent får du en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens. Du sørger for, at stationen altid er indbydende og klar til at tage imod kunderne. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du på forpladsen, det næste betjener du kunder ved kassen, tilbereder og serverer mad eller fylder varer op. Der er fart på - men også plads til grin med kollegaerne og tid til at give kunderne en god service. 


 Det praktiske 

 
 Ansættelsesform: timelønnet 

 Omfang: Ca. 7 timer pr. uge 

 Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil ligge både i hverdagene og weekenden, typisk i både dag -og aftentimerne.  

 Start: Efter aftale 

 Løn: Grundløn for ufaglærte: 142,17 kr. Grundløn for faglærte: 151,53 kr. Derudover får du aften-, nat-, weekend- og helligdagstillæg i henhold til butiksoverenskomsten.  

 Pension: 10,7% firmabetalt pension gennem PFA. Gælder efter 3 måneders ansættelse og for medarbejdere over 20 år - med mindre du allerede er omfattet af en pensionsordning, så får du pension fra start. 
 

 OBS! Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest, hvis du går videre i processen. 

                     

                 

             

         

        
            



    


        
        
            
 
                
 
                    
 
                        
 
                             
                                 Dine kvalifikationer 
                             
                            
 Hvad tilbyder vi dig? 

 
 En arbejdsplads med alsidige opgaver og mulighed for at lære nyt hver dag 

 Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt 

 En medarbejderapp med mulighed for fleksibel lønudbetaling, indflydelse gennem vores ungeministerium samt gode fordele og rabatter 

 En struktureret onboardingproces, der sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start - understøttet af vores medarbejderapp, hvor du finder guides, træning og nyttige værktøjer 
 

 Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan det er at være medarbejder i Q8, så læs mere på  karrierestationen . 


  


 Hvem passer jobbet til? 


 Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og give kunderne en god oplevelse. Erfaring er ikke afgørende - det vigtigste er din energi og dit engagement. 


 OBS! For at søge skal du være fyldt 18 år og tale flydende dansk, da kundekontakt er en stor del af jobbet. 


  


 Klar på at blive en del af Q8? 


 I ansøgningen har du flere
muligheder, men for at vi kan lære dig bedre at kende, så skal du besvare nogle
enkelte spørgsmål. Derudover skal du optage en kort video, hvor du fortæller om
dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde hos Q8. Vi ved godt, at det kan lyde
lidt grænseoverskridende, men det behøver ikke at være perfekt eller
professionelt, og du kan bare filme på mobilen. 


 Du kan også vedhæfte dit CV, hvis
du har et, men det er helt frivilligt. Vi håber at høre fra dig! 


 Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste ansøgning - seriøst.

                                     Om os 
                                 
                                
 Når vi siger, at dette er "dit livs måske vigtigste job", så mener vi det virkelig. Vi tilbyder ikke bare et sted at arbejde. Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads, hvor du kan udvikle dig og gøre en forskel sammen med andre. Hjælpe kunden og give dem et smil med på vejen. Hver dag. Så uanset om du søger dit første job, det sidste job eller bare er klar til en ny udfordring, tror vi på, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig, her hos os. 


 Seriøst!

                                                             Lynladere på alle bemandede stationer  Frem mod 2026 sætter vi lynladere op på alle vores bemandede Q8-stationer, så flere kan tage rejsen i elbil.
                                                         

                                                     

                                                 

                                            
                                                
 
                                                    
  

                                                    
 
                                                        
 
                                                             Alternative brændstof- og energiløsninger  Vores mission er at transformere vores virksomhed til gavn for samfundet, for vores kunder og for både store og små virksomheder i Danmark og Sverige. Ved at levere ydelser samt transport- og energiløsninger med lavere klimapåvirkning, har vi sat et mål om at opnå netto-nul-emissioner i 2035.
                                                         

                                                     

                                                 

                                            
                                                
 
                                                    
  

                                                    
 
                                                        
 
                                                             Rabat station  Når du er på vagt på stationen, får du 50 % rabat på mad og drikke - og 20 %, når du har fri.
                                                         

                                                     

                                                 

                                            
                                                
 
                                                    
  

                                                    
 
                                                        
 
                                                             Fleksibel lønudbetaling AllGravy  Gennem vores medarbejderapp AllGravy kan du få fleksibel lønudbetaling. Det betyder, at du kan få en del af din løn udbetalt, når det passer dig. Har du taget en ekstra vagt? Så kan du få pengene med det samme. Seriøst!
                                                         

                                                     

                                                 

                                            
                                                
 
                                                    
  

                                                    
 
                                                        
 
                                                             Udvikling  Hos Q8 er din udvikling vigtig for os - uanset hvor du er i din karriere. Vi tilbyder både interne og eksterne muligheder for at styrke dine kompetencer, og vi står klar til at støtte dig hele vejen! Du kan fx blive ledertrainee, salgselev eller få tilskud til ekstern uddannelse.
                                                         

                                                     

                                                 

                                            
                                                
 
                                                    
  

                                                    
 
                                                        
 
                                                             Godt Bagt  I 2025 lancerede vi bagværkskonceptet Godt Bagt - her sælger vi wienerbrød, der måske ikke er perfekte i udseendet, men smager lige så godt som altid. På den måde redder vi hvert år over 200.000 stykker bagværk fra at ende som madspild.

title: Software Developer
description:
Software Developer 5

Location: Seattle, WA, United States

Entity: Oracle America, Inc.

Job Duties: Design, develop, troubleshoot and/or test/QA software. As a member of the software engineering division, apply knowledge of software architecture to perform tasks associated with developing, debugging, or designing software applications or operating systems according to provided design specifications. Build enhancements within an existing software architecture and/or suggest improvements to the architecture. May telecommute. (385.21250)

Employer will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field and 4 years of experience in the job offered or in a Software Developer-related occupation. Position requires:

1. Operating Systems including Linux and Windows;

2. Cloud infrastructure technologies including Amazon Web Services, Oracle Public Cloud, or Microsoft Azure;

3. Agile development methodologies including Scrum;

4. Programming Language: Java;

5. Web Design using AJAX, JavaScript, HTML, CSS;

6. Application Servers including Apache HTTP and Tomcat or Jetty and Jackson;

7. AWS Services including S3, SQS, SWF, and DynamoDB;

8. Open Source Tools and Software;

9. Design of service-oriented architectures including designing for the durability, scalability, and reliability needs of services;

10. API Design: Cross-team or customer-facing public API design for long-term usage;

11. Design of APIs for use in consoles (browser based user-interfaces);

12. Deployment to highly-available services;

13. System operations, including production, deployment, and management;

14. Design and use of encryption in a secure service, including key management and rotation systems;

15. Using workflows for asynchronous execution of tasks; and,

16. PHP, C, Python, and MySQL.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

title: Salgsassistent til Imerco Farum
description:
Salgsassistent til Imerco Farum - Barselsvikariat  
				
  

			
 
 Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af Danmarks største kæde indenfor køkken, gaver og bord? 

 Hos Imerco Farum bliver du en del af et team med dygtige kolleger, som engagerer sig for at skabe gode og mindeværdige oplevelser for vores kunder.
 
 Har du appetit på Imerco? 

 Så tilbyder vi dig en stilling som salgsassistent hvor du:  
 
 Får en uforudsigelig hverdag med masser af udfordringer 

 Bliver en del af et ambitiøst og fagligt stærkt team 

 Skal sælge nogle af Danmarks stærkeste brands. 
 
 Din hverdag som salgsassistent: 

 Som salgsassistent i Imerco Farum bliver det din opgave, at henvende dig til vores kunder og yde en førsteklasses service, hvor du rådgiver dem om vores produkter, så de forlader butikken med en god oplevelse - og alle de relevante produkter. 

 Andre opgaver vil være at: 
 
 Være med til salgsfremmende aktiviteter 

 Sikre at butikken fremstår salgs- og kampagneklar, herunder indbydende udstillinger 

 Modtage og fylde varer op i butikken, samt holde orden på lager og baglokaler 

 Stå for lagerstyring og behandling af reklamationer 
 
 Bidrag med din erfaring: 

 Vi forestiller os, at du: 
 
 Har gode salgsevner. Du ved, hvordan man sælger mere en blot et produkt ved at skabe en unik kundeoplevelse - du aflæser kundens behov og guider dem til det rigtige valg. 

 Trives i at arbejde i højt tempo og kan bevare overblikket, selv når der er travlt. 

 Har erfaring med detailhandel 

 Har kendskab til isenkram - det er en fordel, men er ikke et krav. 
 
 Hvis du er vores nye kollega i Imerco Farum, glæder vi os til at nyde stor gavn af din viden indenfor detailhandel samt din evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og gribe de daglige udfordringer. Vi kan tilbyde en stilling på 37 timer ugentligt. Stillingen er tidsbegrænset og ophører 31-07-2027 

 Vi tilbyder desuden: 
 
 Pensionsordning 

 Sundhedsforsikring 

 Personalekøbsordning 

 Øvrige rabatordninger 
 
 Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte os. Du finder kontakt informationerne til højre i annoncen.  

 Vi forbeholder os retten til at fjerne jobopslag før sidste frist, såfremt den rette kandidat er fundet. 

 Imerco er Danmarks største omnichannel forhandler af køkkenudstyr, borddækning, gaver og boligtilbehør. Imerco har et landsdækkende butiksnetværk med 165 fysiske butikker, en webshop med over 30.000 varer og driver en af Danmarks største kundeklubber, ImercoPlus, med over 1,9 mio. medlemmer.  

 Imerco blev startet af visionære isenkræmmere helt tilbage i 1928, og fylder således 100 år i 2028. Imerco blev i 2007 omdannet til kapitalkæde. I 2017 overtog Imerco detailkæden Inspiration. Imerco er et datterselskab i M. Goldschmidt Holding koncernen. 

 Vi er i alt ca. 1.600 ansatte med hovedkontor i Herlev. Hos Imerco har vi et uformelt og positivt miljø med gode sociale relationer, hvor vi samarbejder på tværs af organisationen.

Vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende




Vi tilbyder


Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du:

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 151,52 kr. i timen som faglært og 142,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst fra HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

 

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

Klik på "Søg nu"

Udfyld formularen

Vedhæft dit motiverede CV 

 

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit motiverede CV!







Medarbejdergoder









Medarbejderrabat
Lidl-rabat: Få 10 % eller 20 % rabat på dine indkøb i vores butikker på udvalgte dage.





Rabatordning
Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.













        

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. Vi værdsætter vores medarbejderes mangfoldighed og fremmer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor hver enkelt føler sig velkommen og respekteret. Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.

Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

title: Proposal Assurance & Submission Officer
description:
• Work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment within the Research Pre-Award team

  • Full time, Continuing opportunity

  • Base salary $117,133 - $127,610 (HEO7) + 17% superannuation

  • Hybrid working arrangement available

About the opportunity

The Pipeline and Pre Award team in DVC Research are on the hunt for another Proposal Assurance & Submission Officer to join their squad!

In this role, you will manage the proposal submission administrative services and offer operational support for the Pre-Award team. You will be leading support for funding proposals and submissions for allocated schemes and providing guidance and escalation support to Proposal Assurance & Submission Administrators.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and want to be surrounded by a high performing team, then we encourage you to read on and then apply if this sounds like you!

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • work in the Pipeline and Pre-Award team, reporting to the Manager, Proposal Assurance & Submissions

  • lead the administration submission requirements for allocated schemes by ensuring funding proposal and submission are compliant and meet quality assurance expectations

  • maintain an accurate and systematic database of funding proposals and submissions

  • understand the complexities of the submissions environment and provide insights, guidance, and regular reporting to the Pipeline and Pre-Awards Teams

  • comply with funding rules and regulatory requirements

  • contribute to the Research Support Community of Practice through trusted stakeholder management.

About you

  • administrative experience in a complex and fast-paced environment

  • excellent negotiating, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills

  • sound judgement, initiative, and discretion with the ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently

  • high-level attention to detail and problem-solving skills

  • excellent computer skills including Microsoft office, databases, excel programs and web-based software

  • interest in, or experience working in, a research-intensive higher education environment.

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

Please note: you must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role required pre-employment or background checks in terms satisfactory to the University. Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

EEO statement

At the University of Sydney, our shared values are trust, accountability and excellence and we strive to be a place where everyone can thrive. We are committed to creating a University community that thrives through diversity and reflects the wider community that we serve. We deliver on this through our commitment to diversity and inclusion, evidenced by our people and culture programs, as well as key strategies to increase participation and support the careers of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People, women, people living with a disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and those who identify as LGBTIQ+. We welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds.

We are proud to be recognised as an Australian Workplace Equality Index (AWEI) Gold employer. Find out more about our work on diversity and inclusion.

How to apply

Applications (including a cover letter, CV, and any additional supporting documentation) can be submitted via the Apply button at the top of the page.

For employees of the University or contingent workers, please login into your Workday account and navigate to the Career icon on your Dashboard. Click on USYD Find Jobs and apply.

For a confidential discussion about the role, or if you require reasonable adjustment or any documents in alternate formats, please contact Nicole Turle Recruitment Operations by email at nicole.turle@sydney.edu.au

 Bonzer is a specialist SEO agency on a mission to be the clear Nordic leader in search - the partner ambitious businesses in Denmark, Sweden and Norway turn to first. We work from our offices in Copenhagen, Stockholm and Oslo, and we take our culture as seriously as our craft. 

 We're looking for someone to run HR day to day across all three markets - and to grow with the role as Bonzer grows. 

 
  
 The role 
 HR at Bonzer is deliberately small, so this role carries real responsibility from day one: you're not the assistant to an HR department, you're the one making it run. Recruitment, onboarding, contracts, vacation and leave - across Denmark, Sweden and Norway - with real trust and a direct line to our CEO, Ulrich Svarrer. 

 You won't be inventing anything from scratch. Our foundation is in place: a written handbook, clear values we hire and grow people against, and a performance framework that already works. Your job is to make it all run smoothly in practice - every hire, every onboarding, every process. 

 
  
 What you'll do  
 
 Recruitment & onboarding - coordinate hiring end to end: job posts, candidate communication, interview scheduling, and an onboarding that makes new colleagues feel at home fast. 
 

 
 HR administration - employment contracts, employee records, and our HR system (HiBob), kept accurate across three countries. 
 

 
 Salary, vacation & leave - support payroll, and administer vacation, parental leave and absence correctly in each market. 
 

 
 Employee relations - be a friendly, trusted first point of contact for HR questions from colleagues and managers. 
 
 
 
  
 What we're looking for  
 
 A background in HR, business administration or similar - recently finished studies with some HR exposure is a great starting point. 
 

 
 Strong organizational skills and follow-through: lots of moving parts, and you're the one keeping them straight. 
 

 
 A working understanding of HR and labor law in at least one Scandinavian country, and the curiosity to learn the other two. 
 

 
 Empathetic and approachable - people should find it easy to come to you. 
 

 
 Fluent in English and at least one Scandinavian language. 
 
 
 
  
 What we offer  
 
 More responsibility and trust than the title suggests, and room to grow into it. 
 

 
 A specialist company that knows exactly what it is, with a written, honest handbook instead of tribal knowledge. 
 

 
 Competitive salary. 
 

 
 A great office in the heart of Copenhagen (Farvergade), plus colleagues in Stockholm and Oslo you'll work closely with. 
 

 
 Social events, snacks and drinks in the office, and people who care about doing things properly. 
 
 
 
  
 Practical details  
 
 Location: Copenhagen HQ, Farvergade 2-4 
 

 
 Employment: Full-time, start as soon as possible 
 

 
 Process: 30-min intro call   45-min interview at the office   30-min final interview 
 

 
 Apply via The Hub.  
 
 
 
  

 We're hiring for our HR function and are open to different levels of seniority - you'll also find our HR Lead post on The Hub. Apply to the one that fits you best; we'll figure out the right fit together.

title: 조직문화 담당자 (3-7년)
description:
About

=====

글로벌 콘텐츠 ​플랫폼 ​기업, ​SpoonLabs와 함께 ​하실
조직문화 ​담당자를 지금 찾고 ​있어요

=====

스푼랩스가 만드는 글로벌 콘텐츠 플랫폼 Spoon & Vigloo!
• 오디오부터 비디오까지, 스푼랩스는 전 세계 사람들의 일상을 재밌는 콘텐츠로 가득 채우고 있습니다.
• 실시간 라이브부터 귀로 ​듣는 ​팟노블까지 ​글로벌 오디오 플랫폼, Spoon - https://www.spooncast.net/kr
• 2분의 ​몰입을 선사하는 ​글로벌 숏드라마 ​플랫폼, Vigloo - https://www.vigloo.com/ko

=====

[포지션 소개]
우리는 조직문화를 단순한 사내 이벤트나 복지로 생각하지 않습니다.
스푼랩스의 조직문화는 구성원이 몰입하고 최고의 성과를 낼 수 있도록 만드는 중요한 비즈니스 인프라입니다.
빠르게 성장하고 변화하는 조직에서 데이터와 구성원의 목소리를 바탕으로 조직을 진단하고, 더 나은 협업 방식과 치열한 몰입 문화를 만들어갈 조직문화 담당자를 찾고 있습니다.

*직무명 및 주요 업무는 인터뷰 및 입사 과정에서 지원자의 강점과 전문성을 고려하여 상호 협의 하에 조정될 수 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 몰입 중심 조직문화 구축
• 일회성 이벤트보다는 조직의 비전과 핵심가치가 실제 업무와 성과로 연결되도록 다양한 변화·혁신 이니셔티브를 기획하고 실행해요.
• Merit Money, Recognition Program 등 스푼랩스의 정신과 핵심가치를 내재화하기 위한 제도를 운영해요.

2. 조직 진단 및 솔루션 설계
• 성과 창출을 저해하는 조직 내 병목 현상과 이슈를 선제적으로 발굴해요.
• 데이터 기반의 조직 진단(리더십 진단, Pulse Survey, 360 Feedback, FGI 등)을 통해 근본 원인을 분석하고, 최적화된 솔루션을 도출하고 해결해요.

3. 소통 및 회의 문화 혁신
• 1on1, 타운홀, 팀 회고 등 조직 내 각종 미팅이 형식에 머물지 않고 성과 창출의 도구로 작동하도록 퍼실리테이션하고 문화를 개선해요.
• 스푼랩스의 방향성에 맞게 빠르고 작은 실험을 반복하는 실험 문화를 정립하고 확산해요.

4. 조직 학습 역량 강화
• 스푼랩스를 하나의 거대한 학습 조직(CoP)으로 발전시키기 위한 L&D 전략을 수립하고 실행해요.
• 리더십 코칭, 성과 관리, 커뮤니케이션 등 교육 프로그램을 기획하고 운영해요.

5. 노사 커뮤니케이션
• 다양하고 복잡한 조직 환경 속에서 구성원의 목소리를 기민하게 포착하여 주요 아젠다를 도출하고, 노사협의회를 운영 및 개선해요.

Requirements

• 조직문화, HRD, 조직개발 관련 실무 경력 3년 이상 ~ 7년 이하인 분
• 몰입과 성장 : 업무적 성장을 삶의 중요한 가치 중 하나로 여기며, 성장하기 위해 업무와 학습에 자발적으로 시간과 에너지를 투자하시는 분
• 장인정신과 문제해결력 : 어려운 상황에서도 쉽게 타협하지 않고 끝까지 파고들어 의미 있는 성과를 만드는 분. 지속적으로 더 나은 방식과 개선 방법을 고민하시는 분
• 조직문화에 대한 철학과 회복탄력성 : 조직의 성과에 의미 있는 임팩트를 만들어 보았거나 조직문화에 대한 분명한 철학을 가진 분. 변화의 성과가 단기간에 보이지 않더라도 흔들리지 않고 꾸준히 이니셔티브를 추진하시는 분
• 전략적 주도성 : 주어진 업무(How)를 수행하는 것을 넘어, 조직의 비즈니스 목표 달성을 위해 해결해야 할 과제(What/Why)를 스스로 정의하고 실행하시는 분
• 냉철한 분석과 설득력 : 복잡한 HR 이슈를 데이터로 날카롭게 분석하는 역량과 이를 구성원이 공감하고 행동하게 만드는 강력한 스토리텔링 역량을 겸비하신 분

Preferred

• 고속 성장하는 IT 스타트업 및 애자일(Agile) 조직문화에서의 경험을 보유한 분
• 조직 진단 도구를 설계·운영하고, 그 결과를 바탕으로 액션 플랜을 도출하여 긍정적 변화를 이끌어내 본 분
• 워크샵, 타운홀 미팅 등에서 전문적인 퍼실리테이션을 수행할 수 있는 분
• 영어 또는 일본어 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분 (글로벌 협업 환경)

Benefits

[팀소개] 스푼랩스 EX 팀을 소개합니다
스푼랩스 EX 팀은 Employee eXperience 팀의 약자로, 스푼랩스에서 HR 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.

[팀 미션]
• 모든 구성원이 업무에 온전히 행복하게 몰입할 수 있는 환경을 조성하여 개인과 팀, 그리고 회사의 성장을 함께 이루어낸다.

[팀 비전]
• 구성원에게는 거쳐 간 어떤 인사팀보다 나은 인사팀으로, 회사에는 성장의 원동력으로 기억되는 팀
• '이 조직이 여기까지 온 건 EX팀 덕이 크다'는 말을 구성원들로부터 듣는 팀
• 구성원의 70% 이상이 성장과 보상에 만족하는 회사로 만드는 팀
• 구직자들에게 '스푼랩스라면 한 번쯤 일해 보고 싶다'는 말을 듣는 회사로 만드는 팀

=====

[스푼랩스는 어떻게 일하나요? 여기에 답이 있어요]

Work Hard. Win Together.
밤낮을 넘어 치열히, 원팀으로 끝까지.

완벽보다 속도, 고민보다 실행.
스푼랩스는 빠르게 시도하고, 실패는 안고 다시 달립니다.
결국 답에 닿을 때까지 몰입합니다.

밤낮을 넘는 긴 몰입의 시간,
끝없는 시도와 수정으로 답에 다가섭니다.
속도는 빠르고, 기준은 높고, 불확실성은 큽니다.
누군가에게 이곳은 버거울 수 있지만,
우리는 그 안에서 치열하게 성장하며 한 걸음 더 나아갑니다.

더 멀리 나아가기 위해
앞서가되 독주하지 않고,
함께할 때 더 단단하기에
서로를 믿고 배우며, 겸손하게 성장합니다.

우리는 '편한 일'을 약속하지 않습니다. '압도적 성장'을 약속합니다.
단순한 일이 아닌, 내 인생과 세상을 바꾸는 전력 질주의 무대.
몰입과 끈기로 성장할 준비가 된 사람을 환영합니다.

• 스푼랩스 공식 홈페이지: https://www.spoonlabs.com/kr/
• 스푼랩스 문화 블로그: https://brunch.co.kr/@spoonlabs#articles
• 스푼랩스 테크 블로그: https://medium.com/spoontech
• 스푼랩스 링크드인: https://www.linkedin.com/company/spoonlabs/
• 스푼랩스 인스타그램: https://www.instagram.com/spoonlabs_careers/

=====

[몰입하고, 성장할 수 있도록 이런 제도가 준비되어 있어요]

[성장을 위한 제도] 끊임없이 도전하고 더 나은 결과를 만들어내는 구성원을 위해
• 월 10만원 한도의 자기계발비 지원
• 월 20만원 한도의 일본어, 영어, 한국어 외국어 학습비 지원
• AWS re:Invent, Digital Marketing Summit, MAU Conference 등 업무 관련 국내외 교육 및 세미나 참석 지원
• 우리 같이 공부해요! 사내 스터디 모임 지원
• 사내 도서관 운영 및 신청 도서 구매
• 입사자와 추천자 모두 후한 보상을! 사내 직원 추천 제도
우리는 빠르게 배우고, 더 나은 방향으로 스스로 성장하는 사람들이 함께 모인 팀입니다.

[일하는 방식] 몰입과 실행의 밀도를 높이기 위해
• 해외 법인에서 근무하는 오피스 익스체인지 프로그램
• 창의적 몰입을 위한 워케이션 프로그램
• 오전 8시~10시 사이 자유롭게 출근하는 자율출근제
• 열심히 일하고 안전하게 퇴근해야죠. 야근 식비 및 택시비 지원
• 월요일은 4시간의 몰입을! 더욱 집중해서 몰입하는 주 4.5일제
우리는 더 깊이, 함께 몰입할 수 있는 환경을 선택합니다.

[함께하는 팀을 위한 환경] 치열하게 일한 만큼, 서로를 챙기기 위해
• 든든히 드세요. 아침 식사 제공 및 점심 식비 지원
• 함께해 주셔서 감사해요! 근속 기간별 리프레시 휴가 및 휴가비 지원
• 에너지는 항상 충전되어야 하니까. 무제한 카페테리아 운영
• 생일을 진심으로 축하합니다. 생일자를 위한 반반차 휴가
• 개개인의 일상에도 진심을 담아, 경조 휴가 및 경조비 지원
• 개인 근무 일정에 맞게 알아서 사용하는 휴가/반반차 제도
• 무엇보다 건강이 우선이죠. 연 1회 종합건강검진 제공
• 강남역 역세권의 깔끔하고 세련된 사무실
• 힘들 땐 잠시 쉬어요. 고급 안마의자, 게임기, 다트, 탁구대 구비
치열하게 일한 만큼, 재충전도 중요하니까. 우리는 일하는 순간뿐 아니라, 그 사이사이도 함께 고민합니다.

title: Data Scientist, Manager
description:
Data Scientist - Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Officer – Data Scientist

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Data Scientist to join our AI/ML Science team as part of the Agentic AI platform initiative. The Science pillar drives advancements in LLM research, fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, anomaly detection, and next-generation model development, partnering closely with Platform Engineering, SRE, and Pods/Business Engagement to deliver robust agentic solutions and platform features.

In this role, you will drive applied research and product-oriented data science within the Agentic AI platform initiative. Independently own domain-specific model evaluation, fine-tuning, and operationalization workstreams. This role requires deep technical skills in LLMs, graph-based reasoning, and production-scale AI deployments, as well as the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own BU specific AI/ML problem statements and objectives to deliver value leveraging agentic AI workflows and domain specific LLM solutions.
  • Lead foundational and domain model evaluation, fine-tuning, and prompt optimization with robust data curation and governance.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks, taxonomies, and metrics for model benchmarking and anomaly detection.
  • Build and maintain knowledge graphs, embeddings, and inference engines to enable semantic search, reasoning, and scalable serving.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy scalable AI solutions in production environments.
  • Conduct experiments, analyze results, and communicate findings and best practices across teams.
  • Stay abreast of the latest advancements in generative AI, LLMs, and agentic systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 5+ years of overall experience in IT and 3+ years of relevant experience in applied machine learning or NLP, with hands-on work in production environments.
  • Strong experience with LLMs, GenAI, or NLP, including fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, DGL), knowledge graphs, and vector stores.
  • Familiarity with cloud AI/ML services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Prior work on agentic AI is a big plus

Work Schedule

On-premise

Keywords

Senior Data Scientist, Generative AI, LLM, Applied Machine Learning, RAG, Agentic Applications, Python, Azure, Model Evaluation

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Information Protection Specialist
description:
Information Protection Specialist

Location: Quincy, Massachusetts

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Cyber Policy Enforcement Lead, VP is responsible for leading the enterprise capability that ensures Cyber Policies and Standards are consistently enforced across the organization.

This role drives accountability for cyber compliance through structured enforcement mechanisms, timely risk-based escalation, and managing the consequence management processes. The role serves as the central coordination point for cyber policy enforcement activities, enabling policy and standard requirements are embedded within business processes, ownership is clearly defined, risks are escalated appropriately, and corrective actions are effectively monitored through resolution.

The VP partners closely with cybersecurity SMEs, business stakeholders, and senior leadership to define enforceable requirements, monitor performance metrics, identify consequence considerations, and deliver clear reporting that enables informed management decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the enterprise Cyber Policy Enforcement and Consequence Management capability, enabling consistent application of Cyber Policy and Standard requirements across business units and functions.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance policy enforcement, escalation, and consequence management frameworks, processes, and governance mechanisms.
  • Partner with SMEs from Global Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders to establish enforcement priorities, remediation expectations, and consequence management activities.
  • Drive integration of policy enforcement requirements into business processes, governance forums, and risk management practices.
  • Facilitate structured engagement forums to review compliance performance, residual risks, remediation progress, and enforcement actions as applicable.
  • Prepare and present compliance, enforcement, and risk insights to senior leadership, risk committees, and governance forums.
  • Monitor compliance performance and risk trends, identify systemic issues and root causes, and drive sustainable remediation and continuous improvement.
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and leverage automation opportunities to enhance monitoring, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  • Conduct periodic reviews and updates of enforceable requirements, monitoring expectations, consequence considerations to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Relevant industry certifications strongly preferred, such as:
    • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
    • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
    • CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
    • CGEIT (Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT)
    • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, operational risk, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing policy enforcement, issue management, escalation, and/or consequence management frameworks within a large, complex organization.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity governance, risk management, control frameworks, and regulatory expectations within highly regulated industries.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving cybersecurity SMEs, technology teams, and business partners to achieve risk reduction and compliance objectives.
  • Experience managing enterprise-scale stakeholder relationships across business, technology, risk, audit, and executive leadership functions.
  • Proven track record of driving accountability and influencing senior stakeholders to address non-compliance, remediate risks, and improve control effectiveness.
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level reporting, risk assessments, metrics, and recommendations to senior management, risk committees, and governance forums.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity governance, policy management, standards management, control monitoring, and risk oversight practices.
  • Strong knowledge of industry frameworks and regulations, including NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, FFIEC, SEC, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex risks and recommend practical, risk-based solutions.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and effectively challenge stakeholders while maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Strong executive reporting skills, including the ability to translate complex cyber risk, compliance, and enforcement insights into clear, actionable messaging for senior management and governance forums.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strategic, execution-focused cyber governance leader with experience driving enterprise policy enforcement, escalation, and consequence management. They can translate cyber requirements into enforceable actions, measurable outcomes, and clear accountability, while partnering effectively across cyber, technology, business, risk, audit, and leadership teams. They use metrics and executive reporting to surface risks, support decisions, and reinforce a culture of cyber risk ownership.

title: Kitchen Specialist
description:
Join us and experience Bunnings from the other side of the counter!

What’s in it for you when you’re part of our team:

  • Team discount at Bunnings and other Wesfarmers brands including Kmart, Target and Officeworks to name a few

  • Free standard OnePass membership

  • Access to over 100+ exclusive team member benefits across health, shopping, travel and stay, wealth, work and leave

  • 12 weeks paid parental leave, regardless of gender

  • Fun stuff like annual festive gifts, discounted food and drinks at our Bunnings Cafe, and travelling store team member opportunities

  • We’re genuinely invested in your career and no matter where you start with us, that pathway is yours to build

About the role:

As a Kitchen Specialist, you'll provide the best experience for all our customers kitchen and bathroom needs. From giving advice on fixtures and fittings to full design, order and installation projects, you'll play a key part in making our customers projects transform into real-life results.


We provide an adult pay rate for 18 years of age and above at $30.45 per hour for this role.

What’s involved:

  • Provide exceptional customer service, understanding their needs, preferences and budget

  • Guide customers to suitable design services and produce quotes

  • Stock management, keeping up to date on newly featured products whilst ensuring a clean and tidy work environment

  • Generate sales and managing on-going orders

  • Work as part of a supportive and inclusive team who are making a difference and have fun along the way

Who we’re looking for:

We’re on the lookout for a team member who is passionate about interiors, design, DIY or residential construction and loves variety in their day-to-day work. Experience in the industry is always a plus, however we will give you all the training you’ll need and show you so that you are fully equipped to turn our customer's dream kitchens into a reality.

You’ll have:

  • A genuine passion for customer experience

  • The ability to engage and connect with our customers to assist with their project journey

  • An eagerness to learn about products and services

  • To act with integrity, be safe and do your best

  • The availability to work flexible hours (including late nights, early mornings and weekends)

When you’re ready to give this opportunity a Red Hot Go, all you’ll need to do is:

  • Submit an application and complete an online chat interview (20 minutes)

  • If successful, next step includes an online video interview (15 minutes)

  • If you’re a match, we’ll invite you to an onsite meet and greet with our leaders (20 minutes)

You’ll be part of a workplace where you’ll feel like you belong.


We love the diversity across our teams, brought together in an inclusive culture guided by our values. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. We strongly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in shaping a workplace that celebrates First Nations voices, perspectives, and contributions. Please note, you must be age 15 or over to apply for a role at Bunnings.

We’re all about fairness at Bunnings, and our team’s here to support you every step of the way. If you need any adjustments, just let us know - we’re here to help. If you’ve got the experience, skills, and drive to grow - but don’t quite nail every part of the job description - we still want to hear from you. For support, contact us at jobs@bunnings.com.au.

Bunnings reserves the right to close job advertisements at any time, so we encourage you to apply early. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, as we have a dedicated internal Talent Acquisition team managing all hiring processes.

About Us

Bunnings is the leading retailer of home improvement and lifestyle products in Australia and New Zealand. We're proud to support project builders, commercial tradespeople and the housing industry through our network of stores, trade centres, frame and truss sites and online.

At Bunnings, our purpose is simple: we’re here to inspire people to have a red hot go! Whether that's backing our team to grow, supporting customers to take on new projects, or helping communities make a real difference. By joining our passionate and diverse team, you will be part of a culture that encourages you to roll up your sleeves and build something great together. If you’re ready to have a go, apply today.

Please note if you are offered a role with us, background checks may be required. This can include police, employment, medical and qualification checks. If a police check search returns a criminal record, Bunnings will assess whether the record impacts your ability to perform the key requirements of the role.

title: Robotics Fleet Operations Technician
description:
At Robot.com, we automate businesses to achieve peak efficiency and productivity, freeing human time for higher-level tasks. We believe the future is powered by clean and effective technology, and we’re committed to offering low or no-cost delivery services for everyone.

We are a dynamic, fast-paced organization that values collaboration, creativity, and innovation — and we’re excited to welcome the next generation of tech talent to our team.

About the Role

As a Robotics Fleet Operations Technician, you’ll be responsible for ensuring our robot fleet operates at peak performance and reliability. This role combines technical expertise, operational coordination, and process design to maintain a fleet availability rate above 95% and ensure seamless deployments across our sites.

Key Responsibilities

Operational & Coordination

  • Act as the on-site operations point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring smooth daily performance.

  • Plan, coordinate, and monitor robot deployments, redeployments, and recoveries.

  • Design workflows for systematic maintenance and visual inspections.

  • Ensure operational goals and KPIs are consistently met (fleet uptime >95%, SLA compliance, service quality).

  • Support cross-functional initiatives in growth, marketing, and client engagement.

  • Develop SOPs for process improvement and documentation consistency.

  • Prepare and present performance reports, OKRs, and site performance dashboards.

Maintenance & Technical

  • Guarantee fleet uptime above 95% through proactive maintenance and resource planning.

  • Design and implement workflows for systematic visual inspections and deployments.

  • Coordinate robot deployment, redeployment, and recovery as required.

  • Provide on-site guidance and act as a technical consultant for operations and field teams.

  • Lead preventive and corrective maintenance plans to ensure robots remain fully functional and visually optimal.

  • Maintain detailed logs of all interventions, updates, and replacements.

  • Manage spare parts and tool inventory efficiently.

  • Execute hardware and software updates and field testing.

  • Monitor connectivity (SIM cards, data plans, network performance).

  • Collaborate with technical teams to diagnose and resolve recurring issues.

  • Drive initiatives to improve maintenance processes and reduce downtime.

Team & Compliance

  • Act as a technical consultant and mentor for on-site team members and interns.

  • Conduct weekly operational reviews, share insights, and coordinate improvement actions.

  • Support training programs for local coordinators and technical teams.

  • Promote a culture of safety, collaboration, and accountability.

Qualifications

  • Education: Degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, Electronic, or Biomedical Engineering (or equivalent technical background).

  • Experience: Prior experience in robotics, maintenance coordination, or fleet operations preferred.

  • Skills:

    • Strong technical and diagnostic skills

    • Excellent communication and coordination abilities

    • Solution-oriented and proactive mindset

    • Resilience and adaptability in dynamic environments

  • Language: Native English

  • Travel: Must hold or be able to obtain a U.S. VISA

What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation

  • Round-trip flights from your home country to assigned sites

  • Groceries or meal allowance during travels

  • Travel insurance

  • Access to Platzi courses to continue your professional development

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, päiväkoti Koskela, Koskela
description:
Tule meille iloiseen ja ammattitaitoiseen joukkoomme ryhmä Koskelanpuistoon Tammenterhojen ryhmään. Tammenterhot on kolmen kasvattajan ryhmä, jossa lapset ovat iältään 3-5 vuotiaita.

Tarjoamme sinulle työympäristön, jossa voit aktiivisessa ja yhteisöllisessä työyhteisössä tukea lasten oppimista ja oivalluksia. Toimintaamme ohjaavat sensitiivisyys sekä lapsen yksilöllisyyden arvostaminen. keskitymme kuluvan kauden aikana erityisesti lasten leikkiin ja leikkiympäristöjen rikastamiseen ja kehittämiseen. Olisiko sinulla innostusta ja halua olla mukana kehittämässä hyvää pedagogista toimintaa, jossa lapsen on hyvä olla ja oppia, kasvaa omaksi itsekeseen?
Sijaitsemme vehreällä alueella hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä monipuolisista retkikohteista.
Olet sitten vastavalmistunut tai konkari, niin olet tervetullut joukkoomme!

Miksi töihin meille?
Meille on tärkeää, että voit tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä hyvän helsinkiläisen elämän eteen. Haluamme, että onnistut ja innostut työssäsi. Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Tuoreimman henkilöstökyselyn mukaan meillä viihdytään ja työ koetaan mielekkääksi!

Saat käyttöösi Suomen suurimman työnantajan henkilöstöedut, kuten jopa 550 euron Epassi Flex -edun käytettäväksi työmatkoihin sekä kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Lue lisää henkilöstöeduistamme ja tutustu Helsingin kaupunkiin työnantajana osoitteessa hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana vastaat lapsiryhmäsi toimintakulttuurin ja oppimisympäristön rakentumisesta, pedagogisen toiminnan suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta, kehittämisestä ja arvioinnista sekä lasten yksilöllisen oppimisen tukemisesta Helsingin varhaiskasvatus- ja esiopetussuunnitelman, varhaiskasvatusyksikön toimintasuunnitelman sekä lapsen vasun mukaisesti.

Kelpoisuusehdot:
Edellytämme, että sinulla on varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus tai siirtymäsäännöksen (75 §) mukaisesti kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto (lto), soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotasoinen tutkinto, esim. lastentarhanopettajan tai sosiaalikasvattajan tutkinto (laki 272/2005 ja asetus nro 608/2005). Kelpoisuusvaatimuksen täyttää myös Opetushallituksen ulkomaisen koulutuksen perusteella tekemä tunnustamispäätös kelpoisuudesta haettavaan tehtävään.

Lisäksi edellytämme sinulta hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Valitun henkilön tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikostaustaote lasten kanssa toimimiseen (504/2002). Alle kouluikäisten lasten kanssa työskentelevien hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskeva selvitys tarkastetaan (tartuntatautilaki § 55).

Aloittaessasi vakituisen työsuhteen varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana Helsingin kaupungilla vuonna 2026 tarjoamme sinulle 2000 euron kannustuspalkkion. Palkkio maksetaan vain kerran samalle henkilölle. Lisätietoja saat rekrytoivalta päiväkodin johtajalta.

title: Keittiön vuoropäällikkö Pyhälle
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme keittiön vuoropäällikköä talvikaudelle Pyhälle. Tehtävä alkaa marrraskuun puolessa välissä ja kestää arviolta huhtikuun loppuun saakka. Tehtävässä kertyy työtunteja arviolta 90-112,5h/3vko, ja palkka neuvotellaan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella.

Etsimme keittiön vuoropäälliköksi ravintola-alan ammattilaista, jolla on halu kehittyä urallaan. Ruuanlaitto on sinulle sydämenasia, ja haluat tarjota asiakkaillesi ensiluokkaisia ravintolaelämyksiä.

Edellytämme sinulta:

* Vankkaa keittiötyön osaamista sekä aiempaa kokemusta a la carte -ravintoloista
* Usean vuoden kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä ja työvuorojen johtamisesta
* Kykyä toimia tehokkaasti myös kiireisissä tilanteissa
* Hyviä yhteistyö- ja organisointitaitoja
* Hygieniapassia

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn upeassa ravintolaympäristössä sekä kannustavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön.

Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta, jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian nettisivuillamme olevan hakulomakkeen kautta. Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

description:

    Job Info

    Job Description








   
   
 

 

   

  
    Background:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    UNFPA's Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) has identified Supply Chain Management (SCM) as a critical strategic priority to ensure progress toward its three transformative results. To enhance strategic foresight, SCMU launched a pioneer model of decentralisation: the Regional SCM Desk in West and Central Africa (WCA), headquartered in Dakar. As part of the SCMU's realignment initiative in 2024, the WCA Regional SCM Desk was designed to bring expertise closer to delivery, embedding supply chain considerations early in program planning and enhancing anticipation of local logistics and political challenges. While the WCA Regional SCM Desk is physically located in the region, it is not a unit of the UNFPA WCA Regional Office (RO). The WCA desk has been set up differently from the other regions. Every region has dedicated Supply Chain Specialists (in all six regions) and Logisticians (in three of the six regions), compared to an additional procurement services team in the WCA region. The WCA regional office (non-SCMU) also has supply chain expertise, whereas not all other regions have this function in their structures.








   
   
 

 

   

  
    The Regional Supply Chain Desk (Downstream Supply Chain) is expected to:

Provide technical inputs into country programme documents, work plans and other relevant technical documents/ grant proposals to ensure supply chain considerations are taken into account.

    
Support countries to develop robust multi-year quantification and adopt government-led and coordinated national supply planning processes.
    





    
Review UNFPA Supplies Partnership Health Systems Strengthening (HSS) Transformative Action (TA) supply chain management applications, ensuring that planned activities are aligned with findings from the LMA process.
    

    
Follow up with countries on outstanding reports, including resolution of audit recommendations related to supply chain management.
    





    
Maintain supply chain management issue logs, detailing the nature and status of significant capacity gaps identified throughout LMA activities and proactively support countries to resolve them.
    

    
Analyse the Quarterly Stock Review (QSR) reports and identify opportunities for re-distribution of overstocked programme supplies to optimise use and reduce wastes/ expiries, including coordinating inter-country transfers as appropriate.
    





    
Position and advocate for integration of SRH supply chain management into regional and national supply chain strategies and development plans with Regional Economic Commissions (RECs).
    

    
Support Country Offices (CO) with their local procurement and with establishing country and region-specific Long Term Agreements with suppliers.
    

    
Conduct transactional procurement and contracting activities in coordination with the other SCMU procurement teams located in Copenhagen.
    

    
Conduct logistics coordination at a regional and country level to facilitate faster movement of goods to the desired locations.
    

    
Provide back-stopping and best practices in logistics management to the COs in the WCA region.
    




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Beyond the pilot period that has extended for 2 years now, there is a strategic need to evaluate this pilot model for delivery against expected results, identify lessons learned, refine reporting and governance structures, and either establish a roadmap for expanding the Service Desk concept to other regions with adjustments, or recommend an alternative course of action based on the assessment.




   
   
 

 

   

  
    How you can make a difference:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization's response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.


UN careers portal



   
   
 

 

   

  
    In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.




   
   
 

 

   

  
    The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.




   
   
 

 

   

  
    UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Job Purpose:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    The primary objective of this consultancy is to conduct a comprehensive review of the SCM Service Desk pilot in Dakar. The findings will inform whether this pilot initiative should be expanded to all or some regions (and if adjustments should be introduced), discontinued, or replaced with alternative solutions. The consultant will:

Evaluate the operational performance and impact of the WCA Regional SCM Desk against its original objectives.

    
Assess the effectiveness of current structure, reporting lines and administrative arrangements between SCMU (at Headquarters and in the region) and the Regional Office.
    

    
Identify best practices and systemic bottlenecks encountered during the pilot phase.
    

    
Assess the feasibility of scaling the model to other regions (e.g., East and Southern Africa, Asia Pacific, Arab States, Latin American and the Caribbean, Eastern Europe and Central Asia) and develop a strategic roadmap for expansion, or recommend against expansion if the pilot findings warrant maintaining the current structure.
    




   
   
 

 

   

  
    The consultant will report to the Head of Pillar 3, SCMU and work in close collaboration with Pillars 1, 2 and the WCARO Regional Supply Chain Management Team and the regional office colleagues.




   
   
 

 

   

  
    You would be responsible for:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    A. Pilot Performance Review

Analyze the efficiency/effectiveness of the "Desk" in handling procurement, supply planning coordination, last-mile assurance (LMA) support, logistics coordination, advisory services to the COs, procurement services to third parties, etc.

    
Review the impact of the Desk on domestic resource mobilisation (DRM) and partner engagement.
    

    
Evaluate the integration of the Desk to the RO and interaction with other teams beyond the Sexual and Reproductive Health and rights (SRHR) team, including internal collaboration models, such as joint planning processes or inter-unit coordination mechanisms, and whether this translates to better programme delivery at CO level.
    

    
Evaluate how the Desk has incorporated or can integrate with digital transformation tools, specifically the UNFPA Control Tower (Supply Chain Analytics Platform) for Orchestration activities.
    

    
Evaluate client engagement strategies and their direct impact on client satisfaction and responsiveness within the WCA region pilot.
    

    
Review the staff morale and experience of the WCA regional pilot
    




   
     
   
   

   
 

 

   

  
    B. Governance and Structural Analysis

Review the current reporting arrangements, specifically the alignment between the Regional Commodity Management Team Lead, the Procurement Specialist, the Regional Supply Chain Specialist, and the Regional Logistician.

    
Compare the advantages and disadvantages of the current arrangement compared to the structure in the East and Southern Africa (ESA) and Arab States (AS) regions and how these structural differences across regions affect the overall functioning of the SCMU support teams located in the regions.
    

    
Evaluate the "dotted line" reporting relationship between outposted SCMU staff and the Regional Office leadership, particularly how it affects decision-making, efficiency, accountability, and performance management.
    

    
Assess the administrative and Information and Communication Technology (ICT) integration within the Regional Office Business Unit.
    




   
   
 

 

   

  
    C. Lessons Learnt & Way Forward

Conduct online stakeholder interviews with SCMU leadership, WCARO management, selected COs in the region and ESA countries that are supported by the Desk.

    
Conduct online interviews with relevant SCMU staff at the Head Quarters, regional desks and from other regions (East & Southern Africa for example), Programme Division and Humanitarian Response Division colleagues, and select suppliers for a comprehensive overview of expectations and support from the Desk
    

    
Synthesise findings into a "Lessons Learnt" report that addresses both successes (e.g., proximity to delivery, understanding of the local context) and challenges (e.g., role clarity, lead times, risks).
    

    
Draft a "Global SCM Service Desk Blueprint" including recommended staffing structures, standard operating procedures, and resource requirements specific to the regions, only if findings support global expansion; otherwise, provide a detailed rationale for maintaining pilot status or exploring alternative models.
    




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Duration and working schedule:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    The consultancy is expected to be for eight (8) weeks. The consultants will work Monday - Friday, 9:00 to 17:30, following the current schedule of SCMU in Copenhagen.




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Place where services are to be delivered:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    This consultancy will be conducted on a fully remote basis.




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Qualifications and Experience:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Education:

Advanced university degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Relations, and related areas is required.


   
   
 

 

   

  
    Knowledge and Experience:

A minimum of 7 years of experience in international supply chain management is required. Previous experience within the UN system or international NGOs, as well as field experience, is considered a strong asset.

    
Proven track record in evaluating decentralised operational models and organisational design.
    

    
Deep understanding of procurement, logistics, and last-mile assurance in fragile and humanitarian contexts.
    

    
Ability to synthesise complex data from digital platforms (e.g., Control Tower) into strategic recommendations.
    




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Languages:

Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in French is highly desirable.


   
   
 

 

   

  
    Required Competencies:




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Values:

Exemplifying integrity,

    
Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
    

    
Embracing cultural diversity,
    

    
Embracing change
    




   
   
 

 

   

  
    Core Competencies:

Achieving results,

    
Being accountable,
    

    
Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,
    

    
Thinking analytically and strategically,
    

    
Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Gode personaleordninger, herunder sundheds- og tandforsikring

	
Gratis adgang til fitnessfaciliteter på lokationen

	
Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje

	
Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt i takt med CAC Mobilitys fortsatte udvikling, herunder kurser og uddannelse der retter sig mod autobranchen, så du altid er opdateret på nye tendenser

title: Structure Supervisor-OSBL
description:
Remarkable people, trusted by clients to design and advance the world.

Wood is currently recruiting for a Structural Supervisor to join the team for an immediate start, supporting construction activities on a major EPCM project for a key client project in Chonburi, Thailand. This role is offered as an initial 12-month contract with the opportunity to continue as an ongoing, longer-term assignment and available for Thai National.

Designing the future. Transforming the World.

Wood has a deep history pioneering technical expertise globally for more than 160 years, from the North Sea to the Gulf of Thailand, and is now embarking on an exciting new chapter. Building on 40 years of Engineering excellence in Thailand, Wood invites you to join our dedicated team, to shape the future of the energy industry in Asia Pacific and beyond. Join us in the heart of Chonburi, within a vibrant and fast-growing hub on Thailand’s Eastern Seaboard where you will enjoy being close to major industrial and energy centres with the lifestyle advantages of a coastal location. Perfectly positioned within reach of Bangkok and minutes from the coastline of Pattaya, our office is the ideal blend of career opportunity and coastal lifestyle.

At Wood Thailand you will thrive in a collegiate team culture by partnering with likeminded, agile industry peers to inspire with ingenuity and create new possibilities.

What we can offer

  • Excellent rates, with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
  • Ongoing work on interesting projects delivered in partnership to leaders of industry across energy and materials markets
  • Global connections, join an inclusive and diverse international community of inquisitive minds and recognised industry innovators, partnering to create new possibilities
  • Flexible working arrangements balance client, team and individual needs with opportunities for hybrid and remote working
  • Commitment to your Wellbeing, with annual contribution to Health Insurance and free 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business

#LI-Onsite

Reporting to the Construction Manager, your immediate focus will be supporting the supporting construction activities on a major EPCM project for a key client. You will bring to life Woods' three-pillar strategy of Inspired Culture, Delivery Excellence and Profitable Growth on the project. Leading by example, you will consistently display and enforce Wood values and behaviour and commitment to the highest standards of safe and ethical behaviour to ensure safe, reliable operations and client satisfaction.

You will thrive on the challenge of balancing technical, team, client, and project leadership in this key site-based role with your focus on relationships and delivery, enabling you to anticipate project needs beyond the immediate scope. You will drive technical excellence and assurance on the painting and insulation portion while working in close partnership with other disciplines and the client, to enable robust technical decisions that ultimately add value to the client and project.

In addition, you will:

  • Ensure that all construction contractors’ supervision and manpower are instructed in and comply with all aspects of the Company Health, Safety, Environment and Security (HSES) policy, site regulations, permit to work procedures and instructions and Client requirements
  • Ensure that construction contractors working within his discipline adhere strictly to the latest Approved for Construction (AFC) project drawings, Specifications, ITP’s, Procedures and Site Instructions
  • Responsible for the HSES, and quality aspects of the work within assigned areas and for ensuring construction contractors complete their work in accordance with the project schedule
  • Proactive in providing support to project team in assigned project work as and when required
  • Vocation, Diploma, or bachelor’s degree in civil or related field
  • Extensive track record managing Civil Construction activities including site preparation, piling, foundation, building, steel structure, testing, walk down, punch listing, reinstatement and pre - commissioning
  • Minimum 10 years experienced of working I Live Plant, Greenfield and Turnaround / Revamp work for Oil & Gas, Refinery, Petrochemical, Power Plant, or others similar type of plants
  • Good HSES awareness and commitment including skill and knowledge in preparation of Method Statement, Job Safety Analysis and Risk Assessment.
  • Good skill and knowledge in work related to General Civil, Foundation, Underground, Structure Steel, Building Drawings, General Arrange Drawings, Concrete Testing and Technical Queries, etc.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English (verbal & written)
  • Basic computer software skills to include the use of word processing and email as well as the use of spreadsheets and electronic presentations

title: Engineer Lead, Site Reliability
