					 Søborg, DK, 2860
					 
			 


			
     
                 

             

         

     

    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
                 
 Er du klar til at blive en del af et stærkt team, hvor tempo, kvalitet og godt humør går hånd i hånd? Så er du måske vores nye hjulmontør til den kommende hjulskiftesæson. 


   


 Om jobbet
 Som hjulmontør hos Audi Gladsaxe bliver du en vigtig del af vores team i hjulskiftesæsonen. Du får blandt andet ansvar for: 

 

 Professionelt hjulskifte på premiumbiler 


 Kontrol af dæktryk, slid og skader, da vi ikke går på kompromis med sikkerheden 


 Afbalancering af hjul for optimal kørekomfort 


 Rengøring og opmærkning af hjul til opbevaring 


 Samarbejde med teknikere og værkstedsledelse for at sikre en effektiv drift 


 Kvalitetssikring af dit arbejde, så vores kunder altid får den bedste oplevelse 

 

   


 Du bliver en del af et team, hvor effektivitet, kvalitet og præcision er nøgleord, og hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen for at sikre, at hver bil forlader værkstedet i topform. 


   


 Om dig
 Vi leder efter dig, der: 

 

 Har erfaring med hjulskifte 


 Trives i et højt tempo og bevarer overblikket 


 Har øje for detaljer og leverer høj kvalitet hver gang 


 Er en holdspiller med godt humør, som bidrager positivt til teamet 

 

   


 Derudover forventer vi, at du har kørekort (minimum kategori B). 


   


 Kendskab til Audi er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du erfaring med andre bilmærker, sørger vi for at udvikle dine kompetencer og give dig den nødvendige oplæring. 


   


 Om os
 Audi Gladsaxe er en del af Semler Gruppen, som har over 100 års erfaring inden for import og salg af biler, og består af mere end 3.000 medarbejdere. Vores specialiserede medarbejdere og mangeårige erfaring giver os en stærk placering på markedet. Det kræver at vi er dedikerede og sætter en ære i vores arbejde hver eneste dag. 


   


 Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, pension, sundhedssikring og en hel del andre fordelagtige medarbejdergoder samt muligheden for at blive en vigtig del af en stor og professionel organisation. 


   


 Hvad kan du forvente af mig som leder?
 Som din leder kan du forvente en dedikeret og ambitiøs tilgang, hvor jeg prioriterer dine muligheder for udvikling og trivsel højt. Jeg arbejder målrettet for at skabe et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til stor frihed i dine egne arbejdsopgaver. 


   


 Samtidig kan du regne med, at jeg er tilgængelig for sparring og hjælp, når du har brug for det. Jeg ønsker at støtte dig i at nå dine mål og sikre, at vi sammen opnår succes gennem samarbejde, respekt og fælles engagement. 


   


 Lyder det som noget for dig?
 Vi ønsker opstart er hurtigst muligt, så derfor behandler vi ansøgninger løbende, så søg gerne allerede i dag. 


   


 Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Værkstedchef Rasmus Lindeborg Vilhelmsen på mail ravi@audi.dk 


   


 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

                 
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
     
                 

             

         

     


    
 
        
 
         

     

                                         

                                        
 
    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
  

     

    
    
 
        
   Din vej. Fælles fremtid  


 Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.   



 At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.  



 Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.   



 Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i.   



 Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.   



 Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.  



 Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Senior Process Engineer for Simatek A/S | Actief Hartmanns A/S
description:
Senior Process Engineer for Simatek A/S 
 

 

 

 Share: 

 


 
  
  
 

 

 


 
 
 Senior Process Engineer for Simatek A/S 
 
 


 

 Would you like to develop advanced process solutions for international industrial customers and leave your technical mark on projects from concept to commissioning? -Join Simatek as a Senior Process Engineer and play a key role in a global engineering niche leader. 


 About the Position 


 As a Senior Process Engineer, you will become a key technical partner within Simatek's Process & Proposal team. Your primary responsibility will be to transform customer requirements into competitive, technically robust process solutions that support the company's continued growth. 


 You will work at the intersection of Technology, Sales, Engineering, Procurement and Project Management, playing a vital role in defining system solutions around Simatek's core products. This position requires a broad understanding of complete process systems and the ability to ensure seamless integration between all technical interfaces. 


 A significant part of your daily work will be as active part of the proposal phase, either working on the definition of new standards that can be quoted, in direct collaboration with Technology and other functions through definition of the system both in terms of technical functionality and commercial, and also preparing technical proposals. Both tasks require performing process calculations, sizing equipment, collaborating with suppliers, and clarifying customer specific technical solutions. At the same time, you will act as an important technical advisor, supporting customer discussions and helping develop solutions that are both technically sound and commercially competitive. 


 The role also offers excellent development opportunities. You will have the chance to influence engineering standards, design tools, and future process solutions. Over time, the position may evolve toward a more commercial role or product development, depending on both the company's needs and your own ambitions. 


 You will become part of an international organization working across borders, where English is the primary business language. The role includes occasional international travel for customer visits and technical meetings. 

 Qualifications 
 

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related engineering discipline 


 Minimum five years of experience in process engineering, system design, or the development of technical solutions within industrial environments 


 Experience with process calculations, PFDs, P&IDs, and equipment sizing 


 Strong understanding of industrial process systems and the integration of multiple technologies 


 Experience with technical proposals, quotations, or engineering projects is an advantage 


 Ability to translate customer requirements into practical, technically sound, and commercially attractive solutions 


 Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across multiple disciplines 


 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. A second or more additional languages are considered an advantage 

 
 About You 

 You are motivated by complex technical challenges and naturally see opportunities where others see limitations. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with many stakeholders and constantly changing priorities, while maintaining a structured and solution oriented approach. 


 You are a strong team player who builds trust across the organization. You communicate clearly, establish strong working relationships, and know how to balance technical requirements with commercial considerations. You take ownership, work proactively, and are motivated by improving processes and helping establish effective engineering standards. 


 At Simatek, personal qualities are valued just as highly as technical expertise. The ideal candidate is curious, solution oriented, and eager to grow within a role where engineering, collaboration, and business go hand in hand. 

 Simatek A/S Offers 
 

 A key role in an international engineering company with a strong technical foundation 


 The opportunity to influence future process solutions and engineering standards 


 A highly skilled and collaborative professional environment 


 Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development as the company continues to grow 


 Flexible working conditions, including the possibility of working from home up to two days per week by agreement 


 An attractive compensation package including pension, health insurance, performance bonus, and a subsidized lunch scheme 


 An active employee association organizing social events throughout the year 

 

 If this opportunity sounds like the right fit for you, please submit your application and CV by clicking the Apply button. We look forward to hearing from you.
 If you have any questions or would like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Branch Manager Henrik Jerichau at  hj@actief-teknikbureauet.dk  or by phone at +45 41 21 14 09. All enquiries will be treated with strict confidentiality. 


 Actief Teknik Bureauet is managing the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S. Therefore, we kindly ask that all enquiries regarding the position be directed to us.
 We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion, or nationality.
 Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified, even if this is before the application deadline. 
	 


 

 

 

 Share: 

 


 
  
  
 

 

 


 
 Søg Stilling 
 

 

 


 

 
 Søg Stilling 
 


 

 
 Søg Stilling 
 

 
 
 Type: 

 

 Fastansættelse 

 

 


 
 
 Region: 

 

 DK Københavnsområdet 

 

 


 
 
 Jobnummer 

 R1005397 

 


 
 
 Ansøgningsfrist  2026-09-09 23:59:00	 


 
 
 Kontakt: 
 Henrik Jerichau 

  eller ring +45 41 21 14 09  

 

 
 	 

 

 

 
 	 


 

 

 About Simatek A/S 


 Simatek A/S is an international engineering company in Denmark with main Danish offixes in Albertslund and Sorø. For more than 40 years, Simatek has developed and delivered advanced filtration and process solutions to industrial customers worldwide. The company is particularly recognized for its high efficiency bag filters and complete process systems, serving industries such as food processing, minerals, chemicals, cement, mining, biomass, and recycling. With customers across the globe, Simatek combines strong engineering expertise with a practical approach to solving complex technical challenges. 


 Simatek is an international company with a strong global presence and an extensive network of customers and business partners. The company combines an agile organization with decades of experience in developing industrial process and filtration solutions. 


 The culture at Simatek is characterized by commitment, collaboration, and a continuous ambition to improve the way things are done. You will become part of an organization where challenging existing solutions, taking ownership, and contributing new ideas are actively encouraged. The pace is fast, and not every process is fully defined. In return, you will have the opportunity to influence the way the business operates, create structure, and help shape a growing organization. This is an environment for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and turning engineering expertise into practical, value-creating solutions.

title: Principal Data Center Electrical Product Development Engineer
description:
Principal Data Center Electrical Product Development Engineer

Location: United States

The ideal candidate combines deep electrical engineering expertise with experience in product development, supplier quality, equipment qualification, failure analysis, and continuous product improvement.

Responsibilities

Product Development & Engineering

· Lead the technical development, evaluation, qualification, and lifecycle management of mission-critical electrical equipment for Oracle data centers.

· Develop equipment technical requirements, specifications, validation plans, and acceptance criteria to ensure products meet Oracle performance, reliability, safety, and operational objectives.

· Collaborate with manufacturers and engineering partners during product design, prototype development, factory testing, and product qualification.

· Drive design improvements and product enhancements based on field experience, operational data, lessons learned, and emerging technologies.

· Evaluate new technologies and electrical products for deployment within next-generation Oracle data centers.

Equipment Quality & Reliability

· Lead root cause investigations for electrical equipment failures, reliability concerns, warranty issues, and field quality events.

· Develop corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with suppliers and internal stakeholders to improve product reliability and reduce operational risk.

· Define equipment qualification processes including Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), reliability testing, environmental testing, and long-term performance validation.

· Establish reliability metrics, failure trends, and performance analytics to support continuous product improvement.

· Partner with Quality, Operations, and Manufacturing teams to improve product consistency and long-term equipment performance.

Supplier Technical Leadership

· Serve as Oracle's primary technical interface with electrical equipment manufacturers and suppliers.

· Review supplier designs, manufacturing processes, quality documentation, testing procedures, and engineering change requests.

· Support supplier audits, technical assessments, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness reviews.

· Evaluate supplier technical capabilities and participate in strategic sourcing decisions for critical electrical equipment.

Standards & Continuous Improvement

· Develop and maintain Oracle electrical equipment standards, technical specifications, approved product lists, testing procedures, and engineering guidelines.

· Lead engineering reviews for product changes, component substitutions, obsolescence management, and qualification of alternate suppliers.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment quality, manufacturability, reliability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

· Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices, technical training, and knowledge sharing across the organization.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Summary As Oracle continues to expand its global data center infrastructure, we are seeking a Principal Data Center Electrical Product Development Engineer to lead the technical development, qualification, and lifecycle management of mission-critical electrical equipment deployed across Oracle's data centers. This role is responsible for driving the development, validation, quality, and continuous improvement of electrical equipment including switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, busway, PDUs, automatic transfer switches (ATS), generators, power distribution assemblies, protection systems, and emerging power technologies. The engineer will work closely with internal engineering teams, suppliers, manufacturing partners, quality organizations, and operations to ensure products meet Oracle's performance, reliability, safety, and scalability requirements.

 Civil Budget Engineer  

 Hedehusene, Denmark 

  

 Ready to help build a better future for generations to come? 

 In an ever-changing, fast paced world, we owe it to ourselves and our future generations to live life responsibly.  At ROCKWOOL, we work relentlessly to enrich modern living through our innovative stone wool solutions.  

 Join us and make a difference! 

  

 Your future team: 

 You will become part of the Civil Department responsible for Civil aspects of (slet Budgets across) major CAPEX projects from concept to civil design, construction and handover phases. . We are a team of 15 engineers and project managers representing 7 different nationalities across 3 locations in Denmark, Poland and USA. We have expertise in structural and civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering, as well as project management. 

  

 What you will be doing: 

 We are looking for an experienced Civil Budget Engineer to establish and manage our CIVIL budget framework across our capex project portfolio. This newly created role offers the opportunity to elevate our CIVIL budgeting practices through innovative structure and streamlined processes. 

 In this position, you will develop and implement best-practice budgeting processes and governance while optimizing budget structures across our CIVIL project portfolio. On concrete capex projects, you will manage CIVIL cost estimates, purchase requisitions, goods receipts, and invoice processing within Rockwool systems. You will also serve as   a key liaison between     engineering    experts    and     Project Directors    ,   coordinating closely with multiple stakeholders in Denmark and internationally. 

  

 Your Key Responsibilities & Job Content 
 
 Cost & Breakdown Structure Management (WBS/CBS): Establish, structure, and maintain the Project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) in the ERP system to ensure accurate financial alignment with project scopes. 

 Data Governance & Financial Mapping: Ensure strict data integrity by accurately mapping master data (materials, vendor codes, activity types) to the financial chart of accounts and specific cost centers. 

 Cost Tracking & Variance Analysis: Monitor and analyze actual expenditures (Actual Costs) against the approved budget baselines. Perform detailed variance analyses to identify, investigate, and report financial deviations. 

 Commitment & Purchase OrderO Reconciliation: Review and reconcile purchase orders (POs), commitments, and accruals within the system to maintain a real-time, accurate picture of total financial exposure. 

 Financial Forecasting & EAC: Develop, update, and maintain robust financial forecasts, including Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC), leveraging advanced data models and system trends. 

 Cash Flow & Milestone Management: Forecast cash flow requirements by integrating master project schedules and milestones with vendor payment terms and master data logs. 

 Change Management & Baseline Control: Assess, quantify, and track the financial impact of scope changes and Change Orders. Process approved changes in the system to ensure continuous baseline control. 

 Reporting & Business Intelligence (BI): Design, generate, and distribute comprehensive monthly cost status reports and performance dashboards, translating complex system data into actionable insights for project management and stakeholders. 

 Risk & Contingency Tracking: Maintain and monitor the project risk register from a financial perspective, evaluating contingency draws and potential bottom-line impacts. 

 System & Process Optimization: Act as a bridge between Finance, IT, and Project Operations to optimize financial workflows, automate data retrieval, and ensure a "Single Source of Truth" across all platforms. 
 
  

  What you bring: 
 
 Master's degree in civil engineering and/or project management or equivalent 

 10+ years of proven experience as a quantity surveyor and budget lead on major construction projects 

 Solid technical   CIVIL   expertise combined with extensive CAPEX budget management experience 

 Industrial and international project experience, with proven ability to lead budget structures and cost control across complex, multi-cultural settings 

 Strong adherence to project governance 

 Fluent in written and spoken English at a high professional business level 
 
  

 Open to travel approx. 20-30 days a year. 

  

 Ready to apply? If you recognize yourself in this profile and challenge, we kindly invite you to apply with CV written in English. For questions, please reach out to Baris Bekdik at  baris.bekdik@rockwool.com.  

  

 Who we are 

 At ROCKWOOL Group, we are committed to enriching the lives of everyone who experiences our products and services. We help our customers and communities tackle many of today’s biggest sustainability and development challenges, from energy consumption and noise pollution to fire resilience, water scarcity, and flooding. Our product range reflects the diversity of the world’s needs, while supporting our stakeholders in reducing their own carbon footprint. 

  

 Stone wool is a fully recyclable, versatile material that forms the basis of all our businesses. With more than 13,000 dedicated colleagues in around 40 countries and sales in more than 120, we are the world leader in stone wool products, from building insulation to acoustic ceilings, external cladding systems to horticultural solutions, engineered fibres for industrial use to insulation for the process industry, and marine & offshore. 

  

 Sustainability is central to our business strategy.  ROCKWOOL was one of the first companies to commit to actively contributing to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDG’s) framework and are actively committed to 11 SDGs, including SDG 14, Life Below Water.  Through our partnership with the One Ocean Foundation and in connection with our sponsorship of the Denmark SailGP team, we will help raise awareness around ocean health challenges in an effort to accelerate solutions to protect  it.     

  

 Diverse and Inclusive Culture 

 We want all our people to feel valued, respected, included and heard.  We employ 79 different nationalities worldwide and are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees, promote diversity, and work against all forms of discrimination among ROCKWOOL employees. 

  

 At ROCKWOOL, you will experience a friendly team environment. Our culture is very important to us.  In fact, we refer to our culture as “The ROCKWOOL Way".  This is the foundation in which we operate and is based upon our values of ambition, responsibility, integrity and efficiency.

title: Robotics Embedded Systems Intern
description:
Hi everyone! We are hiring a Robotics Embedded Systems Intern ⚡🤖 Help us share this opportunity!


Robot.com is looking for a Robotics Embedded Systems Intern to join our Autonomy Department. This is a chance to work on real-world robotics challenges where your technical curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving skills will have a direct impact. From DAY 1, you’ll take on meaningful responsibilities and contribute to projects that advance our delivery robots’ capabilities.


Common Skills We’re Looking For


  • Programming: Python (Medium/High), C++ (Medium/High), ROS/ROS2 (Low/Medium/High).

  • Tools & DevOps: Docker (Low/Medium), Git (High), experience with development environments, good documentation and coding practices.
    Hardware & APIs: Previous integration of APIs and sensors (2D/3D LiDARs, Stereo Cameras, IMU, GPS/RTK, regular cameras).

  • Embedded Systems: ARM architectures, IoT platforms/services, firmware management, OTA updates.
    Debugging & Maintenance: Bug tracking, troubleshooting, and solving integration issues.
    👉 Chill if you don’t check every box—you’ll learn as you grow with us.


What You’ll Do as a Robotics Embedded Systems Engineer


  • Develop & Maintain Software: Design, test, and refine software for robotics and AI applications.

  • Integrate Systems: Connect software, embedded hardware, and data pipelines into unified robotic solutions.
    Optimize Performance: Tune algorithms and improve system efficiency.

  • Debug & Solve Issues: From firmware bugs to hardware malfunctions.

  • Manage Releases: Handle firmware, OS, dependencies, and over-the-air updates for robot fleets.

  • Hardware Integration: Work with communication protocols for sensors, actuators, and robot boards.

  • Firmware & Containers: Maintain embedded firmware, manage containers, and support CI pipelines.
    Documentation & Security: Keep detailed documentation and follow best practices for privacy and security.


About the Team


At Robot.com, we believe robotics will play a key role in solving the last-mile delivery problem. Our Autonomy team is developing control, perception, vision, and analysis systems to make delivery faster, safer, and more reliable.


The Role


You’ll collaborate with roboticists, hardware engineers, IT software developers, and ML experts to ensure system requirements are met. Your work will involve:


  • Design analysis and system characterization.

  • Controller design and system integration.

Running test programs to deliver robust, scalable, and high-performing robots.

title: CRA Device I/II(Guangzhou& Surroungding cities))
description:
Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Site management responsibility for clinical studies according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures, ICH GCP Guidelines, applicable project plans and Sponsor requirements, including verification of study training records.
  • Conducts site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ICH guidelines and GCP; including Pre-study, Site Initiation, Process Monitoring, Routine Monitoring, and Close-out Visits.
  • Prepares and implements project plans related to Clinical Monitoring responsibilities.
  • Ensures the protection of subjects by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to alongside applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Safeguards data integrity by careful source document review, source document verification, query generation, and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems.
  • Confirms Site Regulatory documents and applicable eTMF/Sponsor Documents are complete and current throughout the duration of the trial.
  • Guarantees that the study Investigational Product inventory and accountability is accurate and that study materials are stored securely and per protocol requirements.
  • Ensures adherence to global quality control and CRA performance metrics.
  • Ensures audit readiness at site level.
  • Acts in the project role of a Lead CRA as assigned.
  • General On-Site Monitoring Responsibilities:
  • Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter subjects/patients into the study. Ensure the protection of study subjects or patients by performing eligibility review, verifying that screening, informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure the integrity of the source data reported by careful source document review. Monitor data for missing or implausible data.
  • Ensure study data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance; identify deficiencies, deviations and discrepancies, and initiate corrective action as required.
  • Ensure the resources of the Sponsor and Fortrea are spent wisely by performing the required monitoring tasks in an efficient manner, according to SOPs and established guidelines, including managing travel expenses in an economical fashion according to Fortrea travel policy.
  • Travel, including air travel, may be required and is an essential function of the job.
  • Prepare and submit accurate and timely trip reports.
  • Independently perform eCRF review, 100% source data verification, query generation and resolution against established data review guideline with or without direct supervision, on Fortrea or client data management systems, as assigned by management.
  • Assist with the administration of clinical research projects, recruiting investigators (if applicable), collecting investigator documentation and site management.
  • Update, navigate, and maintain Fortrea or study/Sponsor-specific trial management tools/eClinical systems.
  • Track IP shipments and supplies, as needed.
  • Track and follow-up on serious adverse events as assigned.
  • Work closely with the study team, align monitoring to critical study timelines ensuring study deliverables are met.
  • Prepare and implement study-specific monitoring plans and site Initiation slides, as assigned.
  • Attend investigators’ meetings (if applicable), project team meetings and teleconferences, and others as needed.
  • Present training content for site initiation.
  • Assist with training of new employees (e.g., co-monitoring).
  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). An equivalent amount of experience can be substituted as appropriate.
  • Thorough understanding of ICH GCP Guidelines and understanding of local regulatory requirements.
  • Thorough knowledge of monitoring procedures.
  • Basic understanding of the clinical trial process.
  • Fluent in local office language and in English, both written and verbal.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • External Candidates:
  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). AND
  • A minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Internal Candidates:
  • Internal candidates with a minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Ability to monitor study sites independently according to monitoring plan, project requirements, SOPs, and ICH GCP guidelines.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Have an understanding of the Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, process production of reports, narratives and follow up of SAEs.
  • Good planning, organization, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Works efficiently and effectively in a matrix environment.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Thorough working knowledge of Fortrea SOPs for site monitoring.
  • One (1) or more additional years of experience in a related field (i.e., medical, clinical, pharmaceutical, laboratory, research, data analysis, data management or technical writing) is preferred.
  • Phase I monitoring experience.
  • Life Science or Nursing qualification.
  • Specific skills, systems, certifications, and/or licenses preferred.
  • Personal characteristics (leadership, problem solving, interpersonal skills).
  • Good attention to detail.
  • Methodical approach to work.
  • Good understanding of medical and clinical research terminology and clinical research processes.
  • An understanding of the basics of physiology, pharmacology, and medical devices (when applicable).
  • Good understanding of the principles of ICH GCP, ISO 14155 (if applicable) and local regulatory requirements.
  • Good computer literacy with working knowledge of PCs, Windows and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Good oral and written internal and external communication. Strong interpersonal team and organizational skills, personal presentation. The ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Focus on Customer.
  • Innovate and Change.
  • Pursue Scientific and Process Excellence.
  • Work with Others.
  • Achieve Results.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of data and information during interactions with staff at all levels and across studies and sponsors.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct clinical operations activities most effectively and efficiently.
  • Good analytical and negotiation skills.
  • Experience using e-clinical systems [e.g., clinical trial management system (CTMS)].
  • For medical device positions, experience in providing customer service to device end users.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time.
  • Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or touch objects, tools or controls, including a computer keyboard, for up to 8 hours per day.
  • Standard office and/or home working environment.
  • Clinical Research Unit and hospital environment (administrative only).
  • Risk of eye strain.
  • Will involve outside of normal office hours as required by the role.
  • Travel Requirement is 60% of the time (traveling to study sites).

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
   




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

title: Staff Software Engineer in Test - mobile (m/f/n)
description:
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer in Test to raise the quality bar across our mobile app and backend domain - not by writing more tests, but by changing how the whole domain thinks about quality. This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the intersection of QA and mobile development, driving a native-first testing strategy and a culture where developers own quality rather than hand it off.

Your scope of work will cover 3 areas.

I. Test strategy & native automation

  • Design and own the test strategy across mobile teams for native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin) apps.
  • Set strategy for device and OS-version fragmentation coverage and drive flakiness control at scale, running suites on BrowserStack with GitLab CI.
  • Keep the backend/API/contract layer strong and connect it to the mobile client layer.
  • Own quality gates inside app release and store-deployment pipelines, and drive resolution of quality issues that cross team boundaries within the domain.

II. Coaching, culture & technical leadership

  • Pair on testability, shift quality ownership left into the dev workflow, and be the person teams seek out before implementation starts.
  • Mentor Senior Software Engineers in Test, accelerating real, visible growth, and provide technical guidance across the domain.
  • Run knowledge-sharing across QA and Dev: tech talks, workshops, reusable documentation, pair sessions; co-lead the OneTech/QA community.
  • Co-shape the domain's technical quality direction with the SEM, with full autonomy within the domain, and analyze quality trends from reports/metrics to identify improvement areas.
  • Define quality metrics and gates and use them to frame quality risk in business terms for EMs, SEMs, and PMs.

III. AI Governance in testing

  • Define the AI adoption approach for quality engineering in the domain - which tools, which workflows.
  • Design AI-assisted testing workflows and set governance and data-security standards across teams.
  • Assess and manage the risk of AI usage in testing (including production-facing work), not just the productivity upside.
  • Mentor engineers on responsible, effective AI use and report on AI ROI for quality engineering.

Must-have

  • Strong experience automating mobile app tests natively (iOS or Android - ideally both), with commercial, working-level Swift and/or Kotlin.
  • A track record designing test strategy / the test pyramid - not just executing on someone else's plan.
  • Proven shift-left experience - entering the process before coding and measurably changing the outcome.
  • Experience leading technical/process change and working directly with development teams.
  • Experience in introducing mock-based testing - setting the standards and education
  • Proven impact beyond a single team - standards set for multiple teams, or a cross-team quality initiative led.
  • A hands-on, critical relationship with AI - using it and assessing its risks, not just its benefits.
  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Fluency in Polish.
  • Experience with BrowserStack and CI/CD (GitLab).
  • Snapshot testing experience (e.g., swift-snapshot-testing, Paparazzi).
  • Familiarity with Appium - useful for understanding what we're migrating away from.
  • Experience applying AI in testing workflows (we're building skills to support the migration).
  • Experience in the logistics or e-commerce industry.
  • ISTQB Advanced Level - Test Automation Engineer certification.

Why InPost?

  • An international, cross‑functional environment with experienced engineering leaders.
  • The opportunity to work on products used by millions of users across Europe.
  • Real ownership and influence over teams, technical direction, and long‑term solutions.
  • Flexible working model with remote options in Poland.
  • A strong engineering culture focused on quality, collaboration, and impact.
  • We offer a B2B contract.

title: Nordjylland - uopfordret (timelønnede) hos Kongsvang
description:
Nordjylland - uopfordret (timelønnede) hos Kongsvang





  




















































































Vil du være en del af Kongsvang teamet i Nordjylland?
Søg uopfordret i Hobro/Mariager, Aalborg, Hjørring, Frederikshavn og Skagen-området.




I Kongsvang er vi konstant på udkig efter nye, dygtige kollegaer, som vil være med til at løfte servicebranchens kvalitet og ydelser samt gøre en stor forskel for de arbejdspladser, som vi hver dag løser serviceopgaver for. 




Dertil søger vi løbende kvalificerede:

Servicemedarbejdere: Vores servicemedarbejderes primære arbejdsopgave er at sørge for en ren helhed hos kunden - gennem daglig rengøring af eget område og egenkontrol heraf. Som en af hverdagens helte er du som servicemedarbejder således med til at opretholde og højne Kongsvangs serviceniveau - og dermed sikre høj kundetilfredshed.

Kvalitetsassistenter: Vores kvalitetsassistenters vigtigste opgave er, udover daglig rengøring af eget område, at sikre den rene helhed og have fokus på den samlede kvalitet hos kunden. Som kvalitetsassistent har du derfor daglig kontakt med servicemedarbejderne samt kundes kontaktperson på stedet. Kvalitetsopfølgning er således en fast del af dit arbejde.

Tilsynsassistenter: Vores tilsynsassistenters vigtigste opgave er at levere kvalitetsbevidst og ordentlig rengøring samt at føre tilsyn af eget og kollegaers arbejde. Som tilsynsassistent agerer du "højre hånd" for din nærmeste leder og udvalgte kunder, hvor du dels har manuelt rengøringsarbejde og dels ugentlig tilsynstid. Du står derfor for den daglige ledelse - og det er dit ansvar at sørge for en ren helhed hos kunden og herved sikre en høj kundetilfredshed.




Hvem er du? 


Selvstændig, kvalitetsbevidst og ordentlig i dit arbejde


Præsentabel i dit ydre og serviceminded


Kan arbejde alene og i teams med andre


Stabil, loyal og fleksibel


Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk og/eller som minimum engelsk


Kan fremvise straffeattest og børneattest


Rengøringserfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav


Skriv gerne, hvis du før har arbejdet med tilsynsopgaver eller lignende





Hvad kan vi tilbyde?


Deltid eller fuldtid, primært i morgentimerne (fra kl.05.00 og frem) eller eftermiddags/aftentimerne (fra kl.14.00 og frem).


Rengøringsarbejde under ordnede arbejdsforhold


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst


En god og ordentlig introduktion til arbejdet


Kursus i Kongsvang Academy på vores hovedkontor i Åbyhøj, Aarhus


Sundhedsordning i forbindelse med medlemskab af Pension Danmark


Mulighed for ansvarsopgaver med tilsyn og ledelse af teams





Fristet?  

Så send os din ansøgning og bliv en del af vores jobbank. Husk at tydeliggøre i hvilket geografisk område du søger. Vi kontakter dig, hvis/når der er et match mellem dine ønsker og en ledig stilling. 




Søg nu




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: C#/.NET Automation Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with strong C#/.NET development, automation, test automation, and Azure DevOps experience.

This role is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining and supporting scalable software solutions within an enterprise banking environment. The successful candidate will work across software engineering, automation, test automation, DevOps integration and production support to improve system reliability, delivery efficiency and operational performance.

Although the role carries the title of Systems Engineer, the requirement is strongly development and automation focused. The ideal candidate will be comfortable writing production-quality code, building automated test frameworks, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines and supporting business-critical systems in a governed, high-pressure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance and maintain applications using C#, .NET and .NET Core.

  • Build and maintain scalable, secure and high-quality software solutions.

  • Develop automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.

  • Design, develop and execute automated test scripts, preferably using Selenium.

  • Build and enhance test automation frameworks.

  • Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

  • Use Azure Test Plans for test management, planning, execution and reporting.

  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services.

  • Ensure code quality through unit testing, integration testing and automated testing.

  • Participate in system design, technical analysis, code reviews and solution troubleshooting.

  • Support production systems, including incident investigation, root cause analysis and issue resolution.

  • Identify opportunities to improve system stability, performance, maintainability and reliability.

  • Collaborate with development, QA, infrastructure, business and operations teams.

  • Follow enterprise governance, security, risk and compliance standards.

  • Contribute to Agile delivery ceremonies, continuous improvement initiatives and DevOps practices.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation where required.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET / .NET Core.

  • Proven software development experience in an enterprise environment.

  • Experience with test automation, preferably using Selenium.

  • Experience integrating automated tests into Azure DevOps pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of Azure Test Plans.

  • Experience with automation development, scripting, process automation or related automation tooling.

  • Solid understanding of RESTful API development and backend services.

  • Database experience, preferably SQL Server or similar relational databases.

  • Experience with version control tools such as Git.

  • Understanding of the full SDLC.

  • Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD and Agile delivery.

  • Ability to troubleshoot application, integration and production issues.

Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Exposure to the Azure cloud platform.

  • Experience working in a financial services, banking or regulated enterprise environment.

  • Knowledge of containerisation technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.

  • Exposure to enterprise integrations and complex system landscapes.

  • Understanding of secure coding practices.

  • Experience working with governance, risk, compliance and audit requirements.

  • RPA or process automation exposure would be advantageous.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years' software development experience.

  • Proven experience in C#/.NET development.

  • Proven experience in automation, test automation or quality engineering.

  • Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Financial services experience is advantageous but not mandatory.

Soft Skills and Competencies

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.

  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Kan du tage medansvar for den daglige drift i butikken og bidrage til, at kunderne får en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye salgsleder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et verdensklasse sammenhold, og sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Vi investerer i dig som medarbejder, og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.




Om jobbet


Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse 

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Åbne og/eller lukke butikken

Bestille varer hjem til butikken




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen

Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives med en travl hverdag

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som salgsleder i Lidl får du:

Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.

Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.

Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

description:
Lærere til supplering i matematik, kemi, engelsk og religion. Lærer til vikariat i engelsk hurtigst muligt.   
                
 
                    
 På Århus Akademi starter vi suppleringskurser den 1.9, og der afvikles eksamen i december. Vi mangler undervisere til matematik A, matematik B, kemi B, engelsk A, religion B. Vil det være noget for dig? 



 Vi søger kollegaer, der er stærke formidlere af fagene. Elever på disse hold har alle en afsluttet gymnasial uddannelse bag sig og vil typisk være mellem 19 og 25 år. Eleverne er som oftest meget målrettede og skal bruge denne eksamen til at søge ind på deres videregående uddannelse. 



 Som underviser på et GSK-hold skal du kunne arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret. Det er vigtigt, at der er en klar plan, og at undervisningen er tilrettelagt under hensyn til det meget komprimerede forløb. 



 Det er en fordel at have erfaring med lignende hold. Hvis du ikke har erfaring fra lignende forløb, har vi på Akademiet gennemført disse forløb mange gange og vil kunne give dig sparring i forhold til tilrettelæggelsen. 



 Undervisningen på alle vores suppleringshold er tilrettelagt mandag - fredag inden for tidsrummet 9.30 - 14.00. 



 Vi har derudover et vikariat i engelsk til 2 HF-hold på første år. 



 Århus Akademi har vi hf, 2-årigt STX (Studenterkursus), GSK-hold i nogle fag, og som noget nyt leverer vi EUX-undervisning til pædagogisk assistentuddannelsen og EUX-SOSU-uddannelsen. Vi er i alt ca. 500 elever og 60 ansatte på Århus Akademi. 



 På Århus Akademi har vi et tæt fagligt samarbejde omkring vores klasser. Vi søger derfor lærere, der er gode til at indgå i et fagligt samarbejde med de øvrige lærere tilknyttet holdene.  



 Som skole har vi fokus på de sociale relationers betydning for faglig udvikling og trivsel. Relationen til eleverne er vores omdrejningspunkt. Målet er kontinuerligt at skabe stærke faglige og sociale fællesskaber blandt eleverne, mellem elever og lærere og blandt alle os ansatte på skolen.  



 Yderligere oplysninger om skolen og stillingerne fås på www.aarhusakademi.dk eller ved henvendelse til rektor Mette Jespersen på aame@aarhusakademi.dk eller på telefon 4030 3289 



 Ansøgning med kopi af eksamensbeviser og evt. udtalelser via Gymnasiejob.dk.

Har du f.eks et sabbatår? Og kunne du tænke dig at være med til at plukke og pakke spændende bøger på deres aftenhold? Så er her muligheden på en super god arbejdsplads i Køge

        Attraktivt job i et socialt miljø

Vi søger nu medarbejdere til DBK i Køge. Du vil komme til at arbejde på deres lager, hvor dine arbejdsopgaver f.eks. vil være pluk af bøger samt tage bøger fra paller og ligge i kasser, så de er klar til at blive plukket.

Virksomheden ligger vægt på et højt engagement fra alle deres medarbejdere, og at man er indstillet på at løfte i flok, når behovet opstår. Det er en virksomhed med et godt renommé og en arbejdsplads, hvor der er en god stemning og fri omgangstone blandt medarbejderne.

Som kommende vikar bliver du en del af et stort team i en afdeling, hvor tempo og humør er højt. Derudover, så er kvalitet et centralt omdrejningspunkt i arbejdet, og du spiller derfor en afgørende rolle i at bevare dette. 


Du skal beherske dansk i skrift og tale.

Hurtige hænder til aktive opgaver
Udover pluk af bøger, vil du i denne stilling have til opgave at sikre at dine kolleger, der plukker de enkelte ordre til afsendelse, aldrig løber tør for bøger. I "opfyldningen", vil du via det højteknologiske lager automatisk få tildelt en palle med bøger, hvorfra du omfordeler disse til mindre kasser, der automatisk kører videre på løbebånd til opbevaring i pluk-lager afdelingen.

Dertil ser vi gerne, at du: 



Har masser af gå-på-mod



Kan se en fordel i at få klaret dagens "træning" på arbejdet



Udviser høj mødestabilitet og engagement

title: Quality Control Scientist II (Fully Onsite Position)
description:
AbbVie Biologics Analytical Research & Development (Biologics ARD) is a global analytical sciences organization responsible for CMC analytical development of AbbVie's pipeline of innovative therapeutic biologic products. We are a world-class team of scientists and leaders united by a shared mission to advance industry-leading analytical capabilities and meaningfully contribute to the advancement of AbbVie’s pipeline of innovative medicines.

The Biologics ARD team at the AbbVie Bay Area site in South San Francisco has a long and rich history of biologics development. Located in a state-of-the-art facility housing end-to-end CMC development capabilities, the team works collaboratively to advance novel biologic therapeutics – including multi-specifics, ADCs, antibodies, and novel modalities – into first-in-human clinical development and through to clinical proof of concept. Careers in AbbVie Biologics ARD provide unique opportunities to work with cross-functional and global teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Scientist II to join our Quality Control team focused on early stage (first in human through Ph 2 clinical) development. The Quality Control team is responsible for a wide range of Quality Control GxP activities, including change management, document management, coordination of outsourced release and stability testing, shelf-life evaluation, preparation of Certificates of Analysis and coordination of the exception/quality event process. In this role, you will represent the QC function on one or more program teams, with responsibility for authoring quality documents and regulatory submission sections. You will collaborate with Technical and Quality SMEs to achieve QC deliverables for release of GMP drug substance and drug product batches to enable clinical supply, as well as manage shelf-life assignment for clinical batches.

Responsibilities:

  • Represent the QC function on cross functional program teams.
  • Collaborate with analytical leads to achieve release and stability program deliverables.
  • Author quality documents and IND/IMPD sections to enable regulatory submissions and clinical supply.
  • Evaluate and trend stability data using JMP or other statistical software to support retest dating and shelf life assignments.
  • Prepare and review/verify quality control documents, including certificates of analysis, reference standard qualification reports, release & stability protocols, data packages and stability reports.
  • Initiate and review change records in collaboration with Technical and Quality SMEs and stakeholders.
  • Provide support during internal and external audits and inspections.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for GxP quality system document management activities and coordinate closely with document authors, owners, stakeholders and approvers to initiate and complete document workflows within target timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with SOPs, standards, and requirements.
  • BS or equivalent education with typically 7 or more years of experience or MS or equivalent education with typically 5 or more years of experience.

  • Must have a minimum of two years hands-on experience:

    • Lab experience with methods commonly employed for release and stability testing of antibody therapeutics.
    • Evaluating and trending of GMP stability data for drug substance and drug product shelf-life assignment.
    • Use of data analysis tools (e.g. JMP) and LIMS systems.
    • Document management in the biopharmaceutical industry, including GxP electronic document management systems.
    • Working in a GxP regulated environment.
  • Effective interpersonal, collaboration and communication skills.
  • Must have a proactive approach and independently follow through with responsibilities.
  • Must be adaptable and flexible in the face of evolving priorities and timelines.
  • Well-developed data and time organization/management skills with a high attention to detail.

    Work Environment
  • This position is an on-site role. To be successful, candidates must enjoy and thrive in an on-site, highly collaborative environment with daily face-to-face cross-functional interactions between scientists and colleagues.

description:

  Slagtersvend 
 Bilka ønsker at skabe tilfredse kunder og en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse for alle. Vi stræber efter at gøre hver dag speciel for vores kunder med formålet: Vi inspirerer til flere værdifulde øjeblikke. Gennem vores udvalg, konkurrencedygtige priser og engagerede medarbejdere skaber vi en indkøbsoplevelse, der både opfylder behov og bringer glæde. Vil du bruge dine evner som faglært slagter til at give kunderne inspirerende madoplevelser, der kan gøre enhver forbipasserende lækkersulten? Så er du måske Bilka slagterens næste slagtersvend. 

 Hvad tilbyder vi dig? 

 Som medarbejder i Bilka - uanset niveau - har du mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og menneskeligt samt forfølge dine karriereambitioner, ikke kun i Bilka, men på tværs af hele koncernen. Vi ved, at tilfredse og dygtige medarbejdere er nøglen til at sikre, at kunderne vælger at handle hos os. 

 Som slagtersvend får du en aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du veksler mellem forskellige opgaver. Bl.a. opfyldning og klargøring af slagterboksen, så butikken fremstår indbydende og præsentabel, rådgivning af vores kunder omkring alt fra valg af dette rette tilbehør, tilberedning af den perfekte steg og selvfølgelig forberedelse og tilberedning af alle vores mange produkter. 

 Hvad bringer du med dig? 

 Du er uddannet slagter. Men vigtigst af alt er, at du er udadvendt og hjælpsom, så kunderne oplever god service, når de handler hos dig. Du er stolt af dit håndværk og sætter en ære i at dele dine madoplevelser med kunderne. 

 Du tager ansvar og har en høj faglighed, der også udmunder i stor respekt for fødevaresikkerhed og overholdelse af egenkontrol og hygiejne. Du er stolt af dit håndværk og sætter en ære i at dele dine madoplevelser med kunderne, og du kan implementere dine egne erfaringer og viden, når produkterne skal sælges i butikken. 

 Vi leder efter dig der har en venlig og imødekommende personlighed. Og så er vi på udkig efter dig, som gerne giver dine kolleger en ekstra hånd, når I sammen leverer den fælles indsats, der skal til, for at I med stolthed kan tage godt imod kunderne i afdelingen. Med dit gode overblik tager du gerne ejerskab - og også lederskab, hvis der er behov for det. 

 Der kan være mange veje ind i jobbet, og vi er åbne overfor forskellighed. Derfor opfordrer vi kandidater med forskellige baggrunde til at søge. 

 Griber du chancen? 

 Lyder det som noget for dig, så send os din ansøgning med det samme gennem linket her på siden. Vi screener og kalder til samtaler løbende. 

 Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

 Bilka er et hypermarked i konstant vækst. Vi har en brændende ambition om at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads i dansk detailhandel. Så grib chancen, realiser dit potentiale og få 9.500 motiverede kolleger, der slet ikke kan lade være med at udvikle og forbedre.

title: Actuarial Data Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities

Valuations and Reporting

  • Assist in calculating technical provisions and preparing internal valuation reports.
  • Contribute to documentation of actuarial assumptions and methodologies.
  • Contribute to experience investigations, assumption setting, and reserve movement analysis.
  • Support regulatory submissions and statutory returns (QRT, ORSA)


Actuarial Data Management

  • Help maintain and enhance the actuarial data warehouse.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across actuarial datasets.
  • Work with large datasets to identify trends and anomalies.
  • Create and monitor data validation metrics to ensure data integrity
  • Build and maintain the extract, transform and load (ETL) process form the business core systems.

Modelling and Analysis

  • Work with actuarial models to produce forecasts, stress tests and scenario analyses.

  • Provide analytical support for product reviews, business planning, and management reporting and risk-based assessments.

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years actuarial work experience in a life insurance environment. (e.g., financial reporting, valuations).
  • Exposure to SAM, IFRS 17, or other regulatory frameworks preferred.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Data extraction using SQL

title: Bliv pædagogmedhjælper i vores skønne vuggestue på Trøjborg!
description:
Vuggestuen Rudgården søger en pædagogmedhjælper 1. september

Vi er et hus, der hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuer, og derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives med fleksibilitet og har lyst til at bidrage der, hvor behovet er størst. Sammen skaber vi en tryg, omsorgsfuld og udviklende hverdag for børnene.

Vi er en hyggelig vuggestue midt på Trøjborg – tæt på både skov og strand. Vi har fire stuer, 52 skønne børn og en dygtig og engageret personalegruppe, der elsker at skabe de bedste rammer for vores børns første vigtige år.

Hos os er fællesskab vigtigt – ikke kun blandt kollegaer, men også med vores forældre. Vi har et tæt og positivt samarbejde med forældrene, hvor vi deler både små og store øjeblikke fra børnenes hverdag. Vi tror på åbenhed, tillid og dialog, så forældrene føler sig trygge og godt informeret om deres barns trivsel og udvikling.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen og støtter hinanden i hverdagen. Her er plads til både nye idéer og gamle traditioner – fx synger vi fællessang hver fredag, og motorik og udeliv er en naturlig del af dagen.

Hvad får du?

✔️ Et job fyldt med mening – du er med, når børnene tager deres første skridt, siger deres første ord og knytter de første venskaber.
✔️ Erfaring i pædagogisk arbejde – perfekt hvis du fx overvejer at blive pædagog, lærer eller psykolog.
✔️ En hverdag med både inde- og udeliv, hvor du kan bruge din kreativitet, fantasi og gode energi.
✔️ Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og altid har fokus på både trivsel og faglig udvikling.
✔️ Et tæt samarbejde med både børn, kollegaer og forældre, hvor du er med til at skabe en tryg og udviklende hverdag for de mindste.

Hvem er du?

Du elsker at arbejde med små børn og ser deres verden i øjenhøjde.

Du har meget gerne erfaring med vuggestuebørn

Du har et åbent sind, er nysgerrig og kan både lege og være ansvarlig på samme tid.
Du er stabil, fleksibel og klar på en hverdag, hvor der både er praktiske opgaver, sjove aktiviteter og masser af omsorg.
Du trives både inde og ude – også når det regner.

Du kan indgå i et godt forældresamarbejde, hvor du kommunikerer åbent og imødekommende om barnets hverdag.

Du kan navigere i at samarbejde bredt og kan rumme forskellighed

Praktisk info

📅 Opstart: mandag d. 1. september 2026
⏰ Stillingen er på 37 t/uge og med mødetider i tidsrummet 6.30-17.00
📩 Ansøgningsfrist: 17.august kl. 12.00

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for de mindste? Så send os din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at møde dig! 😊

Venlig hilsen

Personalegruppen i vuggestuen Rudgården

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.




Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen


Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.








Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Lead Product Manager, AI-SOC (Remote)

As a Lead Product Manager, AI-SOC, your primary responsibility will be to own the content layer that determines what the autonomous agent investigates, how it investigates, and what it concludes. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Define and maintain the full library of investigation playbooks and queries executed across alert types, data sources, and severities, owning the continuous improvement backlog.

  • Establish telemetry and schema requirements for onboarding new log sources and alert integrations in direct partnership with engineering and data teams.

  • Own the status disposition logic and suppression framework, guiding the evolution from rule-based heuristics to an advanced ML-driven disposition engine.

  • Incorporate threat intelligence, including IOC matching, actor context, and TTP enrichment, into autonomous investigation workflows.

  • Establish and track core quality metrics, including coverage rate, disposition accuracy, and false positive rates, leveraging feedback loops from MDR analysts.

  • Partner with MDR operations to ensure autonomous investigation output consistently meets the quality bar required to replace manual Tier 1–2 triage at scale.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include:

  • Bring 7+ years of experience in security operations, alert triage, detection engineering, or security engineering within an MDR, MSSP, or enterprise SOC environment.

  • Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Detection & Response across multiple technical domains, including endpoint, network, identity, cloud, or SaaS/email.

  • Apply direct experience with major EDR/XDR platforms to write queries, review telemetry, and render defensible disposition decisions.

  • Leverage strong proficiency in investigation methodology and the MITRE ATT&CK framework to map alert types to adversary behaviors.

  • Demonstrate 2+ years in product management or equivalent SOC leadership where domain expertise was translated into clear engineering requirements.

  • Drive efficient decision-making that resolves complex product challenges and enables operational momentum across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Establish clear ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes, quality metrics, and operational commitments.

  • Build global cross-functional networks across engineering, data science, and security operations to drive sustainable platform enhancements.

  • Act as an active driver of change when transitioning legacy operations toward AI-driven autonomous workflows.

  • Bring strong written and verbal communication skills to align cross-functional partners and executive stakeholders around vision and execution.

  • Possess US Citizenship with active or prior security clearance experience in federal or government environments.

  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.

  • Must be able to design for end-user simplicity while ensuring the system can handle complexity and exceptions internally.
  • The candidate should have experience in breaking down projects into MVP and Agile deliverables, delivering complex end systems incrementally.
  • Must be able to design for disaster recovery in IaaS Cloud platform and possess strong scripting skills, such as Python, Bash, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, SSM, etc.
  • Must have experience with managing substantial numbers of cloud accounts consistently using automation. Cloud SDK, CLI and scripting hands-on knowledge is necessary.
  • Good listener and communicator. Strong verbal, non-verbal diagramming, and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations
  • Experience with working and building an automated build-pipeline, continuous integration, and continuous deployment. Experience with source code control repositories
  • In-depth understanding of Interface-Contracts, Loosely Coupled designs and simplifying solutions and reducing TCO for the end-to-end picture.

description:
