title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer

Location: Nashville, TN, United States

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

We are seeking a Principal Member of Technical Staff to contribute to the architecture, design, and development of this next-generation system. This is a rare opportunity to work on a zero-to-one project and help shape the foundations of OCI’s future infrastructure. As a senior individual contributor, you will drive major technical components within the platform, translating high-level goals into scalable designs and delivering reliable, cloud-native solutions. You'll take ownership of complex technical areas, lead design reviews, and be a hands-on contributor. You’ll also help elevate engineering quality across the team by mentoring peers, advocating for best practices, and contributing to process and tooling improvements. You will bring strong technical depth in distributed systems, Networking, AI infrastructure protocols like RDMA, experience building infrastructure platforms, and a passion for tackling open-ended problems with pragmatism and creativity.

title: Data Scientist (EC AI)
description:
Job Description:

Rakuten Group, Inc. is a global leader in internet services and has a diverse ecosystem spanning across e-commerce, fintech, communications and more serving approximately 1.8 billion members worldwide. Founded in Tokyo in 1997, the Group operates in over 30 countries and regions with more than 30,000 employees.

Based in Singapore's Central Business District, Rakuten Asia Pte. Ltd. serves as the regional headquarters for Asia, driving value through areas such as advertising product development, product strategy, and data management to support Rakuten Group's global ecosystem. Learn more at:

The "AI Lab" organization within Rakuten is focused on advancing artificial intelligence applications across the company. It plays a key role in developing innovative AI solutions, and fostering collaboration to integrate AI into various Rakuten services.

Main Responsibilities

  • Analyze assistant interactions and internal evaluations to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Generate data-driven insights to guide product development and feature prioritization.

  • Conduct research to improve agent architecture and user intent understanding to enhance response quality.

  • Design and execute experiments, identifying the right metrics to evaluate impact.

  • Collaborate with engineers and other Agent Science team members to implement and productionize improvements.

  • Leverage diverse datasets across Rakuten’s ecosystem to improve assistant capabilities and deliver customer value.

  • Clearly communicate findings and contribute to research and product decisions.

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • Over 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong Python and ML skills for data processing, analysis, and prototyping.

  • Proficiency in SQL and working with large-scale structured data.

  • Solid foundation in statistics, experimental design, and predictive modeling.

  • Possesses strong problem identification and formulation skills, with a track record of proactively identifying potential issues and developing effective solutions.

  • Demonstrated ability to thoroughly research and evaluate potential solutions and identify the optimal approach for a given problem.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Rakuten is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications regardless of sex, marital status, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, religious belief, or age.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Principal Software Engineer - Full Stack - Java, AVP

Location: Hyderabad, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Principal Software Engineer - Full Stack - Java, AVP

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across UI and backend components, with a focus on building scalable, high-quality platform solutions as part of our UI Framework team.

Our Platform Engineering organization is innovating and transforming our platform by moving away from monolithic software to utilizing next generation cloud-based technology that leverages Microsoft Azure, AKS, React, etc. The UI Framework team is an integral part of this strategic modernization.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex full-stack design, development, architectural and implementation decisions – ensuring performant, high quality and scalable software delivery

  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Managers to create simple and sustainable software architectures and solutions for complex problems

  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for escalated issues.

  • Review code and ensure adherence to architectural and coding standards.

  • Mentor engineers through technical leadership.

  • Drive continuous improvement in team development practices.

  • Ensure delivery of high-quality software via test automation; assisting with manual testing as required.

  • Engage in the agile software development process by adhering to and advancing the CRD scrum methodology, including attending all daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives

  • Collaborate with global teams on platform initiatives.

Qualifications:

Recommended Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.

Recommended Experience:

  • 12+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Strong experience with React and Java; C# experience a bonus.

  • Experience designing distributed systems.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools as part of routine development and work activities

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Experience in financial services is a plus.

Supervisory Responsibility:

☒ Individual Contributor ☐ Team Lead ☐ Manager of Managers

About Charles River Development:

Charles River Investment management System in a platform that provides many Front-Office functions including Portfolio Management, Order Management and Execution, Compliance, Performance & Attribution, Modelling, Scenario Analysis, and Wealth Management.

We are part of the State Street Bank. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers, and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark in the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading, and investment management to institutional clients.

Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility. We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers.

Interested in learning more about us? Visit our www.statestreet.com www.crd.com LinkedIn page: State Street on LinkedIn

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: 10% Butikkselger MATCH Lambertseter
description:
MATCH Lambertseter søker målrettet og serviceinnstilt Butikkselger 10%, er det deg?

Vi søker Butikkselger til 10% stilling!

Du:

  • Liker å ta ansvar og er pålitelig, fleksibel og møter arbeidshverdagen med godt humør

«Det er gøy å jobbe i Match fordi alle jobber sammen mot samme mål. Det målet er fornøyde kunder,» Elham, Butikkselger

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har fullført og bestått videregående skole, relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende utdannelse

Stillingen krever at du er fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid, og at du kan jobbe på dag- og kveldstid i både ukedager og helger, i tillegg til i ferier.

Mangfold er en styrke, og vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulike livserfaringer og perspektiver. Vi oppfordrer alle kandidater med oppgitte kvalifikasjoner til å søke.

Søkere behandles og intervjuer avholdes fortløpende.

title: SPRENDIMŲ VERSLO KLIENTAMS VADYBININKĖ (-AS)
description:
Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) infrastruktūros klientų skyriaus komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už sprendimų verslo klientams įgyvendinimą. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #Energysmart

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Aptarnaujant nepriklausomus elektros energijos ir gamtinių dujų tiekėjus bei stambiausius nekilnojamojo turto vystytojus, mezgant ir palaikant ilgalaikius bendradarbiavimo ryšius;
  • Įgyvendinant verslo klientams pritaikytus sprendimus, analizuojant jų poreikius bei inicijuojant aptarnavimo procesų tobulinimą;
  • Koordinuojant vykdomus projektus, organizuojant susitikimus su klientais ir užtikrinant savalaikį klausimų sprendimą bei projektų įgyvendinimą laiku;
  • Bendradarbiaujant su vidaus komandomis, siekiant klientams pasiūlyti efektyviausius ir jų poreikius atitinkančius sprendimus;
  • Inicijuojant pokyčius ir aptarnavimo procesų tobulinimą, identifikuojant vertę verslo klientams kuriančias veiklas bei gerinant klientų patirtį.
  • Aukštasis išsilavinimas;
  • Ne mažesnė nei 1 metų klientų aptarnavimo darbo patirtis B2B srityje;
  • Geros anglų kalbos žinios;
  • Puikūs darbo MS Office pagrindinėmis programomis (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) įgūdžiai;
  • Aukšta kalbos kultūra, komunikabilumas, geri derybiniai įgūdžiai;
  • Sudėtingų situacijų valdymo įgūdžiai;
  • Atsakingumas, iniciatyvumas, orientacija į rezultatą, komandinio darbo ir laiko planavimo įgūdžiai;
  • B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimas.
  • Galimybę kasdieniniais darbais kurti vertę Lietuvai;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą, kurį sudaro sveikatos draudimas ir sveikatinimosi išmoka;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Finansinį skatinimą už kandidatų rekomendavimą;
  • Modernią, aukščiausius saugumo reikalavimus atitinkančią darbo aplinką;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Profesionalią naujos kartos energetikų bendruomenę;
  • Vertybėmis grįstą lyderystę ir verslo sprendimus.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

title: Director-Risk Management
description:
The Global Risk & Compliance Organization (GRC) is an independent risk management function, led by the Chief Risk Officer, with the objective of ensuring that American Express operates in a safe, sound, and fully compliant manner with all applicable regulatory expectations.

The Enterprise Conduct Risk Management team within Global Risk and Compliance (GRC) is responsible for identifying and managing conduct risk across all processes and geographies at American Express.

The Director, Conduct Risk Management Data Analytics will be part of the GRC organization and will report to the Vice President, Conduct Risk Management. The successful candidate will lead a team of high performing managers and analysts and will be responsible for performing advanced data analytics to identify, measure, monitor, and report on conduct risks. This role is critical in providing independent oversight and challenge on conduct risk program across the enterprise, with a focus on ensuring behaviors and processes align with regulatory expectations and company’s Risk Appetite. We are seeking an experienced people leader to be a part of this exciting journey.

This position requires a strong enterprise risk mindset, sound judgment, analytical capability, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively. The individual must be able to connect individual risk events and control weaknesses to broader customer, colleague, regulatory, and enterprise impacts.

  • Perform advanced data analytics on enterprise complaints to identify volume, trends, themes within Conduct Risk related complaints (Knowledge of NLP modeling techniques preferred)

  • Use advanced AI-ML techniques to identify systemic issues discovered through various data channels, e.g. complaints, Colleague & Labor Relations cases (knowledge of Model Risk Management Framework is preferred)

  • Manage end to end monitoring (for trends/themes) and reporting of conduct risk complaints at enterprise level

  • Develop and manage repository of data driven indicators (KRIs) to identify areas with high conduct risk likelihood

  • Lead independent reviews and credible challenge of first-line practices as they relate to Conduct Risk Identification, governance, reporting, and adherence to policies/regulatory requirements. Identify thematic and systemic weaknesses through these oversight activities, document observations in accordance with applicable risk oversight programs, ensure timely remediation, and escalate material concerns as needed.

  • Support ongoing monitoring and assessment of enterprise Conduct risk themes, control effectiveness, and emerging risks to inform risk oversight activities and escalation processes.

  • Support the design, maintenance, and ongoing review of conduct risk testing requirements for the enterprise

  • Partner with teams across Global Risk and Compliance, Internal Audit Group and other business units with customer facing colleagues to support effective conduct risk mitigation and governance practices.

  • Build the best team through proactive coaching and feedback

  • Advanced degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related discipline is preferred.

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in risk management and data analytics, preferably within the financial services industry.

  • Strong understanding of Model Risk Management Framework and other important risk management policies and frameworks like Issue Management policy

  • Proven track record in developing and delivering risk insights and communications to senior leadership, highlighting key risks, control performance, and emerging risk themes.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply thought leadership and strategic thinking to deliver initiatives to advance a programs’ maturity and development

  • Ability to Influence senior stakeholders and help embed a strong risk-aware culture throughout the organization, encouraging proactive risk management behaviors at all levels

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills – able to distill complex risk topics into actionable insights for executive audiences.

  • A strong sense of integrity and courage to challenge the status quo.

title: Senior Manager, AI Agent / Machine Learning Engineering
description:
Senior Manager, AI Agent / ML Engineering

Location: Nashville, TN, United States

The Senior Manager will lead a team of engineers while serving as a hands-on technical leader responsible for defining, building, and operating next-generation AI systems on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This leader will set the architecture and engineering direction for production-grade agentic AI platforms, autonomous workflows, scalable inference infrastructure, and enterprise AI applications used in large-scale, business-critical environments.

This role requires an experienced engineering manager who can build and develop high-performing teams, translate ambiguous product and platform goals into a durable technical strategy, and drive execution across multiple organizations. The successful candidate will be accountable for hiring, mentoring, performance management, technical planning, and delivery, while remaining actively involved in system design, prototyping, coding, code reviews, operational readiness, and incident follow-up.

The ideal candidate combines deep distributed-systems expertise with practical, hands-on experience building AI agents and AI-native applications. This includes developing and orchestrating LLM-based agents, tools, APIs, memory systems, retrieval pipelines, evaluations, guardrails, and cloud-service integrations. The candidate should be comfortable writing production code, debugging complex systems, and guiding engineers through difficult architectural and implementation decisions.

The expectation is to lead the team in shipping, scaling, and operating reliable, secure, observable, and cost-efficient AI systems, while raising both the engineering and management bar across the organization. This leader will establish strong execution practices, promote operational excellence, and ensure the team delivers measurable business and customer outcomes.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

The Senior AI Agent / ML Engineering Manger role is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for defining, building, and operating next-generation AI systems on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

title: Engineering Program Manager
description:
Engineering Program Manager

Description -

Business Environment and Job Summary:

The New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) organization under Inkjet Supplies Development and Operations (ISDO) is responsible for developing innovative technologies and delivering winning products to the marketplace. NPDI team focuses on validating design robustness, reliability, and customer experience to successfully deliver new technologies and products.

The team supports a diverse portfolio across the Home, Office, Large Format Design and Production printing segments. This broad product portfolio provides engineers with opportunities to work across multiple technologies, gain exposure to different market segments, and develop their careers through a variety of technical and leadership experiences.

The Engineering Program Manager leads cross-functional ink qualification / new product introduction / transformation programs that support product continuity, regulatory compliance, supplier strategy, cost optimization, and manufacturing readiness. This role is responsible for leading multiple project teams, and overseeing the complete process of product design and development. The role ensures designs and project activities are compliant with technology and development guidelines and standards. The role applies advanced subject matter knowledge to provide perspective to cross-organization projects, drive innovation and integrate new technologies into projects. The role acts as the central communication hub between technical teams, business stakeholders, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, operations, and executive leadership to ensure successful qualification and implementation of technology / product development in the inkjet and supplies ecosystem. Beyond project management and communication expertise, individuals will also have opportunities to serve as technical leads to manage projects of varying complexity.

In this role, you will:

  • Leads multiple project teams of internal and outsourced development partners responsible for all stages of design and development for complex products, solutions, and platforms.

  • Coordinate activities across Ink Chemistry, Writing Systems, Reliability Engineering, Manufacturing, Regulatory and product stewardship, Packaging, Supply Chain, and Hardware printer partners organizations

  • Reviews and evaluates designs and project activities for compliance with technology and development guidelines and standards; provides tangible feedback to improve product quality.

  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimizing product product/solution output, quality enhancements and cost of delivery.

  • Provides domain-specific expertise and overall platform leadership and perspective to cross-organization projects, programs, and activities.

  • Develops cost estimates, business cases, appropriation requests and plans for engineering projects.

  • Drives innovation and integration of new technologies into projects/product development activities.

  • Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members to set an example of design and development, innovation, and excellence.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Program Management: Lead programs which include establishing the program scope, schedule, milestones, budget, and resource requirements. Develop and maintain the program Plan of Record (POR). Drive program execution and ensure alignment with business objectives. Manage qualification dashboards, status reporting, and executive communications. Capture lessons learned to promote continuous improvement

  • Stakeholder Management: Align stakeholders on scope, risks, schedules, and implementation plans. Create executive updates, dashboards, and review presentations. Present program status to leadership and decision boards. Drive timely communication across all stakeholders. Escalate critical issues and decision points when required.

  • Qualification Management: Facilitate technical and qualification reviews, decision meetings, and escalation forums. Ensure qualification plans are established and executed. Monitor qualification readiness, test progress, and gate approvals. Track qualification risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies. Drive timely completion of qualification milestones and change requests. Support qualification documentation and audit readiness.

  • Risk and Compliance Management: Assess business, technical, regulatory, and supply chain risks. Lead risk mitigation planning and execution to support regulatory compliance and market access requirements. Manage trade-offs between performance, cost, supply continuity, and schedule with the program.

  • Communication and Reporting: Ensure proper implementation of Technology development process (TDP), Product development process (PDP), and Management of Change (MoC) processes.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering/ Chemistry/Materials Science/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

  • 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in electrical/mechanical design and tools/chemical/materials science, program/project management, product/technology development, manufacturing, or quality engineering.

  • Experience with product qualification, NPI, manufacturing change management, or supplies product/technology development.

  • Experience leading cross-functional global teams and ability to work across multiple time zones / both within and outside one's own work group

  • Technical breath & system approach

  • Demonstrated analytical and empirical problem-solving skills

  • System thinker, looking for connections, and comfortable with things being dynamic or ambiguous

  • Growth mindset, good flexibility and adaptability are key

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • Available for occasional travel (25%)

Technical Skills

  • Product qualification and validation

  • Risk management

  • Manufacturing processes

  • Quality systems

  • Regulatory compliance

  • Data analysis and reporting

  • Project scheduling and planning

Leadership Competencies

  • Stakeholder management

  • Executive communication

  • Strategic thinking

  • Problem solving

  • Influence without authority

  • Conflict resolution

  • Decision-making under uncertainty

Success Measures

  • Delivery of major program checkpoints on time, with quality and within budget.

  • Strength of cross‑organizational alignment and decision velocity for successful gate approvals and implementation

  • Program return-on-investment realization and contribution to printer partners’ business objectives.

  • Executive confidence, stakeholder satisfaction, and team engagement.

  • Risk reduction, regulatory compliance achievement, business continuity and market access protection.

  • Quality and reliability performance after implementation with expected customer experience outcomes.


Impact & Scope
• Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.

Complexity
• Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.

Our mission is to connect people and improve lives across the globe, and we believe that the more people we connect, the better our planet becomes.

We’re all about breaking down barriers and building bridges—because diversity fuels innovation and drives success!

Overall Role Purpose:

The Qualifier is responsible for qualifying leads and re-profiling Multichannel customers by telephone.

Tasks are focused on identification of revenue potential with Suspects and existing Multichannel account customers and initiating rank-up of MCA customers with revenue potential above MC revenue threshold.

Key Activities:

Customer- Internal

Telemarketing Manager

· Undertake any projects/duties as assigned by the Telemarketing Manager

· Carry out any task that is required by his or her superiors from time to time.

Customers

· Calls leads as assigned by SFA system

· Calls Multichannel customers for re-profiling/rank up as prioritized by Multichannel Coordinator

· Notifies sales executive of development lead when needed

Stakeholder-Internal

Country Sales Function (Field Sales Group, Telesales Group, Marketing, CS Groups)

· Ensure co-operation with other members of the sales team and throughout the sales force

Lead Qualification Process Deployment

· Use communications skills to identify decision makers for Express shipping and gain access to them

· Combine sales skills with DHL product/service knowledge and convert the maximum possible suspect leads into prospects/identify rank-up potential during re-qualification

· Continually develop knowledge of DHL’s services and general commercial awareness in order to provide the best possible standard of customer service and maximise the department’s contribution to the sales function

Customer Information Maintenance & Reporting

· Ensure that customer information is maintained accurately on the customer database

· Clean lead lists and Multichannel data with captured information

What we need?

§ Strong analytical and planning skills;

§ Good communication and presentation skills;

description:

Designing the future. Transforming the World.

Join us in the heart of Chonburi, within a vibrant and fast-growing hub on Thailand’s Eastern Seaboard where you will enjoy being close to major industrial and energy centres with the lifestyle advantages of a coastal location. Perfectly positioned within reach of Bangkok and minutes from the coastline of Pattaya, our office is the ideal blend of career opportunity and coastal lifestyle.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist, AVP

Location: Bangalore, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and hands-on Lead Data Scientist (AVP) to join our AI/ML Science team as part of the Agentic AI platform initiative. This role is pivotal in shaping the science strategy for large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and advanced analytics across business domains. You will be responsible for leading the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of AI/ML solutions that address complex, high-impact business problems at enterprise scale.

The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, advanced analytics, and model lifecycle management, as well as proven experience in translating business needs into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, and governance teams, and play a key role in mentoring data scientists and advancing best practices in model governance and Responsible AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI/ML and LLM-based solutions: problem framing, data exploration, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Architect and implement advanced generative AI and agentic applications, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embedding, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

  • Define and drive best practices for model evaluation, benchmarking, error taxonomy, explainability, and anomaly detection.

  • Build and maintain knowledge graphs, graph-based reasoning engines, and semantic search capabilities to power intelligent applications.

  • Partner with engineering, SRE, and platform teams to productionize models, optimize for scalability and reliability, and integrate models into enterprise platforms and workflows.

  • Ensure compliance with Responsible AI practices, model governance, regulatory requirements, and enterprise MRM controls.

  • Drive the creation and adoption of reusable AI assets, experimentation frameworks, and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines.

  • Communicate complex technical findings, recommendations, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.

  • Mentor and guide junior and senior data scientists, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, and knowledge sharing.

  • Stay current with advancements in LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems, and AI/ML engineering to drive pragmatic adoption within the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • BS, BTech, or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

  • 8+ years of overall experience in IT and 5+ years of relevant experience in machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI solution development, with 2+ years in generative AI/LLMs.

  • Proven track record of designing, developing, and operationalizing AI/ML models at enterprise scale.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and leading ML/AI frameworks (Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, etc.).

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, NLP, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG.

  • Experience with both structured and unstructured data, feature engineering, model experimentation, and tuning.

  • Solid understanding of model validation, explainability, testing, monitoring, and Responsible AI.

  • Proficiency with Azure and/or AWS for AI/ML development and deployment.

  • Experience with graph databases and libraries (e.g., Neo4j, DGL), knowledge graphs, and semantic search.

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across business, engineering, architecture, and governance teams.

Good to have skills

  • Experience in financial services, risk, operations, or other regulated enterprise environments.

  • Familiarity with model risk management, regulatory compliance, and Responsible AI controls.

  • Experience with Databricks, Spark, SQL, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI/ML engineering toolsets.

  • Knowledge of agentic AI, workflow orchestration, and enterprise AI platform capabilities.

  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, CI/CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and production monitoring.

  • Prior mentoring or team leadership experience.

  • Ability to present complex technical concepts in a business-friendly manner.

title: Principal Engineer – Hydraulic (Pumping & Pipeline Systems)
description:
WSP India is currently seeking a Principal Engineer – Hydraulic (Pumping & Pipeline Systems) for Australia Mining Infrastructure Projects (Materials Handling Infrastructure). They shall be responsible for engineering design of Process with WSP Engineering and Client Standards. Previous experience in an EPCM environment in the O & G, Power plant, Chemical process plant, Mining processing industry is an asset.

A Team player and willing to work collaboratively with a motivated and highly successful team in Australia. The position will be for Mumbai location.

About the role:

We are seeking a Principal Hydraulic Engineer to support mining infrastructure projects across Australia, with a strong focus on pumping systems, pipeline networks, and water management systems.

This is a hybrid role combining process engineering, hydraulic analysis, and pipeline/pumping system design, rather than a conventional EPC-style discipline role.

The position will lead technical delivery, mentor engineers, and interface with multidisciplinary teams across Australia and India.

The role requires close collaboration and effective coordination with clients, multidisciplinary engineering teams, vendors, suppliers, pipeline route survey consultants, geotechnical investigation teams, construction contractors, and other key stakeholders to ensure engineering excellence, compliance with project requirements, timely delivery of deliverables, and successful project execution.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead design and analysis of:

  • Pumping systems (HP pumps, transfer systems)

  • Pipeline and network systems (water, slurry, dewatering)

  • Define system philosophy:

  • Pumping strategy and operating scenarios

  • Overpressure and surge protection philosophy

  • Brownfield integration and tie-ins

  • Provide technical assurance and review of key deliverables like Pipeline route selection and feasibility studies, material selection, wall thickness design, pipeline stress analysis in accordance with applicable international codes and standards, design of crossings for highways, roads, railways, rivers, and other utilities, pipeline integrity management, identification and mitigation of geohazards, and preparation of material specifications and other engineering deliverables.

  • Undertake and lead pipeline design work for projects and studies including typical activities and deliverables: -

  • Concept design and layout development

  • Process descriptions and design basis

  • Material balances

  • Preparation of process flow diagrams & piping and instrumentation diagrams

  • Hazardous area classification/assessment

  • Preparation of equipment lists, equipment datasheets, specifications

  • Fluids lists and materials selection

  • Process hazard studies (including HAZOP) and design safety reviews

title: Engineer Lead, Site Reliability
description:
Job Description: Engineer Lead – Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Role Overview
The Engineer Lead – Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) will provide technical and thought leadership to ensure the reliability, resiliency, scalability, and observability of mission‑critical platforms supporting Banking Solutions, Payments, and Capital Markets.
This role blends advanced SRE practices, resiliency and chaos engineering, and service health governance with people and technical leadership. The Engineer Lead will define reliability standards, mentor teams, and partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Product stakeholders to embed reliability as a core product feature.

What You Will Be Doing
SRE Leadership & Strategy

Act as the technical lead and reliability champion, driving SRE best practices across multiple teams and platforms.
Define and evangelize reliability standards, principles, and operational excellence frameworks.
Guide teams in balancing feature velocity with system reliability using error budgets and SLO-driven decision-making.
Mentor and coach engineers in SRE, observability, incident management, and automation.

Service Health, SLI/SLO & Observability

Define, implement, and govern Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets.
Establish standardized service health monitoring and reporting frameworks across platforms.
Design and maintain end-to-end observability solutions covering infrastructure, applications, APIs, and customer experience.
Drive reliability insights through dashboards, health scores, and executive-level metrics.

Resiliency Testing & Chaos Engineering

Lead resiliency engineering initiatives to validate system behavior under failure conditions.
Design and execute chaos engineering experiments to proactively identify weaknesses in architecture and operations.
Integrate resiliency testing into CI/CD pipelines and pre-production environments.
Partner with development and architecture teams to ensure systems are fault-tolerant, self-healing, and resilient by design.

Incident Management & Operational Excellence

Lead high-severity incident response efforts, providing clear technical and operational direction.
Establish and continuously improve incident management, escalation, and communication practices.
Drive blameless post-incident reviews, ensuring root causes are addressed and preventive actions are implemented.
Measure and improve operational KPIs such as MTTR, MTTD, and incident recurrence rates.

Automation, Platform Reliability & Cloud Operations

Champion automation-first approaches to reduce toil and manual intervention.
Oversee deployment pipelines, configuration management, and release reliability practices.
Guide teams on Infrastructure as Code (IaC), environment consistency, and cloud governance.
Ensure disaster recovery, backup, and failover strategies are tested and production-ready.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

Collaborate with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Security, Architecture, and Product teams to embed reliability into the SDLC.
Ensure platforms comply with security, regulatory, and audit requirements, especially in financial services environments.
Influence technical roadmaps to prioritize resiliency, stability, and customer experience.

Core Requirements

Strong experience with Core SRE practices, including system reliability, incident management, automation, and observability.
Hands-on expertise in resiliency testing and chaos engineering methodologies.
Proven experience designing and operating SLI / SLO / Error Budget frameworks at scale.
Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices architectures, and cloud-native platforms.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud).
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Expertise in monitoring, observability, and logging tools, such as:

Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog
Splunk, ELK Stack


Strong background in incident management, post-mortem facilitation, and production support.
Proficiency in automation and scripting (Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible).
Experience managing and improving CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps).
Ability to lead technical discussions, influence decisions, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
Strong ownership mindset with accountability for service reliability and customer outcomes.

Experience with Harness Chaos Engineering (CE) or similar chaos engineering platforms.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer, Vice President

Location: Bangalore, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Full Stack Engineering leader to set the technical strategy and execution model for full-stack platform engineering across multiple pods and platform areas. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in enterprise-scale software architecture, cloud-native transformation, and engineering leadership, along with the ability to guide long-term platform direction while ensuring strong delivery, governance, and operational discipline.

As a VP, you will define the multi-platform full-stack engineering roadmap, establish architecture guardrails and engineering standards, and represent Engineering in cross-functional and executive governance forums. This role is suited for a leader who can align technology decisions with business priorities, scale engineering capability across teams, and drive platform quality, resilience, and adoption across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the full-stack engineering strategy and technical roadmap across multiple pods, product areas, and platform domains.

  • Define architecture guardrails and technology standards for backend services, frontend platforms, APIs, integration layers, cloud-native delivery, and developer tooling.

  • Own engineering direction for multi-platform modernization, scalability, reliability, security, and engineering efficiency.

  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, Risk, Security, and Operations leaders to align engineering investments with business goals and enterprise standards.

  • Drive organization-wide initiatives to improve developer experience, release velocity, platform adoption, observability, and software quality.

  • Establish governance and decision frameworks for technology choices, architecture patterns, engineering controls, and production readiness.

  • Oversee engineering execution across pods, ensuring alignment to delivery commitments, capacity planning, and technical quality expectations.

  • Represent Engineering in cross-functional governance forums, architecture boards, and executive reviews, clearly articulating technical risks, trade-offs, and priorities.

  • Build and lead engineering leadership talent across pods, including hiring, mentoring, succession planning, and organizational capability development.

  • Drive consistency in engineering standards across teams, including secure coding, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, documentation, and incident management practices.

  • Influence investment decisions related to platform tooling, cloud strategy, vendor selection, and engineering operating models.

  • Partner with finance and leadership stakeholders on budget, headcount planning, and resource prioritization for the engineering function.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and market trends to evolve the organization’s full-stack engineering posture and long-term platform strategy.

  • Champion a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and measurable business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 12–17 years of experience in software engineering or platform engineering, including significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles.

  • Proven track record of defining and executing technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or platform areas.

  • Deep expertise in enterprise-scale application architecture, including backend platforms, frontend ecosystems, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering.

  • Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, multi-cloud strategy, modernization programs, and engineering governance in complex environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to establish and scale engineering standards, architecture guardrails, delivery models, and operating practices.

  • Strong understanding of resilience, performance, security, compliance, observability, and operational risk in enterprise production environments.

  • Experience leading engineering managers, technical leads, or multi-team engineering organizations.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at senior and executive levels.

  • Experience owning or influencing budget, workforce planning, vendor management, and strategic technology investments.

  • Strong judgment in evaluating technology trade-offs and aligning architecture decisions to long-term business and platform needs.

  • Exposure to modern application trends such as event-driven systems, API ecosystems, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

1163 U.S. 31 North - Petoskey, Michigan 49770

This role is responsible to work independently to display and stock products; to ensure that you contribute to the financial best interest of the store. Additionally, this role is responsible for meeting company guidelines for guest experience, as well as complying with company guidelines for safety and food safety.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical retail store environment (varied temperatures) and is exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. Travel requirements vary by assignment.

As part of our People First culture, SpartanNash is proud to offer a robust and competitive Total Rewards benefits package.

title: Vikariat i matematik på Odder Gymnasium til besættelse hurtigst muligt
description:
Der vil på Odder Gymnasium være et deltidsvikariat i matematik til besættelse hurtigst muligt. Vikariatet dækker 2-3 hold i matematik i efteråret og vil primært omfatte undervisning i 1.g. Den præcise ansættelsesgrad vil afhænge af ansøgers profil, men er på mindst 1/3 stilling. Man vil få tilknyttet en erfaren faglærer som mentor.

Samtaler afholdes løbende i ansøgningsperioden.

Om Odder Gymnasium

Odder Gymnasium er et lokalforankret gymnasium med ca. 500 elever fordelt på 6-7 klasser pr. årgang og ca. 55 ansatte. Gymnasiet har en stærk og bred profil med et højt fagligt niveau og prioriterer at udbyde og oprette studieretninger inden for både de naturvidenskabelige, samfundsvidenskabelige, sproglige og kreative områder.

På Odder Gymnasium er der en stærk skolekultur, en høj elevtrivsel og et meget engageret lærerkollegium. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed i de enkelte fag og i samspillet mellem fagene, og vi prioriterer at kunne rumme elever med forskellige baggrunde, interesser og drømme for videre uddannelse ved at give udfordringer til både de dygtige elever og til de elever, som skal have lidt ekstra hjælp.

Skolens tre grundværdier faglighed, fællesskab og engagement er styrende for vores måde at drive skole på. Vores udgangspunkt er, at en forudsætning for høj faglighed, stærke fællesskaber og stort engagement er, at både elever og medarbejdere på Odder Gymnasium trives. Derfor er respekt for den enkelte nøgleord – både respekt for den enkeltes evner og muligheder og respekt for hinanden som ligeværdige individer. Vi er bevidste om, at vi alle er vigtige for at skabe den skole, vi gerne vil have. Skolens medarbejdere er helt afgørende for, at skolens vision, værdier og strategiske indsatser kommer til live og får betydning for vores måde at være skole på. Det forudsætter dygtige medarbejdere, der trives og samarbejder professionelt om kerneopgaven både formelt og uformelt på alle niveauer.

Flere oplysninger om Odder Gymnasium kan findes på skolens hjemmeside: .

Ansøgning og CV med dokumentation for gennemførte eksaminer, evt. pædagogikum samt eventuelle referencer sendes elektronisk via www.gymnasiejob.dk senest mandag d. 17. august. Samtaler afholdes løbende i ansøgningsperioden.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse på telefon 86 54 45 00 eller på mail og@odder-gym.dk.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

title: Principal AI Software Engineer
description:
Principal AI Software Engineer

Location: Nashville, TN, United States

The Principal AI Agent / ML Software Engineer is a Senior Staff-level, hands-on technical leadership role responsible for defining, building, and operating next-generation AI systems on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This person will set architecture and engineering direction for production-grade agentic AI platforms, autonomous workflows, scalable inference infrastructure, and enterprise AI applications used in large-scale, business-critical environments.

This role requires a proven engineer who can translate ambiguous product and platform goals into durable technical strategy, lead multi-team execution without direct authority, and remain deeply hands-on in design, code, reviews, operations, and incident follow-up. The ideal candidate combines deep distributed systems experience with practical AI-native engineering, including orchestration of LLMs, tools, APIs, memory, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and cloud services. The expectation is to ship, scale, and operate reliable, secure, observable, and cost-aware AI platform systems while raising the technical bar for engineers across the organization.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: T&A실 미주·대양주 사업개발 매니저
description:
About

[소수정예 팀, ​핵심인재 ​중심의 ​AI Native ​조직]
마이리얼트립은 작은 팀이 빠르게 ​결정하고 ​실행하며, 고객의 ​문제를 끝까지 책임지는 ​방식으로 일합니다.
우리는 ​역할에 ​머무르지 않고, ​변화를 ​전제로 ​움직입니다.

이제 그 방식은 ​AI를 ​통해 더 선명해졌습니다.
AI를 ​잘 ​활용하는 ​것을 넘어, AI를 ​전제로 문제를 ​정의하고 ​해결합니다.
마이리얼트립은 그렇게 ​AI Native ​조직으로 ​진화해왔습니다.

이 기준이 자연스럽고, ​이 기준을 ​스스로에게 요구할 수 있는 분이라면,
우리가 바라보는 ‘여행 경험의 완전한 연결’을 함께 현실로 만들어갈 수 있다고 믿습니다.


[함께 일하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요.]
마이리얼트립' 하면 떠오르는 '현지에서만 할 수 있는 특별한 경험' — 투어·입장권·액티비티·미식·클래스까지 모두 T&A실이 만듭니다. T&A는 마이리얼트립이 시장 1위를 지켜온 핵심 영역이자, 엔데믹 이후 가장 가파르게 성장하는 사업입니다.

미주·대양주팀(APOC)은 미국·캐나다·멕시코 등 미주, 호주·뉴질랜드, 하와이·괌·사이판 등 태평양 휴양지를 담당합니다. 핵심 도시를 안정적으로 운영하는 동시에, 빠르게 성장하는 지역을 파트너십·펀드·관광청 협업을 통해 다음 성장 축으로 키워야 하는 팀입니다. 이번에 함께할 분은 그 성장 지역들의 사업 기회를 직접 만들고 확장하는 역할을 맡습니다.


[미주·대양주팀이 일하는 방식에 대해 소개드려요.]
[Customer Obsession] 여행자도, 파트너도 우리의 고객입니다.
여행자에게 더 나은 경험을 만드는 것은 물론, 파트너를 '요청하는 상대'가 아니라 함께 성과를 만드는 고객으로 바라봅니다. 양쪽의 진짜 니즈를 이해하는 데서 좋은 사업 기회가 나온다고 믿습니다.

[Small Team Always Wins] 오너십을 가지고, 맡은 지역을 하나의 사업처럼 바라봅니다.
성장의 기회를 스스로 찾아 움직이고, 연차와 관계없이 내 지역을 어떻게 키울지 직접 그리고 실행해볼 수 있습니다.

[Action Matters] 완벽한 계획보다 빠른 실행을 택합니다.
오래 고민하기보다 일단 해보고, 결과를 보며 방향을 잡아갑니다. 실행의 속도가 곧 경쟁력이라고 믿습니다.

[Know the Why] 날카롭게 피드백하고, 서로 챌린지하며 토론합니다.
더 나은 결정을 위해서라면 직급이나 연차와 관계없이 서로의 생각에 솔직하게 질문하고 의견을 더합니다. 피드백을 그냥 받아들이기보다 근거로 다시 짚어보고, 가장 나은 답을 함께 찾아갑니다. 이런 과정이 우리가 가장 빠르게 성장하는 방법이라고 믿습니다.

[Change is our DNA] 어제의 방식에 안주하지 않습니다.
시장도, 우리가 일하는 방식도 빠르게 바뀝니다. '원래 이렇게 해왔으니까'에 머무르지 않고, 더 나은 방법이 있으면 도구든 프로세스든 과감하게 바꿉니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고성장 지역의 사업 기회를 발굴하고 키웁니다
• 브리즈번, 골드코스트 같은 급성장 도시부터 케언즈, 울루루 같은 신규 성장 지역까지, 빠르게 크는 시장을 데이터로 짚어내고 어떤 상품·카테고리·파트너·딜로 성장을 만들 것인가를 설계합니다.
• 신규 카테고리·상품을 발굴하고, 필요한 상품이 없으면 새 파트너를 직접 소싱해 첫 매출까지 만들어냅니다. 발굴 → 실행 → 확장을 오너십 있게 소유합니다.

2. 상품 판매를 넘어선 새로운 사업 기회를 발굴합니다
• 관광청 및 외부제휴사로부터 마케팅 펀드 유치, 시설사·제휴사와의 제휴 수익 등 상품 판매 외의 새로운 수익·협업 기회를 직접 발굴합니다.
• 파트너 목표와 당사 수익 목표를 동시에 달성하는 Win–Win 구조를 설계하고, 협상 테이블을 직접 리드해 딜을 성사시킵니다.

3. 담당 지역·파트너를 지표로 관리합니다
• 담당 도시의 핵심 지표를 관리하고, 기존 파트너와의 관계·성과를 운영하며 상품 구성·가격 경쟁력·파트너 믹스를 조정해 성장과 수익성을 함께 끌어올립니다.

4. 프로모션을 기획하고, 목표 달성을 위해 유관 부서 협업을 리드합니다
• 데이터로 프로모션·가격 전략을 세우고, 트렌디한 콘텐츠로 담당 지역을 알립니다. 필요시 마케팅·운영·법무·프로덕트 등 유관 부서와 협업해 설득·조율하며, 하나의 목표를 향해 함께 움직이도록 이끕니다.

Requirements

• BD·전략·세일즈·기획 등 관련 경력 2년 이상을 보유하신 분
• 영어로 서면 및 구두 커뮤니케이션이 모두 가능하신 분
• 데이터로 원인을 찾고 다음 액션을 설계하는 분
• 이해관계자를 설득하고 협업을 주도하실 수 있는 분
• 업무에 AI를 적극적으로 활용하는 분

Preferred

• 전략 컨설팅펌 인턴/경력 등 데이터 기반 문제해결 경험
• 풍부한 여행 경험을 바탕으로 여행자 니즈를 이해하고, 시장 수요가 높은 여행 상품을 기획할 수 있는 분
• 신규 카테고리·신사업을 0→1로 기획해 성과로 만든 경험
• B2B 파트너십·제휴 및 스폰서십 유치 경험
• 콘텐츠·트렌드 감각(2030이 좋아할 테마·채널·콘텐츠에 밝고, 트렌디한 상세페이지·기획전을 빠르게 제작) 및 Figma 등 디자인 툴 활용
• 플랫폼·OTA·e-커머스·글로벌 IT 근무 경험
• Excel·SQL 등 분석 하드스킬(Pivot, Index/match, vlookup, 쿼리 등)

Benefits

[업무 몰입을 위한 제도 & 복지]
• 시차 출퇴근: 07:00–10:30 내 자율 출근
• 업무 장비 지원: 업무에 필요한 최신 장비, 다양한 AI툴 제공 (생산성/몰입 최우선)
• 리프레시 지원: 반반차/반차 제도 지원, 연차 외 생일 반차, 가족휴가 별도 제공
• 자기계발: 자기계발비 별도 지원
• 식사·간식 지원: 점심 식대 별도 지원, 간식 상시 제공
• 건강 케어: 연 1회 건강검진 지원
• 보험 지원: 본인·배우자·자녀 대상 실손/단체상해보험 가입 지원
• 경조 지원: 경조휴가 및 경조비 지원

Job Title: Front of House 

 

Fish are like us - we all swim together. Strange Fish are bold, curious individuals who fit right in here.

We like people who are a little bold, curious, and comfortable just being themselves. If you enjoy making others smile, feel energised in busy places, and want to bring your own sparkle to our dining room, then maybe this Front of House position is for you.




Are You

Confident when things move quickly?

Able to keep your cool and standards, even when there is a little pressure?

Good at making friends, kind and diligent in your work?

A listener who helps others with humility?

Curious about Danish and Japanese traditions?




What You’ll Be Doing at Sticks ‘n’ Sushi 

Keep a positive mood and share good energy - we like “hygge".

Show our values and help guests feel relaxed and happy.

Always be enthusiastic and friendly, with a smile.

Give service that cares and helps guests make good memories.

Learn about Danish and Japanese food, culture, and service so you can guide guests with confidence.




What You’ll Bring to Us 

It is good if you have experience in a busy restaurant and know excellent service.

We value energy, hospitality, and a bit of Danish charm (“Ja tak!").

You like to learn, can do many things at once, and do not get stressed easily.

Kindness, respect, and a “big smile, small ego" attitude are important.

We love teamwork and camaraderie - it’s nice to work with other “Fish" like you.




How We Will Support Your Journey with Us 

Come join us and grow your skills at our Lead ‘n’ Learn academy, where you will find structured training to help you take new steps and succeed in your role.




The Benefits That Go Beyond the Day to Day  

We work hard while having fun and learning together. At Sticks ‘n’ Sushi, everyone helps build a meaningful workplace where all are welcome and represented. You’ll get:

50% off at all restaurants, including drinks

Company pension scheme

Health insurance 

Employee assistance and wellbeing support

Retail and high street discounts

Team events, parties, and awards




Ready to Jump In?  

Click apply - it’s quick and easy. We welcome everyone to Sticks ‘n’ Sushi, and we can’t wait to hear about the unique Fish that you are. If your spark matches ours, we’ll invite you for a chat. If it feels right, we’ll dive straight in together.

That’s us.

title: Alumiinihitsaaja
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme ammattitaitoista alumiinihitsaajaa Pirkanmaan alueelle. Työssäsi hitsaat alumiinirakenteita MIG- ja TIG-menetelmillä piirustusten ja työohjeiden mukaisesti. Työtehtävät sisältävät erilaisten teollisten komponenttien ja rakenteiden valmistusta sekä viimeistelyä, ja työ edellyttää huolellista ja itsenäistä työotetta sekä kykyä työskennellä osana tuotantotiimiä.
Me tarjoamme sinulle:
* Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 14-18 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa
Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!
Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!
Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.
Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä joonas.lahteenmaki@worker.fi
Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Ekstrahjelp ARK Mo i Rana
description:
ARK Mo i Rana søker salgsglad ekstrahjelp!

Vi tilbyr en arbeidsplass med til tider høyt tempo og mange spennende mennesker. Sammen med kollegaene dine er du ARK sitt ansikt utad. Du vil ha en sentral rolle i å gjennomføre kampanjer og aktiviteter, og skape en inspirerende butikkopplevelse for ARK sine kunder!

Som ekstrahjelp har du varierende arbeidstid og må påregne å jobbe dag, kveld og helg ved behov. Vi kaller inn til intervju fortløpende og vi ser for oss oppstart snarest.

Du vil følge produktene fra de ankommer butikken, til du overlater dem i hendene til en fornøyd kunde. Det innebærer utpakking og prising av varer, sørge for at butikken til enhver tid er presentabel og innbydende, og ellers utføre de oppgaver som butikksjef delegerer til deg. Som person er du ansvarsfull og du bidrar aktivt til å skape et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Brenner for gode kunderelasjoner

  • Er ærlig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Har interesse for bøker

  • Har gode holdninger og godt humør

  • Er fleksibel og positiv

  • Er ryddig og strukturert

  • Er 18 år eller eldre

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt, kanskje har du en interesse eller egenskap som ikke kommer frem på din CV? ARK mener mangfold og inkludering er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsing.

Vi vet du vil trives i en organisasjon som har tydelige mål og møter utfordringene med entusiasme og pågangsmot i en bransje i utvikling. ARK går nye veier samtidig som vi fremhever og forsterker vårt hovedfundament; nemlig bøkene. Vi tenker langsiktig og er ansvarsbevisste på vegne av fellesskapet og vi har omtanke for hverandre. Sammen har vi det gøy på veien mot målet!

Gir dette deg en god følelse? Send din CV og søknad i dag! Vi ser frem til å bli bedre kjent med deg.

title: Rörläggare sökes med start omgående Malmö
description:
Vi söker erfarna rörläggare

Vill du arbeta i en roll där rörläggning står i centrum och din kompetens verkligen kommer till sin rätt? Vi söker nu skickliga rörläggare till mark- och VA-projekt i Malmö

Hos oss blir du en del av ett kunnigt team med hög yrkesstolthet, där kvalitet, säkerhet och precision är avgörande i varje moment.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

Sonder is an inclusive, not-for-profit organisation that has been providing better quality health and support services to the South Australian community since 1993. We support thousands of people each year to access services across seven key domains – Mental Health, Aboriginal Health, Alcohol and/or other Drugs, Employment, Community Health, Disability, and Homelessness

What benefits can we offer?

When you work with Sonder, you become part of the Sonder family and that provides you with a number of benefits such as:

  • Salary (excluding super) paid above award and reviewed annually

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Professional development allowance provided yearly

  • Generous salary packaging options - increase your take home pay by 6-12%

  • 17.5% Leave Loading

  • Modern and welcoming office spaces

  • Christmas Closure Bonus Leave (above annual leave entitlements)

  • Training opportunities

  • Meal & entertainment allowances

About the Role:

As the Mental Health Project Officer, you’ll work as part of a multidisciplinary team to support the delivery of high-quality mental health services across Sonders’ Mental Health portfolio. You’ll play a key role in monitoring data and performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and supporting continuous quality improvement initiatives.

You’ll also provide high-level executive support to leadership meetings across the Mental Health portfolio, helping to ensure effective coordination, reporting and follow-through on key priorities.

*This location is flexible between the Kids Hub Marion GP Plus, and the Playford Health Hub.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients, colleagues, agencies and the broader community.

  • Experience providing administrative and executive support for meetings.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

  • Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, exercise initiative and use sound judgement.

Qualification and Other Requirements:

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Primary Location

VIC - Melbourne - 655 Collins St

Job Description Summary

Service Stream’s Utilities division are currently seeking a Project Coordinator to join our growing team in Advanced Metering.

About the Role

Reporting to the Scheduling & Performance Manager. The Project Coordinator is responsible for the effective planning, coordination, and administration of daily metering works across a distribution network grid. The role ensures field workforce schedules are optimised, client requirements are met, and operational data is accurately captured to support performance reporting and invoicing.

Nature of position: Permanent / Full time

Location: Collins St, Melbourne

Reporting Line: Scheduling & Performance Manager

Key responsibilities

  • Plan, schedule, and adjust daily work activities for a team of field-based metering technicians
  • Allocate jobs efficiently based on geographic location, priority, skill set, and resource availability
  • Monitor work progress throughout the day and make real-time adjustments to schedules as required
  • Ensure all scheduled works meet client service level agreements (SLAs) and operational targets
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date scheduling records across internal systems and client platforms
  • Perform high-volume data entry and updates in Excel and relevant client systems
  • Point of contact between field staff, internal teams, and client representatives
  • Communicate schedule updates, conflicts, change and risks to relevant stake holders
  • Generate and process invoices using SAP in line with completed work and contractual requirements
  • Ensure all invoicing data is accurate, validated, and submitted within required time frames
  • Prepare and maintain monthly forecasts based on planned versus actual completion rates
  • Analyse scheduling and performance data to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities
  • Lead initiatives to streamline complex workflows, driving efficiency and continuous operational improvement
  • Ensure all work performed is in accordance with contractual requirements, to company standards and to the satisfaction of the client
  • Undertake and complete any other duties as requested by the Scheduling & Performance Manager
  • Strong focus on problem solving, compliance and servicing the client’s expectations

Experience required

  • Minimum 12 months in a scheduling, workforce coordination, or operations support roles
  • Competencies in MS Office Suite: Word & Outlook is essential.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data entry, tracking, and basic analysis)
  • Experience working with enterprise systems (SAP or similar ERP systems)
  • Basic technical knowledge of electrical metering work is an advantage
  • Excellent organizational, time management and administration skills
  • High level attention to detail and proactively meet deadlines
  • Familiarity with scheduling/dispatch systems or workforce management tools
  • Knowledge of energy network operations is an advantage but not essential)

About Us

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries. Specialising in designing, constructing, and maintaining new and existing networks, we provide end-to-end engineering and asset management solutions for our blue-chip client base. Committed to fostering a workplace culture that values diversity and inclusion, Service Stream actively promotes the employment of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, people with disabilities, LGBTQI individuals, and other diverse groups. As a signatory to the Veterans Employment Commitment, we also value the skills and experience of ex-ADF members and their partners, strongly considering veterans who meet the key criteria for our employment opportunities.

Service Stream does not accept any unsolicited resume referrals from external Recruitment or Labour Hire Companies.

Department
