Butik

























Kan du tage medansvar for den daglige drift i butikken og bidrage til, at kunderne får en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye salgsleder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et verdensklasse sammenhold, og sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Vi investerer i dig som medarbejder, og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.




Om jobbet


Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse 

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Åbne og/eller lukke butikken

Bestille varer hjem til butikken




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen

Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives med en travl hverdag

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som salgsleder i Lidl får du:

Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

 

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

Klik på "Søg nu"

Udfyld formularen

Vedhæft dit motiverede CV 

 

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!







Medarbejdergoder









Medarbejderrabat
Lidl-rabat: Få 10 % eller 20 % rabat på dine indkøb i vores butikker på udvalgte dage.





Rabatordning
Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.













        

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. Vi værdsætter vores medarbejderes mangfoldighed og fremmer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor hver enkelt føler sig velkommen og respekteret. Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.


    



























Butik
Elmegade 22

4400 Kalundborg









Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

title: Vice President - Branding and Communication
description:
Job Title:

Vice President - Branding and Communication

Work Type:

Permanent

Location:

DLF Downtown, Sector 25A Phase 3, Block 3

It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

A core focus of this role is partnering the Head of Communications & Branding to deliver integrated communication programs that elevate employee engagement, enable operational clarity and readiness, and strengthen the visibility as a world‑class global capability centre for the company

1. Internal Communications

  • Plan and deliver internal communication campaigns supporting business priorities, people initiatives, operational updates, and transformation programmes.
  • Develop content for internal channels (newsletters, Town Halls, leadership messages, intranet, digital signage, videos).
  • Create messaging and materials for senior leaders (video scripts, talking points, presentations, leadership notes).
  • Ensure communications foster a transparent, inclusive, and informed workplace.

2. COO Communications Enablement (Key Stakeholder: COO Team)

  • Partner with COO team (Service Delivery, Workplace & Facilities, Site Operations) to design and execute operational communications that improve clarity, safety, and continuity—e.g., floor moves, facilities updates, site services, maintenance/downtime notices, service readiness, business continuity, and change/release communications.
  • Establish comms SOPs, templates, and runbooks for incidents, planned works, and service announcements; drive timely, audience‑appropriate messages across channels.
  • Coordinate incident communications cadence (initial alert, updates, resolution, post‑incident note) and facilitate after‑action reviews to capture and implement communication improvements.
  • Translate operational changes into clear employee‑friendly narratives, FAQs, and “how‑to” guidance to reduce friction and support adoption.

3. External Communications & Employer Branding

  • Execute employer brand initiatives to attract top talent and strengthen market presence.
  • Develop external content (social media, PR inputs, talent branding collateral, leadership visibility content).
  • Ensure all external assets reflect design standards, tone of voice, and identity.

4. Brand Governance

  • Steward India’s visual and verbal identity, ensuring alignment with Group standards.
  • Review and approve brand assets, internal collaterals, and partner‑produced materials.
  • Support brand campaigns and drive consistency across on‑site, digital, and people‑engagement touchpoints.

5. Content Development

  • Draft high‑quality written content: articles, leadership messages, campaign copy, video scripts, digital content, employee stories.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and collaborate with stakeholders for timely delivery.
  • Curate content showcasing company India’s culture, capabilities, and community impact.

6. Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with People & Culture, Risk, Tech, Operations, Finance, DCO, COO Office, Talent Acquisition, and other teams to understand needs and deliver tailored solutions.
  • Manage relationships with creative partners, vendors, and agencies as needed.

7. Program & Campaign Management

  • Lead and execute multi‑channel campaigns from concept to delivery, including measurement and reporting.
  • Support major organisational events (Town Halls, Connect Sessions, leadership visits) and culture‑building initiatives.
  • Track performance metrics (engagement, reach, sentiment) and drive continuous improvement.

Success Measures

  • Operational comms effectiveness: On‑time delivery vs. agreed SLAs, reduced escalations due to comms gaps, improved colleague clarity and action‑ability (survey/feedback).
  • High‑quality, timely delivery of communication programs across internal and external channels.
  • Measurable improvements in employee engagement and campaign performance.
  • Strong alignment tobrand s tandards and tone of voice.
  • Increased visibility and recognition of India’s employer brand.
  • Positive feedback from internal stakeholders, and leadership.

Essential

  • 8–14 years in corporate communications, branding, internal communications, employer branding, or related fields.
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling, with adaptable tone and style.
  • Experience running multi‑channel campaigns in large/global organisations.
  • Strong brand governance and creative content development capability.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with speed, clarity, and accountability.
  • High stakeholder management capability, including confidence engaging senior leaders and internal stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience in BFSI, technology centres, or global capability centres.
  • Experience crafting social media and leadership visibility content.
  • Good if they have experience in incident / change / BCM related communications.

A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

More focus on you:

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities

Join NAB India:

This is your chance to join NAB India and along with your experience and expertise to help shape an innovation driven organisation that focuses on making a positive impact in the lives of its customers, colleagues and communities

To know more about us please click here

To know more about NAB Global Innovation Centres please click here

We’re on LinkedIn: NAB Innovation Centre India

description:
Principal Platform Software Engineer

Location: United States

Leads platform projects crossing multiple teams, evolving runtimes or middleware patterns for interoperability and multi-tenant scale. Diagnoses and resolves complex cross-service issues; enforces versioning, compatibility, and safe rollout practices. Drives observability standards, capacity planning, and resilience patterns across several workloads. Produces migration guides and adoption playbooks that raise ecosystem consistency and developer experience.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We are looking for engineers with distributed systems experience. You should have experience with the design of major features and launching them into production. title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Senior Enterprise Software Engineer

Location: IND-Pune-Smartworks

Remote Type: Hybrid (8 days/month)

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Wolters Kluwer is seeking a Senior Enterprise Software Engineer to design, develop, and implement scalable cloud-based solutions, with a strong focus on Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps practices, and automation.

This role represents a key step in the evolution from traditional IT operations toward software-driven infrastructure engineering, where systems and environments are built, deployed, and managed through code and automated pipelines.

The engineer will contribute to the development of enterprise platform capabilities, leveraging modern CI/CD toolchains and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed.

Key Responsibilities

Software & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Build automation solutions to replace manual operational activities
  • Contribute to the development of enterprise cloud services across Azure and AWS

CI/CD and Automation

  • Design and maintain pipelines using:
    • Azure DevOps (ADO Pipelines)
    • Jenkins
    • GitHub Actions
    • GitLab CI/CD
  • Ensure consistent and repeatable deployment processes across environments
  • Integrate validation, testing, and security controls into delivery pipelines

AI-Enabled Development

  • Utilize AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, M365 Copilot) to:
    • Accelerate code and IaC development
    • Improve documentation and test coverage
  • Validate AI-generated outputs and ensure adherence to engineering standards
  • Apply basic prompt engineering techniques to support development activities

Cloud & Platform Contribution

  • Support the provisioning and automation of infrastructure in Azure and AWS
  • Contribute to shared platform components and reusable modules
  • Assist in implementing event-driven and API-based automation

Security & Compliance

  • Integrate security practices into development workflows:
    • Secure coding
    • Secrets management
    • Dependency validation
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards and policies

Operations & Reliability

  • Support system monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution
  • Contribute to observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting)
  • Improve system reliability through automation and continuous improvement

Work Breakdown

  • 50% Software & Infrastructure Engineering
  • 25% CI/CD & Automation
  • 15% Operations & Troubleshooting
  • 10% Innovation & AI enablement

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience

Experience

  • 5–7 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or cloud engineering
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform (IaC)
  • Experience with CI/CD tools:
    • Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD
  • Experience working in Azure and/or AWS environments
  • Programming experience (Python preferred)

AI Capability

  • Practical experience using AI tools for development productivity
  • Ability to validate AI-generated code and outputs
  • Understanding of responsible AI usage in engineering workflows

Core Competencies

  • Strong execution and problem-solving skills
  • Automation-first mindset
  • Attention to detail and quality
  • Collaboration and teamwork
  • Continuous learning and adaptability

Other Duties and Soft Skills

  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.
  • On call rotation responsibilities with the Service Delivery and Operations Team
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success.
  • Minimal domestic travel requirements
  • Normal professional office environment.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: Snowflake Platform Engineer
description:
Snowflake Platform Engineer, Officer

Location: Hyderabad, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Snowflake Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) team. This role is responsible for the design, implementation, automation, and governance of enterprise-scale Snowflake data platforms within regulated financial environments.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Git-based development workflows, and ITSM processes (ServiceNow), with a focus on platform reliability, security, compliance, and automation.

Key Responsibilities

Snowflake Platform Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate Snowflake environments (multi-account, multi-region, replication & failover).

  • Implement secure RBAC models, access provisioning, and governance frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.

  • Develop and maintain automated onboarding pipelines (accounts, databases, warehouses, roles).

  • Optimize warehouse performance and cost (FinOps), including query tuning and utilization tracking.

  • Implement data protection, encryption, masking policies, and regulatory compliance controls.

Cloud & Infrastructure (Azure)

  • Architect and manage Snowflake integrations with Azure services (Azure Key Vault, Private Endpoints, Managed Identity).

  • Configure secure network connectivity (Private Link, VNet integration, firewall policies).

  • Troubleshoot TLS/SSL, connectivity, and authentication issues across Azure and Snowflake.

Automation & DevOps

  • Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform for Snowflake and Azure resources.

  • Develop CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (ADO) for:

    • Integration configurations

    • Grants and RBAC automation

  • Enforce Git-based version control practices for platform artifacts (SQL, scripts, Terraform modules).

  • Implement automated testing, validation, and rollback mechanisms for deployments.

ITSM, Change & Release Management

  • Integrate platform workflows with ServiceNow for:

    • Change requests

    • Incident management

    • Service catalog automation

  • Drive controlled release processes ensuring compliance with enterprise change policies.

  • Support audit-ready deployments with traceability across environments (Dev, QA, Prod).

Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure platform adherence to regulated environment standards (e.g., SOC2, ISO, financial compliance frameworks).

  • Maintain audit logs, activity tracking, and access reviews across Snowflake and Azure.

  • Implement controls for Data retention, and security policies.

  • Partner with Security and Risk teams for periodic audits and remediation.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop runbooks, SOPs, and architecture documentation aligned with CRD standards.

  • Provide L3 support and lead production incident resolution (Sev1/Sev2).

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks.

  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and automation maturity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in data platform engineering or cloud infrastructure roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

    • Snowflake (core platform, security, replication, performance tuning)

    • Microsoft Azure (Storage, Networking, Identity, Key Vault)

    • Terraform (IaC for cloud and Snowflake resources)

    • Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, release management)

    • Git version control (branching strategies, code reviews)

    • Experience in supporting third party applications such as Talend,Qlik,Looker.

  • Experience with ServiceNow ITSM workflows.

  • Proven experience working in regulated or financial services environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with:

    • Snowflake account replication and DR strategies

    • Multi-cloud data architectures (AWS/Azure hybrid)

    • Automated data access provisioning workflows (AI-driven preferred)

  • Knowledge of:

    • Data governance and catalog tools

    • Security frameworks and compliance standards

    • Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Co-pilot

  • Snowflake and/or Azure certifications are a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Strong platform engineering mindset (automation-first, scalable design)

  • Deep understanding of data security and governance

  • Excellent problem-solving and production troubleshooting skills

  • Ability to work across cross-functional teams (CPE, Security, ACO, DevOps)

  • Strong documentation and executive communication skills

Success Metrics (KPIs)

  • Reduction in manual onboarding effort (%)

  • Improvement in warehouse utilization efficiency / cost savings

  • Increase in automated deployment coverage (%)

  • Reduction in Sev1/Sev2 incidents

  • Audit compliance with zero critical findings

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to build and scale enterprise-grade cloud data platforms

  • Work in a highly regulated, mission-critical financial environment

  • Drive automation, AI integration, and platform innovation

  • Collaborate with global engineering and security teams

Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.

Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

Vi forestiller os at du er:

Udadvendt og brænder for at give vores gæster gode oplevelser

Sikre, at vores dejlige gæster får den bedste oplevelse

title: Informatica Developer
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Informatica Developer within PNC's Technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh PA.

Job Title: Software Engineer Senior (Informatica Developer)
Required Skills & Experience
Strong experience in data engineering and ETL development
Strong experience with Informatica (PowerCenter and/or Informatica Cloud/IICS)
Advanced SQL, PL/SQL skills and experience with large-scale data transformations
Experience with data warehousing platforms (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle, Teradata )
Writing and optimizing code for data pipelines to ensure systems are highly efficient, scalable, and capable of handling large-scale financial datasets.
Proficient with code deployment tools such as Udeploy, Artifactory
Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Knowledge of financial and cost data, preferably Activity Based Costing
Experience with data quality, reconciliation, and performance optimization
Collaborate with Finance Product owners, analysts to gather requirements and implement data solutions that meet business needs.
Analyzes and evaluates requirements by working with users, product owners and management and provides recommendations on the scope and complexity of the solution.
Proactive and detail-oriented professional with strong sense of ownership
Creative problem solver who can tackle complex data challenges.
Mentor who can guide junior engineers and contributes to team growth.
Build and optimize data architectures ensuring high performance, reliability, and security.
Proposes & designs data solutions to address complex business needs. Prepares technical and procedural documentation required.
Acts as a lead by developing and documenting technical specifications for proposed solutions. This includes hands-on coding and testing as well to support solutions.
Participates in code reviews & overall testing.
Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development environments
Strong collaboration and communication skills for working with finance and business stakeholders

Soft Skills
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non technical audiences
Strong ownership mindset and accountability for deliverables end to end
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and recommend data driven solutions
Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal oversight
Mentorship mindset—able to guide junior analysts and review analytical workPNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Provides detailed technical design and development of software solutions using existing and emerging technology platforms.
  • Proposes & designs software solutions to address complex business needs.
  • Writes code, tests and deploys software.
  • Prepares technical and procedural documentation required for software.
  • Maintains and debugs software.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Application Development, Business Management, Customer Solutions, Design, ETL (Informatica), Group Problem Solving, Informatica Development, PL/SQL (Programming Language), Process Improvements, Release Management, Software Solutions, User Experience (UX) Design

Competencies

Application Delivery Process, Application Design, Architecture, Application Development Tools, Application Testing, Packaged Application Integration, System Development Life Cycle, Technical Troubleshooting, Technical Writing/Documentation

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

No Required License(s)

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit .

Disability Accommodations Statement

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.


At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)


PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history.

California Residents

Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

title: Inpakoperator - vaste nachtshift
description:
Waarom we hier zijn

Tony's Chocolonely zet zich in om een ​​einde te maken aan uitbuiting in de cacao-industrie, en onze fabriek speelt daarin een cruciale rol. Hoe meer repen we produceren van onze ethische cacaobonen, hoe groter de positieve impact in de wereld!

We bevinden ons momenteel in de spannende fase van de uitbreiding van onze chocoladefabriek in Borsbeek. Door bij ons te komen werken, maak je deel uit van het productie- en verpakkingsproces van onze heerlijke, hoogwaardige chocolade die wereldwijd wordt verkocht!

Jouw job:

Als inpakoperator ben je verantwoordelijk voor de vlotte werking en het schoonmaakonderhoud van de inpakmachine om bij te dragen aan een hoge productiviteit. Je werk is een afwisseling van manueel werk, machine-bediening en kwaliteitscontroles. Jouw leidinggevende is de shiftleader en je maakt deel uit van het productie-team.

Takenpakket:

  • Bediening en toevoer van de inpakmachine volgens correcte veiligheids- en kwaliteitsnormen

  • Onregelmatigheden signaleren aan collega inpakoperatoren, lijnoperatoren en shiftleader.

  • Schoonmaak van de inpakmachine en de werkplaats.

  • Manueel werk; inpakken, stickeren, stapelen, inclusies mengen, rework verwerken.

Jouw profiel:

  • Je kan overzicht houden bij een snel bewegende inpakmachine.

  • Je hecht veel belang aan orde, hygiëne en veiligheid en leeft onze procedures nauwkeurig na.

  • Je werkt samen en communiceert goed met je teamgenoten aan de lijn.

  • Je hebt basis technisch inzicht om kleine storingen te kunnen detecteren.

  • Je bent opmerkzaam om onregelmatigheden te signaleren aan je collega’s, techniekers en shiftleader.

  • Je gaat ergonomisch te werk en kan fysiek bukken en tillen.

  • Productie-ervaring is wenselijk maar niet noodzakelijk, chocolade-productkennis is een troef.

  • Je spreekt Nederlands, want aan een bewegende machine moeten je collega’s je onmiddellijk kunnen begrijpen.

  • Ervaring met de normen van een voedsel-omgeving zijn een voordeel.

En ten slotte:

  • Je bent in staat om 38u per week te werken vanuit onze fabriek in Borsbeek tijdens de vaste nachtshift van 22-6u (opkomen zondag 22u en start weekend vrijdag om 6u)

  • Je woont in België en bent wettelijk toegelaten om er te werken.

  • Je gaat flexibel om met de veranderingen die gepaard gaan met een groeiend bedrijf.

  • Je gelooft met hart en ziel in de missie van Tony.

Onze voordelen (de kers op de taart):

Bij Tony's krijg je de kans om deel uit te maken van iets buitengewoons; in de eerste plaats door echt impact te maken in de wereld, maar ook door te genieten van de leuke voordelen:

  • maaltijdcheques van €9 per gewerkte dag (€1.09 werknemersbijdrage)

  • ploegenpremie van 30%

  • 20 vakantiedagen

  • hospitalisatieverzekering

  • pensioensparen volgens de sectorale bepalingen

  • dagelijks verse soep, brood en fruit in de cafetaria

  • onvergetelijke teamevenementen

  • héél veel chocolade

Maar we weten ook dat chocolade niet genoeg is om de rekeningen te betalen, dus we hebben ervoor gezorgd dat je salaris net zo lonend is. Voor deze functie betekent dat een startloon van 17.53 EUR/uur.

Klinkt als jij?
Wil bijdragen aan onze missie? Stuur ons je sollicitatie!
Iedereen is welkom om te solliciteren. Van Classics tot limited editions, we weten dat verschillende smaken het leven inspirerender maken. En niet alleen in ons chocolade assortiment. Bij Tony’s verwelkomen we iedereen met evenveel enthousiasme – ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, leeftijd, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, nationaliteit, handicap of veteranenstatus. Crazy about chocolate, serious about people.

about people.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer

Location: Nashville, TN, United States

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building the next generation of AI native engineering systems powering cloud operations, infrastructure automation, and developer productivity at scale. We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer (IC4) who operates as an AI native builder. This is not a traditional software engineering role centered on manual coding. Engineers on this team use AI assisted development, coding agents, and automation first workflows as the default mode of software creation. This role focuses on rapidly building intelligent systems, internal platforms, operational tooling, and cloud native services using modern AI driven engineering practices. You will work across distributed systems, automation platforms, developer experience, and operational intelligence to dramatically improve engineering velocity, reliability, and scale.

title: Taloushallinnon assistentti
description:
Haemme joukkoomme taloushallinnon assistenttia

Savukosken kunta julistaa haettavaksi toistaiseksi voimassa olevan taloushallinnon assistentin toimen (0,5).

Haemme taloushallinnon assistenttia osaksi kunnan hallinto- ja talouspalveluita. Tehtävässä toimit yhteistyössä kunnan oman henkilöstön ja ulkoistetun taloushallintopalvelun kanssa.

Tehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa osto- ja myyntilaskujen käsittelyä, maksuliikenteen hoitaminen, kirjanpidon, talousarvion ja tilinpäätöksen valmistelua, käyttöomaisuuskirjanpidon ylläpitoa, taloushallinnon asiakirjojen käsittelyä sekä muita päivittäisiä taloushallinnon tehtäviä kunnan ja palveluntuottajan välisen vastuunjaon mukaisesti. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu taloushallinnon asiakaspalvelua ja muuta taloushallinnon tukea kunnan toimialoille.

Toimen kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva ammattitutkinto.

Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen kunta-alan taloushallinnon tehtävistä. Arvostamme huolellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta, hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä taloushallinnon tietojärjestelmien tuntemusta.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka määräytyy KVTES mukaisesti. Toimen täytössä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Toimeen valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan.

Toimi täytetään 1.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Kunnassa on liukuva työaika ja mahdollisuus tehdä etätyötä kunnan etätyöohjeen mukaisesti.

Olemme savuton työnantaja.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Overview:
Robot.com is building the world’s leading robotic delivery network, transforming last-mile logistics through autonomous systems. With deployments across major campuses and cities, we are scaling rapidly and developing the software and hardware that power the future of delivery. We are a fast-paced, collaborative, and mission-driven team committed to creating technology that is efficient, accessible, and impactful.

The Role:
We are seeking a Full Stack Developer to design, build, and maintain both frontend and backend software systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, implement new product features, and ensure that applications are scalable, secure, and high-performing. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning features end-to-end and working in a dynamic environment where autonomy and problem-solving are valued.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Implementation

  • Develop, test, and maintain web applications with a focus on scalability and usability.

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Create and optimize frontend interfaces using React and modern UI frameworks.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to define and deliver new features.

  • Participate in code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

  • Ensure applications meet quality and security standards through testing and monitoring.

Infrastructure & Optimization

  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to design efficient data models.

  • Support deployment workflows, containerization, and cloud environments.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and production issues.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Experience

  • 2–4+ years of full stack software development experience.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript for both frontend and backend development.

  • Strong experience with React and Node.js.

  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, modern web architectures, and component-based UI design.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and collaborative workflows.

  • Comfort working with cloud platforms (AWS, Vercel, or GCP) and containerization tools (Docker).

  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

Attributes

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced and evolving environments.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

Why Join Robot.com?

  • Work at the forefront of robotics and real-world autonomous systems.

  • Opportunity to influence core technology decisions in a rapidly growing environment.

  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture focused on innovation and impact.

  • Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and benefits package.

title: Boiler Plant Operator
description:
Overview

Ansible Government Solutions, LLC (Ansible) is currently recruiting Boiler Plant Operator to support the Fayetteville VA Medical Center located 2300 Ramsey Street, Fayetteville, NC 28301. The schedule is typically 12-hour shifts. If you accept employment with Ansible, you must also acknowledge that any assigned schedule is subject to change at the direction of either Ansible or its customers.

Ansible is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Federal customers with solutions in many arenas. Our customers face wide-ranging challenges in the fields of health care, national security, and information technology. To address these challenges, we employ intelligent and committed staff who take care of our customers’ success as if it is their own.

Responsibilities
  • Operate, monitor, and control:
    • High-pressure steam boilers
    • Hot water generators
    • Feedwater systems
    • Pumps and compressors
    • Fuel systems
    • Water treatment equipment
  • Monitor gauges, meters, BMS/SCADA systems, combustion efficiency indicators, and safety devices.
  • Adjust controls to maintain proper pressure, temperature, water levels, and fuel-air ratios.
  • Perform routine testing and sampling of:
    • Boiler feedwater
    • Condensate
    • Cooling water
  • Adjust chemical treatment systems and blowdown operations to maintain proper water quality.
  • Perform preventive maintenance on:
    • Boilers
    • Burners
    • Pumps
    • Valves
    • Piping systems
    • Control systems
  • Identify equipment issues and operational abnormalities.
  • Complete basic repairs and escalate major issues when appropriate.
  • Perform Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and prepare equipment for maintenance and inspections.
  • Maintain accurate operational and maintenance logs.
  • Track system parameters, fuel usage, water quality results, and maintenance activities.
  • Report safety hazards, equipment failures, environmental concerns, and operational incidents.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, boiler safety codes, and environmental requirements.
Qualifications
  • North Carolina High-Pressure Stationary Engineer Certification (Class 1 required)
  • Must meet requirements of VHA Directive 1810.
  • OSHA 10-Hour Safety Certification
  • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Certification
  • Confined Space Entry Certification
  • Knowledge/training in Water Treatment and Boiler Chemistry (strongly preferred/required by SOW).
  • 3 to 5 years of direct experience operating high-pressure industrial or commercial steam boiler systems
  • No sponsorship available.

All candidates must be able to:

  • Sit, stand, walk, lift, squat, bend, twist, and reach above shoulders during the work shift
  • Lift up to 50 lbs from floor to waist
  • Lift up to 20 lbs
  • Carry up to 40 lbs a reasonable distance
  • Push/pull with 30 lbs of force

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Undersköterska med tilläggsuppdrag som gruppledare i Hemse
description:
Gotlands Hemtjänster söker en engagerad undersköterska som vill stärka vårt team i Hemse där vi varje dag gör skillnad för människor som inte längre klarar vardagen själva.

Du kommer att arbeta nära våra kunder för att ge dem den bästa möjliga omsorgen och stödet som bidrar till ökad livskvalitet. Arbetet innebär att utföra omsorgsinsatser enligt individuella genomförandeplaner och att bidra till en trygg vardag för våra kunder. Tilläggsuppdraget innebär vissa administrativa uppgifter och samarbete med olika yrkesgrupper på samtliga enheter.

Ansvarsområden

  • Ge personlig omsorg och stöd inom hemtjänsten baserat på individuella behov och önskemål.

  • Skapa och upprätthålla en säker och trivsam miljö för kunderna.

  • Dokumentera och rapportera omsorgsinsatser samt notera eventuella förändringar i kundens tillstånd.

  • Kommunicera effektivt med kollegor och kunder för att säkerställa en integrerad vård och omsorg.

  • Utföra vissa administrativa uppgifter enligt arbetsbeskrivningen för gruppledare.

Önskade kvalifikationer

  • Undersköterska eller annan likvärdig utbildning.

  • Förmåga att sätta kundens behov i centrum och snabbt anpassa sig till olika situationer.

  • Utmärkt förmåga att kommunicera tydligt i tal och skrift med både kollegor, kunder och övriga som är involverade i våra kunders omsorg.

  • Grundläggande datorkunskap/datorvana för dokumentation.

  • Förmåga att strukturera sitt arbete och arbeta självständigt samt aktivt söka lösningar för förbättrad vård och kvalitet.

  • Du ser och värdesätter människors olikheter och bidrar aktivt till mångfald och inkludering.

  • Tidigare erfarenhet inom hemtjänst eller liknande vårdsektor är meriterande men vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

  • Körkort är ett krav.

Vi erbjuder

  • Möjligheten att utföra ett meningsfullt arbete som bidrar till människors livskvalitet.

  • En positiv och stöttande arbetsmiljö där dina insatser uppskattas och värderas.

  • Möjligheter till personlig utveckling och karriärvägar inom företaget.

  • Att ingå i ett professionellt och engagerat team som delar vår vision av högkvalitativ omsorg.

  • En arbetsplats där arbetsglädje och omtanke genomsyrar hela verksamheten.

Om Gotlands Hemtjänster

Gotlands Hemtjänster strävar efter att erbjuda högkvalitativ och individanpassad omsorg till våra kunder. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att skapa trygghet och värde i människors vardag genom vårt dedikerade arbete. Vårt team består av erfarna och passionerade medarbetare som alla delar viljan att göra skillnad. Bli en del av vår hemtjänstfamilj och bidra till en positiv förändring i våra kunders liv varje dag.

Omfattning och arbetstid

  • Tillsvidareanställning, sysselsättningsgrad 100%.

  • För närvarande är arbetstiden förlagd till dagtid måndag-fredag inklusive röda dagar.

· Tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Låter detta intressant? Ansök redan idag! Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och ser fram emot att höra från dig. Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet och välkomnar sökande oavsett kön, ålder, bakgrund eller erfarenhet.

Före eventuell anställning ska utdrag ur belastningsregistret tillsammans med giltig fotolegitimation visas upp. Vid kallad intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Skicka din ansökan och CV så snart som möjligt — urval sker löpande då tillsättning sker snarast. Vi välkomnar sökande oavsett kön, ålder eller bakgrund och strävar efter en inkluderande arbetsmiljö.

title: Sr IE Engineer
description:

Penang, Malaysia

title: Lead Mobile Engineer
description:
DualEntry - Lead Mobile

Department: Engineering

Location: Remote, Argentina, Uruguay, Brazil

Compensation: $120K – $180K • $40K – $60K Equity

Employment Type: FullTime

About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Build!

  • Turn Figma designs into fast, polished components with smooth animations, backed by clean API integration and solid performance

What Sets You Up for Success

  • 5+ years Android experience, ideally at a high-growth startup

  • Track record building smooth, high-performance apps - animations included

  • Comfortable with Figma-to-code and the full release cycle, IDE to App Store

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

Meet the Engineering Team

  • Ignacio shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

Benefits & Compensation

  • This position has a work schedule from Monday to Saturday

Interview Process

title: AI Personalisation Product Lead
description: ## AI Personalisation Product LeadApplyremote type: Hybridlocations: Johannesburg: Cape Towntime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Todayjob requisition id: JR-78933**Let's Write Africa's Story Together!**Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.**Job Description**The AI Personalisation Product Lead is the technical product owner for Old Mutual’s AI-driven personalisation engines. This is an engineering-adjacent leadership role that owns the product track for four interconnected AI systems: the Next Best Action (NBA) engine, the content personalisation engine, the dynamic optimisation infrastructure, and the chatbot personalisation capability. The Lead is accountable for the technical maturity, production reliability, and performance improvement of these systems — not for the commercial proposition they serve. This is a deeply technical role. The ideal candidate has a background in machine learning engineering, data science leadership, or AI product management within a production ML environment. They must be fluent in the language of model training, feature engineering, serving infrastructure, latency optimisation, champion-challenger experimentation, and MLOps — not just able to discuss these topics at a conceptual level, but able to make architectural decisions, review model performance, challenge data science approaches, and unblock engineering bottlenecks. This person runs sprint planning, reviews pull requests with the team, triages production incidents, and makes trade-off decisions between model accuracy and serving latency. The role leads a technical team of 13 to 15 resources in data science, ML and engineering.## **Key Responsibilities**Next Best Action (NBA) Engine — Product Ownership* Own the NBA product vision, technical roadmap, and engineering backlog — defining what capabilities the engine needs to develop, in what sequence, and to what performance standard.* Define the NBA decision framework: what actions the engine evaluates, what signals it consumes, what constraints it respects (commercial rules, partner obligations, frequency caps, POPIA consent), and how it ranks competing actions.* Direct the Data Science team on model development.* Own the real-time serving infrastructure.* Design and govern champion-challenger experimentation: define experiment protocols, statistical rigour standards, traffic allocation strategies, and decision criteria for model promotion.* Build and maintain the feature store: curate the real-time and batch feature sets (behavioural, demographic, transactional, contextual) that feed NBA models, ensuring feature freshness, quality, and governance.* Integrate NBA outputs into Rewards and Digital Platform customer touchpoints: work with Technology/Engineering on API design, integration patterns, fallback handling, and error management.* Monitor NBA performance daily: model accuracy (AUC/precision/recall), acceptance rates, revenue attribution, latency metrics, and drift detection — triggering retraining when performance degrades.* Build feedback loops: ensure action outcomes (accepted, ignored, rejected) are captured, pipeline-processed, and fed back into model training data on a defined cadence.* Report NBA performance and attributed revenue to Business Owners monthly, with clear methodology transparency.Content Personalisation Engine — Product Ownership* Own the content personalisation product vision and technical strategy: how the engine determines which content, articles, offers, and recommendations to serve to each user.* Direct the development of content recommendation algorithms: collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, hybrid approaches, and contextual re-ranking models.* Build and maintain user interest profiles from behavioural data (content views, reads, dwell time, shares), stated preferences, and inferred affinities.* Own the content taxonomy and tagging framework (jointly with Data Architect): define the metadata structure, classification schema, and machine-readable content attributes that enable effective algorithmic matching.* Integrate personalised content feeds into Digital Platform (app, web, WhatsApp) and Rewards experiences.* Implement editorial override and curation controls: build mechanisms that allow marketing and content teams to pin, boost, suppress, or schedule specific content alongside algorithmic recommendations.* Design and run experiments to measure personalisation impact: A/B tests of personalised vs. non-personalised content, content diversity experiments, and filter bubble detection.* Ensure content diversity to prevent filter bubbles: implement exploration mechanisms, serendipity algorithms, and diversity constraints that maintain content discovery alongside personalisation.* Monitor content personalisation performance: engagement lift, content consumption depth, return frequency, and personalisation coverage metrics.Dynamic Optimisation & Experimentation Infrastructure* Own the experimentation platform: design, build, and maintain the A/B testing and multi-armed bandit infrastructure that enables automated optimisation of campaigns and experiences.* Implement multi-armed bandit algorithms for automated traffic allocation: where experiments should converge to the winning variant dynamically rather than waiting for manual analysis.* Build real-time campaign optimisation pipelines: automated bid, creative, and audience adjustment based on streaming performance signals.* Develop adaptive algorithms for experience personalisation that improve over time through continuous learning — not just static rule-based personalisation.* Create guardrails and circuit breakers: automated safety mechanisms that prevent optimisation algorithms from degrading experiences, violating business rules, or producing statistically invalid conclusions.* Establish statistical rigour standards for experiment design: minimum sample sizes, power calculations, duration rules, and significance thresholds.* Build dashboards that surface experiment results and automated decisions transparently: stakeholders must be able to see what the algorithms are doing and why.Chatbot AI Personalisation — Product Ownership* Own the chatbot personalisation product: the AI/ML capability that makes the chatbot contextually aware, brand-consistent, and able to guide users through personalised journeys.* Integrate the chatbot with NBA engine outputs: the chatbot should be able to surface the NBA-recommended action within conversation, not operate as a disconnected system.* Integrate the chatbot with the content personalisation engine: the chatbot should recommend relevant content, articles, and features based on the user’s profile and conversation context.* Build decision trees and personalisation logic for chatbot-guided journeys: the chatbot must be able to navigate users through complex multi-step processes (onboarding, rewards redemption, feature discovery) with contextual personalisation.* Own chatbot integration into the InteGreat (DAE) adviser platform: define adviser-specific chatbot use cases, conversation flows, and integration requirements.* Implement chatbot analytics: conversation completion rates, containment rates, personalisation effectiveness (CSAT, conversion from chatbot interactions), and escalation patterns.* Continuously improve chatbot responses based on conversation log analysis, user feedback, and outcome data.Customer Micro-Segmentation — Technical Infrastructure* Own the technical segmentation infrastructure: the models, pipelines, and data systems that produce granular customer segments for precision targeting and personalisation.* Direct the Data Science team on segmentation model development.* Build dynamic segments that update in real time as customer behaviour changes — not static segments refreshed weekly.* Integrate segments into the NBA engine, content personalisation engine, marketing automation platform, and CRM — ensuring segments are actionable across all activation channels.* Establish segment governance: creation, naming, validation, retirement, and deduplication standards.* Provide segment insights to the Demand Marketing Leads and Business Owners: segment-level performance reports that prove targeting value and inform campaign strategy.MLOps, Platform Engineering & Technical Governance* Own the ML development lifecycle across all AI products: model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining — with defined cadences, quality gates, and rollback procedures.* Define and enforce model governance standards: model documentation, bias testing, fairness assessment, explainability requirements, and audit trails.* Own the MLOps pipeline: CI/CD for models, automated testing, deployment orchestration, model versioning, and A/B deployment infrastructure.* Manage the AI/ML technology stack: ML training platform (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent), model serving infrastructure (KServe, Seldon, or custom), feature store, and experiment platform.* Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, and technical prioritisation for the AI Personalisation squad across all four product areas.* Manage the dedicated engineering resources: Scrum title: Principal Engineer – Hydraulic (Pumping & Pipeline Systems)
description:
WSP India is currently seeking a Principal Engineer – Hydraulic (Pumping & Pipeline Systems) for Australia Mining Infrastructure Projects (Materials Handling Infrastructure). They shall be responsible for engineering design of Process with WSP Engineering and Client Standards. Previous experience in an EPCM environment in the O & G, Power plant, Chemical process plant, Mining processing industry is an asset.

A Team player and willing to work collaboratively with a motivated and highly successful team in Australia. The position will be for Mumbai location.

About the role:

We are seeking a Principal Hydraulic Engineer to support mining infrastructure projects across Australia, with a strong focus on pumping systems, pipeline networks, and water management systems.

This is a hybrid role combining process engineering, hydraulic analysis, and pipeline/pumping system design, rather than a conventional EPC-style discipline role.

The position will lead technical delivery, mentor engineers, and interface with multidisciplinary teams across Australia and India.

The role requires close collaboration and effective coordination with clients, multidisciplinary engineering teams, vendors, suppliers, pipeline route survey consultants, geotechnical investigation teams, construction contractors, and other key stakeholders to ensure engineering excellence, compliance with project requirements, timely delivery of deliverables, and successful project execution.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead design and analysis of:

  • Pumping systems (HP pumps, transfer systems)

  • Pipeline and network systems (water, slurry, dewatering)

  • Define system philosophy:

  • Pumping strategy and operating scenarios

  • Overpressure and surge protection philosophy

  • Brownfield integration and tie-ins

  • Provide technical assurance and review of key deliverables like Pipeline route selection and feasibility studies, material selection, wall thickness design, pipeline stress analysis in accordance with applicable international codes and standards, design of crossings for highways, roads, railways, rivers, and other utilities, pipeline integrity management, identification and mitigation of geohazards, and preparation of material specifications and other engineering deliverables.

  • Undertake and lead pipeline design work for projects and studies including typical activities and deliverables: -

  • Concept design and layout development

  • Process descriptions and design basis

  • Material balances

  • Preparation of process flow diagrams & piping and instrumentation diagrams

  • Hazardous area classification/assessment

  • Preparation of equipment lists, equipment datasheets, specifications

  • Fluids lists and materials selection

  • Process hazard studies (including HAZOP) and design safety reviews

  • SIL assessment

  • Process basis of safety

  • Detailed process design calculations

  • Pressure relief design Utilities schedules, utilities flow diagrams and line sizing

  • Preparation of validation documentation

  • Commissioning plans and support

  • Prepare the following for pipelines and their components:

  • Material specifications and datasheets

  • Fabrication specifications

  • Installation specifications

  • Pipeline design and installation, stress analyses

  • Material takeoffs

  • Bids & Proposal support

  • Pipeline reports and installation manual

  • To ensure technical excellence in Pipeline engineering and design.

  • Develop and review:

  • Basis of Design (BoD)

  • Design criteria and technical specifications

  • P&IDs and process schematics

  • Hydraulic calculations and reports

  • Perform and validate:

  • Hydraulic modelling (PumpSim, or equivalent)

  • Flow scenarios and system behaviour

  • Pipe sizing and pressure rating

  • Review and guide:

  • Pipe class and valve class selection

  • Pump selection and system curves

  • Co-ordination of a design to ensure good interface with all other disciplines.

  • Participation in design reviews and technical audits.

  • Input into multi-discipline design programmes.

  • Contributing to processes to maintain change & cost control.

  • Develop the strength of the expertise within the Pipeline engineering department.

  • Support/generate cost and manhours estimate for proposals, studies and projects.

  • Act as Lead Pipeline Engineer on selected projects controlling design, specifications, costs, hours, quality and programme.

  • Lead and deliver Pipeline engineering scopes for mining sustaining capital and brownfield projects.

  • Develop and review pipeline design documentation, including mass and energy balances, PFDs, P&IDs, process descriptions, and design reports.

  • Support concept studies, feasibility assessments, and detailed design phases with Pipeline modelling and optimisation input.

  • Liaise with operations teams to understand plant performance issues and develop improvement strategies.

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior Pipeline engineers and designers.

  • Ensure all designs comply with WSP’s quality standards, client requirements, and relevant Australian and international codes and standards.

  • Contribute to project planning, cost estimation, and risk assessments for process-related scopes.

  • Make technical presentations internally, to clients and to outside organisations.

  • To ensure that process safety issues are fully considered within projects eg. HAZOP, LOPA, hazardous area classification, SIL reviews.

  • Contribute to:

  • Maintenance strategies

  • System operability and reliability improvements

  • Provide practical, field-aligned engineering solutions

Client / External focus

  • Maintain strong colleague relationships and contribute to the teams’ performance of client satisfaction.

  • Contribute to knowledge sharing in internal and external forums.

  • Remain up to date with market and competitor knowledge.

Key Competencies

  • Lead Pipeline engineering activities associated with mining infrastructure projects including:

  • Raw water systems

  • Mine water management systems

  • Mine dewatering systems

  • Tailings transport systems

  • Reclaim water systems

  • Slurry transport systems

  • Process water distribution networks

Mandatory Skills

We anticipate you will have an interest in the following areas:

  • You will also be computer literate with a reasonable proficiency in MS office suite and Navisworks.

  • Having a thirst for knowledge, cultural awareness, an open mind, and good English

  • communication skills are essential, along with the ability to work as part of a team.

  • Coordinating his/her work with other members of the Team.

  • Work competently with minimal supervision or on an individual basis.

  • The candidate must have a valid passport.

  • Key competencies expected are:

  • Collaboration & Teamwork

  • Technical Capability & Delivery

  • Adaptability & Learning

Desired Skills

Strong experience in:

  • Pumping systems and pipeline networks
  • Hydraulic design and system analysis

Good understanding of:

  • Overland pipelines
  • Transient / surge analysis

Exposure to:

  • Slurry pipelines and rheology (desirable)

Experience in:

  • Technical documentation and specifications
  • Multidisciplinary coordination

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • 7-16 years of experience in process engineering.

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree & preferred master’s degree in mechanical/civil engineering. PG diploma or certificate in Piping engineering would be an asset.

  • Strong organizational, technical, and communication skills.

  • Strong attention to the detail.

  • Familiar with working in a LEAN environment.

  • Experience with projects in Australia, New Zealand would be an advantage.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, in English.

  • C. Eng, P. Eng qualification would be an added advantage.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Associate Backend Software Engineer II
description:
As an Associate Backend Software Engineer II in AbbVie Business Technology Solutions (BTS), you’ll have opportunities to contribute to the digital transformation of a leading biopharma company, helping to create solutions that impact patients and their communities for the better.

The ideal candidate will excel in delivering adaptable and user-friendly web applications and data analysis pipelines that can evolve to meet scientists’ needs. Additionally, the successful candidate will have the ability to independently identify, engineer, and optimize new software solutions to address critical business requirements. A continuous drive to improve existing methods and processes is essential.

Responsibilities:

  • Independently design and develop software to answer scientific or business questions, demonstrating proficiency across a range of technologies related to programming languages, data integration, and data visualization and analysis.
  • Design, develop, and maintain backend components of enterprise applications.
  • Ensure security and integrity of software solutions, safeguarding data and system operations.
  • Continuously seeks learning opportunities to stay updated with emerging web technologies and data analysis tools, applying innovative solutions to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Use AbbVie values to govern decisions, actions and behaviors, ensuring that work reflects our commitments to Patients, Affordability, Accountability & Service Commitment, Decisiveness, Innovation & Thoughtful Risk while fostering Diversity & Inclusion, Integrity & Respect, Learning, Continuous Improvement & Personal Growth, Teamwork & Collaboration.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree - preferably in Computer Science or Data Science - plus 2 years of experience OR Master’s degree with 0 years of experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Javascript, SQL, and Typescript.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic environment and developing flexible solutions to meet evolving requirements.
  • Ability to work independently with strong time management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to communicate effectively with scientists, developers, application analysts, managers and IT professionals.
  • Good presentation, training, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • APEX development experience in Salesforce.
  • Experience with incorporating Generative AI techniques into custom software solutions
