title: Senior Control Systems Networking Engineer, Data Center Technology Systems
location: London, UK; Dublin, Ireland; Amsterdam, Netherlands
description:
Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department -- cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements -- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical).

To support delivering AI and Infrastructure at an unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity, the Data Center Control Engineering team takes the control/networking design of our data centers into the future. Our team mirrors a research and product development department where cutting-edge designs/strategies are incubated, developed and productized for construction.

In this role, you will take on complex OT networking and infrastructure challenges to develop new technologies, and optimize processes to further increase our networking posture and networking infrastructure across products.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Ireland: €110000 - €112000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Netherlands: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Develop scope, requirements for networking initiatives to drive the design, implementation, testing of secure, and resilient operational technology (OT) security solutions. Perform design document development, implementation and lab and on-site testing of networking solutions.
  • Perform technical review of new control system infrastructure initiatives, embedding networking requirements into the lifecycle from initial design, testing to deployment.
  • Serve as a technical liaison and collaborate between cross-functional teams to resolve complex design, integration, and deployment challenges in mission-critical environments.
  • Perform sustaining and life cycling activities during pre and post deployment, and operations for networking solutions and OT infrastructure components (e.g., SCADA/HMI servers, clients, software).
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and maturation of the OT environment to drive risk reduction.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience managing the technical design and implementation of OT infrastructure and networking.
  • Experience in industrial control system architecture as it pertains to network segmentation, standard protocols (e.g., BACnet, Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850), and system administration.
  • Experience in industrial control system hardware (e.g., PLCs, relays, IEDs, IO modules) and networking layer integration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Knowledge of, or experience in electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Knowledge of, or experience in data center infrastructure/critical infrastructure.
  • Ability to generate technical product specifications/requirements, conceptual schematics, and system architecture drawings to drive control networking system projects.

Vil du arbejde med nogle af de mest interessante sager inden for EU & Konkurrenceret? Vil du videreudvikle dine juridiske evner i et dynamisk og inspirerende miljø? Og vil du rådgive førende danske og internationale virksomheder?


Så er du muligvis vores nye kollega i afdelingen for EU & Konkurrenceret.

Bliv en del af en kompetent og succesfuld afdeling

Vores konkurrenceretsafdeling rådgiver danske og internationale klienter inden for alle aspekter af dansk og EU-konkurrenceret, statsstøtte og generel EU-ret. Afdelingen består af både jurister og økonomer med erfaring fra væsentlige sager i Danmark og EU.


Vi har klienter inden for en række industrier, herunder finansielle virksomheder, shipping og maritime virksomheder, medicinal-, bygge- og konstruktionsbrancherne, fremstilling af forbrugsvarer, energi, forsikring, medier, fast ejendom, detailhandel, software og computer, sport og underholdning, telekommunikation, teknologi og elektronik, transport og forsyningsvirksomhed.


Vi rådgiver bl.a. om:



Fusionsanmeldelser til konkurrencemyndighederne


Konkurrenceretlig due diligence, herunder af leverandør-/samarbejdskontrakter


Screening af direkte udenlandsk investering (FDI)


FSR-anmeldelser til EU-Kommissionen


Spørgsmål relateret til forbuddet mod konkurrencebegrænsende aftaler


Udarbejdelse af kontrakter med blandt andet distributører og agenter


Overvejelser om strukturering af samarbejdsaftaler


Udarbejdelse af compliance-programmer


Forbuddet mod misbrug af dominerende stilling, herunder rådgivning om prissætning og rabatter


Myndigheders kontrolundersøgelser (dawn raids)


Gør karriere på globalt plan

Vi har et internationalt udsyn, og mange af vores sager er internationale. Du kommer derfor til at samarbejde med klienter og kolleger på tværs af kulturelle, juridiske og geografiske grænser. Herudover tilbyder vi udviklingsprogrammer og udstationeringer hos klienter og udenlandske advokatforbindelser. Det giver dig muligheden for at etablere vigtige kontakter.

Samarbejde med dygtige og sociale kolleger

Udover højtprofilerede sager og stærke internationale relationer tilbyder vi også et attraktivt og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige kolleger og en uformel, men altid ordentlig, omgangstone.

Fagligt blandt de bedste

Vi lægger vægt på, at vores rådgivning er på det højeste faglige og kommercielle niveau, og du har den største chance for succes i jobbet, hvis du kan sige ja til følgende:



Du er dygtig og ambitiøs og ønsker at videreudvikle dig gennem arbejde med komplekse og spændende sager.


Du har særlig interesse for og/eller erfaring med konkurrenceret.


Du har en bred forståelse for såvel juridiske som forretningsmæssige sammenhænge, og du er i stand til at sætte dig ind i komplekse sager og skabe overblik.


Du arbejder selvstændigt, grundigt og målrettet, men har samtidig lyst og evne til at arbejde i teams, herunder i tæt samarbejde med andre specialeafdelinger.


Du lægger vægt på klar kommunikation både i skrift og i tale på både dansk og engelsk.


Du er en pragmatisk og løsningsorienteret rådgiver og en god projektleder.


Om os

Hos Gorrissen Federspiel arbejder vi i fællesskab ud fra en vision om, at vi vil være et advokatfirma i en liga for sig. For os betyder det, at vi har de mest tilfredse klienter, som vælger os for vores dybe faglighed og vores ordentlighed. Det betyder også, at vi har de dygtigste og mest engagerede medarbejdere. Det er én af vores fornemmeste opgaver at tiltrække branchens bedste talenter og sikre optimale rammer for, at vores medarbejdere kan trives, udvikle sig og have et spændende og udfordrende arbejdsliv. Derfor er fleksibilitet, udvikling og balance centrale elementer i tilgangen til vores medarbejdere.


Læs mere om Gorrissen Federspiel som arbejdsplads på www.gorrissenfederspiel.com/karriere.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Partner Erik Molin eller Senior HR-konsulent Mette Thording på 33414141.


Alle, der har et talent, kan dygtiggøre sig hos Gorrissen Federspiel. Vi vurderer såvel nuværende som kommende medarbejdere på baggrund af deres kompetencer, og skeler ikke til social baggrund, kultur, køn, etnicitet, religion, alder, hudfarve eller seksualitet. Hos Gorrissen Federspiel opfodrer vi derfor til, at vores ansøgere ikke indsætter et billede i deres CV, da det hjælper os med at skabe en så effektiv og fair rekrutteringsproces som muligt. Vi har og ønsker en mangfoldig medarbejdersammensætning, hvorfor vi forpligter os til at skabe rammerne for en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces med lige muligheder for alle ansøgere.


Gorrissen Federspiel er et af Danmarks største advokatfirmaer. Vi beskæftiger mere end 650 medarbejdere, heraf 360 jurister, og vi tilbyder rådgivning inden for alle erhvervsrelaterede områder. Som firma lægger vi vægt på kvalitet, holdånd, ordentlighed, værdiskabelse og perspektiv. The extra mile har i mange år været et af vores slogans, og hos Gorrissen Federspiel gælder det både i forhold til klienter og kolleger - vi vil være ’In a league of our own’.

Butik

























Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.


Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00. 

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.

title: Kulttuurijohtaja
description:
Kulttuuri on Turulle merkittävä elinvoiman ja hyvinvoinnin lähde ja tärkeä osa kaupungin imagoa. Kulttuuri näkyy, kuuluu ja tuntuu kaikkialla ja on osa turkulaisten ja Turkuun tulevien elämää. Vuonna 2029 vietämme 800-vuotisjuhlaamme, jossa kulttuurilla on suuri merkitys.

Turku kehittää taiteen ja kulttuurin edellytyksiä laajassa yhteistyössä jatkuvasti uudistuen. Turussa on vahva museoiden, kuvataiteen ja musiikin kenttä sekä voimakas vapaan kentän toimijaverkosto. Turku on investoinut vahvasti kulttuurin sisältöihin ja uusiin upeisiin tiloihin. Ajassa elävä ja kehittyvä kirjastomme palvelee kansallisella huipputasolla kaikenikäisiä turkulaisia.

Kulttuurijohtaja johtaa kulttuurin palvelukokonaisuutta ja vastaa oman toimialueensa seudullisesta ja valtakunnallisesta yhteistyöstä sekä edunvalvonnasta. Kulttuurin palvelukokonaisuus vastaa kaupungin kulttuuri-, museo-, kirjasto-, orkesteri- ja yleisten kulttuuripalvelujen kehittämisestä ja järjestämisestä sekä yhteistyöstä vapaan taidekentän kanssa. Kulttuurijohtaja toimii kansliapäällikön suorassa alaisuudessa ja osana kaupungin johtoryhmää.

Haemme tehtävään henkilöä, jolla on vahva kokemus kulttuuri- ja taidekentästä. Tehtävän menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää lisäksi kunnan hallinnon ja päätöksentekomenettelyn ymmärrystä sekä kokemusta suurten kokonaisuuksien johtamisesta. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää lisäksi vahvoja neuvottelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä esiintymiskykyä. Lisäksi arvostamme hyvää kielitaitoa sekä kuuntelevaa ja kehittävää työotetta.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto.

Tehtävään valittavan henkilön on esitettävä todistus terveydentilaa koskevasta selvityksestä (KVhL 7 §). Lisäksi tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä voidaan tehdä henkilön suostumuksella henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014, lisätietoja: supo.fi) sekä pyytää todistus yksityisyyden suojasta työelämässä annetun lain 7 §:n mukaisesta huumausainetestistä. Tehtävään valinta edellyttää, että em. selvitysten perusteella hakija voidaan katsoa soveltuvaksi tehtävään.

Viran kokonaispalkka on 7 939,74 €/kk.

Työsuhde-etuina Turun kaupunki tarjoaa mm.:
- monipuolisia koulutuksia
- Fölin työmatkakortin edullisempiin bussimatkoihin
- Tyky-rannekkeen Turun kaupungin liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluihin

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Turun kaupunki suosii anonyymiä rekrytointia. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytointiprosessin ensimmäisessä vaiheessa työhakemuksen avoimiin kysymyksiin ei tule sisällyttää tietoja esim. iästä, äidinkielestä tai sukupuolesta. Vaikka osaa tiedoista taustatiedoissa kysytään, nämä tiedot eivät näy rekrytoivalle lähijohtajalle anonyymissä hakijaraportissa. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen.

title: Hospitalist Physican
description:
Overview

Ansible Government Solutions, LLC (Ansible) is currently recruiting multiple Hospitalists to support the Fargo VA Health Care System located at 2101 Elm Street N, Fargo, ND 58102. Schedule typically includes either 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM or 7:00 PM - 7:00 AM. If you accept employment with Ansible, you must also acknowledge that any assigned schedule is subject to change at the direction of either Ansible or its customers. Competitive full-time pay packages are available to qualified candidates.

Ansible is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Federal customers with solutions in many arenas. Our customers face wide-ranging challenges in the fields of health care, national security, and information technology. To address these challenges, we employ intelligent and committed staff who take care of our customers’ success as if it is their own.

Responsibilities
  • Admit and coordinate care for hospitalized medical patients.
  • Perform history and physical examinations upon admission.
  • Evaluate, diagnose, and treat hospitalized patients.
  • Order and interpret:
    • Laboratory tests
    • Diagnostic imaging
    • Electrocardiograms (EKGs)
  • Prescribe and manage medications.
  • Coordinate patient placement within the hospital.
  • Conduct end-of-life discussions and advance care planning.
  • Consult with specialty and subspecialty providers.
  • Manage discharge planning and ensure appropriate follow-up care.
  • Coordinate care with primary care providers.
  • Provide perioperative medical management.
  • Assess and stabilize patients with emergent conditions.
  • Participate in rapid response teams and code team activations
  • Abscess incision and drainage
  • Thoracentesis
  • Paracentesis
  • Lumbar puncture
  • Nasogastric tube insertion/reinsertion
  • Transurethral catheter placement
  • Removal of lines and tubes
  • Joint aspiration/injection (excluding ankle and hip)
  • Tennis elbow injections
  • Fecal occult blood testing
  • All ACLS procedures
  • Review all admissions recommended by NPs and PAs.
  • Participate in person-to-person handoffs for inpatient admissions.
  • Provide consultation and treatment recommendations to referring providers.
  • Initiate social work referrals for homeless veterans and patients without primary care providers.
  • Provide patient discharge education and follow-up instructions.
  • Ensure communication of test results in accordance with VA policy
Qualifications
  • MD or DO degree.
  • Board Certified or Board Eligible in Internal Medicine.
  • Active, full, and unrestricted license to practice medicine in any U.S. State, Territory, Commonwealth, or the District of Columbia
  • Active AHA BLS and ACLS
  • Must be able to pass a Federal background investigation.

All candidates must be able to:

  • Sit, stand, walk, lift, squat, bend, twist, and reach above shoulders during the work shift
  • Lift up to 50 lbs from floor to waist
  • Lift up to 20 lbs
  • Carry up to 40 lbs a reasonable distance
  • Push/pull with 30 lbs of force

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Assemblage Monteur (Elektrisch)
description:
In Weert bouwen en testen we hoogwaardige verticale vorm‑vul‑sluitmachines voor klanten wereldwijd. Als Assemblage Monteur (Elektrisch) sluit je de machines en randapparatuur elektrisch aan, stel je ze af en voer je testen uit zodat onze machines betrouwbaar de fabriek verlaten.


Je krijgt een afwisselende rol binnen de assemblagevloer waarbij je vanuit technische tekeningen, elektrische schema's en werkinstructies aan de slag gaat. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van productie en engineering om te zorgen dat elke machine aan onze kwaliteitseisen voldoet en klaar is voor transport en inbedrijfstelling.

  • Aansluiten van verpakkingsmachines, sub assemblages en inbouwen/aanleggen van randapparatuur volgens schema’s, tekeningen en werkinstructies.
  • Elektrisch afstellen, controleren en beproeven van machines en randapparatuur met test‑ en meetapparatuur.
  • Solderen, bedraden en uitvoeren van functionele controles en kwaliteitschecks.
  • Waar nodig opsporen en verhelpen van storingen bij klanten en assisteren bij inbedrijfstelling (max. 10% van je arbeidstijd).
  • Meedenken met engineering en productie om assemblageprocessen en klantoplossingen te verbeteren.

Je bent een vakman, of vakvrouw, die technisch inzicht combineert met nauwkeurigheid en zelfstandigheid. Je voelt je prettig in een moderne montageomgeving, pakt verantwoordelijkheden en draagt actief bij aan verbeteringen.

  • Afgeronde MBO‑opleiding in een technische richting of gelijkwaardige ervaring.
  • Je leest elektroschema’s vlot en hebt bij voorkeur al ervaring als elektrisch monteur of assemblagemonteur.
  • Nauwkeurig, handvaardig en praktisch ingesteld; je werkt zelfstandig en bent een echte teamspeler.
  • Fulltime beschikbaar met de mogelijkheid om je werktijden flexibel in te delen.
  • Goede beheersing van Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie met een technische focus en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling. Naast een stabiele werkomgeving bieden we jou als Assemblage Monteur (Elektrisch) aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en doorgroeimogelijkheden.

  • Een uitdagende, stabiele baan bij een internationale high‑tech organisatie.
  • Een salaris tussen de € 3.474,- en € 4.475,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring.
  • Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, met onder andere: 27 vrije dagen en 13 ADV dagen (deels flexibel in te vullen), flexibele werktijden, korting op je fitnessabonnement, fietsplan en een winstdelingsregeling.
  • Een super fijne, collegiale werksfeer met enthousiaste en professionele collega’s.
  • Een flinke dosis verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol.
  • Een heerlijke kantine on-site in Weert in een onlangs gerenoveerd pand.

Enthousiast geworden? Klik op de 'Ik heb interesse' button! Heb je nog vragen? Stuur een e-mail naar Birgit.sadiki@syntegon.com. Ik help je graag verder!

title: Sr. Work Pack Engineer - Mechanical
description:
The Sr. Work Pack Engineer will support one of our coal-fired power plant projects in Mariveles, Bataan. The role is responsible for coordinating and executing Mechanical Inspection activities, ensuring that all work is planned and delivered in accordance with Wood's standards and client expectations. The project encompasses comprehensive maintenance services and project execution support, contributing to the facility's safe, reliable, and efficient operation.
  • Prepare mechanical maintenance inspection works considering materials, manpower resources, equipment and tools.
  • Prepare works in line with Wood and client’s procedures and HSSE quidelines.
  • Prepare works considering cost efficient but quality resources.
  • Carry out field visit and survey to establish the detailed scope of work.
  • Coordinate with technical authorities, buyers, vendors and relevant office & site personnel during the process of work preparation.
  • Inspect delivered materials at the supply base prior to sending to the sites.
  • Prepare work schedules.
  • Raise defects notification as needed and extension of work orders.
  • Conduct IPOP (Implementation Planning on Paper) and JHA (Job Hazard Analysis).
  • Prepare work orders for IAP nomination and comply to all nominations criteria.
  • Witness equipment testing onshore.
  • Promote positive HSSE culture at the workplace and ensure consistent raising of Safety Observation Cards.
  • Support and contribute to Wood values, programs and initiatives at the workplace like safety, continuous improvement and MCFC – Maintenance & Construction Feedback Card.
  • Support Wood’s initiative for cost saving and help sustain a cost-effective maintenance work preparation strategy.
  • Support and contribute to Wood in achieving overall KPIs set by client.
  • Support resources optimization.
  • Promote respect within colleagues, client and sub-contractors.
  • Support implementation and HSSE during turnarounds and production holds.
  • Provide quality handover or report.
  • Minimum 10 years' experience in engineering design, site engineering, or brownfield project support in power generation or heavy industrial facilities
  • Experience assisting in the preparation of Statements of Work, project definition packages, and engineering work packs
  • Background in field verification activities, site surveys, and as-built drawing reconciliation
  • Capability to prepare engineering technical specifications, data sheets, and supporting calculations under the supervision of senior engineers
  • Familiarity with coal-fired power plant systems in their discipline area is highly desirable
  • Experience in drafting, maintaining, and updating engineering

title: Centralized Portfolio Analytics - Sr Associate
description:
Organization Description

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We’re proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

Risk Management helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risks in a constantly changing environment. The work covers areas such as determining credit worthiness, understanding regulatory changes and evaluating country-specific risk. Risk Management provides independent oversight and maintains an effective control environment.

Employer Description

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America’s households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Job Description

Bring your experience, skills, and passion to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Credit Risk Management, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Credit Risk Management is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class.


As an Associate within the Credit Risk Management team, you will play a pivotal role in driving analytics to monitor and diagnose portfolio performance, identify emerging risks and profitability headwinds, and recommend any account management actions. The role will help operationalize trigger-based insights for downstream strategy execution—enabling broader use cases such as customized customer messaging—in close partnership with stakeholders across Risk, Product, Technology, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance. The individual will provide disciplined second-line challenge to support early identification and of portfolio risks and unprofitable segments.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead comprehensive analytics to measure and challenge key business initiatives and be able to independently generate solutions

  • Provide thought leadership and lead initiatives end to end, including defining problem statements, identifying risks and opportunities, securing stakeholder buy-in, and bringing ideas to life

  • Work independently and in teams to identify and assess performance trends, utilizing both statistical and data mining tools and quantitative methodologies

  • Conduct root cause analysis to provide clear, actionable recommendations to senior leadership and various stakeholders

  • Prepare and present detailed risk monitoring reports to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of findings

  • Support the development and maintenance of the company’s risk management framework, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements

  • Monitor internal and external behavioral data along with public information on industry trends, regulatory changes, and credit risk management best practices to continuously improve risk management processes

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Ability to logically structure and execute analyses using strong analytic, interpretive and problem solving skills
  • Ability to translate complex analysis into practical solutions and create concise presentations with sound business conclusions
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative discipline (ex: Finance, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, among others) or 3+ years of analytics experience
  • Possess the drive to succeed, be results oriented, have high attention to detail, and independently make decisions
  • Previous experience with either SAS, SQL, Python, or Tableau analytic tools (other coding languages would be considered)

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Knowledge of consumer lending business

title: Ventilationstekniker til indregulering og installation i Viby J
description:
Er du ventilationstekniker og vil du have firmabil og ordentlig løn?

Vi mangler en erfaren tekniker til indregulering og installation i Viby J.

Du lander i et større ventilationsmiljø, hvor opgaverne ligger i både bolig- og erhvervsbyggeri. Projekterne kan spænde fra kontorbygninger og butikscentre til varehuse, fabrikker og byggeri med høje krav til indeklima. Arbejdet foregår med makker eller i hold, så du står ikke alene med de større afleveringer.

Det her er for dig, der kan lide ventilation som fag og ikke bare vil skrue dele sammen. Indreguleringen kræver ro, præcision og en tekniker der gider få anlægget til at spille. Du får firmabil, og kørekort er nødvendigt fordi du skal kunne køre ud til pladserne.

Det får du

Løn: 220-260 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Viby J og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 260 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Ventilation, indregulering og installation

Din hverdag

Dagen drejer sig om installation og indregulering af ventilationsanlæg. Du følger opgaven fra det praktiske montagearbejde til anlægget skal måles ind, justeres og afleveres ordentligt. Rækkefølgen aftaler du på pladsen med makkeren eller holdet, så næste fag kan komme til.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Indregulerer ventilationsanlæg på byggepladsen
  • Installerer ventilationsanlæg i bolig- og erhvervsbyggeri
  • Måler og justerer luftmængder
  • Sikrer at anlægget er klar til aflevering
  • Samarbejder med makker og andre fag på pladsen

Hvis noget ikke stemmer i anlægget, siger du til i tide og får det løst, før det bliver dyrt for alle andre. Det er den slags tekniker, der gør en forskel på en ventilationsopgave.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har mindst 4 års erfaring som ventilationstekniker
  • Kan arbejde med indregulering og installation
  • Trives med at arbejde med makker eller i hold
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet på større ventilationsprojekter før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar for dit håndværk og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 2 uger.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en ventilationstekniker mere i Viby J, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Sr. Applied Scientist – AI Velocity Team, Applied AI Acceleration Solutions Architecture
description:
Are you passionate about using data science to transform how businesses understand and optimize customer interactions at scale? Do you want to build the models and analytics that power the next generation of AI-driven customer experiences while working directly with customers to accelerate production deployments?

As a Senior Applied Scientist within the Applied AI Solutions team, you will collaborate across AI Velocity Teams (AIVT), enabling multiple customer engagements simultaneously. You will lead data science initiatives that span the full lifecycle — from identifying high-value business problems and formulating hypotheses, through rigorous experimentation and modeling, to deploying production-grade solutions that serve thousands of customers. You will bring deep expertise in statistical inference, machine learning, and experimental design to drive measurable impact across Amazon Connect's analytics products and broader Connect AI initiatives.

A critical dimension of this role is working directly with customers during production pilots to accelerate time-to-value. You will partner with Applied AI Solutions Architects and Customer Success Specialists to design, build, and deploy AI solutions in customer environments during fixed deployment cycles. You will enable field teams with data-driven insights, reusable analytical assets, ROI tools, and scalable tooling that accelerate customer engagements and solution delivery. Your work will directly influence customer decisions to adopt Connect Customer AI by quantifying business outcomes and demonstrating measurable value.

You will operate with significant autonomy, owning the scientific direction of your projects while collaborating with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, technical, and business stakeholders. You will be expected to identify the right methodology for each problem — whether that's a classical statistical approach, a modern deep learning technique, or a novel combination — and communicate your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. This role spans Connect AI initiatives including conversational analytics and agentic AI capabilities, offering the opportunity to pioneer data science approaches that scale intelligent analytics worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and deploy statistical models and machine learning pipelines to drive product improvements and business decisions
- Work directly with customers during production pilots to design, build, and deploy AI solutions that demonstrate measurable business value
- Design and execute A/B experiments and causal inference analyses to measure the impact of new features and model changes on customer outcomes
- Build ROI models and business case tools that quantify the value of Connect Customer AI for existing customers transitioning from Connect Customer Basic
- Develop and maintain forecasting systems for demand prediction, capacity planning, and workforce optimization
- Develop and apply NLP and generative AI techniques to extract insights from structured and unstructured data at scale
- Partner with applied scientists and software engineers to productionize models, ensuring reliability, monitoring, and operational excellence
- Enable AI Velocity teams with reusable analytical assets, diagnostic notebooks, and scalable tooling that accelerate customer engagements
- Build benchmarking studies and optimization frameworks that demonstrate value across customer cohorts
- Own success metrics and create mechanisms to measure model performance, adoption, and business impact
- Communicate findings and technical trade-offs to senior leadership and customer executives through written documents (6-pagers, science reviews) and presentations
- Operate as a shared resource across 2-3 AIVT teams simultaneously, providing data science expertise across multiple customer engagements

A day in the life
- Start the morning on a call with the AI Velocity Teams preparing for a strategic customer engagement — reviewing the analytical assets and dashboards you've built, walking through how to interpret model outputs, and tailoring recommendations to the customer's contact center environment
- Join a customer working session where you're deploying a production pilot — analyzing their historical contact data, building demand forecasting models, and demonstrating how AI optimizations will reduce their cost per serviced contact while improving customer experience metrics
- Dive into a deep analysis triggered by AIVT field feedback — a large enterprise customer is seeing unexpected patterns in their contact data, and you're pulling together multi-source data to isolate root cause and build a reusable diagnostic notebook the AIVT team can leverage for similar cases
- Participate in a Conversational Analtyics science review, presenting your A/B test results on a new sentiment classification approach and discussing trade-offs between model accuracy and inference latency with the engineering team
- Spend the afternoon building a reusable ROI calculator that field teams can use across customer engagements — packaging your economic models with configurable parameters so teams can quickly quantify the value of Connect Customer AI for different customer profiles and usage patterns
- Collaborate with AI Architects and Customer Success Specialists across your three active AIVT engagements, providing data science guidance on model selection, evaluation frameworks, and success metrics for each customer's unique use cases
- Wrap up by reviewing a design document for an agentic AI feature that will use conversation analytics to automatically surface coaching recommendations for contact center supervisors, providing feedback on the evaluation methodology and success metrics

About the team
Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Senior projektledare inom elmarknad
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i ett omfattande utvecklingsarbete inom energisektorn där nya roller och processer på elmarknaden ska omsättas till fungerande lösningar i praktiken. Uppdraget är kopplat till införandet av en fristående BSP-roll i Sverige och spänner över systemstöd, marknadsdesign, regelverk, onboardingprocesser samt juridiska och regulatoriska förutsättningar.

Du driver ett redan påbörjat projekt framåt i nära dialog med marknadsaktörer, verksamhet, IT och andra stödfunktioner. Här får du arbeta i en komplex och samhällsviktig miljö där ditt ledarskap blir avgörande för att få ihop helheten och skapa framdrift. Det här är en roll för dig som vill påverka hur framtidens balansmarknad fungerar i praktiken.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du ansvarar för projektets tid, kostnad och resultat.
  • Du driver projektet enligt projektmodellen PPS genom projektets olika faser.
  • Du leder projektteam i arbetet med att utveckla och införa nödvändiga arbetsprocesser och rutiner.
  • Du tar fram och inför processer och rutiner i linjeverksamheten samt säkerställer att lösningar överlämnas till förvaltning.
  • Du koordinerar verksamhetskrav mellan verksamhet, IT och andra stödfunktioner.
  • Du säkerställer att organisationen är redo internt och externt när det gäller marknadsdesign och införande av nya arbetssätt.
  • Du planerar, följer upp och rapporterar projektets progress till styrgrupp.
  • Du hanterar risker enligt etablerade rutiner och driver förändringsledning inom projektet.
  • Du bidrar även vid behov i andra utvecklings- och implementeringsprojekt inom samma verksamhetsområde.
Krav
  • Minst 10 års arbetslivserfarenhet som projektledare, förvärvad under de senaste femton 15 åren. Erfarenheten ska ha innefattat ansvar för kommunikation med beställare, kravställare, leverantörer, verksamhetspersoner och intressenter.
  • Minst 10 års praktisk arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta enligt projektstyrningsmodeller såsom PPS, PROPS, PEJL eller likvärdig metodik, förvärvad under de senaste 20 åren.
  • Minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet, förvärvad under de senaste 5 åren, av att leda elmarknadsrelaterade projekt eller uppdrag.
  • Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet som projektledare, förvärvad under de senaste 10 åren, av att verkställa verksamhetskrav till IT-stöd i en organisation.
  • Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet, förvärvad under de senaste 10 åren, från arbete inom samhällskritisk infrastruktur, exempelvis energi, vatten, telekommunikation eller järnväg.
  • Giltig certifiering inom minst ett av följande områden: IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2, ITIL, XLPM, PM3, SAFe eller annan motsvarande professionell certifiering inom projekt- eller programledning.
  • God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
  • Möjlighet att genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning (kräver svenskt medborgarskap, dubbla medborgarskap medges ej)
Meriterande
  • Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha arbetat för en statlig myndighet med verksamhetsutvecklingsprojekt de senaste 10 åren.
  • Minst 1 års erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med att implementera regelverk kopplat till elmarknaden, förvärvad de senaste 5 åren.
  • Minst 3 års erfarenhet, de senaste 5 åren, av arbete i minst ett standardiserat projektverktyg, till exempel Antura Projects.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Chief Technical Specialist [Open to internal and external applicants]
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP's policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels offers a spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting-edge global perspectives and advocacy. UNDP invests in the Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in UNDP's Strategic Plan.

UNDP is an accredited Implementing Agency for the Global Environment Facility (GEF) Trust Fund and the family of funds such as the Least Developed Countries Fund (LDCF), the Special Climate Change Fund (SCCF), and the Global Biodiversity Framework Fund (GBBF). As an Implementing Agency, UNDP offers countries highly specialized services for eligibility assessment, project formulation and due diligence, co-financing mobilization, implementation oversight, results management and evaluation, and knowledge management.

Papua New Guinea (PNG) harbors exceptional marine biodiversity of global significance, including the highest marine biodiversity richness of the Pacific Ocean. The country's 3.12 million km² Exclusive Economic Zone encompasses 13,840 km² of coral reefs, 4,200 km² of mangrove forests and extensive seagrass beds, supporting more than 500 species of stony coral and 1,635 reef-associated fish species. Despite this extraordinary natural endowment, PNG's coastal and marine ecosystems face severe and accelerating threats from illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing, destructive fishing practices, coastal pollution, climate-induced coral bleaching, habitat conversion, and governance failures.

This project 'Accelerating PNG's Sustainable Blue Economy through Strengthened Governance and Investment in Marine Areas' (PIMS 9532, GEF ID 11262) is a child project of the GEF-8 Blue Green Islands (BGI) Integrated Program. With a total GEF grant of USD 16.76 million and co-financing of over USD 43.2 million, it represents a major GEF-funded marine conservation investment in PNG.

The project aims to strengthen the protection and sustainable use of coastal and marine ecosystems through four integrated components:

  1. Integrating Natural Capital Accounting (NCA) into national economic planning.
  2. Strengthening governance through Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) and Marine Spatial Planning (MSP).
  3. Demonstrating Nature-based Solutions (NbS) and innovative public-private-community partnerships.
  4. Ensuring robust Knowledge Management and learning, linking PNG to the global BGI platform.

Through these interventions, the project aims to place 3.9 million hectares of marine areas under improved management, restore 20,000 hectares of mangroves, move over-exploited fisheries toward sustainable levels, and avoid 19 million tonnes of CO₂e emissions, while directly benefiting 10,000 people, at least 50% of whom are women.

The project operates in three critical seascapes: the Autonomous Region of Bougainville (AROB), New Ireland Province (NIP), and Bootless Bay (National Capital District & Central Province), reflecting diverse ecological and governance contexts.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • The CTS will report primarily to the Assistant Resident Representative (ARR), Environment and Climate Change Portfolio, UNDP PNG Country Office and liaise with the UNDP Bangkok Regional Hub Regional Technical Advisor for Ecosystem and Biodiversity.
  • The CTS will work in close collaboration with the national project team (Project Manager/Coordinator, M&E Specialist, Gender-Safeguards Specialist, Communications Officer, Community Mobilizers and Technical Specialist ), as well as with other international advisors engaged under the project.
  • The CTS will maintain regular communication with the BGI IP Global Coordination Project team and the UNDP Planet Hub technical advisors at the Bangkok Regional Hub.
  • The CTS will be office-based in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea, with travel to the three target geographies (NCD, New Ireland Province and AROB) as required and approved by the UNDP Country Office.
  • The CTS will be given access to all relevant project documentation, databases and information systems necessary for the execution of tasks under this assignment.
  • The CTS will be provided with office space and standard equipment at the Project Office in CEPA and UNDP Country Office in Port Moresby.
  • Given the regional and international nature of the assignment, the CTS is expected to be reasonably flexible with availability across different time zones for coordination with the Bangkok Regional Hub and BGI-IP global project coordination teams.

The Chief Technical Specialist (CTS) will provide overall technical leadership, strategic guidance, and quality assurance for the project. The CTS is the project's principal international technical expert, responsible for ensuring that all interventions are of the highest standard and coherent across all outcomes and geographies. S/he will provide critical capacity building to the Project Manager, Project Management Unit (PMU), and the national Implementing Partner, the Conservation and Environment Protection Authority (CEPA) – to ensure that the project meets GEF, UNDP and Government of PNG requirements throughout its lifecycle.

Primary responsibilities include:

1) Strategic Technical Leadership and Quality Assurance - Lead technical oversight and ensure high-quality implementation aligned with international best practices.

  • Provide substantive technical leadership and oversight across all project outcomes, ensuring that the integrated approach to blue economy, MPA governance, NbS and NCA is coherent, evidence-based and aligned with international best practices.
  • Prepare and/or review all major technical documents, terms of reference, analytical reports, baseline assessments and knowledge products produced under the project.
  • Review and provide high-quality technical inputs on deliverables produced by consultants and sub-contractors, ensuring they meet UNDP, GEF and national government standards.
  • Ensure consistency and coherence of technical approaches across the three target geographies (NCD/Central Province, New Ireland Province and AROB), adapting approaches to local ecological and socioeconomic conditions while maintaining methodological consistency for results aggregation.
  • Provide technical guidance on ecosystem assessment, MPA management effectiveness, MSP framework design, mangrove/coral reef/seagrass conservation and restoration strategies, and NbS business model development.
  • Provide technical guidance on the design and implementation of natural capital accounting (NCA) exercises, including application of the UN SEEA Ecosystem Accounts framework to coastal and marine ecosystems.

2) Monitoring, Evaluation, and Adaptive Management - Guide project monitoring, risk management, reporting, and adaptive management processes.

  • Ensure that the indicators included in the project results framework are monitored annually in advance of GEF Project Implementation Reports (PIRs) submission deadlines and provide substantive technical inputs to the annual GEF PIRs.
  • Oversee and guide the implementation of the project M&E plan, including periodic appraisal of the project's theory of change and results framework with reference to actual project progress.
  • Oversee and guide the design of surveys, assessments and monitoring protocols commissioned for evaluating project results, including GEF Core Indicators and METT/OECM tracking tools.
  • Provide guidance to Technical Officers and Community Mobilizers for conducting field-level M&E activities, and carry out project site visits to appraise on-the-ground progress and validate written reports.
  • Manage and monitor project risks, identifying critical issues and proposing mitigation measures; update the project risk register in coordination with the Project Manager.
  • Guide and assist the Project Manager in adaptive management processes, including revisions to multi-year workplans as needed.
  • Guide and assist the Project Manager in preparing for, participating in, and responding to the mid-term review (MTR) and terminal evaluation (TE) of the project, including preparation of management responses.

3) Capacity Building and Institutional Strengthening - Strengthen capacities of the project team and partners through technical training and support.

  • Design and deliver on-the-job training for the Project Manager, PMU staff and CEPA counterparts on technical and programmatic aspects of the project, including marine biodiversity monitoring, MPA governance, MSP frameworks, GEF reporting requirements and UNDP programme management standards.
  • Build national capacity in NCA methods and application, ecosystem-based fisheries management, marine spatial planning and sustainable blue economy business models.
  • Provide strategic input to strengthen the capacity of national partners to sustain project results after the close of GEF funding, including supporting the development of financing mechanisms, institutional arrangements and policy frameworks.
  • Provide technical advocacy among key stakeholders at national and sub-national levels, including assisting government units and service providers in the design and implementation of project interventions.

4) Partnerships, Coordination, and Knowledge Management - Support coordination, partnerships, knowledge exchange, and participation in technical platforms.

  • Liaise with the BGI Integrated Program global coordination platform, GEF-funded projects active in PNG and the Pacific region, and complementary initiatives implemented by co-financing partners, promoting synergies and collaboration.
  • Participate in national, regional and international fora as appropriate, including technical working groups, GEF community of practice platforms and UN inter-agency coordination mechanisms.
  • Capture lessons learned during project implementation; coordinate with the Communications Officer to provide technical inputs to the development of knowledge products, including brochures, policy briefs, lessons-learned reports and case studies.
  • Provide technical inputs to the development and dissemination of outreach materials and ensure that knowledge management activities support scaling up of project results.
  • Participate in project board meetings, technical steering committees and other project governance mechanisms on an as-needed basis.

5) Resource Mobilization

  • Provide strategic guidance on resource mobilization and financing opportunities to support implementation and long-term sustainability of project interventions.
  • Support engagement with development partners, financial institutions, private sector actors and other investors to promote sustainable blue economy investments and partnerships.
  • Provide technical inputs to the development of concept notes, investment cases, funding proposals and blended finance opportunities linked to marine conservation, NbS and sustainable coastal livelihoods.
  • Facilitate coordination with relevant government agencies and partners to align project investments with national blue economy priorities and financing frameworks.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Competencies

Core competencies:

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

People Management:

UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site.

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies:

Business Direction & Strategy

  • Strategic Thinking: Develop effective strategies and prioritised plans in line with UNDP’s mission and objectives, based on the systemic analysis of challenges, opportunities and potential risks; link the general vision to reality on the ground to create tangible targeted solutions; learn from a variety of sources to anticipate and effectively respond to both current and future trends; demonstrate foresight.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact other parts of the system

Business Management

  • Project Management; Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goals.
  • Communications; Communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels.
  • Partnership Management; Build and maintain partnerships with wide networks of stakeholders, Governments, civil society and private sector partners, experts and others in line with UNDP strategy and policies

2030 Agenda: Planet

  • Nature; Ecosystems and Biodiversity

2030 Agenda: People

  • Gender; Gender and Environment

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

  • An advanced university degree (Master's degree) in Marine Biology, Ocean Governance, Natural Resource Management, Environmental Science, Ecology, or a closely related discipline is required, or
  • A first-level university degree (Bachelor's degree) in the above fields in combination with two additional years of relevant experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced degree

Experience:

  • Minimum of 7 years (with Master's degree) or 9 years (with Bachelor's degree) of progressively responsible experience in the following areas:

    Marine biodiversity conservation, Marian Protected Area (MPA) management, marine spatial planning and/or sustainable fisheries management, with demonstrated in-country experience in the Pacific Islands region and/or Papua New Guinea.

    Project advisory and backstopping support to GEF-funded or similar international development projects, including technical quality assurance, results-based management and PIR reporting.

    Stakeholder engagement and capacity building with government counterparts, civil society, indigenous and local communities, and private sector partners.

Required skills:

  • At least 5 years of demonstrable experience in an advisory or CTS role with a major international organization.
  • Proven Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc) and advanced knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages, experience in handling web-based management systems.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience developing or implementing projects with financing from the GEF Trust Fund (including GEF-8 or equivalent generation) or Green Climate Fund, particularly in the biodiversity focal area.
  • Experience with natural capital accounting (NCA) using the UN SEEA Ecosystem Accounts framework applied to coastal or marine ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience in the design and implementation of NbS and/or blue economy business models in the Pacific Islands or comparable island developing state contexts.
  • Prior experience working with or in Papua New Guinea or the Melanesian Pacific.
  • Experience with FPIC processes, IPLC engagement standards, UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (SES) and gender-responsive approaches in conservation programming.
  • Experience working with UNDP or similar international organizations is highly desirable; familiarity with UNDP POPP

Required Language(s)

  • Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Tok Pisin or other official PNG languages is an advantage.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

title: Datacentertekniker til Silkeborg
description:
Datacentertekniker – Silkeborg

Vil du arbejde med kritisk IT-infrastruktur i et moderne datacenter?

Vi søger en engageret og teknisk stærk Datacentertekniker til vores datacenter i Silkeborg. Du får en central rolle i den daglige drift, overvågning og udvikling af vores netværk, telekommunikation og lokale serverinfrastruktur.

Stillingen er ideel til dig, der trives med en kombination af hands-on teknisk arbejde, fejlfinding, drift og udvikling, og som motiveres af at sikre, at kritisk IT-infrastruktur altid fungerer stabilt og sikkert.

Din rolle

Du bliver en del af et IT-infrastrukturteam og får en bred kontaktflade til både lokale og globale IT-kolleger samt eksterne leverandører.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært være fordelt på:

  • 70 % netværk og telekommunikation
  • 20 % server- og hostinginfrastruktur
  • 10 % øvrig IT-infrastruktur

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Drift og administration af LAN, WLAN og WAN.
  • Drift og fejlfinding på Cisco-netværksinfrastruktur.
  • Administration og implementering af VLANs og netværkssegmentering.
  • Drift af telekommunikationsløsninger og datakabling.
  • Drift og vedligeholdelse af lokale on-premise servere.
  • Arbejde med virtualisering, herunder Hyper-V.
  • Proaktiv overvågning af netværk, kapacitet, performance og tilgængelighed.
  • Fejlfinding og håndtering af incidents og eskalationer.
  • Patching og sikkerhedsopdateringer af netværks- og hostingudstyr.
  • Arbejde med netværkssikkerhed og security policies, herunder Cisco og Palo Alto.
  • Samarbejde med leverandører inden for netværk, servere, telekommunikation og datakabling.
  • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af netværks- og serverdiagrammer samt teknisk dokumentation.
  • Bidrage til udarbejdelse af HLD, LLD og tekniske standarder.
  • Deltage i og drive lokale og globale IT-infrastrukturprojekter.
  • Koordinere den daglige drift med lokale IT-serviceleverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant IT-uddannelse med fokus på netværk, infrastruktur eller hosting. En bachelorgrad er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har den relevante praktiske erfaring eller er i gang med en tilsvarende uddannelse.

Vi forventer, at du har:

  • 2-3 års erfaring med IT-infrastruktur, netværk, telekommunikation eller et tilsvarende område.
  • God forståelse for netværks-, server- og datacenterhardware.
  • Praktisk erfaring med netværk, servere, telekommunikation og virtualisering.
  • Erfaring med Cisco LAN/WLAN/WAN.
  • Erfaring med VLAN og netværkssegmentering.
  • Kendskab til ITIL og IT Service Management. Erfaring med ServiceNow (SNOW) er en fordel.
  • Forståelse for netværkssikkerhed og security policies.
  • Gerne erfaring med Palo Alto firewalls.
  • Evnen til at læse, udarbejde og vedligeholde tekniske diagrammer og dokumentation.
  • Gode analytiske evner og en naturlig tilgang til fejlfinding og problemløsning.
  • Gode samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.
  • Evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar, samtidig med at du fungerer godt i et team.

CCNA-certificering er en fordel, ligesom certificeringer inden for servere, netværk eller firewalls vil være et plus.

Du behersker dansk og engelsk på et professionelt niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

En hverdag tæt på teknologien

Som datacentertekniker får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt på den infrastruktur, der får IT-miljøet til at fungere. Du vil både have opgaver foran skærmen og ude i datacentret, hvor du blandt andet kan arbejde med netværksudstyr, servere, racks og fysisk kabling.

Du får en rolle, hvor stabil drift, sikkerhed og oppetid er i centrum, men hvor der samtidig er mulighed for at påvirke, forbedre og udvikle infrastrukturen.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Hvis du brænder for netværk og IT-infrastruktur, kan lide at løse tekniske udfordringer og gerne vil arbejde i et professionelt datacentermiljø i Silkeborg, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV – vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?




Bliv vores nye laborant i Household Care - Application Research (HHC-AR)
I denne rolle får du mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af fremtidens enzymløsninger til maskinopvask, så millioner af forbrugere verden over kan opnå skinnende rent service med et lavere forbrug af energi, vand og kemikalier.



Du bliver en del af en af vores forskningsafdelinger i Bagsværd, hvor kemikere og laboranter arbejder tæt sammen om at udvikle næste generations løsninger til maskinopvask. Her deltager du i planlægning og udførelse af laboratorieforsøg og anvender statistiske metoder og digitale værktøjer til at analysere komplekse data og omsætte resultaterne til klare konklusioner i tæt samarbejde med kemikere og andre laboranter.



Du får indsigt i enzymer og kemien bag moderne opvaskemidler til maskinopvask, som gør det muligt at fjerne selv vanskelige madrester og belægninger på en mere bæredygtig måde. Samtidig bliver du en del af et innovativt, internationalt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med varierede arbejdsopgaver og gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling. For den rette kandidat er dette en unik mulighed for at arbejde me



Rollen & dit bidrag
Som laborant i Household Care - Application Research vil du blandt andet:


Planlægge og udføre laboratorieforsøg inden for maskinopvask.



Bidrage til udviklingen af nye enzymløsninger til opvaskemidler.



Analysere forsøgsdata ved hjælp af statistiske metoder og digitale værktøjer.



Håndtere og strukturere større datasæt samt omsætte resultater til klare konklusioner.



Samarbejde tæt med kemikere og laboratoriekolleger om forsknings- og udviklingsprojekter.



Bidrage til løbende forbedringer af arbejdsmetoder, datahåndtering og digitalisering.




Hvad der skal til for, at du får succes i denne rolle
Vi forestiller os, at du:


Er uddannet laborant.



Har erfaring med anvendt forskning, udvikling af nye komplekse løsninger eller rengørings- og opvasketeknologi.



Har erfaring med statistisk databehandling, håndtering af store datasæt og digitale værktøjer.



Har interesse for at bidrage til yderligere brug af digitalisering og datahåndtering.



Kommunikerer mundtligt og skriftligt på engelsk.



Arbejder struktureret og har fokus på kvalitet og dokumentation.




Andre færdigheder og interesser, som vi værdsætter
Det vil være en fordel, hvis du:


Har erfaring med JMP.



Er en stærk teamplayer, der samtidig kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.



Er proaktiv, nysgerrig og initiativrig.



Motiveres af at arbejde i et internationalt forskningsmiljø.



Har interesse for bæredygtige løsninger og teknologisk innovation.




Det, vi kan tilbyde dig
Hos Novonesis får du mulighed for at:


Arbejde med forskning og udvikling, der gør en reel forskel for mennesker og miljø.



Blive en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt team.



Udvikle dine tekniske og personlige kompetencer gennem spændende projekter og samarbejder.



Arbejde i et internationalt miljø med kolleger fra forskellige faglige baggrunde.



Bidrage til udviklingen af innovative biosolutions til globale markeder.




Arbejdsforhold
Stillingen er placeret i Bagsværd.
Du bliver en del af et laboratoriemiljø med tæt tværfagligt samarbejde mellem kemikere og laboranter. Arbejdet udføres primært i laboratoriet og omfatter både praktisk forsøgsarbejde, dataanalyse og dokumentation.



Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026. 

Kontaktoplysninger: Senior Department Manager Klaus Gori, E-mail: Klsg@novonesis.com





Vores formål viser vejen

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

title: Laboratory Technician, Protein Engineering, Måløv, Denmark
description:
Position 

             
                Laboratory Technician, Protein Engineering, Måløv, Denmark
             
            
                
 
                     
                        
    
        
    
    
    
    
    
        
 
             
             
             
             
             
         
    


        
    


                     
                 

            
            
             Job description 
            
 
  Job description  
 Location 
 
 Måløv, Denmark 
 
 Job category 
 
 Research 
 
    Apply now       
 
 
 
     

 Are you passionate about protein expression and motivated by the opportunity to contribute to the discovery of future biotherapeutic medicines? Join our Protein Engineering team in Måløv and play a key role in advancing innovative protein-based therapies that can make a meaningful difference for people living with serious chronic diseases. Built following the latest Novo Nordisk job advert structure and salary guidance. 

   

 Your New Role 

 As a Laboratory Technician within Protein Engineering, you will contribute to the discovery and development of recombinant protein therapeutics by supporting core laboratory activities across protein expression workflows. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a highly collaborative research environment where scientific excellence, innovation, and teamwork drive progress. 

 In this role, you will: 
 
 Cultivate mammalian suspension cell lines used for recombinant protein production and optimisation. 

 Perform transient protein expression activities, including DNA preparation, transfection processes, and protein harvesting. 

 Analyse protein samples using a variety of laboratory techniques, including SDS-PAGE and Bio-Layer Interferometry. 

 Support the efficient execution and continuous improvement of protein expression workflows, ensuring high-quality and reproducible results. 

 Collaborate closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians while maintaining accurate documentation through electronic laboratory notebooks and other digital systems. 
 
 You will be part of a dynamic scientific environment where your technical expertise and attention to detail will directly support the advancement of Novo Nordisk’s early research portfolio. 

   

 Your New Department 

 You will join Protein Engineering, a department within Protein Research, where we focus on discovering and engineering recombinant biotherapeutics and enabling protein technologies across Novo Nordisk’s research portfolio. As part of Protein and Peptide Research within Therapeutics Discovery, we combine diverse scientific expertise to advance innovative protein- and peptide-based therapies. Our teams work across disciplines, united by a shared commitment to scientific excellence, innovation, and the ambition to create life-changing treatments for patients around the world. 

   

 Your Skills and Qualifications 

 To thrive in this position, we expect that you bring a strong technical foundation, a passion for laboratory work, and a collaborative mindset. 

 We imagine that you: 
 
 Hold a Laboratory Technician qualification or an equivalent scientific education. 

 Have practical experience working with mammalian suspension cell culture, transient protein expression, and molecular biology techniques. 

 Are familiar with automated liquid handling systems, ideally including BIOMEK platforms.

 Beyond your technical capabilities, you are a proactive and dependable team player who takes pride in delivering high-quality work. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job - you're becoming part of a story that spans generations. 

   

 What we offer 

 At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. 

   

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes - we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare.
