title: Organization AI Research Program Manager, DeepMind (Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
This role is open to DeepMind employees as a secondment opportunity and will not impact your status as a full time employee. Your level and ladder will not change for the duration of the secondment.

Google Full Time Employees will need to secure pre-approve from their VP to apply for this role as your current team will not be able to backfill you for the duration of your bungee, and so will need to pre-agree to loan your headcount to DeepMind for the duration of the bungee. Google FTC employees, and those impacted do not need this approval.

As a Program Manager for Organizational AI Research, you will be the operational engine scaling our AI research capacity. In this 12-month assignment based in Mountain View or New York, you will build scalable research operations from the ground up while acting as a strategic partner to leadership. You will foster high-impact external partnerships with leading academic institutions and internal partners like Google.org, while seamlessly bridging the gap between cross-functional partners, such as research, engineering, and legal teams. Your work will directly impact how we prioritize research, manage inbound collaborations, and build the technical workflows that enable our researchers to thrive. If you excel at bringing operational excellence to ambiguous spaces and possess the strategic and technical acumen to collaborate on cross-functional AI initiatives, this role is for you

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $132000 - $176000 (USD) + 0% bonus target

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Design operational frameworks, managing researcher onboarding logistics, external partner access, legal contracts, playbooks for recurring academic programs, and inbound collaboration triage.
  • Act as a thought partner by establishing business cases and triage processes, defining project success metrics, and building cross-functional teams for prioritized goals.
  • Drive operational relationships with key partners, formalize academic agreements with institutions, manage initiatives, and lead high-profile research conferences.
  • Architect internal and external insights-sharing strategies, maintain visibility of the lab’s mission via internal sites, and collaborate with PR on publication cadences and content calendars.
  • Translate complex research needs into technical requirements, partnering with technical program managers, engineering, and data teams to oversee tooling adoption, data migrations, quality standards, and application testing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in program management, product management, or related technical roles.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in program management, including managing cross-functional projects, tracking timelines, and coordinating stakeholders.
  • Experience managing complex, large-scale programs from initiation to delivery.
  • Experience leading cross-functional program management initiatives across multiple teams or organizations.

title: 도메인 ML 엔지니어 (시니어)
description:
About

“Design-to-Manufacturing AI Platform”

위즈코어는 ‘Design-to-Manufacturing AI Platform’을 비전으로 국내외 제조기업의 데이터 기반의 디지털화를 견인하고 있습니다.

제조업 고객의 디지털 혁신을 위한 가이드가 되어 솔루션을 제공하고, 데이터의 가치를 새롭게 창출하고 고객과 함께 성장할 수 있도록 인도하고자 합니다. 현재는 열정 가득한 120여 명의 구성원들이 서울 본사(가산), AI Factory Division(성수), 베트남(VINA)에서 근무하며 함께 성장하고 있습니다.


■ 채용절차
서류전형 – 1차 면접 – 2차 면접 및 레퍼런스 체크(필요 시) - 최종합격

■ 참고사항
입사 후 3개월은 시용계약 기간이 적용됩니다.
직원은 회사를, 회사는 직원을 알아가기 위한 시간입니다.
3개월 후 서로의 의사를 존중하여 정직원 계약이 진행됩니다.

Responsibilities

• 설비 센서 · 시계열 · 비전 데이터 분석 및 Feature Engineering
• 이상탐지 / 마모 예측 / RUL 등 도메인 특화 모델 개발 및 성능 개선
• 정비 이력 기반 라벨 정합성 검증 — onset 시점 보정, 예방정비 / 실고장 구분, 고장 코드 정규화
• 엣지 · 클라우드 파이프라인(MLflow · Triton · Ray) 활용한 모델 등록 · 서빙 적용
• 예측 근거 제시 체계 구축 — 시계열 attribution, SHAP, Grad-CAM 등 현장 판정 근거 설계
• Model Drift 감지 기준 및 운영 정책 정의, Retraining 루프 검증
• 재학습 검증 게이트 설계 — 골든 데이터셋 기반 성능 하한선, 자동 승격 차단 기준
• 제한된 GPU 자원 하의 실험 설계 — Kueue 큐 제출, 선점 대응 체크포인트, DataLoader 최적화

Requirements

• ML/MLOps 경력 7~15년
• PyTorch 기반 모델 개발 실무 경험 (CNN · Detection 계열 포함)
• 시계열 / 이상탐지 / Vision 중 1개 이상 도메인 적용 경험
• 노이즈 · 결측이 있는 실데이터 전처리 경험

Preferred

• 제조 · 설비 · 에너지 등 산업 현장 데이터 경험
• 생존분석, 준지도 · 자기지도 이상탐지 경험
• XAI 도구 실무 적용 경험
• 공유 GPU 클러스터 환경 학습 경험

Benefits

■ 직원들의 성장을 지원합니다
• 외부 유료 교육 및 세미나 지원
• 사내 도서관 운영, 읽고 싶은 도서 구입 적극 지원
• 우수사원 및 장기 근속자 포상제도
• 성과에 따른 인센티브제도

■ 편안한 환경에서 일할 수 있습니다
• 자율과 책임을 중요시하는 사내 문화
• 자유복장
• 자유로운 연차사용

• 유류비 / 통신비 지원
• 점심식사 지원(지정식당 이용)

■ 슬픈 일, 기쁜 일을 함께합니다

• 설/추석 명절 선물 지원
• 경조사 지원

title: Operations Administrator
description:
Operations Administrator

Location: Kelana Jaya, Petaling Jaya HQ, Malaysia

Support operational excellence at GAC

Are you a fresh graduate or early-career professional who is organized, detail-oriented and eager to build a career in the shipping and logistics industry? Do you enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, managing documentation and working with different stakeholders to ensure smooth operations? If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your operational and administrative skills in a dynamic environment, GAC Shipping Malaysia wants you on our team.

The Role

The role provides efficient operational and administrative support to the Operations team. If appointed, you will coordinate shipping documentation, vessel licensing processes, vendor registrations, courier arrangements and other operational support activities to help ensure smooth and timely business operations.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Process and coordinate Domestic Shipping License (DSL) applications for vessels.

  • Prepare and issue Bills of Lading (BLs) for Ship-to-Ship (STS) operations in coordination with the Operations team.

  • Print and distribute Bills of Lading and ensure their timely delivery.

  • Arrange courier services, including DHL, Lalamove and other logistics providers.

  • Monitor and track incoming and outgoing courier shipments and coordinate with the Operations team to ensure timely delivery.

  • Track incoming bunker samples and coordinate dispatch arrangements.

  • Manage supplier onboarding and vendor registration activities.

  • Handle vendor registration processes for clients and maintain accurate documentation records.

  • Manage hotel credit facilities, including renewals and maintenance of approved credit arrangements.

  • Provide administrative and operational support to branches across Malaysia.

  • Undertake additional operational responsibilities in line with business requirements and professional development.

Benefits

Benefits may include flexible working arrangements, medical coverage, health screenings, development support, employee engagement activities, performance-based bonus eligibility, selected wellness/dental benefits, referral incentives, mental wellness support, birthday leave and subsidized parking.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

  • Diploma / Advanced Diploma / Higher Diploma / Degree in Shipping, Maritime Studies, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.

  • Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

  • Prior internship or working experience in shipping, logistics, maritime operations or administrative support will be an advantage.

  • Good command of English and Bahasa Malaysia, both written and spoken.

Skills & Attributes

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

  • High attention to detail and ability to handle documentation accurately.

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

  • Basic knowledge of shipping, logistics, maritime operations or documentation processes would be an advantage.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving, coordination and follow-up skills.

  • Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities.

Why Join GAC?

As a GAC employee, you will:

  • Become part of the GAC global community.

  • Gain exposure to a regional and global business environment.

  • Benefit from structured training and development programmes.

  • Access a range of employee benefits that support your work and wellbeing.

If you think you have what it takes to become part of our team, we look forward to receiving your application.

GAC uses official recruitment channels and, in some cases, appointed third-party recruiters for specific positions. A genuine recruiter representing GAC will never ask candidates for payment to arrange or facilitate an interview. To apply for a role with GAC, please use our official careers site or verified LinkedIn listings.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer - Assistant Vice President

Location: Bangalore, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

As Data Engineer you will

  • Collaborate across a variety of teams to enable our Data Platform needs and design, implement, and maintain a secure and scalable infrastructure platform spanning across AWS/Azure and our Data Center
  • Own and ensure that internal and external SLA’s meet and exceed expectations, System centric KPIs are continuously monitored
  • Work on our data lake, data warehouse, and stream processing systems to create a unified query engine, multi-model databases, analytics extracts and reports, as well as dashboard and visualizations
  • Design and build systems for high availability, high throughput, data consistency, security, and end user privacy, defining our next generation of data analytics tooling
  • You will mentor other engineers and promote software engineering best practices across the organization designing systems with monitoring, auditing, reliability, and security at their core
  • Come up with solutions for scaling data systems for various business needs and collaborate in a dynamic and consultative environment
  • Knowledge of at least one of the public cloud platforms AWS, Azure, or GCP is required.
  • Knowledge of a programming language - Python, Scala, or SQL
  • Knowledge of end-to-end data analytics workflow
  • Hands-on professional experience in Databricks
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Bonus - Knowledge of Data Science and Machine Learning (e.g., build and deploy ML Models)

Core/Must Have Skills:

  • Knowledge of at least one of the public cloud platforms AWS or Azure is required.
  • Minimum 5+ years of Databricks experience using Azure Cloud
  • 5+ years of hands on expertise in Hadoop and Scala
  • Practical experience with Data Engineering and the accompanying DevOps & DataOps workflows
  • Knowledge of a programming language - Python, Scala, or SQL
  • Knowledge of end-to-end data analytics workflow
  • Hands-on professional experience in Databricks
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Bonus - Knowledge of Data Science and Machine Learning (e.g., build and deploy ML Models)
  • Strong end-to-end ownership and a good sense of urgency to enable proper self-prioritization

Good to Have Skills:

  • Certification on Azure/AWS
  • Certification on Hadoop, Scala and Databricks
  • Familiarity with SDLC and Agile methodologies

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: 포카마켓 국내사업부 공급 BD 운영 (1년 계약직)
description:
About

컬렉팅 혁신을 현실로 만들어온 여정
2021년 4월, 트위터에서 비효율적으로 이루어지던 거래 방식을 개선하며 시작된 포카마켓은,
팬덤 컬렉팅 문화 전체를 재정의하는 도전을 이어왔습니다.
먼저 ‘1:1 매칭 거래’ 시스템을 도입하여 국내 거래의 신뢰성을 높였고,
이어서 ‘인벤토리 입고 거래‘를 통해 200개국 이상의 글로벌 거래를 가능하게 만들었습니다.
2025년에는 C2C 플랫폼 ‘USED‘을 런칭하며 전 세계 어디서나 누구나 자유롭게 포토카드를 사고팔 수 있는 환경을 구축했습니다.
디지털 경험을 넘어 오프라인으로도 확장했습니다.
글로벌 관광객들이 직접 포토카드를 만나고 픽업할 수 있는 ‘포카스팟(PocaSpot)’을 통해
온·오프라인이 연결된 새로운 컬렉팅 경험을 제공하고 있습니다.
또한 2025년 2분기부터 본격화한 B2B 사업은 매 분기 150% 이상의 성장을 기록하며,
국내외 파트너사들과 함께 팬덤 비즈니스의 새로운 가능성을 열어가고 있습니다.

인플루디오가 일하는 방식
구성원의 성장이 곧 회사의 성장이라 믿어요.
우리는 서로의 성장을 위해 적극적으로 피드백하고, 필요한 지원은 아끼지 않아요.
수평적으로 소통하며 빠르게 실행해요.
직급보다 역할에 집중하며, 모든 팀원이 자유롭게 의견을 제시하고 빠르게 실행합니다.
팀플레이어로서 주도적으로 문제를 해결해요.
스스로 문제를 발견하고 해결하는 주도성을 중요하게 여기며, 개인이 아닌 팀플레이어로서 임팩트 있는 성과를 만들어갑니다.
전 세계 팬들의 컬렉팅 경험을 혁신하는 여정에 함께하고 싶다면,
지금 인플루디오에 합류하세요.


포지션 소개
포카마켓 국내사업부는 두 개의 미션을 동시에 움직입니다.
하나는 대표 K-pop 팬덤 플랫폼으로 도약하는 것입니다. 우리는 포토카드 거래를 넘어 팬들이 덕질하는 모든 경로를 포카마켓 안으로 담아내는 것을 목표로, 매달 새로운 아이템을 시장에 던지고 검증하는 실험적인 도전을 이어가고 있습니다. 정답이 없는 신규 시장을 빠르게 열어가는 조직입니다.
다른 하나는 팬들이 원하는 포토카드를 언제든 만날 수 있도록, 시장에 필요한 공급을 안정적으로 확보하는 것입니다. 원하는 카드는 늘 존재하지만 정작 시장에 나와 있지 않은 경우가 많고, 이 간극을 메우는 힘이 플랫폼 경쟁력의 핵심입니다.
이 포지션은 이 두 미션의 접점에서, "필요한 공급을 어떻게 만들어낼 것인가"라는 문제를 직접 풀어내는 자리입니다. 인기 아티스트의 물량이나 비정기적으로 발생하는 수요는 기존 방식만으로는 채워지지 않습니다. 시장을 조사해 공급 여력이 있는 셀러·파트너를 발굴하고, 이들을 포카마켓으로 전환시키는 다양한 프로그램을 직접 설계·운영해 새로운 공급을 만들어냅니다.
동시에 국내사업부가 새롭게 선보이는 서비스의 초기 운영(01)을 함께 맡아, 아이디어가 시장에서 검증되기까지의 실무를 폭넓게 담당합니다. 국내 앱을 이끄는 PO 조직과 가장 가까이에서 일하며, 현장에서 발견한 것이 곧바로 제품·사업 의사결정으로 연결되는 경험을 하게 됩니다.

Responsibilities

1. 공급 소싱 & 셀러 그로스 — 마켓플레이스의 공급(Supply)을 책임집니다 (핵심)
• 인기·탑티어 아티스트의 물량 확보를 위한 소싱 전략 수립 및 실행
• 발굴한 대상을 포카마켓 공급자로 전환시키는 성장 프로그램 기획·운영
• 데이터·시장 조사를 통해 공급 여력이 높은 셀러와 파트너를 발굴하고 우선순위를 선별
• 새로운 공급 채널 발굴 및 파트너 제휴 커뮤니케이션
2. 신규 서비스 인큐베이션 & 0 -＞1 오퍼레이션
•실험실 신규 아이템의 인큐베이팅 및 운영 (월 단위로 시장에 출시·검증)
•서비스 단계에 따라 담당 범위가 유연하게 확장·변동
3. 국내사업부 운영 전반 지원
•포카애즈(광고 상품), API 사업 등 사업부 운영 업무 지원
•운영 과정에서 발견한 비효율을 프로세스·정책 개선으로 연결
•이용자 인터뷰 등 리서치 지원 및 인사이트 도출

Requirements

• 정답이 정해지지 않은 문제를 스스로 정의하고, 길을 찾아 실행하는 주도성을 가진 분
• 여러 업무를 동시에 감당하면서도 계획적이고 체계적으로 우선순위를 관리해 완수하는 분
• 내부 팀·외부 파트너 등 다양한 이해관계자 사이에서 논리적으로 상황을 설명하고 유연하게 소통·협업할 수 있는 분
• 데이터와 현황을 바탕으로 대상을 선별하고 우선순위를 판단할 수 있는 분
• K-POP, 중고거래, 포토카드 시장에 관심과 이해가 있는 분

Preferred

• 셀러·파트너 발굴, 제휴, BD, 소싱 등 공급/파트너십 관련 경험이 있으신 분
• 신규 서비스나 실험을 0＞1로 세팅하고 운영해 본 경험이 있으신 분
• AI 도구를 업무에 능숙하게 활용해 생산성과 실행 속도를 높여본 경험이 있으신 분
• SNS, 중고거래 서비스 등을 통해 K-POP 포토카드를 직접 판매해 본 경험이 있으신 분
• 서비스 운영·CS 실무 경험이 있으신 분
• SQL 등 데이터를 직접 조회·분석해 본 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

1. 업무에 몰입하며 성장할 수 있게
•인플루디오 구성원 설문조사 결과 만족도 1위! ‘함께 일하는 동료’
•유연한 근무를 위해 반반차까지 활용 가능해요.
•효율적인 업무를 위한 기본적인 업무 장비(노트북, 모니터, 마우스, 키보드)를 지원해요.
•월별로 구성원 개인마다 각자 선호하는 AI툴을 적극 지원해요.
•업무 성장을 위해 교육비, 도서비를 지원해요.

2. 열심히 일한 만큼 보상과 리프레시는 확실하게
•리프레시를 위해 여름에는 5일 간의 워케이션 or 2일 휴가 둘 중 1가지를, 겨울에는 설연휴 쯤 1일 휴가를 제공해요.
•반기별 성과 인센티브 제공으로 성과에 대해 확실하게 보상해요.
•생일이 있는 달에는 반차로 조기 퇴근하고, 명절에도 두둑한 선물을 드려요.
•각자의 입맛을 반영한 맛있는 간식과 커피는 무한으로 제공해요.

3. 구성원이 자유로운 소통으로 성장에 집중할 수 있게
•직급 불문, “-님"으로 부르는 수평적인 소통 문화를 가지고 있어요.
•분기별 타운홀 미팅을 통해 회사의 성과와 방향성을 공유해요.
•분기에 2번 셋째주 수요일 스페셜 런치로 2시간 동안 구성원들과 여유롭고 맛있는 점심 시간을 가져요.
•팀 워크샵으로 팀을 단단하게 만들어요.
•반기별 전사 행사로 모든 구성원이 하나의 팀이 되는 시간을 가져요.
•포카마켓에서 함께 성장할 좋은 팀원들을 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Mental Health Clinician
description:
Who are we?

Sonder is an inclusive, not-for-profit organisation that has been providing better quality health and support services to the South Australian community since 1993. We support thousands of people each year to access services across seven key domains – Mental Health, Aboriginal Health, Alcohol and/or other Drugs, Employment, Community Health, Disability, and Homelessness

What benefits can we offer?

When you work with Sonder, you become part of the Sonder family and that provides you with a number of benefits such as:

  • Salary (excluding super) paid above award and reviewed annually

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Professional development allowance provided yearly

  • Generous salary packaging options - increase your take home pay by 6-12%

  • 17.5% Leave Loading

  • Modern and welcoming office spaces

  • Christmas Closure Bonus Leave (above annual leave entitlements)

  • Training opportunities

  • Meal & entertainment allowances

  • Paid parental leave, and much more!

Sonder are open to negotiating further benefits with the successful applicant to ensure an excellent working environment for you.

Salary Band: $92,286.48 - $105,570.40 + Super

Hours: 0.5-0.6 FTE

Contract: Fixed Term

Location: Kaurna Country, headspace Adelaide

More Information & Position Description via this link:

About the Role:

As a Mental Health Clinician, you’ll join a multidisciplinary youth mental health team supporting young people aged 12–25.

You’ll provide specialist triage, comprehensive psychosocial assessments, care planning and coordination, and evidence-based counselling and therapeutic interventions. You’ll work with young people individually and in groups, develop and deliver group programs, and monitor progress and outcomes.

You’ll collaborate with families, carers, professionals and community services to ensure young people receive the right support at the right time. You’ll also contribute to team meetings, professional consultation and clinical supervision.

Experience Requirements:

  • Demonstrated experience working within a fast-paced environment.

  • Provision of Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and/or other evidence based therapies with young people aged 12-25 who have a mental health disorder.

  • Relevant experience in the area of youth mental health.

  • Experience in delivery cognitive behaviour therapy, and other evidence based interventions for youth mental health difficulties

Qualification and Other Requirements:

  • Current or willing to obtain a Working with Children's Check (WWCC)

  • Current or willing to obtain a National Police Check (NPC)

  • Qualified in one of the following disciplines and membership to associated professional body; Psychology, Social Work, Occupational Therapy, or Mental Health Nursing.

How to apply:

Applicants are requested to send a cover letter and resume to Sonder via our careers portal on our website.

Feel free to send any enquiries to sondercareers@sonder.net.au

Advert Closing Date: 25 August 2026

At Sonder, we strive to respond to all applicants. However, due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may only be able to contact those shortlisted for the role. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Lead Fire & Safety
description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Job Purpose: To lead, strategize, and oversee fire safety policies and compliance across all group businesses, ensuring risk mitigation, regulatory adherence, and innovation in fire safety practices while fostering a culture of safety and resilience.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead- Fire Safety

Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:

Understand Adani’s overall strategy and plan for the Fire and Safety function, and provides inputs for strategy formulation, with the aim of supporting functional goals

Establish and implement a comprehensive fire safety strategy aligned with the group’s longterm vision and operational goals across all the Adani businesses.

Evaluate and integrate businessspecific fire safety requirements into groupwide frameworks, ensuring contextual relevance and scalability.

Drive periodic reviews with business heads to assess the alignment of fire safety measures with organizational priorities.

Risk Management and Mitigation:

Develop and operationalize a risk assessment framework for identifying, evaluating, and mitigating firerelated risks across diverse industries.

Establish protocols for continuous monitoring of fire risks, including highrisk industries such as manufacturing, logistics, and infrastructure.

Deploy risk control measures tailored to businessspecific needs, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.

Crisis and Incident Management:

Design, implement, and test groupwide fire emergency response and incident management plans to ensure preparedness for critical situations.

Lead crossfunctional crisis management teams during fire emergencies, ensuring a coordinated response and safeguarding lives and assets.

Oversee postincident investigations, ensuring comprehensive root cause analysis and implementation of corrective measures.

Compliance and Governance for All Group Businesses:

Ensure compliance with national and international fire safety regulations across all group businesses, maintaining a centralized compliance dashboard that can be shared with leadership team.

Audit fire safety measures and systems to identify gaps, ensure adherence, and recommend improvements across businesses tailored to thier secotral needs

Represent the group in regulatory forums, advocating for policies and standards that align with business needs.

Drive standardization of fire safety compliance across businesses, ensuring seamless reporting and transparency.

Research and Innovation:

Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies in fire prevention, detection, and suppression.

Lead pilots for innovative fire safety solutions, such as IoTenabled sensors or AIbased risk prediction.

Establish R&D initiatives to continuously enhance fire safety standards and practices.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Group Security Team

Plant , Site Security Heads

Adani Environment, Health, Safety and Governance (AESG) Team

IT and Digital Transformation Teams

Technocommercial Team

Key Stakeholders - External

Law Enforcement Agencies

Third Party Service Providers , Security Agencies

Emergency Response Services

Government Regulatory Bodies

Legal Consultant

Industry Asscociations and Security Forums

Vendor and Solution Providers

System Integrators

Audit Firms

Lead the planning, engineering, and design of Fire Alarm & Public Address (FAPA) systems, CCTV systems, and associated ELV infrastructure for high-rise and large-scale developments.

Ensure compliance with applicable National and International Fire Safety Codes & Standards, including NBC, NFPA, BS/EN, and other relevant regulations.

Develop and review fire safety solutions for:

  • High-rise buildings
  • Commercial developments
  • Mixed-use developments
  • Large floor area facilities
  • Smart and integrated buildings

Drive the integration of FAPA systems with various building systems to enhance fire safety management and emergency response effectiveness, including:

  • Building Management System (BMS)
  • HVAC & Smoke Management Systems
  • Elevator Recall & Fireman's Lift Operations
  • Access Control Systems
  • CCTV & Video Management Systems
  • Public Address & Voice Evacuation Systems
  • Emergency Lighting Systems
  • Central Monitoring Stations
  • Integrated Command & Control Centers

Establish and optimize centralized fire monitoring and control room operations, ensuring real-time monitoring of:

  • Fire alarms and events
  • System health status
  • Fault management
  • Device connectivity
  • Emergency response workflows

Review cause-and-effect matrices, system architecture, zoning philosophy, network design, and automation logic for integrated fire protection systems.

Provide technical leadership during design reviews, commissioning, testing, and handover stages.

Desired Candidate Profile

✔ Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Fire Engineering or equivalent)

✔ Minimum 12-14 years of proven experience in planning and designing FAPA and CCTV systems.

✔ Demonstrated experience in delivering fire safety technology solutions for high-rise buildings and large-area developments.

✔ Strong knowledge of:

  • NBC India
  • NFPA Standards
  • BS/EN Standards
  • Fire Engineering Principles
  • ELV Systems Design
  • Intelligent Building Systems

✔ Hands-on experience in integrating fire alarm systems with building automation and centralized monitoring platforms.

✔ Strong understanding of command center operations, remote monitoring, system analytics, and fire system health management.

✔ Excellent stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination skills.

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's, Master's Degree, Additional Degrees or Certification in Security Management preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 15 years in the corporate security field, fire , safety field

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Serie B - Fintech Company - Software Engineer

Department: Engineering

Location: Remote, Argentina, Uruguay

Compensation: $54K – $63K • 100usd in app benefits, Insurance Policy, 15 PTO

Employment Type: FullTime

This is a BNPL platform that pursues a mission to give Venezuelans back the opportunity to access credit.

Since our launch in 2022, we've been dedicated to promoting financial inclusion. Today we have more than 9 million active users, both consumers and merchants, and we've become a trusted brand in Venezuela, winning hearts and minds.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who owns systems, not just services. You'll design the backend that moves money for millions of people — which means correctness, resilience, and performance aren't nice-to-haves, they're the job.

You'll work close to Product and to other engineering teams, shaping how our platform scales as we grow. This is hands-on: you'll write code, make architectural calls, and be on the hook for how your services behave in production. The growth path here rewards engineers who go deep, raise the bar around them, and make the system better than they found it.

Overall you will...

  • Design and build robust, scalable backend services in Node.js and NestJS (Express).

  • Create and maintain high-performance RESTful APIs that other teams can build on with confidence.

  • Build for financial correctness — idempotency, reconciliation, retries, and well-defined failure states.

  • Model and manage relational data, primarily in PostgreSQL, with performance and integrity in mind.

  • Make architectural and system-design decisions, and own the trade-offs behind them.

  • Ensure optimal service performance and own production deployments end-to-end.

  • Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, pairing, and clear technical standards.

  • Mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, leaving the team stronger than you found it.

  • Move fast across multiple workstreams in a dynamic, high-growth startup environment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with solid depth in Node.js and NestJS (Express).

  • Proven experience designing and operating RESTful APIs in production.

  • Advanced knowledge of relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.

  • Experience writing unit and integration tests, and treating quality as part of delivery.

  • Strong grasp of design principles and architectural patterns.

  • Track record of shipping features independently and owning service performance in a fast-moving context.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and to mentor others effectively.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking, with genuine curiosity about new technology.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with cloud platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Knowledge of containers and orchestration, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with messaging and queuing systems like RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Pub/Sub.

  • Experience building in fintech, payments, or credit.

  • Spanish and English proficiency.

Interview Process

  • Silver screening Interview

  • Silver Technical Interview (System Design Interview)

  • Client Screening Interview

  • Client Technical interview

  • Client Behavioral Interview

title: Senior Manager, Agentic AI Engineer
description:

Officer – Agentic AI Engineer

On-premise

title: Cake Decorator
description:
As a member of the C&S Wholesale Grocers family of companies, SpartanNash is a food solutions company that delivers the ingredients for a better life. A distributor, wholesaler and retailer with a global supply chain network, SpartanNash distributes grocery and household goods, including fresh produce and the Our Family® portfolio of products, to locations in all 50 states.

Our braggingly happy team members — ranging from bakery managers to order selectors; from IT developers to vice presidents of finance; from HR Business Partners to export specialists — create braggingly happy customers spanning national accounts, independent and chain grocers, e-commerce retailers, U.S. military commissaries and exchanges, and the Company’s own brick-and-mortar grocery stores, pharmacies and fuel centers.

Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

Location:

1163 U.S. 31 North - Petoskey, Michigan 49770

Position Summary:

This role is responsible to decorate cakes and other products; assist in other bakery duties; maintain and operate the bakery department in an efficient manner within company policy; to ensure that the shift contributes to the financial best interest of the store. Complete all other duties as assigned in a timely manner.

  • Decorate cakes, cookies, and other items as determined by production schedule and customer requests.

  • Baking and frying duties as assigned.

  • Price, date, wrap and/or bag bakery products.

  • Follow all Food Safety and Cleaning Expectations

  • High school diploma or GED preferred

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. May be required to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds frequently, and up to 50 pounds occasionally. The associate is required to stand and walk for extended periods of time and may bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical retail store environment (varied temperatures) and is exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. Travel requirements vary by assignment.

As part of our People First culture, SpartanNash is proud to offer a robust and competitive Total Rewards benefits package.

SpartanNash is an Equal Opportunity Employer that invests in Associate development, recognizes and celebrates success, fosters two-way communication, and promotes a sense of belonging. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, including those with disabilities and Veterans.

We are not able to sponsor work visas for this position.

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
Principal Data Scientist, Vice President

Location: Bangalore, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Role Description

We are seeking a visionary and accomplished Data Scientist at the Vice President (VP) level to lead our enterprise AI/ML and generative AI initiatives. As a senior member of the organization, you will set the strategic direction for LLM and generative AI research, model development, and productionization, partnering with business units, platform engineering, and governance to deliver innovative, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

This role requires deep technical expertise in data science and AI, a proven track record in deploying AI at scale, and the ability to influence and guide the organization’s AI strategy and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the strategic roadmap for AI/ML and generative AI (LLM) adoption across the enterprise, aligning with business objectives.

  • Lead and oversee the design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management of advanced ML, NLP, and generative AI solutions for high-value, complex business problems.

  • Architect and operationalize large-scale LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and knowledge graph integration.

  • Establish and own enterprise-wide frameworks for model evaluation, benchmarking, error taxonomy, explainability, anomaly detection, and Responsible AI.

  • Guide cross-functional teams in productionizing AI models, integrating them with enterprise platforms, and ensuring robust MLOps/LLMOps practices.

  • Ensure compliance with model governance, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards, collaborating with risk and compliance teams.

  • Build and scale high-performing data science teams, mentoring and developing talent, and fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.

  • Partner with senior business leaders, product owners, engineering, architecture, and governance to translate strategy into actionable AI roadmaps.

  • Advocate for the adoption of reusable AI assets, experimentation frameworks, and best practices for model development, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Stay at the forefront of advancements in AI/ML, LLMs, agentic systems, and enterprise AI platforms, and drive pragmatic adoption of emerging capabilities.

  • Represent the organization in AI/ML vendor selection, external partnerships, and industry forums.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s, BTech, or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative discipline.

  • 12-17 years of overall experience in IT and 8+ years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, and advanced analytics, including 2+ years leading LLM/gen AI solution development and deployment at enterprise scale.

  • Proven success in designing, developing, and operationalizing AI/ML models for large organizations.

  • Deep technical proficiency in Python and major AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Keras, etc.).

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, NLP, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

  • Experience with structured and unstructured data, knowledge graphs, feature engineering, and graph-based reasoning.

  • Strong understanding of model validation, explainability, testing, monitoring, Responsible AI, and model risk management.

  • Expertise in Azure and/or AWS for AI/ML development, deployment, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience building and managing high-performing data science teams.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to executive leadership.

Good to have skills

  • Experience in financial services, risk, operations, investment analytics, or other regulated enterprise domains.

  • Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, SQL, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar engineering toolsets.

  • Exposure to agentic AI, workflow orchestration, and advanced enterprise AI platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, experiment tracking, and production monitoring.

  • Active participation in AI/ML industry forums, standards bodies, or academic collaborations.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Senior Specialist, QA Operations
description:
Sr. Specialist, QA Operations

Location: Indianapolis - RayzeBio - IN

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio: https://careers.bms.com/rayzebio/

Summary

The Senior Specialist, QA Operations will help support operations through quality oversight in a Radiopharmaceutical facility in Indianapolis, IN. The Senior QA Operations specialist will be providing oversight over shop floor activities in accordance with regulatory standards and RayzeBio procedures. The Senior QA Operations specialist will also be responsible for material and batch disposition activities. This position will utilize quality assurance knowledge in ensuring compliance in operations to support clinical development and GMP commercial operations in accordance with RayzeBio policies, standards, procedures and global current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP).

The Senior Specialist provides Quality support and oversight for operations and disposition activities at the Indianapolis facility, including review and approval of Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, documents, Batch Records, and Material and Lot Disposition. This person may also interact with the Qualified Person (QP) as needed to facilitate release of EU doses.

Job Responsibilities

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Build and maintain cross functional relationships to improve processes and resolve issues.
  • Provide quality oversight on manufacturing and validation activities.
  • Perform real time review of manufacturing records.
  • Perform periodic walkthroughs of manufacturing and Quality Control areas to ensure continued compliance with procedures.
  • Provide guidance on the handling of quality and shop floor activities.
  • Support Quality disposition process by ensuring that all required documents are accurately and properly completed and compiled against approved procedures and specifications, including all related deviations.
  • Assist with and provide QA approval of investigations, CAPAs, change controls, validation documentation, and other related GMP documentation.
  • Identify and report discrepancies from required work practices or procedures to management.
  • Uses AI tools to enhance individual productivity and quality of work

·Make sound decisions by exercising judgment within generally defined practices and policies and applies appropriate notification to management as appropriate.

·Participate as requested in the response team for audits and inspections by health authorities.

Education and Experience

  • BS/MS degree in science related field (including biology, biochemistry, chemistry, engineering, or related areas) is preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in quality assurance and/or compliance roles in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience working in a GMP aseptic manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Experience working with FDA or other regulatory authorities is preferred.
  • ork

Skills and Qualifications

·Expertise in GMP, Quality, material and product disposition

·Strong capability in authoring and critically reviewing investigations, interpreting results, and generating technical conclusions consistent with Quality risk management principles

·Detail-oriented with demonstrated applications in problem solving and decision-making abilities with moderate oversight from management

·Team player who can work independently to achieve objectives in a fast-paced environment

·Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

·Strong background and demonstrated effectiveness in quality assurance operation and compliance of clinical/commercial manufacturing is desired.

·Knowledge of US, EU and rest-of-world cGMP regulations and guidance.

·Knowledge and proven experience in FDA, EMA, or other regulatory authority.

·Well-practiced in exercising sound judgment in decision-making.

·Demonstrated prioritization and organization skills.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision.

This is a position that requires working in an environment with radioactive materials where protective clothing, gloves, and safety glasses are required.

Work Environment

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may require work outside of normal working hours or on weekends.

#LI-HYBRID

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Compensation Overview:

Indianapolis - RayzeBio - IN: $82,236 - $99,650

The starting compensation range(s) for this role are listed above for a full-time employee (FTE) basis. Additional incentive cash and stock opportunities (based on eligibility) may be available. The starting pay rate takes into account characteristics of the job, such as required skills, where the job is performed, the employee’s work schedule, job-related knowledge, and experience. Final, individual compensation will be decided based on demonstrated experience.

Eligibility for specific benefits listed on our careers site may vary based on the job and location. For more on benefits, please visit https://careers.bms.com/life-at-bms/.

Benefit offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans in effect at the time and may require enrollment. Our benefits include:

  • Health Coverage: Medical, pharmacy, dental, and vision care.

  • Wellbeing Support: Programs such as BMS Well-Being Account, BMS Living Life Better, and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP).

  • Financial Well-being and Protection: 401(k) plan, short- and long-term disability, life insurance, accident insurance, supplemental health insurance, business travel protection, personal liability protection, identity theft benefit, legal support, and survivor support.

​Work-life benefits include:

Paid Time Off

  • US Exempt Employees: flexible time off (unlimited, with manager approval, 11 paid national holidays (not applicable to employees in Phoenix, AZ, Puerto Rico or Rayzebio employees)

  • Phoenix, AZ, Puerto Rico and Rayzebio Exempt, Non-Exempt, Hourly Employees: 160 hours annual paid vacation for new hires with manager approval, 11 national holidays, and 3 optional holidays

Based on eligibility*, additional time off for employees may include unlimited paid sick time, up to 2 paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, and military needs and an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas and New Years Day.

All global employees full and part-time who are actively employed at and paid directly by BMS at the end of the calendar year are eligible to take advantage of the Global Shutdown.

*Eligibility Disclosure: The summer hours program is for United States (U.S.) office-based employees due to the unique nature of their work. Summer hours are generally not available for field sales and manufacturing operations and may also be limited for the capability centers. Employees in remote-by-design or lab-based roles may be eligible for summer hours, depending on the nature of their work, and should discuss eligibility with their manager. Employees covered under a collective bargaining agreement should consult that document to determine if they are eligible. Contractors, leased workers and other service providers are not eligible to participate in the program.

RayzeBio and Bristol Myers Squibb

RayzeBio was acquired by Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) in 2024 and is a wholly-owned subsidiary of BMS; however, RayzeBio will continue to operate as a standalone organization.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS and RayzeBio are dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

Candidate Rights

BMS and RayzeBio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california-residents/

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud-protection/

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

title: Electrical Assembly Technician
description:
You will have a varied role on the assembly floor, working from technical drawings, electrical schematics and work instructions. You will collaborate closely with colleagues from production and engineering to ensure every machine meets our quality standards and is ready for transport and commissioning.

  • Connect packaging machines and subassemblies, and install/lay out peripheral equipment according to schematics, drawings and work instructions.
  • Adjust, inspect and test machines and peripheral equipment electrically using test and measurement equipment.
  • Solder, wire and perform functional tests and quality checks.
  • Where necessary, troubleshoot and resolve faults at customer sites and assist with commissioning (maximum 10% of your working time).
  • Work with engineering and production to improve assembly processes and customer solutions.

You are a skilled tradesperson who combines technical insight with precision and independence. You feel at home in a modern assembly environment, take responsibility and actively contribute to improvements.

  • Completed an MBO-level vocational qualification in a technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • You read electrical schematics fluently and preferably have experience as an electrical technician or assembly technician.
  • Precise, good with your hands and practically minded; you work independently and are a true team player.
  • Available full-time, with the option to arrange your working hours flexibly.
  • Good command of English; Dutch is a plus.

You will join an international organisation with a technical focus and plenty of room for personal initiative and development. In addition to a stable working environment, we offer you ,as an Electrical Assembly Technician, attractive employment conditions and opportunities for growth.

  • A challenging, stable position with an international high-tech organisation.
  • A salary between €3,474 and €4,475 gross per month, depending on experience.
  • Attractive employment benefits, including: 27 days of annual leave and 13 ADV days (partially flexible), flexible working hours, a discount on your gym membership, a bike plan and a profit-sharing scheme.
  • A very pleasant, collegial working atmosphere with enthusiastic and professional colleagues.
  • A substantial degree of responsibility and autonomy in your role.
  • A great on-site canteen at our recently renovated facility in Weert.

Interested? Click the "Ik heb interesse" button! Have questions? Send an e-mail to Birgit.sadiki@syntegon.com. I’ll be happy to help!


Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

        Neo Rebel

        

        

Den stille luksus træder i baggrunden og giver plads til en ny form for rebellion. En rebel per definition. Den, der rejser sig i opposition. En rebel af heart, med en rastløs puls, der runger dybt indeni. Hvad er hun? Hvem er hun? Hvad vil hun? Hvad er hendes formål? I dette nye rum - dette NEO Rebel-univers - trives rebellen med et formål og længes til noget nyt. Ingen lånte idealer, ingen kompromiser med mindre; her følger hun sin indre stemme, ikke andres regler.



Hun klæder sig for at definere, ikke for at kopiere - og lader sin individualitet være sit adelsmærke.

Application due: 28-08-2026
Start date: 01-10-2026








Workplace: Hillerød

Department: Hotel- og Restaurationsservice Hillerød
















































Kom ikk’ til Elis, hvis du foretrækker, at alle dine arbejdsdage er ens! Men hvis du kan se dig selv som vores kørende distributionsleder, hvor du i din dagligdag skal træffe beslutninger, der sikrer driften, skaber gode kundeoplevelser og være med til at udvikle vores medarbejdere, så venter vi på dig i vores serviceafdeling i Hillerød.



Hos Elis er du som Distributionsleder en vigtig brik i vores værdikæde og med din energiske og driftsorienterede tilgang er du med til at sikre, at vi får leveret tekstilerne både på det rette sted og på det rette tidspunkt.



Når driften kræver det, skal du være klar til selv at sætte dig bag rattet og køre som servicechauffør. Den resterende tid vil du have din hverdag på kontoret, hvor du arbejder med planlægning, koordinering og opfølgning på den daglige drift. Vi leder efter en Distributionsleder, som har et ønske om og et drive til at være den gode leder i alle situationer. Vi ønsker medarbejdere, som trives, og glade kunder, og det er en grundlæggende holdning, som vi værner meget om. 



Du skal være robust og klar til at tilpasse dig ændringer, og kunne reagere hurtigt på uforudsete afvigelser. Samtidig trives du med at have et tæt samarbejde til alle snitflader, da vi er meget bevidste om, at ingen kan klare sig uden hinanden.



Du vil være en del af Service- og Distributionsteamet, hvor vi i fællesskab afvikler den daglige drift. Din reference vil være til Distributionschefen.





Arbejdsopgaverne vil bestå af



	
Daglig ledelse, træning og udvikling af vores servicechauffører

	
Planlægning og koordinering af den daglige kørsel

	
Daglig kontrol og opfølgning på timeregistrering

	
Proaktivt arbejde med sikkerhed og forebyggelse af arbejdsulykker i tæt samarbejde med teamet

	
Opfølgning på overholdelse af arbejdstidsregler, køre- og hviletidsbestemmelser m.m.

	
Håndtering af sygemeldinger, ferieplanlægning og øvrige personaleadministrative opgaver

	
Drive udviklingsprojekter inden for distributionen sammen med Distributionschefen, herunder ruteoptimering og medarbejderudvikling

	
Opfølgning på relevante KPI’er og driftsmå




 



I relation til jobbet, er det afgørende at du:



	
Har C kørekort og gyldigt EU-bevis

	
Er fortrolig med brug af PC, PDA og lignende

	
Taler og skriver dansk - al vores interne kommunikation foregår på dansk og engelsk.

	
Har interesse for ruteplanlægning og kapacitetsudnyttelse af bilerne

	
Er god til at motivere dine kollegaer og opbygge relationer på tværs

	
Er indstillet på en fleksibel arbejdstid med vagtordning i forhold til akutte problemstillinger

	 




Et job med masser af ansvar, en organisation der hjælper dig med at udvikle dig i din ledelsesopgave og en motiverende lønpakke. Er du fristet? 

Ja? Så er du på rette spor



	
Fuldtidsstilling med funktionæransættelse

	
Elis arbejdsbeklædning

	
Firmatelefon

	
Bærbar PC

	
Attraktiv pensions- og sundhedsordning

	
En god introduktion og en træningsperiode, der giver dig mulighed for at lære Elis, vores services og jobbet bedre at kende.

	
Og mange andre medarbejderfordele: årlige arrangementer, sundhedstilbud, medarbejdertilbud, personale- og kunstforening mv.

	 










Vi glæder os til at modtage dit CV, samt et par linjer om, hvorfor du er motiveret for at søge stillingen senest den 28. august 2026. 



Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Shpetim Ramadani på mail: Shpetim.Ramadani@Elis.com. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og forventet tiltrædelse vil ske med opstart den 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter. 



Som leder bliver du i forbindelse med invitation til 2. samtale blive bedt om at besvare en personanalyse og logiktest. Til samtalen vil HR deltage og give en tilbagemelding på resultaterne.  























          
 


            







    




























Elis Danmark A/S

Hvis du, ligesom os, arbejder langt bedre, når der er gensidig tillid på din arbejdsplads, så er du på rette spor --> 

 

Fordi hos Elis ved vi, at vi kan regne med de mennesker, vi ansætter. Vi giver dem ansvar og hjælper dem i deres udvikling. Vi tror på dem og på det sammenhold, der skal til for at opnå vores mål!

 

At blive en del af Elis betyder også at vælge en international, børsnoteretorganisation med aktiviteter i 30 lande, der har været solid, medmenneskelig og dybt engageret i cirkulær økonomi i over 75 år. Vores mission? At holde erhvervslivet forsynet med miljøvenligt, nyvasket arbejdstøj, linned- og hygiejneprodukter. Vi gør alt dette, samtidig med, at vi altid kombinerer høje standarder med vores CSR-tilgang. Elis var én af de 10 første virksomheder i Danmark, der blev CSR-certificeret, og i 2019 blev Elis verdensmålcertificeret af Bureau Veritas som den første virksomhed i verden. Læs mere påElis.com 

 

Kender du mange virksomheder, der er over 100 år gamle og stadigvæk ligger i toppen?

title: Søren Kanne-skolen søger en pædagogmedhjælper til afd. Toubro.
description:
Pr. 1. september 2026 eller gerne før, søger vi en pædagogmedhjælper til en fast stilling i en blandet funktion på afd. Toubro under Søren Kanne-skolen.
Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt. Den består af timer i SFO og timer som medhjælper for en lærer og støtte for en elev.
Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper med gode skole- og fritidspædagogiske kompetencer.
Vi søger en person, der kan blive i stillingen for minimum skoleåret 2026-2027.

Indenfor skole- og dagtilbudsområdet i Norddjurs Kommune har vi den fælles kerneopgave:
Vi skaber miljøer hvor børn ses, lærer, trives, deltager – og tør livet.
Du skal i samarbejde med dine kollegaer arbejde med kerneopgaven og sørge for at den er et centralt element i det daglige arbejde med børnene.

Herudover ønsker vi at du:
  • Har skole- og fritidspædagogisk erfaring og engagement.
  • Vil være en del af et team af lærere, pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere, der skaber spændende skole og fritidsliv for børnene på afd. Toubro.
  • Har et godt overblik.
  • Er igangsætter inden for et fritidsinteresseområde du brænder for.
  • Er god til at skabe relationer og møder andre med positive forventninger.
  • Ser forældrene som en aktiv og vigtig samarbejdspartner.
  • Kan lide kvalitet og stå inde for det du laver.
  • Kan indgå i et åbent og udviklingsorienteret samarbejde med dine kolleger og ledelsen om børnene og den pædagogiske praksis.
  • Ikke bange for nye udfordringer.

Vi:
  • Arbejder ambitiøst med det gode læringsfælleskab gennem teamsamarbejdet.
  • Ser på det hele barn.
  • Har fokus på daglig bevægelse og sundhed for børn og voksne.
  • Arbejder målbevidst med trivsel.
  • Har en dejlig skole med gode fysiske rammer.
  • Bor tæt på naturen.
Ønsker du en arbejdsplads med humor, udvikling og kollegialt fællesskab, så er vi det rigtige for dig!

Kontakt for mere information skoleleder Jacob Hørlyk på telefon 20 43 90 72.

Lønnen er i henhold til overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfristen er senest søndag d. 23. august 2026.

Vores Norddjurs
I Norddjurs kommune arbejder vi ud fra værdierne tillid, ordentlighed, udvikling og fællesskab, som er beskrevet i vores organisations- og ledelseskodeks Vores Norddjurs.

De fire værdier er grundlaget for organisationens virke og er med i alt, vi gør. Kodekset sætter en fælles retning og er dét, der binder os sammen. Værdierne lever i den daglige praksis og i den måde vi arbejder og samarbejder på. Værdierne udspiller sig på alle ledelses- og medarbejderniveauer, samt i mødet med borger og omverden.

Læs det fulde organisations- og ledelseskodeks her

undefined

Fuldtid

Field of interest: Audit & Assurance

Level of hire: Experienced hire







Firmabeskrivelse


Med vores mere end 2700 ansatte er Deloitte et af Danmarks største revisions- og rådgivningshus. Vi skræddersyer løsninger på tværs af revision, skat, finansiel rådgivning, enterprise risk services, teknologi og transformationer.

I Deloitte Aarhus er vi omkring 350 medarbejdere på tværs af vores forretningsområder, der sammen skaber værdi for en bred vifte af kunder. Vi har før sommerferien meldt ud, at vi ønsker at skærpe vores forretningsmæssige fokus og fokusere kunder i spektret fra de ambitiøse mellemstore virksomheder til store internationale koncerner. Her ser vi at dyb indsigt i industrier, specialisering, teknologiske løsninger og internationalt perspektiv i stadig større grad er med til at skabe værdi for vores kunder.

Om teamet

Vi vil fra 1. september være ca. 85 medarbejdere i Audit og Assurance i Aarhus, som tror på, at stærke relationer og et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø er vores nøgle til succes, og derfor prioriterer vi sociale aktiviteter og samarbejde højt. Her kan du være dig selv, udvikle dine kompetencer og arbejde i teams, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores arbejde foregår i et højt specialiseret og fokuseret miljø på tværs af Deloitte. I Aarhus fordeler vi videst muligt opgaverne ud fra den enkeltes interesse for kundetyper, men arbejder selvfølgelig på kryds og tværs, og lægger vægt på at vi hjælper hinanden.




Stillingsbeskrivelse


Vi søger dig, der allerede har praktisk erfaring som revisor, og enten er i gang med eller har afsluttet HD(R) eller cand.merc.aud. Alt efter hvor du er i din karriere og eventuel uddannelse, er der mulighed for, at du læser deltid på universitet ved siden af dit arbejde hos os. Din hverdag vil mere specifikt foregå i vores afdeling, hvor vi har fokus på kunder indenfor Midt-market segmentet og op. Du vil få tildelt en people leader, der gennem løbende dialog vil støtte dig i din personlige og professionelle udvikling. For os er det vigtigt, at du får muligheden for at skabe nye relationer, og at du hurtigt føler dig som en del af dit nye fællesskab.

Sæt dit aftryk på opgaver som:

Revision af kunder i Midt-market segmentet og op, hvor du opnår dybdegående viden om dine kunder og kan rådgive og revidere dem på et kvalificeret grundlag.

Deltagelse i planlægning af revisioner og koordinering af indsatser med blandt andet Deloittes service- og delivery centre, som varetager mange af vores administrative opgaver forud for og i statussæsonen

Ansvar for delområder i revisionen, hvor du medvirker til at sikre, at årsregnskabet giver et retvisende billede

Udførelse af risikovurderinger af regnskabsområder, hvor du anvender din viden om kundens interne processer

Vi lover dig, at dagene ikke bliver ensformige. Der vil være plads til at lære - både gennem formel undervisning, erfarne kollegaer og kundearbejde. Samtidig vil der også være rig mulighed for at vokse og tage det ansvar, som du har lyst til.




Kvalifikationer


Hos Deloitte værdsætter vi forskellige kompetencer, perspektiver og erfaringer, da det gør os i stand til effektivt at løse komplekse udfordringer for vores kunder. Det vigtigste er, at du kommer med en oprigtig interesse for faget samt en motivation for fortsat at lære og dygtiggøre dig. Og så er det vigtigt, at du:

Er nysgerrig og stiller spørgsmål

Besidder sociale evner, der understøtter dine fremtidige kunderelationer og samarbejde med dine kollegaer

Har interesse i teknologi og digitalisering samt forretningsmæssig rådgivning

Kan forstå og tale engelsk og dansk

Selv hvis du ikke umiddelbart genkender dig selv i alle de beskrevne kvalifikationer, ønsker vi stadig at opfordre dig til at ansøge om stillingen, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage positivt til vores team.




Yderligere informationer


Vil du være en del af vores team?

Klik på knappen "jeg er interesseret" ovenfor, hvis du er klar til at blive en del af vores team.

Send venligst dit CV.

Vi behandler ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende, så vi anbefaler dig at søge hurtigst muligt.

Forventede startdato: Efteråret 2026

Tøv ikke med at kontakte partner Marie Louise Vester Sørensen på masoerensen@deloitte.dk eller 60 46 71 91, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Vi opfordrer alle kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset alder, køn (kønsidentitet eller kønsudtryk), seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, nationalitet eller handicap.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!



In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths - because that is how we can make a difference.

Kokemus terveyskeskustyöstä, hoidon tarpeen arvioinnista ja Apotti-potilastietojärjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi.

Toivomme, että sinulla on suoritettuna LOVE-lääkehoitoluvat. Ne on mahdollista suorittaa myös työn alkaessa.

title: PRN RN
description:
About Crossover Health

Crossover Health is creating the future of health as it should be. A national, team-based medical group with a focus on wellbeing and prevention that extends beyond traditional sick care, the company delivers an entirely new model of healthcare—Primary Health—built on the foundation of trusted relationships, an interdisciplinary care team approach, and outcomes-based payment. Crossover’s Primary Health model integrates primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation and more, and delivers care in surround-sound—in-person, virtually and via asynchronous messaging. Together we are building a community of members that embraces healthcare as a proactive part of their lifestyle.

Job Summary

The Registered Nurse (RN) is an essential part of the collaborative patient care team that supports an exceptional patient experience. Our RNs are empowered to practice and contribute throughout the care experience. At its core, the RN provides direct patient care while demonstrating servant leadership, leading clinic-wide huddles and leveraging our interdisciplinary approach to integrated care. The RN promotes a level of care that goes beyond industry standards and strives for excellence at every step.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs evidence-based nursing care and patient education

  • Performs care management by connecting patients with specialists and following up to ensure patients are getting the care they need

  • Utilizes population management tools to ensure patients receive optimal care based on industry-wide recommendations

  • Provides phlebotomy services, performs in-house laboratory tests and works with the provider to determine how and when to send out specialty labs

  • Screens for vaccine-preventable diseases and administers primary care and travel-related immunizations

  • Manages RN schedule and appropriateness of appointments. Takes initiative to contact patients when needed and demonstrate knowledge of when to consult with a provider

  • Complies with all policies, procedures, and protocols of the practice, including performing specific care under standing orders

  • Provides general triage services to walk-ins and over the phone. Assesses patient’s needs, consult provider when needed and direct appropriate care

  • Provides occasional on-site care at client-sponsored events such as flu clinics and biometric screenings

  • Participates in quality improvement programs to ensure the practice is performing efficiently and in accordance with Crossover’s policies

  • Demonstrates proficiency in the use of healthcare analytic tools, systems, and analysis

  • Participates in implementation of new health technologies, products, services, and programs that establish the Crossover Medical Group as a recognized thought leader for employer-based health care and lifestyle medicine programs

  • Manages population health programs and clinic outreach initiatives

  • Serves as a resource to other nurses and the care team, and participate in the training and onboarding of new nurses

  • Assists in performing Quality and Compliance checks required on a daily, weekly and monthly basis

  • Contributes to reporting requirements related to incident reporting and compliance

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Graduate from an accredited school of nursing

  • Minimum 3 years of clinical experience

  • Current Registered Nurse license in the state you are practicing

  • Current BLS (Basic Life Support) certification

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Nursing (BSN)

  • Outpatient care and urgent care experience

  • Knowledge of Apple and Google-based technology or client technologies such as Microsoft or HP

  • Passion for delivering a best-in-class patient care experience in an integrated patient-centered primary care model

  • Creative, flexible and easily adapts to changing priorities

  • Energetic, takes initiative and able to work in a team environment as well as autonomously when needed

  • Embraces new ways of delivering healthcare

Physical Job Requirements

  • Requires standing, walking and sitting for extended periods of time

  • Includes full range of body motion including potential of handling and lifting patients

  • Requires corrected vision, hearing and speech within normal ranges

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

The base pay range for this position is $52.07 to $68 per hour. Pay range may vary depending on work location, applicable knowledge, skills, and experience. This position will be eligible for 401K.

Crossover Health is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, veteran status, disability, history of disability or perceived disability. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at careers@crossoverhealth.com.

title: Intermediate Professional, Supply Chain Management
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Data Analyst to join our Global Business Services team at WSP.com. The Data Analyst will play a crucial role in ensuring that supplier data is accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with internal policies and external regulations. They will typically work within procurement, supply chain, or finance departments and focus on cleansing and enriching the integrity of supplier records, enabling eƯicient supplier management, purchasing processes, and risk mitigation.

The role involves ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of supplier
data within the organization’s ERP or procurement systems. This role will lead the
cleansing of supplier records as we work towards a Global set of supplier data.

• Review and take action steps on duplicate suppliers to merge suppliers and enrich data in line with Global requirements.
• Become a Subject matter expert on Supplier data and it’s impacts with the business and other departments i.e Accounts Payable
• Perform regular data validation, auditing to ensure data integrity is maintained in line with Global requirements.
• Identify and correct discrepancies in supplier records, including duplications, outdated information, or incomplete data.
• Collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain Teams:
• Work with data conversion teams on Integrations and new countries coming onto Horizon to ensure consistency and quality of data. Identify gaps and make recommendations of potential solutions.

• Flag and escalate potential risks, such as non-compliant or high-risk suppliers, to the appropriate teams for further action.
• Raise opportunities where improvements can be made with in the Global Standard process.
• Participate in system upgrades, testing, and deployment of enhancements when required.
• Generate reports on supplier data quality, compliance status, and risk assessments for internal stakeholders.
• Provide regular updates to management on the status of supplier data maintenance activities.

Key Qualifications:
• 1-3 years of experience in supplier data management, procurement, supply chain, or a related role.
• Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar), procurement systems, and data management tools.
• Strong data and management skills, with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
• Knowledge of data governance principles and supplier compliance requirements.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, or related field.
• Experience with supplier or vendor management in a large organization.
• Knowledge of relevant industry regulations (e.g., tax laws, trade compliance, environmental standards).
• Familiarity with automation tools for data processing (e.g., RPA - Robotic Process Automation).
• Experience with data reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.

Key Competencies:
• Detail-Oriented: Ensure that supplier data is accurate and up-to-date, paying close attention to data consistency and quality.
• Analytical Skills: Ability to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvements.
• Collaboration: Work eƯectively with internal teams (procurement, finance, supply chain) and external suppliers.
• Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot issues related to supplier data and take corrective actions promptly.
• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to ensure clear and eƯective interaction with internal teams and external suppliers.

BGV:

• Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

• Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

We are looking for a senior AI Data & Knowledge Engineer to lead the design and evolution of enterprise-grade data and knowledge foundations for AI systems. On-premise

Data Engineering, Big Data Architecture, ETL, ELT, Data Pipelines, Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Airflow, Lakehouse, Data Governance, Data Contracts, Metadata, Lineage, RAG, GraphRAG, Knowledge Graphs, Ontology, Vector Database, AI Data Platform

title: Senior Validation Engineer
