Senior Engineer I, Validation

Location: Bothell - WA - US

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Duties/Responsibilities

The Sr. Engineer I, Validation will play a critical role in ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and industry standards related to GMP asset management and validation in a regulated GMP manufacturing facility. This position requires a hands-on validation engineer with experience in GMP, an understanding of lab/manufacturing equipment, and a proven track record in validation processes.

  • Establish validation protocols, risk assessments, and qualification plans to support GMP operations.
  • Acts as a validation Subject Matter Expert (SME) providing support to multi-function teams, advises operations on validation matters, and potentially serves as the point of contact to present validation programs and strategies and defend their work before Health Authority inspectors and auditors.
  • Executes multiple projects that require qualification work arising from change controls, capital projects, and ongoing supplemental validation deliverable per approved validation plans as a point of contact for project stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively with peers within the cross-functional teams (Facilities and Engineering, IT, Manufacturing, Quality Control, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and Quality Engineering Validation) to manage workload to address priorities, meet schedules, maximize productivity, reduce costs and COGM, and increase efficiencies.
  • With minimal supervision, executes validation projects and tasks assigned and occasionally leads one or more projects within the validation area and contributes to more complex projects and initiatives for the broader site.
  • Regularly reviews, prioritizes, and promptly responds to customer equipment qualification and support requests.
  • Quickly learns from others and consistently steps up proactively. With some frequency, proactively supports other team members and helps them to be successful.
  • Routinely seeks opportunities to learn BMS values. Excels in demonstrating one of the BMS values (Integrity, Innovation, Passion, Urgency, Inclusion, Accountability) and works to address perceived deficiencies.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, quality, and continuous improvement within the validation team.
  • Stay abreast of all relevant GMP regulations, FDA guidelines, and international standards to ensure lab operations remain in full compliance.
  • Interface with regulatory agencies during inspections and audits, serving as the subject matter expert for validation processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address any findings related to validation and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Oversee the qualification and validation of laboratory instruments, equipment, and systems, including but not limited to analytical instruments, autoclaves, and environmental monitoring systems.
  • Implement risk-based validation approaches to optimize processes and reduce validation cycle times while maintaining the highest quality.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and efficiency improvements within the validation function, collaborating with cross-functional teams as needed.
  • Develop and deliver training programs for validation team members to enhance their capabilities and knowledge of validation principles and practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in life sciences/engineering/STEM or equivalent years of experience
  • 5+ years of commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) experience within technical and regulated industries
  • Robust knowledge of cGMP, GDP, GXP, GAMP5 regulations, including 21CFR part 11, computer systems validation requirements, EU GMP Annex 15, and data integrity requirements
  • Experience with equipment/utility/facility qualifications and general commissioning, qualification and validation CQV practices are required.
  • Experience with investigations, deviations and CAPA management in a regulated pharmaceutical industry is beneficial.
  • Experience and in-depth understanding of validation lifecycle deliverables and documents from equipment design through qualification (starting with URS, to the end of IQ/OQ/PQ and SR) and computer system validation (CSV) documents through system retirement.
  • Excellent project and program management, communication skills, and technical writing skills are required.
  • Knowledge and experience with electronic document management systems for quality record, procedural documents and validation lifecycle documents are desired.
  • Possess the professionalism and technical competency required to represent the department before our customers, regulatory agencies, and management.
  • Experience in the Pharma/Biopharma required, cell therapy industry is plus.
  • Detail oriented, with strong GMP, Validation and Engineering experience
  • Experience utilizing regulatory knowledge to drive innovation and improvement in validation and engineering functions.

title: Erikoistuva lääkäri, patologia, Turku
description:
Tyks Laboratoriot Patologian vastuualueella on avoinna 2 erikoistuvan lääkärin virkaa.

Tehtäväsi

Meillä pääset mukaan mukavaan työyhteisöön, jossa osallistut erikoislääkäreiden ohjauksessa patologian osa-alueisiin: Histologiseen ja sytologiseen diagnostiikkaan, obduktioihin ja molekyylipatologiaan. Koulutuksen edetessä pääset mukaan moniin asiantuntijatehtäviin: menetelmien kehittämiseen, laadunvarmistukseen ja kliinispatologiseen meetingtoimintaan.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kehittyä patologian asiantuntijaksi monipuolisessa ja koulutusta tukevassa ympäristössä. Meillä tieteellinen meritoituminen erikoistumisen ohessa on mahdollista, ja kannustamme sinua osallistumaan koulutuksiin sekä kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Viran kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa 559/94 säädetty laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä.

Virat täytetään enintään sen pituiseksi ajaksi, jonka hakija tarvitsee erikoislääkärin pätevyysvaatimusten mukaista koulutusta varten. Käytännössä virat täytetään tarvittavan yliopistosairaalapalvelun pituiseksi ajaksi. Tämän osoittamiseksi hakijan tulee tehdä hakemukseen selvitys suoritetusta ja puuttuvasta erikoistumispalvelusta yleis- ja erikoiskoulutus sekä yliopistoklinikkapalvelut eriteltyinä.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito ja tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen ruotsin kielen taito.

Erikoistuminen toteutetaan määräaikaisessa virkasuhteessa alkaen 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Laboratoriomme sijaitsee Turussa Medisiina D:ssä.

Sinua odottaa kannustava työyhteisö, jossa voit kehittyä monipuoliseksi patologian osaajaksi. Tervetuloa!

The St. Regis is part of Marriott International, a brand leader, offering the most powerful portfolio in the industry, our more than 30 leading brands and nearly 9,100 properties in 142 countries and territories give people more ways to connect, experience and expand their world. At the heart of The St. Regis, our exceptional staff whom we address as "Hosts," are the ultimate luxury ambassadors, dedicated to providing our guests with an exquisite stay and unforgettable experiences. Pursue your passion and grow your expertise at Abu Dhabi’s best address—The St. Regis Abu Dhabi, the house of luxury who is awarded with the prestigious Forbes Travel Guide 5-Star Rating.

Job Requirement:

The Pool & SPA Technician to operate, control, monitor, and record overall Pool & Spa equipment such as Swimming pool filter, booster pumps, filtration system, heat cool pumps, heaters, heat exchangers. Monitoring & controlling chemical parameter of all water facilities making sure all are maintain within Marriott as well as local standard. Water Fountain operation and maintenance. SPA steam, sauna & Jacuzzi operation and maintenance.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
  • Ensure Pool & SPA facilities are working properly.
  • Daily 3-time pool chemical reading to be taken and record to be keep in file.
  • Daily morning chemical reading for all water facilities area need to update in transcendent and request to be close within timeframe.
  • Preventive maintenance need to be done for all equipment as per schedule.
  • Attend daily briefing and get a handover from the previous shift.
  • Follow the routine Preventive maintenance task activity and recorded accordingly
  • Assist Duty engineer to make sure overall pool & spa equipment in proper and maximum condition and follow the Duty engineer to implement P&M activity in appropriate times and when the guests require
  • Follow safety rules such as HACCP, ADAFSA, OSHAD. Practice safe work habits, utilize appropriate safety equipment and report unsafe conditions to the appropriate administrator.
  • Take care of any guest/ staff requests and complete them within the appropriate time. If unable to complete with your shift to handover to next shift accordingly
  • Deliver the stock items for mechanical/shift workshop and recorded accordingly
  • Assist Duty engineer to re-stock the daily consumable material in workshop area such as light, contactor etc.
  • Assist duty engineer to establishes and maintain seamless interaction and communication with all related departments.
  • Handle the routine checklist for overall pool and spa compliance in the property

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Related Work Experience: Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus. Experienced as Pool Technician in a Luxury Hotels.

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
   




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Analyst | HYBRID | DAY 1 HMO
description:
THIS ROLE:

This role is a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) position focused on supporting budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting activities. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial data within Workday Adaptive Planning, ensuring data integrity across systems, and supporting monthly forecasting and budgeting cycles. They will analyze financial performance, prepare variance reports comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, and provide meaningful insights and commentary to finance leaders and senior stakeholders. The role also involves ad hoc financial analysis, reporting, and modelling to support business decision-making. Ideal candidates will have strong Excel and financial modelling skills, experience with reporting tools such as Workday, Power BI, or NetSuite, the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines, and strong communication skills to effectively present financial findings to senior management and board-level audiences.

What you'll do

  • You'll be responsible for financial data input and management within the Workday Adaptive Planning system to support monthly forecasting and budgeting cycles.
  • You'll be responsible for acting as the gatekeeper of quality data across all relevant systems, driving remedial and corrective actions where necessary.
  • You'll support the analysis, review, and articulation of budgets and forecasts to the Cluster Finance Lead and business owners.
  • You'll analyse financial data and prepare reports comparing actual results against budgeted and forecasted outcomes, identifying variances and providing insightful commentary to director-level audiences.
  • You'll support ad hoc reporting, analysis, and modelling requests as part of the wider FP&A team.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Comprehensive remuneration: Motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
  • Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as HMO coverage on your Day 1 with 2 dependents covered and group life and accident insurance
  • Annual leave: All our employees are entitled to 26 days paid leave
  • Hybrid working arrangement: We recognise the value of working flexibly and is keen to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements
  • Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day

ABOUT YOU

  • You have post-qualification experience in industry, which would be advantageous.
  • You possess strong Excel skills, with financial modelling experience being essential and you have experience in any reporting tools (Experience in using Workday, PowerBI, NetSuite, would be a distinct advantage but not required).
  • You are capable of working to tight deadlines and can flexibly prioritize multiple tasks and deliverables simultaneously.
  • You have the ability to summarize findings and conclusions in a succinct and professional manner, tailored to senior management and board-level audiences.
  • You can work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a wider team.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineering & Development, Officer

Location: Quincy, Massachusetts, Princeton, New Jersey

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a Software Developer reporting directly to Lead software engineer. You will contribute to the development, enhancement, and maintenance of data quality and data delivery applications as part of an agile scrum team, working with a strong development group to build challenging, cutting‑edge products in the financial domain.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of the Data Engineering and Data Delivery function, a capability that is vital to the company as it enables the timely, reliable, and scalable delivery of critical financial data that supports core business operations, reporting, and decision‑making.

What you will be responsible for

As Software Developer you will

  • Work independently to develop, test, and debug software enhancements and solutions within the business and technical problem domains

  • Develop, test, debug, and implement software programs, applications and projects using cloud computing using Java, python or other related software engineering languages

  • Write unit and automation tests to ensure a high-quality end product

  • Participate in code reviews

  • Actively participate in the agile software development process by adhering to the scrum methodology including attending all daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives

  • Triage production issues by reviewing code and logs as needed and come up with solutions

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Extensive Java n-tier application experience

  • Python, Java programming Languages

  • Good understanding of AI enabled programming

  • Kubernetes, Kafka, Azure, AWS

  • Reactive programing, KSQL, Streams

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Commercial software development, proficient in developing multi-tier solutions

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent field

  • Knowledgeable of commercial software development,

  • Professional Java & Python development experience

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), good interpersonal skills

  • Ability to gather and understand requirements in the financial sector (Math background highly desirable)

  • Able to work well with peers in a collaborative team environment

  • Experience working with an Agile development methodology is desired

Additional requirements

  • Ability to analyze business requirements and develop solutions to the business needs

  • Strong communication skills, self-motivated, detail oriented, and highly responsible.

  • Strong collaboration skills, working with multiple teams in various locations in an agile environment.

Work Requirement

  • Hybrid with minimum 4 days in office

  • 8:30 AM to 5 PM

Salary Range:

$70,000 - $118,750 Annual

title: Information Security Specialist
description:
Senior Specialist - Information Security

Location: Bangalore

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job Title

Senior Specialist - Information Security

Summary of the Role

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Lead with 8-10 years of experience to drive cybersecurity strategy, threat management, and risk governance across enterprise environments. The role requires strong leadership in SOC/SIEM operations, incident response, and compliance with frameworks such as PCI DSS and GDPR, ensuring robust security posture and regulatory adherence.

Your Main Responsibilities

  • Define and lead enterprise cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Oversee SOC/SIEM operations including monitoring, detection use cases, and incident response effectiveness.
  • Lead threat management activities including threat intelligence, threat hunting, and risk prioritization.
  • Drive incident response governance including major incident handling, escalation, and post-incident reviews.
  • Manage vulnerability assessment programs, remediation tracking, and risk-based prioritization.
  • Establish and enforce security governance frameworks, policies, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with PCI DSS requirements including logging, monitoring, access controls, and audit readiness.
  • Ensure GDPR compliance including data protection, breach notification, and privacy risk management.
  • Drive risk governance practices including risk assessment, mitigation planning, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with business, IT, DevOps, and leadership stakeholders to integrate security into delivery.
  • Lead automation initiatives using SOAR and scripting to improve operational efficiency.
  • Provide executive-level reporting, dashboards, and communication on security posture.
  • Mentor and guide SOC/security teams and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

About the Ideal Candidate

  • Engineering Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • 8-10 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, strategy, or SecOps leadership roles.
  • Strong experience with SIEM/SOC platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic).
  • Proven expertise in incident response, threat management, and security operations.
  • Experience managing vulnerability management lifecycle and tools.
  • Strong understanding of compliance frameworks including PCI DSS and GDPR.
  • Experience in risk governance, risk assessments, and audit management.
  • Exposure to cloud security (Azure/AWS) and hybrid environments.
  • Hands-on experience with automation (Python, PowerShell, SOAR tools).
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and leadership skills.
  • Ability to present to senior leadership and manage cross-functional teams.

Certifications (Good to have):

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CRISC
  • Microsoft SC-200 Security Operations Analyst
  • Microsoft AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer
  • CEH
  • CompTIA Security+ / CySA+
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)

title: Peer Practitioner
description:
Who are we?

Sonder is an inclusive, not-for-profit organisation that has been providing better quality health and support services to the South Australian community since 1993. We support thousands of people each year to access services across seven key domains – Mental Health, Aboriginal Health, Alcohol and/or other Drugs, Employment, Community Health, Disability, and Homelessness

What benefits can we offer?

When you work with Sonder, you become part of the Sonder family and that provides you with a number of benefits such as:

  • Salary (excluding super) paid above award and reviewed annually

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Professional development allowance provided yearly

  • Generous salary packaging options - increase your take home pay by 6-12%

  • 17.5% Leave Loading

  • Modern and welcoming office spaces

  • Christmas Closure Bonus Leave (above annual leave entitlements)

  • Training opportunities

  • Meal & entertainment allowances

  • Paid parental leave, and much more!

Sonder are open to negotiating further benefits with the successful applicant to ensure an excellent working environment for you.

Salary Band: $80,006.68 - $85,798.44 + Super

Hours: 0.96 FTE

Contract: Ongoing

Location: Kaurna Country, Northern Crisis Stabilisation Centre

More Information & Position Description via this link:

About the Role:

As a Peer Practitioner you will use your own lived experience of mental health challenges and recovery to provide genuine peer support and connection to guests, their families, carers and chosen supporters.

You will use a strengths-based, recovery-oriented approach to encourage hope, empowerment and recovery, while acting as a positive role model for people experiencing mental health challenges, distress or crisis.

You'll work collaboratively within the multidisciplinary team, ensuring lived experience perspectives are valued and included in everyday service delivery. You advocate for, and champion the voices, experiences and needs of guests within the service.

Experience Requirements:

  • Personal lived experience of mental health challenges and recovery, and the ability to draw on this experience purposefully and safely in a professional context.

  • Demonstrated experience working within a fast-paced environment.

  • Previous experience in a Peer Practitioner, lived experience, or peer support worker role.

  • Previous experience in an immediate access or crisis care setting is desirable.

  • Experience using databases, electronic case management systems, and computer systems.

Qualification and Other Requirements:

  • Current or willing to obtain a Working with Children's Check (WWCC)

  • Current or willing to obtain a National Police Check (NPC)

  • Certificate IV in Peer Work or equivalent qualification with demonstrated experience in a lived experience, Peer Practitioner, or Peer Support Worker role, or willingness to obtain.

  • Certificate IV in Mental Health or a related field is desirable.

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
   




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
CRD CTO, EVP

Location: Burlington Massachusetts

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Role Overview

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a senior executive responsible for defining and executing the company’s technology vision, strategy, and architecture in support of long‑term growth, innovation, and operational excellence. As a software company operating within State Street Corporation, the CTO will balance the agility and innovation of a technology firm with the rigor, security, and regulatory expectations of a global financial institution.

The CTO will have full accountability for technology delivery outcomes across Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, Architecture, and Platform Engineering, while delegating day‑to‑day operational management to strong senior leaders. This role is central to advancing a cloud‑native, AI‑enabled, and secure technology ecosystem that accelerates time‑to‑market and enables differentiated, industry‑leading solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Technology & Engineering Leadership

  • Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight of Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, Architecture, and platform teams, with end‑to‑end accountability for technology delivery and outcomes.
  • Establish clear operating models, performance standards, and governance to ensure high‑quality, scalable, and resilient technology solutions.
  • Build and retain world‑class engineering and architecture talent, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Platform & Infrastructure Transformation

  • Lead the evolution of the company’s technology platforms and delivery infrastructure toward a modern, cloud‑native future state.
  • Drive improvements in speed‑to‑market, system performance, resiliency, scalability, and security while ensuring operational excellence.
  • Champion modernization of legacy platforms and adoption of contemporary engineering practices and tooling.

Architecture & Portfolio Strategy

  • Define, own, and evangelize a long‑term enterprise architecture that enables the delivery of industry‑leading front‑to‑back (F2B) solutions.
  • Drive alignment and rationalization of the technology portfolio across Engineering, Alpha, SaaS, and other business units to ensure consistency, reuse, and strategic coherence.
  • Ensure architectural decisions support business growth, regulatory requirements, and future scalability.

DevOps & Delivery Enablement

  • Establish and mature DevOps practices, including continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), to accelerate code‑to‑production cycles.
  • Standardize development and release processes to improve developer productivity, reliability, and operational transparency.
  • Promote automation and engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle.

Security, Risk & Resiliency

  • Own and oversee all software security concerns across the product suite, ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
  • Partner closely with enterprise security, risk, and compliance teams to proactively identify and mitigate technology risks.
  • Ensure platforms and applications are designed with security, resiliency, and availability built in by design.

AI & Advanced Technology Adoption

  • Spearhead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across internal platforms, engineering processes, and operational workflows to enhance automation, decision‑making, and efficiency.
  • Champion the integration of AI capabilities into client‑facing products and services to deliver differentiated value and competitive advantage.
  • Ensure responsible, ethical, and scalable use of AI technologies in alignment with enterprise standards.

Financial & Executive Partnership

  • Partner with Finance and the Executive Leadership Team to optimize technology investment, manage cost efficiency, and maximize return on investment.
  • Drive transparency and discipline in technology spend while supporting sustainable growth and client success.
  • Contribute to the broader enterprise strategy as a trusted technology advisor.

Growth & Enterprise Alignment

  • Drive the technology roadmap that supports the company’s ambition to become a billion‑dollar, technology‑led enterprise.
  • Partner closely with parent company leadership to bring collective strategy and vision to life, promoting collaboration across business lines.
  • Maintain a strong alignment with the parent company’s CIO organization through a dual reporting model to ensure enterprise coherence and leverage shared capabilities.

External & Market‑Facing Responsibilities

  • Client Engagement: Articulate the company’s technology strategy, roadmap, and architectural philosophy to clients and prospects, clearly linking innovation to business outcomes.
  • Sales Enablement: Support sales efforts by positioning the company’s platforms (including Alpha) as best‑in‑class solutions in the marketplace.
  • Market Intelligence: Monitor emerging technologies, industry trends, and competitive dynamics to inform technology and operating strategy.
  • M&A and Partnerships: Lead technical and organizational due diligence for potential acquisitions, partnerships, and strategic investments.
  • Brand & Thought Leadership: Partner with Marketing to strengthen the company’s digital and technology brand; represent the organization at industry conferences, media engagements, and executive forums.

Executive Profile

The ideal candidate is a seasoned technology executive with deep experience leading large‑scale software platforms in complex, regulated environments. They bring a proven track record of platform modernization, cloud and AI adoption, and delivering business‑critical technology at scale—while operating effectively within a matrixed enterprise structure.

Salary Range:

$300,000 - $412,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 Vi søger en engageret kollega OVER 18 år til vores butik, der kan arbejde efter skole og i weekenden.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist - Senior Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Officer – Data Scientist

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Data Scientist to join our AI/ML Science team as part of the Agentic AI platform initiative. The Science pillar drives advancements in LLM research, fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, anomaly detection, and next-generation model development, partnering closely with Platform Engineering, SRE, and Pods/Business Engagement to deliver robust agentic solutions and platform features.

In this role, you will drive applied research and product-oriented data science within the Agentic AI platform initiative. Independently own domain-specific model evaluation, fine-tuning, and operationalization workstreams. This role requires deep technical skills in LLMs, graph-based reasoning, and production-scale AI deployments, as well as the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own BU specific AI/ML problem statements and objectives to deliver value leveraging agentic AI workflows and domain specific LLM solutions.
  • Lead foundational and domain model evaluation, fine-tuning, and prompt optimization with robust data curation and governance.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks, taxonomies, and metrics for model benchmarking and anomaly detection.
  • Build and maintain knowledge graphs, embeddings, and inference engines to enable semantic search, reasoning, and scalable serving.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy scalable AI solutions in production environments.
  • Conduct experiments, analyze results, and communicate findings and best practices across teams.
  • Stay abreast of the latest advancements in generative AI, LLMs, and agentic systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 5+ years of overall experience in IT and 3+ years of relevant experience in applied machine learning or NLP, with hands-on work in production environments.
  • Strong experience with LLMs, GenAI, or NLP, including fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, DGL), knowledge graphs, and vector stores.
  • Familiarity with cloud AI/ML services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Prior work on agentic AI is a big plus

Work Schedule

On-premise

Keywords

Senior Data Scientist, Generative AI, LLM, Applied Machine Learning, RAG, Agentic Applications, Python, Azure, Model Evaluation

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Expeditor
description:
Description

Next is looking for a full-time Expeditor to join our team! The Expeditor is an important part of the team, ensuring all plates and courses are prepared and presented accurately. This is a full-time position, paid hourly, and candidates must be willing to work 40+ hours, 5 days a week. Candidates must be available to work Wednesday - Sunday.

Next is a pre-fixe experience that undergoes a creative overhaul every four months, each time inviting guests to explore a new culinary region, theme or moment in time. For example, Winter 2019’s Silk & Spice menu featured dishes that explored the spices and flavors along the historic trade route in Asia, Northeast Africa and Europe. Next was named the Best New Restaurant in the U.S. by the James Beard Foundation in 2012 and awarded a Michelin Star. Past menus have included Ancient Rome (2017), The Hunt (2012), and Alinea Retrospective (2018).

Responsibilities

  • Organize the Expeditor station for nightly service, ensuring all necessary equipment is in place for efficient operation.
  • Communicates all information to kitchen team including standard order information, dietary restrictions, Persons of Note (PON), and any special guest requests
  • Assist in training servers, particularly in food running, dish description, and ingredient information.
  • Maintain direct communication with the kitchen team to ensure an ample supply of clean plateware and serviceware.
  • Verify the quality, quantity, and presentation of each dish leaving the kitchen.
  • Foster positive relationships between front-of-house (FOH) and back-of-house (BOH) teams through effective communication.
  • Audit kitchen space for adherence to health department requirements, safety procedures, and staff hygiene.
  • Ensures adherence to safety and emergency procedures to protect staff, guests and property
  • Reports any maintenance deficiencies promptly to the appropriate personnel.
  • Resolve management requests and guest complaints satisfactorily.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and maintain a deep understanding of the culinary world.
  • Demonstrate courteous and cooperative behavior when interacting with the public and staff, fostering a harmonious workplace.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor/manager


Requirements

  • Demonstrate an unparalleled commitment to your work
  • Possess at least 1 year of experience as an expeditor, server, or related role
  • Ability to excel in a high-pressure, chef-driven environment.
  • Maintain a keen eye for detail in every aspect of your role.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with the team.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a dynamic team.
  • Think clearly, act quickly, and maintain concentration during intense situations.


Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work on your feet for at least 8 hours
  • Must be able to move, pull or lift at least 35 pounds
  • Must be able to climb stairs multiple times per shift


Benefits

  • Competitive hourly wage at $25.00 - $25.50/hour
  • Medical, vision, dental and life benefits available on the 1st month following full-time employment
    • 50% company contribution to single HMO during the first 2 years of full-time employment, 100% contribution available after 2 years
  • Paid time off
  • 401(K) with a company match of up to 4% of deferred earnings
  • CTA/Ventra discount available after 1 month of full-time employment
  • Employee Dining Discount, 20% to any Alinea Group restaurant
  • Referral Bonus Program available


The Alinea Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, religion, age, veteran status, life experiences and ideas. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and strive to provide an inclusive culture that embraces diversity.

Must be eligible to legally work in the United States. We use E-Verify.

title: Prosjektingeniør
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Vil du starte karrieren din med spennende automasjonsprosjekter i energisektoren? Hos ABB i Hammerfest får du jobbe med moderne teknologi, lære av erfarne fagfolk og bidra til løsninger som gjør industrien sikrere, smartere og mer bærekraftig.

Vi søker engasjerte og gjerne nyutdannede til vårt team i Hammerfest, hvor vi driver integrerte løsninger for å automatisere, digitalisere og elektrifisere industrier. Med over 50 års ekspertise innen vårt felt, er vi i forkant av innovasjon, og omformer tradisjonelle tilnærminger for å forbedre driftseffektiviteten og redusere miljøpåvirkningen.

Hvorfor jobbe for ABB i Hammerfest?

Vi har spennende og utfordrende oppdrag på Hammerfest LNG, Goliat FPSO og Johan Castberg. Vi tilbyr et stimulerende og dynamisk arbeidsmiljø hvor du kan arbeide med banebrytende prosjekter, bidra til bærekraft, og nyte positive arbeidsforhold, samtidig som du får muligheter for personlig og profesjonell vekst.

Oppgaver du vil jobbe med

  • Delta i installasjon, igangkjøring og serviceoppdrag
  • Engineering av automatiseringsløsninger på kontrollsystemer
  • PLC-programmering og HMI design
  • Assistere kunder med tekniske spørsmål og samhandle med ulike interessenter

Dine kvalifikasjoner og bakgrunn

  • Bachelorgrad innen automasjon, mekatronikk, kybernetikk eller lignenende.
  • Relevant fagbrev med erfaring kan veie opp for manglende høyere utdanning.
  • Forståelse av kontrollsystemer og prosessautomatisering.
  • Fleksibilitet, ansvarlighet og gode kommunikasjonsevner.
  • Flytende i engelsk og god skandinavisk språkferdighet.

Viktig informasjon om sikkerhetsklarering
Denne stillingen innebærer arbeid på prosjekter og anlegg med særskilte sikkerhetskrav. Det er derfor en forutsetning for ansettelse at du kan sikkerhetsklareres i henhold til gjeldende krav fra norske myndigheter og våre kunder. Endelig tilbud om ansettelse vil være betinget av at nødvendig sikkerhetsklarering kan oppnås.

Noe av det vi tilbyr deg, er:

  • Konkurransedyktige fordeler og fleksible arbeidstider
  • Karriereutvikling gjennom opplæring og utviklingsprogrammer
  • Inkluderende arbeidsmiljø som verdsetter mangfold
  • Innovasjon og teknologi i forkant av bransjen
  • Muligheter for nasjonale og internasjonale oppdrag og samarbeid

Virker dette interessant? Send inn din søknad og CV innen 30.8.2026. Har du spørsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte avdelingsleder Sten Viktor Hakonsen.

ABB er leverandør av samfunnskritisk infrastruktur. Personellsikkerhet er derfor viktig for ABB og våre kunder. I samarbeid med Meditor, gjennomfører ABB Norge bakgrunnssjekk av kandidater som mottar tilbud om ansettelse. Dette for å sikre overholdelse av ABBs retningslinjer for rekruttering og personellsikkerhet, samt overholdelse av lovkrav knyttet til handelssanksjoner. Kandidater vil bli bedt om å avgi relevant informasjon.

ABB er en global teknologileder innen elektrifisering og automasjon, som muliggjør en mer bærekraftig og ressurseffektiv fremtid. Ved å kombinere sin ekspertise innen teknologi og digitalisering, hjelper ABB industrier med å prestere på et høyt nivå, samtidig som de blir mer effektive, produktive, bærekraftige og i stand til å øke sin konkurransekraft. Hos ABB kaller vi dette "Engineered to Outrun". Selskapet har over 140 års historie og rundt 110 000 ansatte over hele verden. ABBs aksjer er notert på SIX Swiss Exchange (ABBN) og Nasdaq Stockholm (ABB).

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Siivooja
description:
Parhaan arjen Mäntsälä!

Teknisen- ja elinvoimapalveluiden toimintakulttuuria kuvaa yhteisöllinen ja rento työtapa. Olemme noin 200 ammattilaisen joukko, jossa kannustamme ja pidämme huolta toinen toisistamme. Toimintaamme ohjaa kuntalaisten tarpeet, kehittymisenhalu sekä yhteisöllisyyden vahvistaminen. Ateria- ja puhtauspalvelujen tulosalueella työskentelee lähes 70 henkilöä, joiden tehtävänä on vastata kunnan eri tilojen siisteydestä sekä tuottaa laadukkaat ateriapalvelut koulu- ja päiväkotikohteisiimme.

Haemme puhtauspalveluiden tiimiimme siivoojaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan, osa-aikaiseen (30h/ vko) työsuhteeseen 1.9.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan. Tulosalueen tehtäviin kuuluvat kohteiden laadukkaiden päivittäispuhtauspalvelujen tuottaminen mm. koulu- ja toimistokohteissamme sekä koulujen loma-aikoihin sijoittuvat perussiivoukset.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on alan soveltuva koulutus, puhtauspalvelujen perustutkinto tai työssä hankittu vastaava osaaminen sekä työkokemus vastaavista työtehtävistä. Työtä tehdään tiiviisti asiakkaidemme kanssa yhteistyössä, joten hyvät sosiaaliset taidot sekä yhteistyökyky auttavat sinua suoriutumaan hyvin tehtävässäsi.

Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky viestiä suullisesti ja kirjallisesti auttavat saavuttamaan päämääräsi. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja haasteita tarjoavan tehtäväkokonaisuuden toisiamme tukevassa ja kannustavassa työyhteisössä. Meillä pääset näyttämään osaamistasi. Työkierto on myös mahdollista eri kohteidemme välillä joustavasti.

Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen yleisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka: 2224,93 eur/kk. Lisäksi voidaan maksaa kokemuslisää aiemman työkokemuksen perusteella. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Mäntsälä on koulutus- ja kehitysmyönteinen kunta. Tuemme työssä jaksamista liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun avulla. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen työn moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä. Tukenasi ovat osaavat ja motivoituneet työkaverit sekä oma tiimi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa puhtaustyönjohtaja Kirsi Koli, puh. 040 314 5478 tai sp. muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@mantsala.fi.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työsuhteen alkua toimitettava hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää.

Jätä hakemuksesi sähköisesti 30.8.2026 mennessä osoitteessa: [Avoimet työpaikat - mantsala.rekrytointi.com](https://mantsala.rekrytointi.com/paikat/?o=A_LOJ&list=1) . Liitä hakemukseen hakukirje ja ansioluettelosi. Toivomme hakemuksia eri ikää, sukupuolta, taustaa ja erilaisia vähemmistöjä edustavilta henkilöiltä. Haastatteluja voimme aloittaa jo hakuprosessin aikana.

Mäntsälä on vireä ja vehmas kunta, jossa eletään turvallista, ihmisenkokoista arkea sujuvien palveluiden, monipuolisten vapaa-ajan mahdollisuuksien ja kätevien liikenneyhteyksien äärellä. Kunnan keskeiset arvot, turvallisuus, osallistava yhteisöllisyys ja vastuullinen, kehittävä vire ohjaavat toimintaamme. Haluamme olla parhaan arjen paikkakunta, jossa on hyvä elää, työskennellä ja yrittää.

title: Senior Associate - Process Engineering
description:
Bring your expertise to shape seamless digital journeys by turning complex, cross-functional needs into resilient, well-controlled operations with measurable outcomes.

As a Process Engineering Senior Associate in the Digital Banking team within International Consumer Bank, you design and implement end-to-end processes that enable new products, features, and customer journeys. You partner across Product, Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Controls to translate ambiguity into clear target states with embedded risk and control intent. You build practical, automated, auditable processes that improve customer experience, reduce manual effort, and lower operational risk.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end process design from early concept through implementation, adoption, and stabilization for new and evolving customer journeys.
  • Design and stand up future-state processes to support new products, features, and digital journeys as the business scales.
  • Execute impact assessments for product launches to identify downstream operational, process, risk, and control implications and drive required changes.
  • Perform structured current-state analysis (data, volumes, exceptions, handoffs, pain points, and controls) and translate findings into practical target-state recommendations.
  • Quantify opportunities and outcomes (for example, straight-through processing, cycle time reduction, reduced exception rates, improved controls) and track delivery to measurable results.
  • Lead cross-functional working sessions and walkthroughs to align on scope, target state, trade-offs, sequencing, and decisions.
  • Obtain formal Operations sign-off on process maps and target-state recommendations, managing dependencies, risks, issues, and escalations.
  • Prepare clear materials and present in governance forums, articulating decisions required, key risks, and delivery progress.
  • Create and maintain end-to-end process maps in Signavio (or equivalent), including journeys, exception paths, ownership, decision points, and control points.
  • Maintain clear linkages between process steps, risks, and controls so designs are implementable and auditable.
  • Identify workflow and case management optimization opportunities and translate them into delivery items (for example, Jira epics and stories) with defined scope, outcomes, and acceptance criteria.

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

  • 5+ years of experience in process engineering, business process management, or transformation.
  • Experience in United Kingdom and European Union retail banking, including digital banking channels and domains such as onboarding, payments, lending, servicing, cards, fraud, or financial crime.
  • Strong process analysis skills, including assessment of volumes, exceptions, failure demand, handoffs, and control points.
  • Hands-on experience creating and maintaining process models using Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN).
  • Hands-on experience with Signavio or another BPMN tool such as ARIS.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional working sessions, challenge constructively, and drive stakeholders from ambiguity to decision and closure.
  • Risk and controls mindset, with the ability to identify control gaps and partner effectively with controls and operational risk stakeholders.
  • Strong critical thinking and logical reasoning skills to connect cause-and-effect across end-to-end journeys and recommend data-grounded improvements.
  • Executive-ready communication skills to synthesize complex process and risk topics into clear options, recommendations, and decisions required.

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

  • Experience using Jira and Confluence to translate process design into delivery.
  • Consulting experience or experience delivering large-scale transformation, including re-engineering, greenfield builds, or operating model change.
  • Experience improving case management and identifying automation opportunities in workflow-heavy environments.

title: Nomeco Aarhus søger lagerspecialist til Inbound (Daghold)
description:
Nomeco Aarhus søger lagerspecialist til Inbound (Daghold) 
      


    
 
        
        
 
            
 Danmarks største lægemiddelgrossist Nomeco søger lige nu en lagerekspedient med engagement og lyst til at være en del af vores velfungerende Inboundhold i Aarhus. Som lagerspecialist hos os indgår du som en vigtig del af det team, der varemodtager og pakker medicinalvarer til de danske apoteker. 

 Vi søger lige nu en lagerspecialist til en 37 timers stilling på vores Inbound-hold. 

 Hos Nomeco sørger vi for rettidig adgang til livsvigtig medicin samt tilbyder effektive logistikløsninger til medicinalindustrien i Norden. Vi er stolte af at være en central del af sundhedssystemets infrastruktur og en pålidelig nordisk partner for industrien med løsningerder spænder fra lagerstyring til levering. Som Danmarks førende lægemiddelgrossist og strategisk partner for både apoteker og hospitaler, er vi "the heartbeat of healthcare". Lige nu er vi 950 medarbejdere, der holder hjertet i gang - og der er plads til dig på holdet. 

 Dine primære opgaver 
 
   Påpladslægning af varer 

   Genopfyldning af hylder 

   Forsendelse 

   Pluk 

   Truckkørsel 

   Diverse ad hoc-opgaver 
 
 Vi søger lige nu en lagerspecialist til en 37 timers stilling. 

 Lige uger: tirsdag til fredag 8:00-16:00 (fredag 15:30) 

 Ulige uger: mandag til fredag kl. 08:00-16:00 (fredag 15:30), Lørdag: 10:00-18:00 

 Det er vigtigt for os, at du kan se dig selv både i de nævnte arbejdstider, og de primære arbejdsopgaver. 

 Lidt om dig 

 De primære arbejdsopgaver er grundlæggende for vores drift, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du motiveres af faste rutiner med personlige mål. Vi leder efter dig, der sætter en ære i at levere høj kvalitet, og som kan arbejde hurtigt og effektivt. Derudover skal du kunne håndtere mange tal og bogstaver på én gang, f.eks. at gennemskue komplekse varenumre, samtidig med at du har fokus på en korrekt optælling. 

 Vi har ikke udpræget tunge løft i vores opgaver, men jobbet kan alligevel opleves som fysisk krævende, da man igennem dagen er på benene, løfter kasser og varer, stiger af og på trucks osv. Det vil være en fordel at du har truckcertifikat, men ikke et krav. 

 Som lagerspecialist hos Nomeco Aarhus trives du med at tage ansvar for de opgaver, du stilles overfor. Du formår at bevare både overblik og et højt humør - også når det går stærkt. 

 Du vil arbejde selvstændigt, og det er derfor naturligt for dig at håndtere dine opgaver på egen hånd. 

 Det er et krav at du skal kunne læse, skrive og tale dansk, da vores opgave- og arbejdsinstruktioner er på dansk. 

 Du skal have et dansk pas eller en gyldig opholdstilladelse og en ren straffeattest. 

 Hos Nomeco tilbyder vi 

 Vi tilbyder et uformelt og positivt arbejdsmiljø, hvor kompetente kolleger står klar til at støtte dig i din karriere. Derudover er der mulighed for at tilmelde sig sundhedsordning og firmarabatter. Dertil får du træning og erfaring med håndtering af medicin. 

 Uden for arbejdstiden har du rig mulighed for at møde kolleger fra andre afdelinger via vores personaleforening Team Nomeco. I Team Nomeco finder du et væld af aktiviteter, der samler kolleger om alt fra sport og spil til kultur og hygge. Uanset aktivitet får du mulighed for at deltage i spændende arrangementer, udvikle nye interesser og styrke dit netværk på tværs af afdelinger. 

 Praktisk information 

 Ønsker du yderligere information om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Associate Manager Wholesale, Operation: Andreas Kvist på tlf. 60428384 i tidsrummet 08:00-15:00 mandag-fredag eller på mail  ANKVI@nomeco.dk  

 Vi kalder løbende ind til samtaler og lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat - så send dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Ansøgninger og CV modtages IKKE via mail, kun via stillingsopslaget. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

 
  

 Vi tilbyder ansættelse på overenskomst.

title: Technician, R&D II Vivarium
description:

Comparative Medicine is responsible for providing animal care and assuring regulatory animal compliance, while meeting and advancing the scientific needs of our researchers with consideration for the well-being of our research animals. The Technician II is responsible primarily for technical procedures (in vivo and invitro) but will also support husbandry/animal care and the operational aspects of Comparative Medicine in a GxP environment.

title: Technical Product Senior Associate - Platform
description:
At JP Morgan Chase, we understand that customers seek exceptional value and a seamless experience from a trusted financial institution. That's why we launched Chase UK to transform digital banking with intuitive and enjoyable customer journeys. With a strong foundation of trust established by millions of customers in the US, we have been rapidly expanding our presence in the UK and soon across Europe. We have been building the bank of the future from the ground up, offering you the chance to join us and make a significant impact.

As a Technical Product Associate in the Chase UK - Developer Experience Engineering team within the Platform organisation, you deliver platform-as-a-product tooling that will be the foundation for building, maintaining, and expanding the bank’s operations.

By taking a platform-as-a-product approach, you put product and platform teams at the heart of our products and build roadmaps that accelerate global product launches. Above all, you know how to prioritise the most important features based on business value and customer needs.

This is a role for someone who thrives in the detail of platform engineering while also engaging a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders across the business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Influence and execute product strategy in partnership with engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Define roadmaps ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.
  • Take the lead on identifying, prioritising, and launching new features that enhance the developer experience.
  • Drive key activities such as quarterly planning and OKRs.
  • Be hands on, detail oriented and outcome focused.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle.
  • Gather requirements from a range of stakeholders, understand platform pain points and prioritise features to deliver the most value in accordance with business objectives.
  • Able to drive key strategic activities including quarterly planning, OKR updates, technical backlog creation and roadmapping.
  • Balance the development of strategic features with ad-hoc business demand and support of a live platform in production.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across a range of technical and non-technical teams, with ability to manage expectations and influence key decisions regarding the platform.
  • Passion for continuous learning.

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities

  • Previous experience in technical product management, software engineering or in a technical role.
  • Experience with cloud-native infrastructure platforms (AWS or other).
  • Experience with one or more observability platforms and tools.
  • Experience with platform engineering – this could be IaaS, SaaS or PaaS.

title: Myyjä, Hämeenlinna Sairaala (20h/vko)
description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava Rkioskin myyjämme.

Rkioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
- Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
- Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
- Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
- Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte kioskilla yhtä lailla.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

- Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
- Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
- Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
- Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
- Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Traineevalmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman Rkioskin yrittäjäksi asti.
Haemme Hämeenlinna Sairaala R-kioskille myyjää. Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 20 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt elokuun aikana. Valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä, joten hae heti!Kauppiaalla on toinen kioski Riihimäen Asemalla, ja työvuorot voivat kohdistua satunnaisesti myös sinne.

Arvostamme

Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä

Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

Kokemusta pelimyynnistä ja postitoiminnoista

Edellytämme

Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

Hygieniapassia (jos sinulla ei vielä passia ole, voit suorittaa sen koeajan puitteissa)

Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

title: Timvikarier sökes till hemtjänst i Täby
description:
Timvikarie till hemtjänst i Täby

Om företaget

Vi är en hemtjänstenhet i Täby som erbjuder högkvalitativ vård och omsorg i hemmet. Vår vision är att underlätta våra kunders vardag genom professionell och omsorgsfull service.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Som timvikarie hos oss kommer du att spela en avgörande roll i våra kunders dagliga liv. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar att ge personlig omvårdnad, serviceinsatser, stödja i dagliga aktiviteter och säkerställa en trygg tillvaro i hemmet för våra kunder. Dokumentation och noggrann rapportering är viktiga delar av arbetet. Arbetet är varierande och flexibelt.

Kvalifikationer

För att passa i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Avslutad undersköterskeutbildning eller likvärdig utbildning.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom hemtjänst eller liknande vårdsektor.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.
  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt såväl som i team.
  • Krav på körkort
  • Krav på cykelförmåga

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är:

  • Empatisk med ett starkt intresse för att hjälpa andra.
  • Strukturerad och ansvarstagande.
  • Flexibel och kan anpassa dig till förändrade förhållanden.
  • Positiv och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet till personlig och professionell utveckling i en stödjande och stimulerande arbetsmiljö. Vi tillämpar kollektivavtal och erbjuder förmåner som exempelvis friskvårdsbidrag, subventionerad träning på Sats m.m. Du kommer att ingå i ett engagerat team med en gruppchef som prioriterar samarbete och arbetsglädje högt.

Övrigt

Vi välkomnar din ansökan senast den 30 april 2025. Tjänsten tillträds enligt överenskommelse. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kommer vi att begära ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret och genomföra bakgrundskontroll. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta verksamhetschef Laila Sjöberg på 010-166 50 14 eller via mejl: laila.sjoberg@adelagruppen.se

title: Specialist_SCM & Logistics
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Customer Support Supervisor


Your role and responsibilities

In this role you will have the opportunity to serve as a key link between ABB Robotics Taiwan and the ABB global supply chain network. Each day, you will place purchase orders with group factories, track manufacturing progress to meet customer delivery deadlines, coordinate with external suppliers and develop new supplier relationships, and collaborate with the finance team on payment arrangements. Additionally, you will manage the receipt and distribution of products/parts to the Taiwan warehouse, coordinate with warehouse operations on shipments, and control inventory and asset management. You will also showcase your expertise by optimizing procurement processes, supply chain efficiency, and inventory accuracy.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the ABB Robotics Taiwan Co., Ltd. in Taiwan. Main stakeholders are the Manufacturing factory, Sales team, Finance team, Warehouse, and etc.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Maintaining complete and accurate data in the ERP system for procurement (SCM) and logistics, including purchase orders, factory schedules, supplier information, and warehouse inventory records.
  • Checking the quality and quantity of incoming goods (Robots & Parts) upon arrival at the Taiwan warehouse to ensure compliance with storage standards and technical specifications.
  • Ensuring daily contact with group factories and external suppliers, tracking delivery schedules and production progress, managing exceptions to meet customer deadlines, and keep relationships with new suppliers.
  • Participating in regular inventory control processes, logistics performance analysis, warehouse coordination meetings, asset management reviews, and working with the finance team on payment processing.

Qualifications for the role
  • You are highly skilled in procurement processes, logistics management, warehouse operations, and supply chain-related tools and methodologies.
  • You have 3+ years of experience in procurement, warehouse management, logistics coordination, or supply chain roles. (previous experience as a Procurement Specialist, Logistics Coordinator, or Warehouse Supervisor with SAP or other ERP systems is preferred)
  • You are passionate about supplier relationship management, inventory optimization, and cross-functional collaboration, with demonstrated problem-solving, negotiation, and communication capabilities.
  • You are at ease communicating in Mandarin and English; proficiency in both languages is essential for this role as you will interact with group factories, international suppliers, and cross-functional teams.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Retail Department Supervisor
description:
TJ Maxx

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: AI Engineer
description:
HOFOR er i gang med at etablere en fælles AI-platform, der skal gøre det muligt at udvikle, afprøve og sætte AI-løsninger sikkert i drift på tværs af organisationen. Vi søger en AI Engineer, der kan udvikle de første løsninger på platformen og omsætte konkrete forretningsbehov til velfungerende AI-agenter, assistenter og integrationer. 



 Fra AI-idé til løsning i drift
 
Du bliver en del af AI & BI Udvikling og får en central rolle i at udvikle, integrere og modne AI-løsninger, der skaber værdi i organisationen. Du kommer til at arbejde i Microsoft Foundry og relevante Azure-services, men du står ikke alene med platformen, du samarbejder tæt med blandt andet cloud-, arkitektur- og sikkerhedsteamet samt forretningen. 



 Du får stor indflydelse på de tekniske løsninger, kort vej fra idé til produktion og mulighed for at udvikle komponenter, der kan genbruges på tværs af organisationen. 



 Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver at: 


 
	
 Udvikle AI-agenter, assistenter, RAG-løsninger og genbrugelige AI-komponenter med Microsoft Foundry og relevante Azure-services 

	
 Udvikle backend-løsninger, AI-baserede værktøjer og integrationer med Python og API’er 

	
 Integrere AI-løsninger med bl.a. ServiceNow, Microsoft 365 og andre forretningssystemer 

	
 Udvikle løsninger, der anvender organisationens data og viden sikkert, kontrolleret og dokumenteret 

	
 Teste og evaluere AI-løsningernes kvalitet, relevans, sikkerhed og performance før og efter idriftsættelse 

	
 Bidrage til automatiseret deployment, monitorering og stabil drift af AI-løsninger i samarbejde med platform-, cloud- og sikkerhedsteams 

	
 Dokumentere løsninger og udvikle komponenter og mønstre, der kan genbruges i kommende AI-projekter 

 


 Erfaring med AI- og softwareudvikling
 
Du har solid erfaring med softwareudvikling og med at udvikle AI-løsninger, der kan integreres med eksisterende systemer og bringes sikkert i drift. 



 Det vigtigste er, at du kan omsætte et forretningsbehov til en teknisk AI-løsning og selv bidrage til udvikling, integration, test og produktionsmodning. 



 Derudover forventer vi, at du: 


 
	
 Har erfaring inden for Python, API’er og backendudvikling 

	
 Har erfaring med Microsoft Foundry, Azure eller en tilsvarende platform til udvikling af AI-løsninger 

	
 Har arbejdet med generativ AI, f.eks. AI-agenter, RAG, værktøjskald eller integration af sprogmodeller
