 Vi søger en ny elev, der kan begynde på mejeristuddannelsen i januar 2027. 

   

 Vil du lære et traditionsrigt håndværk fra bunden, og er du samtidig interesseret i IT og avanceret teknologi? 

   

 Som mejeritrainee i Arla bliver du ekspert i både moderne og traditionelle mejerimaskiner samt får solid indsigt i hele produktionsprocessen. Du kommer til at arbejde i en stor, international virksomhed, hvor håndværk, moderne teknik og kendte mærkevarer bliver en del af din dagligdag. Kickstart din karriere i en global og bæredygtig virksomhed, der bringer sundhed og inspiration ud i verden på naturlig vis, og vær med til at skabe fremtidens mejeri sammen med os.
 
 Om Mejeritraineeuddannelsen  

 Uddannelsen til mejerist er en erhvervsuddannelse, der veksler mellem skoleophold og praktik. Der kommer fart på din hverdag, når du lærer om moderne mejeridrift. 
 
 Dit uddannelsesforløb varer 3 år og 1 måned, og du får løn fra første dag. Din elevtid vil veksle mellem skoleophold på Kold College i Odense og praktik på mindst to mejerier 

 I praktikken bliver du en del af holdet i produktionen og lærer at fremstille mejeriprodukter fra bunden 

 Du kommer med andre ord i nærkontakt med produkterne og får næse for kvalitet 

 Samtidig får du får et godt indblik i moderne mejeridrift og produktionsprocesser og bliver en del af en strømlinet produktion, hvor lean og optimeringsprojekter er en del af hverdagen 
 
   

 Den teoretiske del af uddannelsen består af 55 ugers skoleophold på Kold College, hvor du får venskaber, oplevelser og læring for livet. Du lærer bl.a. om produktionsudstyr, produktkvalitet, logistik, miljøstyring, hygiejne, mikrobiologi, fysik og kemi. Uddannelsen afsluttes med en svendeprøve.
   

 En uddannelse der åbner døre 

 Mejeristuddannelsen giver gode jobmuligheder både i og uden for mejeriindustrien. Danske mejerister ligger klart i top inden for deres felt, og klarer du dig godt under din uddannelse, vil der også være gode muligheder for videre ansættelse hos Arla. Her vil vi naturligvis støtte op om din videre faglige udvikling og dygtiggørelse. Du kan også vælge at videreuddanne dig som f.eks. procesteknolog, levnedsmiddelingeniør eller mejeriingeniør. 
   

 Om mejeriet 

 På Gjesing Mejeri producerer vi ca. 7.500 tons Blåskimmel- og Rødkitost, som sælges til markeder i hele verden, i høj grad under Castello® mærket. Som mejeritrainee på Gjesing Mejeri kan du se frem til en afvekslende hverdag, hvor der er god mulighed for at tilegne dig en solid viden om mejeriteknologi, driften af mejeriudstyr, samt udførelsen af driftskontroller og kvalitets analyser. 

   

  Du vil få en afvekslende hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver, som vil give dig en god forståelse for de mange forskellige processer i fremstillingen af skimmeloste. Noget af arbejdet er fysisk krævende, og der vil forekomme skiftende arbejdstider, da vi opererer næsten hele døgnet -og ind imellem også i weekender.   

   

  Du kan desuden se frem til at samarbejde med dygtige og flittige kolleger i et sikkert og behageligt arbejdsmiljø. Vi har stor fokus på medarbejder trivsel samt gode arbejdsforhold. 

   

 Hvem er du?
   
 
 For at blive en del af holdet, skal du have bestået folkeskolens afgangsprøve og have en naturlig interesse for de naturvidenskabelige fag; særligt matematik, fysik og kemi 

 Vi forventer også, at du er ansvarsbevidst, en teamplayer og brænder for udfordringer 
 
   

 Ansøgning og kontakt 

 Hvis du vil gribe denne spændende mulighed, bedes du sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt via nedenstående link. Vi kigger ansøgningerne i gennem løbende og lukker stillingen, så snart den rette kandidat er fundet.   

   

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte; 

   

 Elevansvarlig  Louise Kragh pr. mail  loked@arlafoods.com , eller Ostemester Nicolaj Miskow mail  nimis@arlafoods.com

title: Director, RA Global Regulatory Strategy

Leads preparation and maintenance of global regulatory product strategies for assigned products. title: MSL/Senior MSL, Hematology/Oncology (Northwest)
description:
The MSL/Senior MSL (MSLs), is a field based scientific expert that strategically supports the scientific and business objectives of Hematology/Oncology across the product life cycle. MSLs are the primary communicators of AbbVie science within a specific geography with healthcare professionals. The MSLs are the field scientific experts on given disease states and treatment options within Hematology/Oncology. They combine strong business acumen, clinical expertise, market awareness, and serve as a conduit of information to a cross functional customer base internally within AbbVie. Based on therapeutic needs and product life cycles, teams may focus on certain responsibilities, including clinical development and pipeline support. This MSL position is an individual contributor which will learn and develop the capabilities and responsibilities of the role as defined by AbbVie Medical Affairs.

Responsibilities:

Execute High Impact Territory Initiatives:

  • Develops, executes and maintains high impact territory plans, including HCP and Investigator engagement plans in alignment with Hematology, Oncology medical and scientific objectives with a focus on quality. Learns to use data and analytics to seek out and maximize opportunities within their territory.
  • Identifies, gains access to, and develops professional customer centric based relationships with external experts (EEs) in therapeutic areas within assigned geography.
  • Delivers on territory plan objectives, meets assigned project deadlines, and achieves annual functional goals. Generates and documents meaningful data point observations (DPOs).
  • Practices core capabilities in segmentation, DPOs, as well as optimal resource utilization.
  • Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and Procedure, including accurate and timely documentation as it relates to HCP interactions.
  • Scientific Resource to External HCPs and other Stakeholders:
    • Provides education relative to disease state, therapeutic landscape and AbbVie products across the product lifecycle to healthcare providers and researchers.
  • Therapeutic Disease State, Landscape, and Asset Expert:
    • Continually educates self on market issues/trends, product knowledge, and new therapeutic areas of interest as it pertains to specific business responsibilities, including creating awareness and relationships for AbbVie in the Medical community.
    • Supports research initiatives across development at the request of R&D to include, but not limited to, site evaluation and identification, recruitment, investigator meetings, external expert identification, and external collaboration management.
  • Maintain Cross-Functional Field Partnerships:
    • Creates, maintains, and collaborates in relationships with Cross-Functional partnerships, including, but not limited to: in field commercial teams, engagement with site management and monitoring and clinical research associates, the Therapeutic Area, HEOR, and with the Medical Outcome Science Liaisons. Works with in-field commercial teams, as appropriate, to develop and execute Account plans designed to support and meet shared business objectives.

Territory includes: Washington, Oregon, Montana, Idaho, Nevada, Alaska

  • Advanced degree preferred in a relevant scientific discipline. Doctorate strongly preferred in a health science or clinical discipline. Significant clinical and/or industry experience in relevant therapeutic area may be accepted in lieu of education requirements.
  • Greater than or equal to 2 years of clinical, scientific/research, or industry related experience or equivalent preferred.
  • The MSL must possess problem solving and analytic skills to be able to identify, and translate specific territory and corporate needs, into an action that will achieve objectives.
  • Exhibits leadership attributes that align with company-wide initiatives such as: All for One AbbVie, Clear and Courageous, Make Possibilities Real, Agile and Accountable, and Decide Smart and Sure.
  • Ability to quickly learn and apply foundational skills in Scientific Storytelling, Identifying Mobilizers, Powerful Questions, and Active Listening.
  • An essential requirement of the position is to meet health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain entry into facilities and organizations that in your assigned territory. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, and proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases.
  • Must be willing to travel up to 75% of the time.

The candidate must live in the territory or willing to self-relocate within the territory.

Job grade, level, and title will be determined by the selected candidate’s credentials, education, and experience.

title: Principal Engineer

Job Description

Job Title

Principal Engineer

Join Amadeus in shaping cutting-edge Customer Relationship Management (CRM) solutions that enhance enterprise customer experiences. In this role, you’ll work with talented teams, contribute to end-to-end architecture, and help drive our digital transformation initiatives.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Define technical architecture, including data models, integration, and security design.

  • Facilitate solution design sessions and ensure alignment between technical and business goals.

  • Implement CRM capabilities across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Sales, Service, Marketing, Customer Insights, Field Service) and SAP CRM.

  • Configure entities and security in Microsoft Dataverse, and develop solutions with Power Platform tools (Power Apps, Power Automate).

  • Design integrations using Microsoft Azure services and APIs.

  • Integrate SAP CRM with SAP ERP systems, including ECC and S/4HANA, leveraging CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), BTP (Business Technology Platform), and Integration Suite.

We welcome professionals eager to make a difference in the digital experience space. Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience with both Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and SAP CRM ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of Power Platform, Azure Active Directory, Azure Logic Apps, and other Azure tools.

  • Understanding of SAP technologies, including integration with core ERP systems.

  • Practical experience designing scalable CRM architecture and integrations.

  • Experience working in collaborative environments, engaging with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with modern development practices and willingness to learn emerging technologies.

(Extensive experience in CRM solution architecture is expected, typically gained over 10+ years, but equivalent capability from diverse paths is welcome.)

What we can offer you

🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams


Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Scaffolding Supervisor-OSBL
description:

Wood is currently recruiting for a Scaffolding Supervisor to join the team for an immediate start, supporting construction (OSBL Areas) activities on a major EPCM project for a key client project in Chonburi, Thailand. This role is offered as an initial 12-month contract with the opportunity to continue as an ongoing, longer-term assignment and available for Thai National.

Designing the future. Transforming the World.

Wood has a deep history pioneering technical expertise globally for more than 160 years, from the North Sea to the Gulf of Thailand, and is now embarking on an exciting new chapter. Building on 40 years of Engineering excellence in Thailand, Wood invites you to join our dedicated team, to shape the future of the energy industry in Asia Pacific and beyond. Join us in the heart of Chonburi, within a vibrant and fast-growing hub on Thailand’s Eastern Seaboard where you will enjoy being close to major industrial and energy centres with the lifestyle advantages of a coastal location. Perfectly positioned within reach of Bangkok and minutes from the coastline of Pattaya, our office is the ideal blend of career opportunity and coastal lifestyle.

At Wood Thailand you will thrive in a collegiate team culture by partnering with likeminded, agile industry peers to inspire with ingenuity and create new possibilities.

What we can offer

  • Excellent rates, with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
  • Ongoing work on interesting projects delivered in partnership to leaders of industry across energy and materials markets
  • Global connections, join an inclusive and diverse international community of inquisitive minds and recognised industry innovators, partnering to create new possibilities
  • Flexible working arrangements balance client, team and individual needs with opportunities for hybrid and remote working
  • Commitment to your Wellbeing, with annual contribution to Health Insurance and free 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business

#LI-Onsite

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
Neho is one of Switzerland’s leading real estate brokerage companies, redefining the industry through innovation. We combine human expertise with powerful digital solutions to deliver a faster, more transparent, and more efficient real estate experience. Our approach has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the SEF Award 2023. What truly sets us apart is our fixed-price model, offering clients a modern alternative to traditional commission-based services, powered by advanced technology.

We are looking for an AI product engineer to lead, hands-on, how we put AI to work. You will build the agents that take the manual, repetitive parts of buying, financing and selling a home off people’s plates, so our experts can spend their time on the moments that matter.

You will not start from zero. We have a compelling vision and working prototypes. Your job is to take this pattern from prototype to product: real agents, real users, measured outcomes. You will get a first agent into production within your first months and grow a pipeline from there.

This is a zero-to-one role with real ownership and visibility reporting directly to our CTO. If you love turning a manual process into working software that ships in weeks rather than quarters, you will feel at home here.

Workload: 80 - 100%

Your Tasks

  • Find the value: Spend real time with product managers, advisors, real estate agents and operations specialists, map their workflows, identify the agent use cases that remove the most measurable toil across the client journey or internal operations - prioritise by outcome

  • Build the agents, hands-on: Design, build, test and ship agents yourself: use agent frameworks & platforms where they are faster, real code where they are not

  • Own the delivery surfaces: Take our prototypes to product, and evolve how agents reach users: in-product, in chat, and later on mobile

  • Build the MCP layer: Wrap the stable domain APIs in thin, well-designed MCP tools your agents act through. You are the first and most demanding consumer of our API-first architecture.

  • Drive the requirements to the teams: Specify the APIs your agents and surfaces need from the domain-owning engineering teams, who build and expose them; you consume clean contracts rather than reaching into systems directly

  • Choose the platform with Platform: Lead the selection of the technology & platforms jointly with the Platform team, accounting for security, Swiss/EU data protection, cost and operability

  • Ship on rails, within the guardrails: Deploy on the company’s fenced, containerised, API-only path; instrument and evaluate your agents; respect data-sensitivity tiers

  • Hand off when an agent grows up: When an agent becomes revenue-critical or touches critical client or financial data, hand it to Engineering for hardening and long-term ownership, and keep building the next one

  • Measure outcomes: Track effort removed, cycle-time and conversion impact, and adoption by the people the agents serve. Not the number of agents shipped

What this role is not

  • Not the builder of core APIs: Domain engineering teams own and expose the stable APIs; you drive the requirements, build the thin MCP wrappers on top, and consume the contracts

  • Not the platform/infra owner: Platform owns runtime, deployment, observability and security; you build on top

  • Not an AI services desk: You are not here to build bespoke tools for every department; you build the agents that move our priorities, and help others self-serve safely on the sanctioned path

What we offer

  • End-to-end ownership of your product with the authority to drive implementation, challenge the status quo, and own the outcome from conception to launch of new features

  • A unique career opportunity to join a fast-growing and award-winning scale-up within the real estate industry

  • Shape the future of real estate tech in Switzerland: Have a direct impact on Neho’s growth, and deliver efficient, and scalable AI tools that give Neho a competitive edge

  • Enjoy flat hierarchies, quick decision-making processes, and the freedom to work autonomously and leave your mark

  • Be part of an energetic, forward-thinking team spanning our offices in Lausanne and Zurich as well as our remote engineering team in Romania

  • Thrive in an entrepreneurial, innovative culture that values transparency, fairness, and strong team support

  • Competitive benefits including 5 weeks of vacation + extra days based on tenure, fully paid maternity/paternity leave, remote work options, regular team events, and more!

What you bring

  • Fluent in the AI stack: You've worked with the modern AI stack in some form (direct model APIs, agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK, orchestration platforms like Dify/n8n). We care about what you shipped, not which tool you used.

  • A developer at heart: You have a software engineering background and have been writing and owning production code for years. Which specific language doesn't matter to us.

  • Comfortable across the stack: Whether that's PHP, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python, you're comfortable building applications, APIs and random other things like browser extensions or even mobile apps.

  • Pragmatic about tools: You reach for agent platforms and AI tooling where they're faster, and write real code where they're not. Comfortable with MCP, webhooks, prompting and streaming UIs.

  • Disciplined about evaluation: You have shipped LLM-based systems to real users: you write evals, design quadrails, think in failure modes, and know when an agent must refuse to answer. In a regulated, document-heavy domain this is the core skill, not a nice extra

  • A discovery person: You are comfortable sitting next to an advisor for an afternoon, mapping a messy human workflow, and earning the trust of the people whose toil you are removing

  • Product-minded: You prioritise by outcome, validate before building, and are willing to kill an agent that does not move a metric

  • Fast and pragmatic: You can get a first useful agent into production in weeks and iterate.

  • Safety-aware: You respect data sensitivity (client, financial, identity) and work within guardrails rather than around them

  • Language: Strong communication skills in English, French or German is considered a plus

Nice To Have

  • Experience with real estate, mortgages, fintech or another regulated, document-heavy domain

  • Familiarity with Swiss/EU data-protection expectations

  • Mobile development experience (for the later delivery surfaces)

What success looks like as an AI Product Engineer at Neho

  • Month 3: first agent live in production, with measured effort removed.

  • Month 6: a handful of agents in production across the journey and internal ops, delivered through a central delivery system and used daily by agents, ops or advisors; the platform choice settled with the Platform team; a clear, prioritised backlog.

  • Month 12: agents are a normal, trusted way we remove toil; the hand-off path to Engineering is working; the case is made for a small agent pod if volume warrants it.

If this sounds like the right professional opportunity for you, then apply now with your CV in English.

Please note that we are only considering applications submitted through our career page:

title: Gymnasiejob.dk - Vikariat i matematik på Odder Gymnasium til besættelse hurtigst muligt
description:
Vikariat i matematik på Odder Gymnasium til besættelse hurtigst muligt 
                
 
                    
 Der vil på Odder Gymnasium være et deltidsvikariat i matematik til besættelse hurtigst muligt. Vikariatet dækker 2-3 hold i matematik i efteråret og vil primært omfatte undervisning i 1.g. Den præcise ansættelsesgrad vil afhænge af ansøgers profil, men er på mindst 1/3 stilling. Man vil få tilknyttet en erfaren faglærer som mentor. 



 Samtaler afholdes løbende i ansøgningsperioden.  



 Om Odder Gymnasium 



 Odder Gymnasium er et lokalforankret gymnasium med ca. 500 elever fordelt på 6-7 klasser pr. årgang og ca. 55 ansatte. Gymnasiet har en stærk og bred profil med et højt fagligt niveau og prioriterer at udbyde og oprette studieretninger inden for både de naturvidenskabelige, samfundsvidenskabelige, sproglige og kreative områder.  



 På Odder Gymnasium er der en stærk skolekultur, en høj elevtrivsel og et meget engageret lærerkollegium. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed i de enkelte fag og i samspillet mellem fagene, og vi prioriterer at kunne rumme elever med forskellige baggrunde, interesser og drømme for videre uddannelse ved at give udfordringer til både de dygtige elever og til de elever, som skal have lidt ekstra hjælp.  



 Skolens tre grundværdier faglighed, fællesskab og engagement er styrende for vores måde at drive skole på. Vores udgangspunkt er, at en forudsætning for høj faglighed, stærke fællesskaber og stort engagement er, at både elever og medarbejdere på Odder Gymnasium trives. Derfor er respekt for den enkelte nøgleord - både respekt for den enkeltes evner og muligheder og respekt for hinanden som ligeværdige individer. Vi er bevidste om, at vi alle er vigtige for at skabe den skole, vi gerne vil have. Skolens medarbejdere er helt afgørende for, at skolens vision, værdier og strategiske indsatser kommer til live og får betydning for vores måde at være skole på. Det forudsætter dygtige medarbejdere, der trives og samarbejder professionelt om kerneopgaven både formelt og uformelt på alle niveauer. 



 Flere oplysninger om Odder Gymnasium kan findes på skolens hjemmeside:  www.odder-gym.dk .  



 Ansøgning og CV med dokumentation for gennemførte eksaminer, evt. pædagogikum samt eventuelle referencer sendes elektronisk via www.gymnasiejob.dk senest mandag d. 17. august. Samtaler afholdes løbende i ansøgningsperioden. 



 Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse på telefon 86 54 45 00 eller på mail og@odder-gym.dk.  



 Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

title: Rakennussiivooja, Jyväskylä
description:
Rakennussiivooja - reipasta tekijää tarvitaan!
Rakennussiivoojana työtehtäviisi kuuluu rakennustyömaan siisteydestä ja järjestyksestä huolehtiminen työmaan eri vaiheissa. Tehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa rakennusjätteen ja materiaalien keräämistä ja lajittelua, työmaan yleistä siivousta, pölyn ja lian poistamista sekä työskentelyalueiden pitämistä turvallisina ja kulkukelpoisina.
Haemme oma-aloitteista ja reipasta tekijää, joka viihtyy fyysisessä työssä. Arvostamme erityisesti hyvää asennetta ja huolellista työotetta – pitkä kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä. Rakennussiivous edellyttää tarkkuutta ja siistiä työskentelyä, ja kokemus loppusiivouksista katsotaan eduksi.

Työssä edellytetään:

* täysi-ikäisyyttä.
* voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia.
* suomen kielen taitoa.

Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus helpottaa työmaille kulkemista, mutta ei ole edellytys. Useat työkohteet sijaitsevat julkisten kulkuyhteyksien varrella.

Meillä pärjää työntekijä, joka osaa toimia tiimissä ja arvostaa hyvää yhteistyötä. Rakennusalalla menestyy, kun on halua oppia ja kehittyä. Työ on fyysisesti aktiivista, joten hyvä peruskunto auttaa jaksamaan. Kädentaidot ja rohkeus käyttää työkaluja ovat hyödyksi, ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattaminen on ehdoton edellytys työmaalla.

Rakennussiivoojan työ on keikkatyötä, joka tuo vapautta arkeen. Saat itse valita, milloin haluat työskennellä ja milloin pitää taukoa – työ mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi.Voit yhdistää työn joustavasti esimerkiksi opiskeluun tai vapaa-aikaan. Palkka kertyy tehtyjen tuntien mukaan, ja työ tarjoaa vaihtelua eri työmaiden ja tehtävien kautta. Samalla kartutat verkostoja ja tapaat uusia ihmisiä.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä työskentelemään vaihtelevien työtehtävien parissa ja tutustumaan erilaisiin työmaihin! Tarjoamme kaikille työntekijöillemme vähintään rakennusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan, joka on yleisesti rakennussiivoojan tehtävissä 12,59 €/h - 14,19 €/h, toki huomioon ottaen rakennusalan osaamisesi. Lisäksi saat kauttamme hyvät työvarusteet.

Rakennussiivoojan tehtävä on tärkeä osa työmaan sujuvuutta. Olit sitten urasi alussa tai kokeneempi tekijä, jätä pikainen hakemus järjestelmämme kautta jo tänään! Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja valintoja keikoille teemme heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Yhdellä hakemuksella ja haastattelulla saat ovet auki monipuolisille työmaillemme!

Lisätietoja (arkisin klo 9-16):

Hanna Jaatinen, Rekrytoija

hanna.jaatinen@workpower.fi / 040 531 4419

Avainsanat: rakennussiivooja, raksa, rakennussiivous, Jyväskylä, Keski-Suomi

WorkPower on vastuullinen, luotettava ja työllistävä kumppani työelämässä. Me tarjoamme yllättävän hyvää työtä. Toimi jo tänään, haut ovat käynnissä 24/7.

title: Product manager - property insights and custom solutions
description:
• Work directly with ANZ analytics and credit risk teams to deepen the value of a leading property data product.
  • Turn customer insights into scalable data products for lenders and brokers across Australia.
  • Permanent role based in Melbourne or Sydney

We're REA

With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named one of Australia’s Best Workplaces four times since 2021 — including third place in 2025 — plus Best Workplace for Women in 2023 and Best Workplace in Technology in 2024 and 2025. These listings are testament to every person who helps make REA a great place to work.

Where the team fits in

This Product Manager role sits within PropTrack’s Mortgage Solutions tribe, in the product team focused on creating integrated, highly effective data insights solutions which improve processing times across the mortgage application and credit risk monitoring processes.

You will work closely with:

  • Commercial & Customer Success – to understand pipeline health, segment needs and go‑to‑market motions for credit unions, fintechs, banks and broker groups.
  • Design (CX/UX) – to deeply understand user journeys and design high‑performing experiences for mortgage application process and credit risk.
  • Data Science & Analytics – to measure funnel performance, optimise targeting and experimentation, and surface actionable insights.
  • Engineering & Delivery – to ship quality product improvements at pace in cross‑functional squads.

What the role is all about

You'll help drive faster mortgage application processing and stronger credit risk monitoring across PropTrack's mortgage solutions products, supporting lenders and brokers to make better-informed decisions.

The role combines a deeply embedded customer partnership with a broader market lens. You'll:

  • Build an informed view of how Tier 1-3 banks, credit unions, non-bank lenders, fintechs and broker groups use mortgage data, insights and workflows.
  • Understand how customer needs are evolving across mortgage applications, collateral assessment, credit risk monitoring and audit processes.
  • Partner with Data, CX/UX and Commercial to run discovery interviews, generative research and experiments across priority customer segments.
  • Own a roadmap across acquisition, conversion and retention, covering data, features, journeys, APIs and the core systems that support key customers.
  • Use product usage, funnel performance and customer feedback to identify opportunities, prioritising them through customer value, commercial impact, data and strategic alignment.
  • Work with Engineering, Design and Data in an agile squad to turn customer problems into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
  • Run experiments, including AI-assisted prototypes and A/B tests, to improve measures such as time to yes, valuation wastage, product uptake and customer outcomes.
  • Identify ANZ use cases that can become MVPs and scalable products for banks, credit unions, fintechs, non-bank lenders and broker groups.
  • Contribute to customer meetings, pitches, strategic account reviews, pricing, packaging and go-to-market opportunities.

The role begins with a strong focus on deepening the value of an established product and customer relationship. As your understanding of the customer and market grows, you'll help turn validated use cases into a broader suite of scalable property data solutions.

Who we’re looking for

You'll be a confident, customer-oriented product manager who can connect financial services problems with practical, data-informed product decisions.

You'll bring:

  • Five or more years' experience in product management or an equivalent role.
  • Experience in lending, credit risk, financial services, B2B SaaS, data products or a related environment.
  • Strong understanding of residential or commercial lending and credit risk concepts, including the three Cs of lending: character, capacity and collateral.
  • Confidence working with data, metrics and banking or credit information; you do not need to be a hands-on coder.
  • Experience with customer discovery, product strategy, generative research and experimentation.
  • Interest in AI tooling, AI product prototyping and the potential of data to improve lending decisions.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills, including the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and simplify complex problems.
  • Sound commercial judgement, strong prioritisation skills and the ability to make progress in ambiguity.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to working across engineering, data, design, commercial and customer success.

Experience with banks, credit unions, non-bank lenders, fintechs, brokers or financial services analytics teams will be highly regarded. If you have the product mindset, customer confidence and curiosity to learn, we'd like to hear from you even if you don't meet every point.

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.

Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Join our Talent Neighbourhood

Keen to be part of REA but didn't find a perfect match with this opportunity? Perhaps the timing isn't right? You should join our Talent Neighbourhood!

We are looking for a motivated and analytical professionals to join our GenAI Center of Excellence at State Street. On-premise

Role Summary & Role Description

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Data Architect to design, implement and manage ServiceNow solutions for CSDM, CMDB Taxonomy and Data Warehousing. This position requires technical architecture, best practices and delivery expertise and strong knowledge of the baseline ServiceNow capabilities to ensure the smooth operation and continual enhancement of the ServiceNow platform.

title: Wealth Advisor - PNC Wealth Management
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Wealth Advisor in PNC Wealth Management, you will be based in Wisconsin.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Consults on investment and insurance strategies, as well as the development of financial plans for clients. Grows and retains an investment and insurance book of business. Owns the client experience, efficiently handling sales and service, identifying sales and/or executing opportunities and making referrals to internal business partners as appropriate.
  • Acquires, expands and maintains client relationships through business development and client networking. Grows client loyalty and share of wallet through an exceptional client experience. Applies product and procedural knowledge to solve client problems appropriately and efficiently.
  • Develops and implements investment and insurance strategies for clients. Determines the best products to support such strategies. Presents sound financial recommendations and guidance to clients. Establishes individual financial plans based on client financial needs and objectives. Monitors financial plans and recommends changes as needed.
  • Actively and regularly coaches and educates internal business partners to identify investment opportunities. Drives investment education and visibility among internal business partners. Shows urgency with activities and leads by example. Has regular and effective communication with internal and external partners to build strong relationships that drive referral activity.
  • Regularly meets with internal business partners to communicate and review business results and pipeline management. Meets service level agreements on lead and referral follow up. Adheres to all applicable laws, regulations, policies and guidelines.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Client Prospecting, Client Relationship Building, Credit Risk Analysis, Customer Engagement, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Investment Banking, Public Speaking, Relationship Building, Relationship Management

Coaching Others, Customer Experience Management., Customer Retention, Effective Communications, Interpersonal Relationships, Managing Multiple Priorities, Prospecting., Sales Tasks And Activities, Selling.

In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

FINRA Series 7 and 66 (or 63,65) required. Life and Health Insurance required.

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit .

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event. Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
   




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

title: AI Product Manager
description:
About Freehand

Most AI companies are building tools. We're building the worker.

Freehand's AI agents replace the human decision-making and coordination layer that sits above enterprise software — handling the analysis, negotiation, prioritization, and execution that previously required armies of logisticians / supply chain professionals.

Our customers include Apple, Meta, GE, Pfizer, J&J, Schlumberger, Cardinal Health, and Unilever. They chose us because we have a fundamentally different answer to what enterprise software looks like when AI can do the job.

If you want to work on something that matters, with people who will push you to be sharper than you thought you could be, this is the place.

The Role & The Team
As an AI Product Manager at Freehand- Teams for Business Spend Management, you’ll define and deliver the future of autonomous p2p workflows. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, UX, and go-to-market teams to ship production-grade AI agents that execute and optimize complex spend workflows with precision, reliability, and explainability. You’ll work directly with CXOs at Fortune 100 companies to understand pain points and convert them into product innovations that displace traditional outsourcing, staffing and SaaS models with intelligent, self-evolving agents. This is a foundational leadership role with scope to define vision, architecture, and roadmap, and execute against it, for one of the most critical domains in enterprise automations, at the cutting edge of generative AI.

What You'll Do

  • Own product vision, architecture, and execution for Freehand’s AI Teams for

Spend Management across key use cases:

· Invoice validation & matching

· Vendor onboarding & collaboration

· Contract and compliance management

· Dispute resolution

· Cross-border payments & remittance

  • Define agent design patterns—multi-capability prompting, tool orchestration, retrieval pipelines, fallback logic, and policy hierarchies—that balance accuracy, reliability, and real-world business context.

  • Ensure end-to-end observability, including agent health, performance monitoring, confidence scoring, and auditability of decisions.

  • Partner with AI/ML and data eng teams to build closed-loop training pipelines and eval sets that drive continual improvement via human-in-the-loop feedback,signal instrumentation, and structured reasoning.

  • Drive high-fidelity UX for AI interactions, enabling explainable, proactive, and intuitive agent experiences across interfaces (UI, email, chat, APIs).

  • Lead technical conversations with enterprise architects and strategic conversations with CFOs, CIOs, and Chief Procurement Officers at Fortune 100 companies.

  • Author clear, actionable documentation (PRDs, solution briefs, agent blueprints) and deliver compelling product demos to internal and external stakeholders.

Who You Are

  • 4–6years in B2B product management with at least 2 years working on first products

  • Experience launching agentic AI products involving:

  • Multi-agent systems with explicit roles & policies mirroring enterprise auth

  • Strong understanding of AI evaluation techniques (factuality, grounding, latency, hallucination minimization) and methods for improving agent accuracy and reliability in production.

  • Proven experience working with enterprise-scale data systems — invoice data, procurement records, contract metadata, FX/tax engines — with deep appreciation for governance, sensitivity, and compliance

title: Retail Supervisor Full-Time Cannington WA
description:
Join us and experience Bunnings from the other side of the counter!

What’s in it for you when you’re part of our team:

  • Team discount at Bunnings and other Wesfarmers brands including Kmart, Target and Officeworks to name a few

  • Free standard OnePass membership

  • Access to over 100+ exclusive team member benefits across health, shopping, travel and stay, wealth, work and leave

  • 12 weeks paid parental leave, regardless of gender

  • Fun stuff like annual festive gifts, discounted food and drinks at our Bunnings Cafe, and travelling store team member opportunities

  • We’re genuinely invested in your career and no matter where you start with us, that pathway is yours to build

About the role:


As a Retail Supervisor at Bunnings, you'll be the go-to and support for the store's senior leadership team. You'll keep the energy high and the workflow smooth in your designated department. By leading by example, you'll work with your team to ensure every day is a success and operations run like a well-oiled machine. Get ready to lead, inspire, and make a real impact!


We provide an adult pay rate for 18 years of age and above at $30.78 per hour for this role.


What’s involved:

  • Lead by example by demonstrating best service practices and support the team in providing friendly and helpful advice to customers

  • Coach the team through guidance on appropriate service behaviours

  • Helping onboard and train new team members by providing training and induction support

  • Merchandising standards to ensure all merchandising meets business requirements

  • Managing and coordinating stock effectively.

Who we're looking for:

Our ideal candidate will share a genuine passion for retail and customer service and be complimentary to the store leadership team. You will have previous experience supervising a team in a fast-paced environment, have open communication and a genuine interest in coaching and developing others.

This role is a great opportunity for an aspiring retail leader to grow their leadership career in a supportive team environment. Surrounded by experienced mentors, you'll have the chance to develop your leadership skills, take on exciting challenges, and make a real impact.

You’ll need:

  • The ability to guide, support, coach and provide feedback, so as to bring the best out of your team

  • To be results driven and a team player

  • Be approachable and confident, creating positive experiences when interacting with our customers

  • Have an eagerness and ongoing enthusiasm to learn about new products

  • To be on your feet assisting with customers across a wide range of retail hours

When you’re ready to give this opportunity a Red Hot Go, all you’ll need to do is:

  • Submit an application and complete an online chat interview (20 minutes)

  • If successful, next step includes an online video interview (15 minutes)

  • If you’re a match, we’ll invite you to an onsite meet and greet with our leaders (20 minutes)

You’ll be part of a workplace where you’ll feel like you belong.


We love the diversity across our teams, brought together in an inclusive culture guided by our values. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. We strongly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in shaping a workplace that celebrates First Nations voices, perspectives, and contributions. Please note, you must be age 15 or over to apply for a role at Bunnings.

We’re all about fairness at Bunnings, and our team’s here to support you every step of the way. If you need any adjustments, just let us know - we’re here to help. If you’ve got the experience, skills, and drive to grow - but don’t quite nail every part of the job description - we still want to hear from you. For support, contact us at jobs@bunnings.com.au.

Bunnings reserves the right to close job advertisements at any time, so we encourage you to apply early. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, as we have a dedicated internal Talent Acquisition team managing all hiring processes.

About Us

Bunnings is the leading retailer of home improvement and lifestyle products in Australia and New Zealand. We're proud to support project builders, commercial tradespeople and the housing industry through our network of stores, trade centres, frame and truss sites and online.

At Bunnings, our purpose is simple: we’re here to inspire people to have a red hot go! Whether that's backing our team to grow, supporting customers to take on new projects, or helping communities make a real difference. By joining our passionate and diverse team, you will be part of a culture that encourages you to roll up your sleeves and build something great together. If you’re ready to have a go, apply today.

Please note if you are offered a role with us, background checks may be required. This can include police, employment, medical and qualification checks. If a police check search returns a criminal record, Bunnings will assess whether the record impacts your ability to perform the key requirements of the role.

title: Associate - Project Planning
description:
Associate– Project Planning is responsible for leading, developing, and continuously improving the Project Planning team across the PMCM India offices. The role ensures that planners are effectively utilised, aligned with project priorities, and consistently delivering high‑quality, timely, and accurate project schedules and planning outputs. This position oversees end‑to‑end project planning processes, ensures adherence to planning standards, governance, and industry best practices, and drives operational excellence through proactive workload planning, performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Establish, refine, and govern project planning processes across all PMCM India teams, ensuring consistency, compliance, and continuous improvement.

- Coach, mentor, and develop Principal Planners, Senior Planners and Planners, raising capability levels and promoting consistency across teams.

- Drive continuous improvement in planning processes, including automation, template improvements, and better utilisation of planning tool -Primavera P6.

- Plan resources, manage utilisation, and allocate workloads effectively across planning teams to ensure operational continuity and balanced capacity.

- Track planning team performance, schedule quality, progress updates, and KPIs, and communicate status updates and risks to Project Managers and UK Planning leads.

- Monitor and audit adherence to planning governance standards, proactively addressing gaps through coaching, corrective actions, and updated workflows.

- Support project delivery planning by collaborating with Project Managers, Engineering teams, and UK Planning leads to ensure required schedule information is issued on time and meets quality expectations.

- Oversee baseline development, schedule updates, look‑ahead schedules, progress measurement, variance analysis, and forecasting.

- Ensure rigorous quality checks on all schedules, validating compliance with procedures, WBS structures, coding standards, templates, and reporting requirements.

- Foster a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and service excellence, ensuring the team delivers reliable and high‑value planning support to UK and internal project teams.

Key Competencies / Skills

- Expert‑level proficiency Primavera P6. Proficiency in MS Project, TILOS, and Power BI.

- Strong leadership capability with experience mentoring team members, forecasting workloads, and fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

- Deep understanding of planning governance, schedule assurance, and quality standards.

- Excellent communication and coordination skills for effective engagement with Project Managers, Engineering teams, UK Planning, and external stakeholders.

- Strong analytical and problem‑solving capability with the ability to anticipate issues and optimise schedule workflows.

- High digital literacy, including advanced proficiency in MS Office and exposure to reporting/analytics tools such as Power BI.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Civil Engineering. Masters will be an added advantage.

- Minimum 16+ years of relevant experience in Project Planning, Scheduling, or related project control functions, with significant experience in leading or managing planning teams.

- Strong hands‑on experience with Primavera P6, MS Project, and other planning/scheduling systems.

- Advanced proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel (data analysis, dashboards, tracking).

- Experience working on UK‑based or large‑scale infrastructure/rail projects is advantageous.

- Professional qualifications such as ChPP, PMQ, PFQ or other equivalent recognised professional bodies are preferred.

- Desirable: Exposure to analytics/reporting tools such as Power BI for performance monitoring and decision support.

BGV:

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

- Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

Job Description

  • Consults on investment and insurance strategies, as well as the development of financial plans for clients. Grows and retains an investment and insurance book of business. Owns the client experience, efficiently handling sales and service, identifying sales and/or executing opportunities and making referrals to internal business partners as appropriate.
  • Acquires, expands and maintains client relationships through business development and client networking. Grows client loyalty and share of wallet through an exceptional client experience. Applies product and procedural knowledge to solve client problems appropriately and efficiently.
  • Develops and implements investment and insurance strategies for clients. Determines the best products to support such strategies. Presents sound financial recommendations and guidance to clients. Establishes individual financial plans based on client financial needs and objectives. Monitors financial plans and recommends changes as needed.
  • Actively and regularly coaches and educates internal business partners to identify investment opportunities. Drives investment education and visibility among internal business partners. Shows urgency with activities and leads by example. Has regular and effective communication with internal and external partners to build strong relationships that drive referral activity.
  • Regularly meets with internal business partners to communicate and review business results and pipeline management. Meets service level agreements on lead and referral follow up. Adheres to all applicable laws, regulations, policies and guidelines.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Client Prospecting, Client Relationship Building, Credit Risk Analysis, Customer Engagement, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Investment Banking, Public Speaking, Relationship Building, Relationship Management

Competencies

Coaching Others, Customer Experience Management., Customer Retention, Effective Communications, Interpersonal Relationships, Managing Multiple Priorities, Prospecting., Sales Tasks And Activities, Selling.

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

FINRA Series 7 and 66 (or 63,65) required. Life and Health Insurance required.

Pay Transparency

Base Salary: $76,500.00 – $127,500.00Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.

Application Window

Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 08/09/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

description:
About

=====

글로벌 숏드라마 ​플랫폼, ​Vigloo와 함께 ​하실
AI Content Creator를 지금 ​찾고 ​있어요

최초 계약 ​기간은 1년이며, 종료 ​시점에 내부 ​논의를 ​거쳐 계약 ​기간 ​연장 ​혹은 전환이 결정될 ​수 ​있습니다.

=====

[Vigloo AI Studio ​팀을 ​소개합니다]

Vigloo AI Studio ​팀은 이런 ​일을 ​해요!
• 우리 팀은 ​밀도 높은 ​영상 ​콘텐츠를 생성형 AI를 ​통해 제작하는 ​역할을 합니다.
• 단순한 AI 영상화가 아니라, 즐거움과 재미를 갖춘 압도적인 영상 컨텐츠를 시각화하는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.
• SF, 판타지, 스릴러 등 장르의 한계를 두지 않고 다양한 유니버스를 넘나들며 시각적 쾌감과 탄탄한 서사를 구축하며, 전 세계 시청자와 팬덤을 매료시킬 영상 IP 확장을 지향합니다.

Vigloo AI Studio 팀은 이런 문화로 일해요!
• 우리는 아이디어를 기획 이상으로 확장하고, 즉각적으로 프로토타입을 깎아내며 눈으로 증명하는 '압도적인 실행력'을 자랑합니다.
• 다루는 장르와 세계관이 매번 역동적으로 바뀌는 만큼, 직군에 얽매이지 않고 대본의 호흡부터 프레임 단위의 디테일까지 치열하게 고민합니다.

Vigloo AI Studio 팀 직무 인터뷰 바로 가기
• https://brunch.co.kr/@spoonlabs/177
• https://brunch.co.kr/@spoonlabs/178

Vigloo 서비스는요,
• 2분 내외의 에피소드로 구성된 고퀄리티 숏드라마를 즐길 수 있는 비디오 플랫폼으로, 국가와 지역을 넘어 전 세계 이용자들에게 서비스되고 있습니다.
• 글로벌 제작 노하우와 각 국가별 현지화 전략이 완벽하게 어우러진 다양한 장르의 콘텐츠가 담겨 있어요.
• Vigloo 즐기러 가기 - https://www.vigloo.com/ko

Responsibilities

Vigloo의 AI Content Creator는 생성형 AI 기술을 활용하여 상상을 압도적인 비주얼의 영상으로 구현하고, 이를 바탕으로 숏드라마를 직접 제작합니다.
• 생성형 AI를 통한 이미지/영상 소스 제작 및 편집/합성
• AI 기반 영상 및 합성 툴을 활용한 고밀도 콘텐츠 제작
• 감독의 연출 방향성에 맞춘 프레임 단위의 디테일 구현 및 비주얼 프로토타이핑
• 트렌디하고 역동적인 세계관 구현을 위한 신규 AI 기술/툴 실험 및 파이프라인 적용

Requirements

• 단순한 이미지/영상 생성을 넘어, 대본(텍스트)을 바탕으로 스토리 맥락에 맞는 씬(Scene)을 구현하고 콘텐츠를 제작해 본 경험이 있는 분
• 생성형/대화형 AI를 활용해 이미지 및 영상 콘텐츠를 직접 제작하고 다듬어본 경험이 있는 분
• 이미지 생성 툴, 영상 합성 툴(Seedance, Kling 등)의 작동 원리를 이해하고 능숙하게 제어할 수 있는 분
• 직군에 갇히지 않고 아이디어를 시각화하기 위해 빠르게 실행하는 성향을 가진 분

Preferred

• 숏드라마, 스토리텔링형 콘텐츠 등 이야기 전개가 포함된 영상 제작 프로젝트에 참여해 본 경험이 있는 분
• Premiere Pro, After Effects 등 영상 편집 및 후반 작업 툴에 대한 높은 이해도를 가진 분
• 영상 후반 제작 파이프라인(VFX, 2D/3D 합성 등) 실무 경험이 있는 분
• Blender, C4D, Maya 등 3D 툴을 활용한 콘텐츠 제작 및 AI 매핑/소스 활용 경험이 있는 분

Benefits

[스푼랩스는 어떻게 일하나요? 여기에 답이 있어요]

Work Hard. Win Together.
밤낮을 넘어 치열히, 원팀으로 끝까지.

완벽보다 속도, 고민보다 실행.
스푼랩스는 빠르게 시도하고, 실패는 안고 다시 달립니다.
결국 답에 닿을 때까지 몰입합니다.

밤낮을 넘는 긴 몰입의 시간,
끝없는 시도와 수정으로 답에 다가섭니다.
속도는 빠르고, 기준은 높고, 불확실성은 큽니다.
누군가에게 이곳은 버거울 수 있지만,
우리는 그 안에서 치열하게 성장하며 한 걸음 더 나아갑니다.

더 멀리 나아가기 위해
앞서가되 독주하지 않고,
함께할 때 더 단단하기에
서로를 믿고 배우며, 겸손하게 성장합니다.

우리는 '편한 일'을 약속하지 않습니다. '압도적 성장'을 약속합니다.
단순한 일이 아닌, 내 인생과 세상을 바꾸는 전력 질주의 무대.
몰입과 끈기로 성장할 준비가 된 사람을 환영합니다.

• 스푼랩스 공식 홈페이지: https://www.spoonlabs.com/kr/
• 스푼랩스 문화 블로그: https://brunch.co.kr/@spoonlabs#articles
• 스푼랩스 테크 블로그: https://medium.com/spoontech
• 스푼랩스 인스타그램: https://www.instagram.com/spoonlabs_careers/

=====

[몰입하고, 성장할 수 있도록 이런 제도가 준비되어 있어요]

[성장을 위한 제도] 끊임없이 도전하고 더 나은 결과를 만들어내는 구성원을 위해
• 월 10만원 한도의 자기계발비 지원
• 월 20만원 한도의 일본어, 영어, 한국어 외국어 학습비 지원
• AWS re:Invent, Digital Marketing Summit, MAU Conference 등 업무 관련 국내외 교육 및 세미나 참석 지원
• 우리 같이 공부해요! 사내 스터디 모임 지원
• 사내 도서관 운영 및 신청 도서 구매
• 입사자와 추천자 모두 후한 보상을! 사내 직원 추천 제도
우리는 빠르게 배우고, 더 나은 방향으로 스스로 성장하는 사람들이 함께 모인 팀입니다.

[일하는 방식] 몰입과 실행의 밀도를 높이기 위해
• 해외 법인에서 근무하는 오피스 익스체인지 프로그램
• 창의적 몰입을 위한 워케이션 프로그램
• 오전 8시~10시 사이 자유롭게 출근하는 자율출근제
• 열심히 일하고 안전하게 퇴근해야죠. 야근 식비 및 택시비 지원
• 월요일은 4시간의 몰입을! 더욱 집중해서 몰입하는 주 4.5일제
우리는 더 깊이, 함께 몰입할 수 있는 환경을 선택합니다.

[함께하는 팀을 위한 환경] 치열하게 일한 만큼, 서로를 챙기기 위해
• 든든히 드세요. 아침 식사 제공 및 점심 식비 지원
• 함께해 주셔서 감사해요! 근속 기간별 리프레시 휴가 및 휴가비 지원
• 에너지는 항상 충전되어야 하니까. 무제한 카페테리아 운영
• 생일을 진심으로 축하합니다. 생일자를 위한 반반차 휴가
• 개개인의 일상에도 진심을 담아, 경조 휴가 및 경조비 지원
• 개인 근무 일정에 맞게 알아서 사용하는 휴가/반반차 제도
• 무엇보다 건강이 우선이죠. 연 1회 종합건강검진 제공
• 강남역 역세권의 깔끔하고 세련된 사무실
• 힘들 땐 잠시 쉬어요. 고급 안마의자, 게임기, 다트, 탁구대 구비
치열하게 일한 만큼, 재충전도 중요하니까. 우리는 일하는 순간뿐 아니라, 그 사이사이도 함께 고민합니다.

title: Syddanmark - uopfordret (timelønnede) hos Kongsvang
description:
Syddanmark - uopfordret (timelønnede) hos Kongsvang





  




















































































Vil du være en del af Kongsvang teamet i Syd- og Sønderjylland, samt Fyn?
Søg uopfordret i Horsens, Vejle/Børkop, Fredericia, Kolding, Esbjerg/Varde, Haderslev, Aabenraa, Middelfart, Odense, Ringe/Faaborg/Svendborg og Assens.




I Kongsvang er vi konstant på udkig efter nye, dygtige kollegaer, som vil være med til at løfte servicebranchens kvalitet og ydelser samt gøre en stor forskel for de arbejdspladser, som vi hver dag løser serviceopgaver for. 




Dertil søger vi løbende kvalificerede:

Servicemedarbejdere: Vores servicemedarbejderes primære arbejdsopgave er at sørge for en ren helhed hos kunden - gennem daglig rengøring af eget område og egenkontrol heraf. Som en af hverdagens helte er du som servicemedarbejder således med til at opretholde og højne Kongsvangs serviceniveau - og dermed sikre høj kundetilfredshed.

Kvalitetsassistenter: Vores kvalitetsassistenters vigtigste opgave er, udover daglig rengøring af eget område, at sikre den rene helhed og have fokus på den samlede kvalitet hos kunden. Som kvalitetsassistent har du derfor daglig kontakt med servicemedarbejderne samt kundes kontaktperson på stedet. Kvalitetsopfølgning er således en fast del af dit arbejde.

Tilsynsassistenter: Vores tilsynsassistenters vigtigste opgave er at levere kvalitetsbevidst og ordentlig rengøring samt at føre tilsyn af eget og kollegaers arbejde. Som tilsynsassistent agerer du "højre hånd" for din nærmeste leder og udvalgte kunder, hvor du dels har manuelt rengøringsarbejde og dels ugentlig tilsynstid. Du står derfor for den daglige ledelse - og det er dit ansvar at sørge for en ren helhed hos kunden og herved sikre en høj kundetilfredshed.




Hvem er du? 


Selvstændig, kvalitetsbevidst og ordentlig i dit arbejde


Præsentabel i dit ydre og serviceminded


Kan arbejde alene og i teams med andre


Stabil, loyal og fleksibel


Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk og/eller som minimum engelsk


Kan fremvise straffeattest og børneattest


Rengøringserfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav


Skriv gerne, hvis du før har arbejdet med tilsynsopgaver eller lignende





Hvad kan vi tilbyde?


Deltid eller fuldtid, primært i morgentimerne (fra kl.05.00 og frem) eller eftermiddags/aftentimerne (fra kl.14.00 og frem).


Rengøringsarbejde under ordnede arbejdsforhold


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst


En god og ordentlig introduktion til arbejdet


Kursus i Kongsvang Academy på vores hovedkontor i Åbyhøj, Aarhus


Sundhedsordning i forbindelse med medlemskab af Pension Danmark


Mulighed for ansvarsopgaver med tilsyn og ledelse af teams





Fristet?  

Så send os din ansøgning og bliv en del af vores jobbank. Husk at tydeliggøre i hvilket geografisk område du søger. Vi kontakter dig, hvis/når der er et match mellem dine ønsker og en ledig stilling. 




Søg nu




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!













































Kongsvang Cleaning & Facility A/S er mere end bare en rengøringsvirksomhed - vi er en multikulturel arbejdsplads med hjerte og handlekraft. Vi brænder for at skabe de bedste arbejdsbetingelser for vores medarbejdere og levere førsteklasses serviceløsninger til vores kunder. Hos os bliver du en del af en dynamisk arbejdsplads, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, trivsel og faglig udvikling højt.

Vores medarbejdere er hverdagens helte, fordi de hver dag gør en forskel med en støvsuger, klud og et smil. De er vores vigtigste ressource, og vi er utrolig stolte af vores medarbejdere, der repræsenterer mange forskellige nationaliteter, baggrunde og faggrupper. Uanset om du er ny eller erfaren i branchen hjælper vi dig godt i gang med rengøringsfagligt kursus og personlig oplæring på din arbejdsplads. Vi hjælper også gerne med danskundervisning, hvis sproget driller.

Vores mål er ikke kun at levere effektiv rengøring, men at gøre en forskel i samfundet, for vores medmennesker og for en mere bæredygtig fremtid.










































































Hos Kongsvang får du:


Et rengøringsjob med faste rammer og ordnede forhold




Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter attraktiv overenskomst indgået mellem DI (SBA) og 3F



Grundig oplæring og introduktion til arbejdet



Mulighed for efteruddannelse såsom danskundervisning og rengøringstekniker



Sundhedsordning i forbindelse med medlemskab af Pension Danmark


En arbejdsplads, hvor din indsats gør en forskel

  Salgsassistentelev til BR 
 Ved du hvad det bedste er? 

 … at arbejde hos BR! Som elev i BR får du en 2-årig detailhandelsuddannelse, hvor du får lov til at lege i arbejdstiden. 

 BR er en ungdommelig arbejdsplads, hvor der bliver skabt stærke relationer, og du får et arbejde, hvor du må folde din kreativitet ud, og hvor dine ideer kan få frit løb. Vi forventer, at vores kunder får oplevelser i særklasse og en hjælpsomhed ud over det sædvanlige. Du skal være med til at skabe et legende frirum for børn, hvor de har lyst til at komme igen og igen. Og så skal du kunne hjælpe deres forældre - og alle andre, der besøger BR - til at gå hjem med det helt rigtige legetøj. 

 Uddannelsen i BR er en del af Salling Groups elevuddannelse og er en uddannelse med fremtidsmuligheder. Du bliver uddannet i en international virksomhed med gode karrieremuligheder inden for detailhandel, og du bliver uddannet med en praktisk tilgang og lærer alt det, som de andre skal læse sig til - samtidig med at du får lov til at lege og møde masser af spændende mennesker. 

 Elevforløbet strækker sig over 2 år og er en kombination af praktik i din butik og teori på Salling Group Academy, Bøgehøj i Ebeltoft. For at starte som elev i BR, skal du have én af følgende uddannelsesbaggrunde: 
 
 EUD/EUX Business-eksamen 

 HHX-eksamen 

 Studentereksamen, HF-eksamen eller HTX-eksamen kombineret med 5-ugers EUD/HGS 
 
 BR - altid en tur værd! 

 Hos BR giver vi kunderne en unik oplevelse, når de besøger vores butikker. En tur i BR er spændende og inspirerende - og altid med sjove overraskelser for børn i alle aldre. Vores 26 butikker er store og rummelige - så der er masser af plads til leg, fart og ballade. 

 I BR har vi Danmarks største sortiment af legetøj, spil og udstyr til børn. Vi vil være først med de nyeste trends, så du vil altid kunne finde det legetøj, der er oppe i tiden. Det betyder, at vores små kunder altid kan finde det, der trender i børnehaven eller skolen, når de handler i BR. Lige fra LEGO, dukker og stjernekikkerter til skateboards, modellervoks og perler - og alt derimellem. 

 Så hvis du mestrer kreativitet, en legende tilgang til produkterne og ikke mindst at skabe mindeværdige oplevelser for børn og deres voksne, er det lige dig, vi søger! 

 Interesseret? 
  Så send os din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

   

     

 Det skal være en oplevelse at besøge BR. Hver gang. Uanset om vores kunder kommer for at købe eller for at ønske. Vi har det brede udvalg, den personlige betjening og plads til legebørn i alle aldre.

title: Logistics Officer - Malaysia
description:
Make an impact across our global supply chain

We are looking for a Logistics Officer to join our Malaysia team and play a key role in coordinating international logistics, freight and supply chain activities.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across suppliers, freight forwarders, procurement and internal teams, while looking for smarter, more cost-effective ways to move materials across borders.

You will be responsible for ensuring materials arrive on time, compliantly and at the right cost, while supporting continuous improvement across our international supply chain.

What you'll do

  • Coordinate international inbound shipments to ensure timely, compliant and cost-effective delivery of materials.

  • Obtain and evaluate freight quotations and recommend transport solutions that balance cost, service and operational requirements.

  • Work closely with suppliers and freight forwarders to consolidate shipments, optimise transport modes and reduce freight costs.

  • Support procurement activities including purchase orders, supplier follow-up and material availability.

  • Manage import/export documentation, Incoterms, tariff codes and customs compliance requirements.

  • Support the effective use of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) and duty concession schemes to maximise potential duty savings.

  • Maintain accurate certificates of origin, duty exemption/licence approvals and other trade compliance records.

  • Monitor supplier and freight forwarder performance, identify risks and recommend improvements.

  • Prepare logistics KPI reports, freight cost analysis, benchmarking data and cost-saving recommendations.

  • Identify and support continuous improvement initiatives to improve freight efficiency, cost control and supply chain performance.

  • Build strong working relationships with suppliers, customs brokers, freight forwarders and internal stakeholders.

  • Support the establishment and effectiveness of logistics hubs as the business grows.

What we're looking for

  • 3–5 years of experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, procurement or supply chain coordination.

  • Strong knowledge of international air and sea freight operations, Incoterms, import/export compliance and customs documentation.

  • Experience working with freight forwarders and logistics providers to optimise freight costs and shipment consolidation.

  • Knowledge of relevant Free Trade Agreements and duty concession schemes is highly desirable.

  • Experience with ERP/MRP or freight management systems.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; Power BI experience is an advantage.

  • Experience preparing logistics KPIs, management reports and data-driven cost reduction initiatives.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across international teams.

Why this role?

This is more than a shipment coordination role. You will have the opportunity to influence freight costs, improve supply chain efficiency, work with international stakeholders and contribute to the development of a growing global logistics operation.

If you are someone who enjoys solving logistics challenges, finding cost-saving opportunities and making supply chains work smarter, we'd like to hear from you.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce or a related discipline.

  • APICS or equivalent supply chain qualification is desirable.

  • Knowledge of ISO systems and import compliance is advantageous.

  • Collaborate with senior engineers and product teams to define agent capabilities and scope.

  • Document agent designs, configurations, and workflows clearly.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of software engineering experience; hands-on AI/agent projects (personal, academic, or professional) are equally valued.

  • AI-first approach — demonstrated ability to think through problems using AI and automation before conventional solutions.

  • Proficiency in at least one of: Golang or Python (Python preferred for agent development; Golang for performance-critical services).

  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source equivalents) and prompt engineering fundamentals, including tool/function calling.

  • Fluent with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) — skilled at providing clear context to get production-quality output, and able to critically review, debug, and refactor AI-generated code (your own and teammates’) rather than accepting it blindly.

  • Strong code ownership — you understand and can explain every line of code you submit, regardless of how it was generated, and follow secure coding practices.

  • Comfort working with REST APIs, JSON, and version control (Git).

  • Actively experiments with new AI coding workflows and shares learnings with the team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack).

  • Exposure to vector databases or semantic search for agent memory/retrieval.

  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Airflow).

  • Knowledge of both Golang and Python.

  • Any personal AI projects, bots, or automation tools you’ve shipped.

Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.
