title: Customer Master Data Lead
description:
Job Description:

Role Summary
The Customer Master Data Lead serves as the organization’s escalation point for complex customer master data decisions, protecting the integrity of the customer golden record by resolving ambiguous, conflicting, or high-impact issues related to ownership, hierarchy, critical attributes, duplicates, and account relationships.


The role applies governance standards, business context, and sound judgment to determine the right path forward when standard processes do not provide a clear answer, partnering across Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, Finance, IT, and Digital to keep customer data accurate, scalable, and aligned with enterprise needs.

Key Outcomes

  • Maintain accurate and trusted customer golden records.
  • Work through customer master data matters that prove too complex for existing processes.
  • Ensure customer hierarchies, ownership assignments, and critical attributes are consistently managed.
  • Resolve data conflicts that impact multiple teams, systems, or business processes.
  • Prevent the introduction of inaccurate, duplicate, or conflicting customer data.
  • Enable reliable reporting, customer management, and operational execution through sound data stewardship.

Core Responsibilities

Customer Data Governance

  • Act as a critical escalation point for complex customer master data issues and disputes.
  • Make governance-based decisions regarding customer structure, hierarchy alignment, duplicate management, and critical customer attributes when standards do not provide a clear answer.
  • Exercise independent judgment to resolve ambiguous or conflicting customer data scenarios while balancing business needs, enterprise standards, and long-term data integrity.
  • Document and communicate significant governance decisions that impact customer data standards.

Data Stewardship & Decision Management

  • Evaluate and resolve complex customer data issues that require interpretation beyond standard procedures.
  • Determine appropriate customer hierarchy structures and account relationships.
  • Review and approve exceptions to established customer data standards where necessary.
  • Ensure governance decisions are consistently applied across customer records.

Data Quality & Risk Resolution

  • Identify high-impact data quality issues that could affect reporting, customer experience, sales execution, integrations, or downstream business processes.
  • Assess data risks and determine the most appropriate correction path for complex or sensitive customer records.
  • Oversee resolution of duplicate records, conflicting customer attributes, incorrect ownership, and hierarchy misalignment.
  • Identify recurring patterns in complex data issues and recommend targeted safeguards or standard updates where needed.
  • Maintain decision consistency across similar customer master data scenarios.
  • Communicate the rationale, impact, and required follow-up for significant customer master data decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience entering or maintaining data in Salesforce or similar systems
  • Familiarity with structured data standards or business rules
  • High attention to detail
  • Clear communication

Tools & Platforms

  • Salesforce (Account hierarchy, ownership, team assignment)
  • Reltio
  • Microsoft 365, Excel, Power BI

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Sr Software QA Engineer

Location: San Diego, California, Remote - United States

Remote Type: Flex

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

At Dexcom, the Postmarket Investigations team serves as a critical link between real-world product performance and continuous product improvement. As part of the Customer Advocacy organization, we assess postmarket feedback and product data to ensure learnings are integrated into future product enhancements. This role has a direct impact on patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance through partnership with teams across R&D, Quality, and Commercial Operations. Our team values technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning, while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. Team members have the unique opportunity to drive quality improvements, influence key business processes, and contribute to technologies that empower people to take control of their health.

Where you come in:

  • You will collaborate with cross-functional partners including Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, R&D, Clinical, and Process Engineering to support the investigation, documentation, and resolution of software- and device-related postmarket issues.

  • You will drive the development and continuous improvement of complaint investigation processes, ensuring alignment with software risk management activities such as hazard analysis, DFMEA, PFMEA, and product risk assessments.

  • You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of Dexcom’s software ecosystem and technical architecture to effectively evaluate product performance, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • You will apply structured problem-solving methodologies and data-driven approaches to conduct investigations, lead engineering studies, and identify root causes using statistical analysis and industry-standard tools.

  • You will analyze, synthesize, and communicate investigation outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and supporting informed decision-making across the organization.

  • You will contribute to postmarket quality processes, including CAPA, Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs), and other quality system activities, ensuring thorough assessment of product performance and risk.

  • You will perform software-focused risk assessments related to product anomalies, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and postmarket trends, helping to ensure product safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

  • You will partner with product development and quality teams to translate postmarket insights into actionable improvements, driving enhancements to product performance, user experience, and patient safety.

What makes you successful:

title: Gymnasiejob.dk - Horsens HF og VUC søger vikar i dansk og engelsk
description:
Horsens HF og VUC søger vikar i dansk og engelsk 
                
 
                    
 HF-lærer i dansk og engelsk ved Horsens HF & VUC 



 Vi søger snarest muligt en underviser til et vikariat med undervisning i dansk og engelsk på HF. Vikariatet er med 50% ansættelsesgrad og indeholder både onlineundervisning og fremmødehold, der løber over hele skoleåret. Stillingen kan søges af kandidater både med og uden pædagogikum. Du vil blive en del af et velfungerende lærerkollegium, der prioriterer vidensdeling og samarbejde.  
 

 
Om dig 



 Vi forventer, at du er både fagligt ambitiøs, anerkendende og god til at skabe betydningsfulde relationer. Som HF-lærer skal du med fagligt overskud forstå at motivere, udfordre og støtte vores elever i deres læring. Du skal brænde for dine fag, være interesseret i at udvikle den pædagogiske praksis gennem egen og fælles refleksion. Du bliver en del af et engageret HF-lærerteam, så vi lægger vægt på, at du prioriterer samarbejde og er nysgerrig i forhold til at arbejde på tværs af fag. Du skal have en relevant akademisk uddannelse, der giver undervisningskompetence i fagene. 



 
 
Om skolen
 
Horsens HF & VUC tilbyder en række uddannelser på både grundlæggende og gymnasialt niveau. Vi udbyder f.eks. HF både som ungdomsuddannelse og enkeltfag til voksne, og vi udbyder almen voksenuddannelse på grundskoleniveau. Fleksible tilrettelæggelser gør det muligt for den enkelte elev at tilpasse sin uddannelse efter egne behov. Skolen har omkring 450 årselever og ca. 60 medarbejdere. Vi er en skole, som prioriterer samarbejde om og udvikling af undervisning og pædagogik for at skabe det størst mulige læringsudbytte for vores elever gennem et glimrende uformelt kollegialt samarbejde. Som nyansat på skolen vil du få tilknyttet en kollega som mentor, som vil hjælpe dig godt i gang med arbejdet, og du vil også opleve, at du altid kan spørge en vilkårlig kollega om hjælp, hvis du har brug for det. Skolen har en personaleforening, der flere gange i løbet af året laver forskellige sociale arrangementer for skolens ansatte. 



 Skolen ligger midt i Horsens kun 10 minutters gang fra banegården. Du kan læse mere om os på  www.horsenshfogvuc.dk . 



   



 Information og ansøgning 



 Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, religion eller tilhørsforhold til at søge.
 
Ansøgninger sendes via gymnasiejob.dk senest den 24. august 2026 kl. 12.00. 



 Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem staten og Gymnasieskolernes Lærerforening. 



 Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte vicerektor Kasper Wettergren på kw@horsenshfogvuc.dk. 



 Samtaler forventes afholdt løbende.

title: Client Partner – Google Ads
description:
Client Success Manager – Google Ads

Location: Noida
Experience: 6+ Years
Role: Client Success Manager – Google Ads

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Client Success Manager – Google Ads to manage and grow client relationships while driving strong performance across Google Ads campaigns. The ideal candidate will have 6+ years of experience in digital marketing, paid search, and client servicing, with a strong understanding of Google Ads and performance marketing.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients, understand their business objectives, translate them into effective paid media strategies, and work closely with internal teams to deliver measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with clients and serve as the primary point of contact.

  • Develop a strong understanding of clients’ business goals, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

  • Plan, execute, optimize, and oversee Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, and other relevant formats.

  • Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve ROAS, ROI, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and overall campaign efficiency.

  • Develop paid search strategies, budgets, forecasts, and performance plans aligned with client objectives.

  • Conduct regular performance reviews and present actionable insights and recommendations to clients.

  • Prepare and deliver weekly/monthly/quarterly campaign reports and business reviews.

  • Identify opportunities for account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of client engagements.

  • Work closely with PPC, analytics, creative, content, and technology teams to ensure successful campaign execution.

  • Troubleshoot campaign and tracking-related issues and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution.

  • Stay updated on Google Ads product updates, industry trends, bidding strategies, automation, and performance marketing best practices.

  • Ensure client satisfaction, retention, and long-term account growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in client success, account management, paid media, or digital marketing.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Google Ads / Google PPC.

  • Experience managing significant advertising budgets and multiple client accounts.

  • Strong understanding of campaign optimization, bidding strategies, keyword research, audience targeting, conversion tracking, and attribution.

  • Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager is preferred.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to translate campaign data into clear business insights and recommendations.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Google Ads certification is preferred.

About Us

EbizON is a global team specializing in building technology products and driving growth through multi-channel digital marketing. We’ve partnered with Fortune companies, eCommerce brands, SaaS firms, and VC-funded startups—helping over a dozen billion-dollar companies with consulting, technology, and digital transformation.

We take pride in our fun, collaborative, and growth-focused culture built on integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness, and teamwork. Our goal is simple—make life better by giving people peace of mind through impactful solutions.

Why Join Us

  • Equal Opportunity Employer: We value diversity and inclusivity across all teams.

  • Flexible Timings: Enjoy the freedom to balance work and life your way.

  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with clients worldwide through virtual platforms like Teams and Zoom.

  • Retreats & Celebrations: Connect, unwind, and celebrate with fun Fridays and festive events.

Vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du:

Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.

Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.

Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

title: Director of Health Services
location: CA - Antioch: The Commons at Dallas Ranch
description:
Director of Health Services

At MBK Senior Living, we're committed to putting people first – our residents and team members. Exceeding expectations and enriching lives drives our day-to-day. And it's all powered by Yoi Shigoto, a Japanese concept that translates to "good, quality work." It's more than a mantra. It's part of our company-wide commitment to build trust, set high standards, and develop potential in ourselves and others!

Whether you're looking for a flexible, part-time job or the pathway to a lasting career, you'll find it here at MBK Senior Living–and a whole lot more! When you join the MBK Senior Living team, you'll enjoy:

-Impacting lives and building lasting relationships

-Executing exceptional signature programs in dining, fitness, wellness, and care

-A supportive community team that encourages personal and professional growth and celebrates your

success

-A fun-filled, energetic environment that's centered in hospitality and high-quality service

-Competitive salaries

-Professional development, training, and personal coaching through our Mentor, Buddy, and Executive

Director in Training Programs

-Education loan assistance & scholarships

-Financial and legal services

-Team Member discounts

-Health and Wellness resources

Full-time benefits include:

-Rich benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision and 401k matching up to 4%

-Childcare and eldercare assistance

-Flexible spending accounts

If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact, find purpose and joy, and receive the training, tools, and support to reach your career goals – look no further, apply today!

Job Description

Schedule: Tuesday-Saturday
Rate of Pay: $115,000-$125,000 annually

Job Summary:

The Director of Health Services (DHS) leads the overall implementation of clinical health and wellness services in the community. The DHS serves as a liaison between families, hospital personnel, physicians, community organizations, and other related service agencies to provide quality care to MBK Senior Living residents. The DHS collaborates with the Director of Sales and the Executive Director (ED) to set the stage for MBK Senior Living to become the senior living provider of choice. Additionally, the DHS is responsible for coordinating care with outside agencies, communicating with families, managing a clinical team, and developing personalized plans of care for residents’ needs, then communicating them to the care team.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Interview, hire, train, set performance goals and timelines, monitor performance, and provide coaching for Medication Technicians.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Conduct and coordinate assessments/evaluations of potential residents and make recommendations for admission in accordance with current rules, regulations, and community policies and procedures.
  • Conduct and/or approve routinely scheduled re-assessments and change of condition assessments promptly.
  • Draft initial Individualized Service Plans (ISP) and update based on schedule and change of condition for residents and partner with ED to review with responsible parties and/or residents.
  • Alert the ED, family members, and others (as necessary) of any changes in residents’ physical or emotional health, and institute interventions as appropriate.
  • Assess the community’s ability to meet resident needs under licensure and collaborate with the ED on plans to retain the residents or move them to a higher level of care when necessary.
  • Develop and maintain good working relationships and effective communication with families and service providers.
  • Train, assign, and supervise Medication Technicians.
  • Perform all administrative duties accurately and timely, including expense reporting, submission of invoices, team member evaluations, etc.
  • Coordinate prescription orders with doctors’ offices, as well as pharmacy delivery of medications, including oversight of the central storage, tracking, and delivery of medications, and ensuring the Medication Administration Records are completed according to company policy and State regulations.
  • Responsible for the overall safety, health, and wellness of residents.
  • Ensure that clinical and care-related regulations and policies are closely monitored and followed.
  • Ensure that physician orders are carried out properly.
  • Aid in the community marketing effort through positive interactions, acting as a liaison between the community and families/outside health service providers.
  • Key management member acting as Manager on Duty when necessary.
  • Collaborate with Department Directors on resident care and caregiver oversight.
  • Collaborate with the Regional Director of Health Services to ensure compliance with MBK policy and procedure and State Regulatory Guidelines
  • Maintain a safe and secure environment for staff, residents, and guests following established safety standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Understand and comply with Federal, State, and local regulations, and company policies and procedures concerning the department.
  • Promote and lead with a spirit of teamwork and open communication in accordance with the MBK principles and core values.
  • Manage labor and other expenses to align with the community budget.
  • Perform other job duties or special projects as assigned or requested by Supervisor and/or Regional Team.

Education Requirements:

  • College Degree required or equivalent work experience and license.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing, Human Services, or the Health Care field is highly desirable.

Experience Requirements (in years):

  • 2+ years of prior related work experience functioning in a similar healthcare management role, within a similar industry/work environment is essential.
  • 2+ years of prior management or supervisory experience required.

Required Competencies/Licenses/Certifications:

  • Licensed RN, LPN, or LVN and must adhere to all requirements to have and maintain a license, including CEU completion and timely renewal.
  • CPR certification required.
  • Must complete required Background clearances, health screening, and provide negative TB test results within 7 days of employment (must be within the last 6 months).
  • Valid state-issued driver’s license and valid insurance or reliable method of transportation for resident assessments.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word, Excel, and Outlook) and operating standard office equipment.
  • Must have excellent communication skills, including the ability to speak, write, and read English.
  • Must possess the ability to make sound, independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action, and to remain calm during stressful or emergency situations.
  • Must possess the ability to always deal tactfully and professionally with personnel, residents, family members, and guests.
  • Must possess strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

  • Must be mobile and able to perform the physical requirements of the job, including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, squatting, pulling, reaching overhead, and repetitive motion.
  • Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday, in the community, and between neighborhoods.
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and push up to 250 pounds, as necessary.
  • Ability to assist in the physical movement of residents during routine transfers or in emergency situations.
  • Ability to travel within 50 miles of the community to perform assessments/evaluations.
  • Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Inspiring people, creating experiences, and supporting goals are just a few ways MBK Senior Living creates a positive work environment. It's how we support our team members, serve our residents, and achieve our pursuit – to be the senior living provider of choice in each market we serve.

MBK Senior Living has pursued this goal for more than 30 years. Currently, the company owns and operates 35 Independent Living, Assisted Living, and Memory Care services in senior living communities throughout the Western United States. We’re proud to have been ranked among the Top 50 "Best Workplaces in Aging Services" by Fortune magazine and certified as a “Great Place to Work” by the Great Place to Work Institute since 2017.

MBK is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, or other protected reason. Our company is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for qualifying individuals in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact talentacquisition@mbk.com.

Regulatory Disclosures for Senior Living Communities with Medicaid Residents: An “Excluded Party” is a person that the federal or state government found not eligible to provide care and services in a facility that receives Medicare or Medicaid funding. If employed at one of our senior living communities that receives Medicare or Medicaid funding, team members must not be considered an “Excluded Party” as defined by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, any state Medicaid Programs, and any additional federal and state government contract programs. If, as a team member, you learn that you are an Excluded Party at any time, you must present your Excluded Party notice letter to your supervisor immediately.

Other Regulatory Requirements: If employed at one of our senior living communities, team members must continually comply with certain laws and regulations that impact the company, including, but not limited to, as applicable, state licensing regulations, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA), Resident Rights as defined by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, and any other federal or state laws relating to team members’ professional licenses.

If as an associate you learn you are an Excluded Party, you must present your Excluded Party notice letter to your supervisor immediately. An Excluded Party is a person that the federal or state government found not eligible to provide care and services in a Community that receives Medicare or Medicaid funding. In addition, at all times, during your employment, all associates must be in compliance with certain laws and regulations that affect the company, including but not limited to Resident Rights, HIPAA, State licensing regulations, and those laws relating you an associates’ professional license.

Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.


Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.


Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.


Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.


Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

Ansøg
Projekt og Speciale samarbejde


Står du og skal skrive semester- eller bachelorprojekt? Er det blevet tid til at skrive speciale? Kunne du tænke dig at samarbejde med en virksomhed med fokus på udvikling og vækst? 



Migatronic er en af Europas førende udviklere og producenter af svejseløsninger til manuel og automatiseret svejsning til den professionelle industri. Vi satser stærkt på produktudvikling af intelligent svejseteknologi- og software. Vi samarbejder hver dag med vores kunder om at effektivisere processerne i deres svejseproduktion og højne kvaliteten af svejste produkter.



Vi finder det værdifuldt at samarbejde med studerende og har solid erfaring hermed. For os er det vigtigt at bidrage til, at du får mulighed for at anvende teori i praksis, og at du kan arbejde med en konkret opgave eller problemstilling.



Migatronic har hovedkontor i Fjerritslev, Nordjylland og med datterselskaber i 10 europæiske lande. I vores danske moderselskab udvikler og producerer vi svejseløsninger til en stor del af verden. I vores hovedsæde i Fjerritslev har vi mange dygtige medarbejdere, som arbejder med udvikling og design samt produktion og test, men også salg, kundesupport og service. Derforuden har vi en Økonomi, IT, Marketing, Kvalitets- samt HR-afdeling, som ligeledes supporterer hele koncernen. I Aabybro har vi en afdeling der arbejder med automatiserede svejseløsninger, så interesserer du dig for bl.a. robotter og automatik, har muligheden her.



Der er således mange forskellige muligheder for projekt- samt specialesamarbejde uanset din studieretning.



Er du interesseret? Så upload din ansøgning med følgende informationer:



	
Det overordnet emne for projektet eller specialet

	
Hvilken studieretning og semester du går på

	
Hvad du ønsker at skrive projekt eller speciale om

	
Forventet omfang af samarbejdet og metode - spørgeskema, interview, løsning af konkret opgave eller problemstilling…

	
Hvilke formelle krav og rammer der er for projektet eller specialet

	
Afleveringsdato for projekt/speciale

	
Dine kontaktoplysninger




Når vi modtager din ansøgning om projekt-/specialeskrivning, vil den relevante afdelingschef blive forelagt emnet og vurdere, om det er et projekt eller speciale, der er relevant, samt om vi har kompetencer og ressourcer til at bidrage din opgave.



Vær venligst opmærksom på, at vi ikke modtager ansøgninger eller CV via e-mail.

title: Senior/Staff - Agent Platform (Cortex Code)
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Role

The Cortex Code team is building the future of coding agents for working with data. See our flagship product in action: Cortex Code in Action: Live Demos + AMA.

As a Staff/Principal AI Engineer on Cortex Code , you will help define architect agent behavior at enterprise scale by building the agentic systems and methodology that make our users build cutting edge agentic systems that are efficient, repeatable, auditable, and shippable. You’ll partner with modeling, platform, and product leadership to turn customer pain into golden scenarios, metrics, and experiment loops that the whole team can trust.

Responsibilities:

  • Agent strategy & systems: Own major pillars of the quality stack: tuning agent behavior to engage on next generation agentic coding tasks.

  • Hill-climb infrastructure: Design and evolve pipelines and tooling that support large-scale experimentation, error mining, and iteration on prompts/tools/workflows with clear before/after signals.

  • Deep analysis & prioritization: Lead postmortems on quality regressions; cluster failure modes; translate findings into a prioritized roadmap for engineering and modeling partners.

  • Cross-functional leadership: Align product, infra, and applied AI on what “good” means for critical customer workflows; mentor engineers and uplevel eval craft across the team.

  • Production-minded rigor: Ensure quality systems are dependable in practice—reproducible runs, stable datasets, versioning, and operational clarity when things drift.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Master’s or higher preferred but not a requirement.

  • 10+ years of experience shipping AI/ML-backed software in production, including Staff-level ownership of technical direction, cross-team delivery, and mentoring.

  • Strong track record building and operating eval harnesses, measurement, and/or experimentation loops for LLM/agent systems—not only one-off benchmarks.

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, Go (strong in at least two).

  • Exceptional communication skills: crisp write-ups, constructive debate, and ability to influence without authority across engineering and product.

  • (Optional) Experience with data engineering pipelines (dbt, Airflow), data modeling, data analysis, retrieval systems, and semantic layers is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Deep experience with agentic coding tools (IDE agents, CLI agents) and intuition for model strengths, failure modes, and prompting limits.

  • Background in data engineering (dbt, Airflow), analytics, retrieval / RAG, or semantic layers—highly relevant for data-centric coding agents.

  • Prior work on LLM observability, safety/guardrails, or quality systems used as release gates in production.

You may be a particularly good fit if you

  • Have built and owned complex quality + data pipelines—substantial state, branching logic, and operational requirements.

  • Thrive in high-intensity environments with short feedback loops and high standards for rigor.

  • Take ambiguous “quality is slipping” problems to completion: you care about clear metrics, reproducibility, and sustained improvement—not one-off score bumps.

  • Are a power user of modern coding agents and care about turning intuition into systematic measurement and team-wide practice.

About Snowflake

Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud trusted by the world's most innovative companies. We're shipping production-ready AI applications at scale and want you to join us in building the future of how businesses interact with their data through Cortex Code, Cortex agents, Cortex analyst, Cortex search.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information:

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $236,000 - $309,750.
  • Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

Vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende




Vi tilbyder


Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du:

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 151,52 kr. i timen som faglært og 142,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst fra HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

 

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

Klik på "Søg nu"

Udfyld formularen

Vedhæft dit motiverede CV

 

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00. 

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV! 







Medarbejdergoder









Medarbejderrabat
Lidl-rabat: Få 10 % eller 20 % rabat på dine indkøb i vores butikker på udvalgte dage.





Rabatordning

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. Vi værdsætter vores medarbejderes mangfoldighed og fremmer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor hver enkelt føler sig velkommen og respekteret. Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.

title: Commercial Project Manager
description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role:

As a Commercial Project Manager, you have a unique position to drive the commercial strategy and operational efficiency within the Sales & Marketing teams. In this role, your primary responsibility is to drive a targeted promotional and tactical planning for the Netherlands market. By establishing the foundation for these plans and aligning the sales teams' execution, you directly influence the commercial trajectory and overall performance of the country.

These are some of the key ingredients to the role:

  • Promotional Planning & Coordination: Coordinate and integrate all planned promotional activities (deals, promotions and vouchers) into the sales forecast, and work with different sales and marketing teams to create an aligned year-round planning to win the market.
  • Tactical Planning: Analyse gaps in our partner estate and deliver tactical planning for sales teams to reach country objectives and targets.
  • Analysis & Adjustment: Support Trading department with forecast accuracy and identify the causes of deviations (root-cause analysis) to refine the forecasting models.
  • Pre- and post-evaluation: Conduct analyses to support Sales and Marketing in estimating the ROI (Return on Investment) and volume impact of available growth levers, and develop enablement materials for both partners and commercial teams.
  • Insights and Reports: Generate standardized and ad-hoc management reports on sales and the effectiveness of commercial initiatives for Sales Management and sales teams.
  • Commercial tooling: Manage and act as the SME for offer & promotional tooling in the NL market, identify product opportunities and provide input to improvements in offer tooling that help and our partners win the market.

What will you bring to the table?

  • Minimum of Bachelor's or Master's degree level of working and thinking in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Economics, Supply Chain Management).
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience in Consulting, Demand or Supply Chain Planning, or Sales Operations
  • Excellent ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and translate actionable insights into concrete action plans.
  • Know how to act in an ever-changing environment and complex organisational structure
  • A flexible, result and solution-oriented and creative way of operating
  • Project management experience
  • Ownership, innovation, customer focus, getting it done, partnership and responsibility.

Like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! With us, you can count on:

💰 A competitive salary package
📝 Hybrid working: three days per week in the office in Amsterdam and two days at home.
🏋️‍♀️ Gym and padel court on location: for €5 per month you can use our office gym in Amsterdam for relaxation and a fresh mind in daily life.
🍽️ JET Pay Allowance: a credit of €90 per month with a max of €9 per day, so you can order the most delicious dishes.
🏠 Pension scheme with an employer contribution of 60%.
☀️ Vacation days: based on a full-time contract you have 26 vacation days with the option to take 5 extra days of unpaid leave annually.
🚗 Travel allowance: from 5 km commuting distance you receive a travel allowance with a choice of mileage reimbursement or an NS Business card.
🌐 A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from more than 99 countries, and the opportunity to participate in our various communities.
📖 Various training opportunities via our Learning Hub, Bookboon, internal training sessions and online English courses.
😎 The most fun events: drinks, team outings and enjoyable parties with all your colleagues!

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

title: Senior SQL Server Administrator
description:
SQL Server Administrator (Performance Tuning) - Senior Associate

Location: Bangalore, India, Hyderabad, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job description for SQL Server Administrator with Performance tuning

Role Description:

This role is for a SQL Server Administrator with Performance tuning

Key Responsibilities:

  • Requirements analysis and system design.
  • Download and install SQL Server service packs and updates.
  • Configure and maintain SQL Security controls
  • A deep understanding of CI/CD tools and a strong desire to help teams release frequently to production with a focus on creating reliable high-quality results.
  • Expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps and emergent experience with DataSecOps and Data Governance practices — deep experience with managing and scaling container-based infrastructure-as-code technologies from the CNCF and related orbits
  • Make recommendations for system architecture per Microsoft SQL Server best practices
  • Manage database backup and recovery, as well as disaster recovery planning, in coordination with the IT manager and System Engineer
  • Create, change, and improve SQL Server Agent tasks and maintenance plans
  • Proactively monitor SQL Server maintenance tasks, troubleshoot failed processes, and address issues as soon as possible
  • Troubleshoot application sluggishness and poor performance
  • In charge of database migrations and server updates
  • Create documentation and training for routine database administration activities, as well as train server operations employees on them
  • Integrate SQL Server with corporate applications
  • Independently analyze, solve, and correct issues in real time, providing problem resolution end-to-end.
  • Production support as needed.
  • End to end understanding of software architecture, design, development and implementation.
  • Continuous integration and build process, test automation and deployment.

Primary Skills (Must Have):

  • Strong Practical experience using Scrum, Agile modelling and adaptive software development.
  • Proven problem solving, communication, interpersonal and analytical skills
  • Extensive knowledge of data warehousing concepts and data analysis.
  • Experience in Performance Tuning, Query Optimization, using Performance Monitor, SQL Profiler and other related monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • 6 plus years of experience in SQL Server Administration
  • Azure Cloud DevOps experience.
  • T-SQL (Transact-SQL) Programming Perform any extra responsibilities that are allocated to you
  • Write stored procedures and T-SQL scripts.
  • Experience in working on various MS SQL Database versions 2016,2017, 2019, 2022
  • Experience in applying SQL Server service packs and database upgrades on same server and new server.
  • Experience in Database performance tuning and troubleshooting users and application related issues
  • Experience in continuous process improvement and automation using PowerShell
  • Experience in HA solutions like Always ON setup and maintenance, Log shipping, Database mirroring and replication
  • Experience in SQL Server cluster
  • Experience in Upgrade, Patching and migration to On Prem and Cloud
  • Experience in Database security and encryption setup using TDE and masking
  • Manage database backup and recovery, as well as disaster recovery planning
  • Create, change, and improve SQL Server Agent tasks and maintenance plans.
  • Proactively monitor SQL Server maintenance tasks, troubleshoot failed processes, and address issues as soon as possible.
  • Providing database support for development and deployment of database scripts in Development, Test, Pre-Production and Production environments
  • Monitoring performance and managing parameters to provide fast query responses to front-end users
  • Excellent English communications skills (written and verbal)

Secondary Skills (Good to Have):

  • Certification on Azure and AWS
  • In charge of big data ETL into SQL Server, as well as authoring and modifying SQL Server Reporting Services reports
  • Ability to multi-task, meet aggressive timelines and have strong work ethics.
  • Experience of working in the financial industry

Qualification:

Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree level qualification in a computer science.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Museumsinspektør med ansvar for samlingsarbejde søges til Energimuseet
description:
Museumsinspektør med ansvar for samlingsarbejde søges til Energimuseet - Danske Museer - ODM












































































    
    
    
    

















				

					

						

							

							

								Søg

					

				

								
							

						

					

				




















Museumsinspektør med ansvar for samlingsarbejde søges til Energimuseet






































































Energimuseet søger en museumsinspektør, der kan tage det primære ansvar for koordinering og udvikling af museets samlingsarbejde, og som samtidig har lyst til at bidrage til forskning, vidensformidling, projektudvikling og udstillingsudvikling i tæt samarbejde med museets øvrige faglige medarbejdere.




Om stillingen




Energimuseet er et specialmuseum med store ambitioner. Vi er et dedikeret team, hvor samarbejde, fleksibilitet og faglig nysgerrighed er en vigtig del af hverdagen. Som museumsinspektør får du en central rolle i museets faglige arbejde og mulighed for at præge udviklingen af både samlinger, forskning og museal formidling.





Du bliver den primære tovholder på museets samlingsarbejde og koordinerer indsatsen sammen med vores engagerede frivillige. Samtidig bidrager du til forskning og vidensproduktion og deltager i udviklingen af udstillinger og projekter i samarbejde med museets erfarne museumsinspektør og stærke formidlingsteam, og indgår som led museets drift sammen med alle museets medarbejdere. Stillingen supplerer museets eksisterende museumsinspektør, der har ansvar for udstillinger, og den nye inspektør får således det primære faglige ansvar for registrering og samling. Stillingen rummer både strategiske og praktiske opgaver og giver gode muligheder for at sætte dit præg på museets faglige udvikling i de kommende år.




Dine arbejdsområder




Samlingskoordinering og -drift





Du får det primære ansvar for at skabe overblik og fremdrift i museets samlingsarbejde gennem:






Samlingsudvikling, registrering og dokumentation af genstande, fotos og arkivmateriale





Arbejde med kvalitetssikring, herunder bevaringsforhold, konservering og kassation





Koordinering og understøttelse af samlingsarbejdet og museets frivillige på samlingsområdet






Forskning og vidensproduktion





Du bidrager til museets faglige udvikling gennem:






Forskning, og herunder samarbejde med universiteter, museer og andre forskningsmiljøer





Formidling af viden om energihistorie og grøn omstilling, både skriftligt og mundtligt





Bidrag til digitale platforme, podcasts og andre formidlingsformater





Øvrige opgaver




Som en del af et mindre museum vil du også bidrage til:






Udstillingsudvikling og konceptarbejde, herunder fundraising og projektudvikling





Faglige henvendelser og rapportering til myndigheder





Lejlighedsvise rundvisninger, arrangementer og øvrige museale formidlingsopgaver





Almindelige driftsopgaver, når det er nødvendigt.





Vi forestiller os, at du





Har en relevant kandidatuddannelse inden for historie, etnologi, STS eller beslægtede fagområder





Har erfaring med registrering og samlingsforvaltning på museum eller tilsvarende institution





Har erfaring med, eller interesse for, forskning og vidensproduktion og flair for formidling - gerne også i digitale formater





Er god til at koordinere, prioritere og skabe struktur og arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i tværfaglige samarbejder





Trives i samarbejdet med frivillige og forskellige fagligheder





Har interesse for energi-, teknologi- eller kulturhistorie





Er tryg ved at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk






Erfaring med fundraising og fondsansøgninger er en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Vi tilbyder





En alsidig stilling med høj faglig bredde og stor variation i opgaverne





Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af et museum i forandring





Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger og frivillige





Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje





Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og indflydelse





Om Energimuseet




Energimuseet er Danmarks museum for energi, elektrificering, varme og grøn omstilling. Museet arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, kulturhistorie, samfund og hverdagsliv og rummer historiske samlinger, udstillinger, undervisning og aktiviteter.





Museet er en selvejende institution beliggende i naturskønne omgivelser ved Tange Sø i Bjerringbro og arbejder målrettet på som statsanerkendt kulturinstitution at styrke sin rolle som nationalt formidlingscenter for energiens historie og fremtid.




Praktiske oplysninger




Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med reference til direktøren. Der kan forekomme enkelte arbejdsdage i weekender og aftener i forbindelse med arrangementer og events.





Tiltrædelse: Tidligst 1. oktober 2026
Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026.





Send ansøgning og CV til job@energimuseet.dk





Jobsamtaler forventes at finde sted medio september.




Kontakt




Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os:





Simon Olling Rebsdorf, direktør
Tlf. +45 61 51 77 14
sor@energimuseet.dk





Christina Louise Lykkeberg Sørensen, museumsinspektør
Tlf. +45 86 68 42 11- tryk 3 for "Samling"

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Agentic AI Engineer - Assistant Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Senior Associate - Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for motivated and analytical early-career professionals to join our GenAI Center of Excellence at State Street as Agentic AI Engineers. This role is ideal for individuals passionate about building agentic AI systems and workflows. You will work closely with Senior AI Engineers to develop, integrate, and support multi-agent workflows and event-driven architectures, contributing directly to the evolution of our agentic AI platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with senior engineers to design and build agent workflows and platform components.
  • Developed basic agent workflows utilizing at least one agent framework (such as LangChain, Langraph, GoogleADK).
  • Assist in building event-driven processes for scalable agentic AI systems.
  • Exposure to the agentic stack leveraging managed services and orchestration tools on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.
  • Write, execute, and maintain unit and integration tests for code quality and reliability.
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of agentic services in cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and/or on-prem environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and other team ceremonies to foster knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the pod.
  • Stay current with new technologies and methods in AI and distributed systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 0–7 years of overall experience in software engineering, with 2+ years of exposure in developing AI/ML, distributed systems, or agent-based architectures.
  • Proficient in Python and familiar with at least one additional modern programming language (such as Java, Go, or C++).
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices.
  • Experience developing, testing, and troubleshooting applications in cloud environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
  • Understanding of basic DevOps practices, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

title: Anfran laskentatehtävien osaajaverkosto
description:
Anfra työnantajana

Anfra on Suomessa ja Pohjois-Ruotsissa toimiva, yli 250 ammattilaista työllistävä ja monipuolisesti palveleva betoni- ja infrarakentaja. Keskeisintä osaamistamme ovat paikallavalettavat betonirakenteet, rakennesuunnittelu sekä infrarakentaminen teollisuuden, yritysten ja julkisen puolen hankkeisiin. Erikoisalaamme ovat teollisuusrakentaminen sekä energiarakentamisen infra.

Rakennusalaa rohkeasti uudistavana, innovatiivisena ja voimakkaasti kasvavana yrityksenä tarjoamme osaajillemme laajasti kehittymismahdollisuuksia. Sujuvan työarkemme takana on matala hierarkia, moderni johtaminen ja ketterät toimintatavat. Johtamis-, laatu- ja ympäristösertifikaatit luovat pohjan vastuulliselle toiminnalle arjessamme. Anfralaisen tunnistat arvoistamme - hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito, jotka ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistämme toimistolla ja työmaalla.

Meillä Anfralla muutos ei ole poikkeus – se on kasvun tuoma normaali ja anfralaisia innostava tila. Kasvamme kovaa vauhtia, ja se näkyy: projektit lisääntyvät, tavat uudistuvat, roolit elävät. Täällä et tule tekemään samaa päivästä ja vuodesta toiseen, vaan opit, sopeudut ja kehityt jatkuvasti kanssamme. Emme hae täydellisyyttä, vaan rohkeutta tarttua uuteen uteliaasti – siten rakennamme yhdessä joka päivä piirun verran parempaa Anfraa.


Oletko jo kokenut tai vasta uraasi aloitteleva betoni- tai maarakentamisen laskentaosaaja? Liity Anfran laskentatehtävien osaajaverkostoon!


Mikä homma?

Haemme säännöllisesti uusia osaajia vakituisiin kokoaikaisiin työsuhteisiin laskentapuolen tehtäviin Kempeleen toimistollemme. Anfran laskentatiimissä työskennellään sekä betoni- että maarakentamisen laskennan parissa, ja taustastasi ja vahvuuksistasi riippuen työsi voi painottua jompaan kumpaan. Laskentatiimi tekee päivittäistä yhteistyötä myynnin ja tuotannon kanssa.

Tehtävään ajateltu palkkaraami on noin 2500 - 5000 €/kk riippuen kokemuksestasi laskennan ja/tai sopivaa osaamista antavien työmaatehtävien parista. Voit tutustua lisäksi hyviin arkea tukeviin työsuhde-etuihimme urasivuiltamme. Toimistotehtävissämme työskennellään joustavasti hybridimallilla.


Mitä kaipaamme sinun työkalupakkiin?

Sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta maarakentamisen tai betonirakentamisen laskentatehtävistä, tai kattava pohjaosaaminen työmaakokemuksen kautta. Koulutustaustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi yhdyskuntatekniikan rakennusinsinööri, rakennusmestari tai -teknikko.

Eduksi katsotaan maarakentamisen tai betonirakentamisen työmenetelmien tunteminen, rakennusteknisten piirustusten lukutaito, sopimustekniikan ja rakentamismääräysten tuntemus, sekä hyvä paineensietokyky. Sinulla on sujuva suomen (suullinen ja kirjallinen), sekä englannin kielitaito, ruotsin kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Sinulla on myös näppärät IT-taidot, ja hyppäät rohkeasti Anfran mukaan rakennusalan digitalisaation eturintamaan. Käytössämme on Admicom- laskentaohjelmisto ja lukuisia muita ohjelmistoja.

Olet kehittymishaluinen tiimipelaaja, ja Anfran arvot hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito kuvaavat myös sinun toimintatapojasi. Arki kasvavassa yhtiössä ja hyvässä joukkueessamme on vauhdikasta ja palkitsevaa, joten uskomme että sinäkin viihdyt kanssamme, mikäli innostut tekemisen meiningistä sekä sopivasta itsesi haastamisesta.

Suhtaudut uteliaasti uusiin toimintatapoihin ja sytyt kasvun tuomista mahdollisuuksista, ollen myös sinnikäs haasteenpaikoissa. Sinulla on jatkuva halu oppia uutta ja kyky pysyä muutoksen kyydissä pelottomasti - sillä se minkä opit eilen, voi olla huomenna jo vanhentunutta tietoa. Ennen kaikkea koet merkityksellisenä saada jättää ammattitaitoisen kädenjälkesi Anfran kehittymiseen.


Kiinnostuitko tulemaan anfralaiseksi?

Haemme säännöllisesti uusia anfralaisia eri positioihin, ja kuulisimme mielellämme sinusta, vaikkei meillä olisikaan juuri nyt sopivaa paikkaa auki.

Tutustumme hakijoihin rullaavasti, ja olemme yhteydessä sopiviin ehdokkaisiin, kun näköpiirissä voisi olla profiiliisi sopivia mahdollisuuksia. Rekryprosessimme etenee seuraavasti:

  1. Ilmaise kiinnostuksesi anfralaiseksi jättämällä meille hakemus urasivujemme kautta simppelillä hakusysteemillämme (katso jos et usko!)
  2. Rekrytointiammattilaisten lisäksi hyödynnämme rekrytointiprosessissamme automatiikkaa ja tekoälyä. Jos perusasiat mätsäävät, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä tutustumiskeskustelun merkeissä.
  3. Jatkoon valitut henkilöt pääsevät esittelemään itseään lisää sinulle sopivana hetkenä henkilöarviointien kautta (itsenäisesti tehtävät persoonallisuusarviointi ja kykytestit)
  4. Näiden pohjalta meillä onkin jo mukavasti lisätietoja, ja kutsumme sopivia henkilöitä jatkotapaamisiin tutustelemaan Anfran tiimiläisten kanssa ja kuulemaan lisää meiningistämme
  5. Kaikki natsaa? Ei muuta kun kättä päälle ja mukaan Anfran huippuun joukkueeseen!

Mikäli sinulla jäi kysyttävää, voit olla yhteydessä sähköpostitse henkilöstöjohtaja Tuomo Hilliahoon tuomo.hilliaho@anfra.fi.

title: Murer til fliser og badeværelser i Sulsted
description:
Er du murer og vil du have firmabil og et sted, hvor det skal være sjovt?

Vi mangler en murer til fliser, bad og renovering i Sulsted.

Du bliver en del af et hold, hvor murerarbejde spænder fra boliger til erhverv. Opgaverne ligger i Nordjylland, og du skifter mellem selvstændige opgaver og arbejde med makker. Der er både nybyg, renovering, badeværelser og facader i ordrebogen, så du får brugt mere end én side af faget.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan tage en fliseopgave seriøst og stadig være nem at arbejde sammen med. Firmabilen gør hverdagen nemmere, og du får frihed under ansvar, når du kører ud på egne opgaver. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du kører selv ud til opgaverne.

Det får du

Løn: 180-210 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Sulsted og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 10 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Fliser, renovering og makkerarbejde

Din hverdag

Dagen veksler mellem planlagte mureropgaver og opgaver der skal lukkes færdigt på pladsen. På fliseopgaver handler det om underlag, fald og finish, så arbejdet står skarpt når kunden ser det. Nogle dage kører du selv, andre dage løser du opgaven sammen med en makker.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Lægger fliser og klinker i bad og andre rum
  • Renoverer og reparerer murværk
  • Arbejder med nybyg, renovering og tilbygninger
  • Pudser, vandskurer og laver facadeopgaver
  • Hjælper på badeværelsesprojekter fra bund til finish

Stemningen skal være ordentlig, men arbejdet skal stadig afleveres skarpt. Hvis noget ikke stemmer på pladsen, siger du til i tide, så kunden får en løsning der holder.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som murer
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt på egne opgaver
  • Har erfaring med fliser eller badeværelser
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både renovering, nybyg og facadeopgaver før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar for dit arbejde og være en god kollega på pladsen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: [쿠팡] 로켓그로스 콘텐츠 마케터 계약직 (계약직, 전환 가능)
location: 서울 광진구 아차산로 412, 이스트폴 타워 A, EP Tower (East Pole Tower)
description:
About

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.



팀 소개

Seller Awareness 마케팅팀은 로켓그로스 서비스의 핵심 가치를 확산하고, 판매자(Seller)의 성공적인 온보딩과 비즈니스 성장을 지원합니다. 우리는 셀러 여정에 맞춘 브랜드 마케팅부터 가이드·교육 콘텐츠 개발, 신규 기능 및 정책을 알리는 GTM(Go-To-Market) 홍보 콘텐츠 기획까지 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션의 전 과정을 아우릅니다. 데이터에 기반한 전략적 사고와 다양한 콘텐츠 포맷을 통해 판매자에게 명확한 가치를 전달하고, 서비스의 지속 가능한 성장을 주도합니다.

Responsibilities

로켓그로스 셀러 어웨어니스 및 브랜드 마케팅 전략 수립 및 실행
셀러 여정을 기반으로 한 핵심 메시지 및 콘텐츠 방향성 기획
영상 및 디지털 콘텐츠 캠페인 기획, 제작, 운영 및 성과 분석
외부 제작사 및 에이전시와의 협업을 리딩하여 콘텐츠 제작 품질 및 일정 관리
AI 툴을 활용한 바이트 사이즈 (short-form) 콘텐츠의 자체 기획 및 제작
콘텐츠 성과 데이터 분석을 통한 인사이트 도출 및 전략 고도화

Requirements

콘텐츠 디렉팅- 디지털 콘텐츠 (특히 영상, 숏폼 등)의 기획부터 제작, 채널 운영 및 성과 분석까지의 Full-cycle 경험이 있으신 분
커뮤니케이션/PM- 외부 대행사, 제작사 및 사내 유관 부서와의 협업을 주도하고, 프로젝트 일정 및 퀄리티를 리딩해 본 경험이 있으신 분
데이터 기반 사고- 마케팅 성과 지표 (GA4, 콘텐츠 조회수, 전환율 등)를 직접 분석하고, 데이터 기반의 인사이트를 도출해 전략에 반영할 수 있으신 분

Preferred

AI 툴 활용력- ChatGPT, Midjourney, 다양한 영상/디자인 AI 툴을 실무에 적극적으로 활용하여 콘텐츠 제작 공정을 효율화(AGILE)해 본 경험이 있으신 분
편집 툴 활용력- 프리미어, 캡컷, 포토샵 등 편집 툴을 활용해 숏폼 등의 편집이 가능하신 분
스타트업/테크 기업 경험- 빠른 호흡의 이커머스나 IT/테크 기업에서 주도적으로 신규 캠페인을 세팅하고 리드해 본 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

• 열린 문화, 배움을 장려하는 문화
- 직책과 위계질서 대신 다양성이 공존하는 문화
- 배움 있는 삶, 사내 기술공유를 통한 스터디 활성화
- 외국어 및 기타 업무스킬관련 교육 무제한 지원

• 임직원 단체 상해보험
- 직계가족 대상 실손보험 지원

• 휴게공간
- 열심히 일한 당신을 위한 한강뷰 카페테리아,
- 300원에 모든 음료를 즐길 수 있는 밴딩머신 등

• 무료 조식/석식 지원
- 맛있게 먹는 밥은 0칼로리

• 자유로운 휴가 만끽, 사유없는 연차사용

• 다양한 취미를 즐길수있는 사내동호회 및 동호회비 지원

title: Embedded AI Engineer Intern [IDA: 00051]
description:
As a team member of the Innovation team, you will be involved in the software development of innovative system solutions. This role offers hands-on experience in developing algorithms and systems that enable intelligent visual understanding for real-world applications, along with opportunities to contribute to research and innovation.

Intern would be working together with the R&D innovation team in the following tasks:
a) Assist in designing, implementing, and optimizing computer vision and perception algorithms.
b) Develop and test object detection, tracking, and recognition models using state-of-the-art techniques.
c) Conduct research on emerging computer vision methods, including literature reviews and benchmarking new algorithms.
d) Experiment novel approaches for object detection and perception.
e) Work with large datasets to train and evaluate models.
f) Collaborate with senior engineers and researchers to integrate vision algorithms into production systems.

a) Familiar with programming languages such as Python, C/C++, and embedded software development concepts.
b) Understanding of embedded systems, including microcontrollers, embedded Linux, hardware-software integration, and real-time systems.
c) Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals, including deep neural networks, model training, inference, and performance evaluation.
d) Exposure to computer vision and perception systems, including image processing, object detection, and feature extraction techniques.
e) Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and experience with model deployment pipelines is an advantage.
f) Understanding of Edge AI concepts, including model optimization, quantization, pruning, and deployment on resource-constrained devices.
g) Exposure to AI acceleration technologies such as CUDA, TensorRT, OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, or NPU-based platforms will be an advantage.
h) Familiarity with embedded AI hardware platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, STM32, ESP32, Qualcomm RB platforms, or similar edge computing devices is an advantage.
