title: Head of Government Affairs & Public Policy Australia
description:
Head of Government Affairs & Public Policy Australia

Description -

Role Summary

The Head of Australia Government Affairs & Public Policy (GA&PP) leads HP’s engagement with the Australian Federal Government, State and Territory Governments, the Department of Defence, regulators, industry bodies, and other key public-sector stakeholders to advance HP’s business objectives and public policy priorities.

The role is responsible for developing and executing integrated government affairs, policy advocacy, and stakeholder engagement strategies that strengthen HP’s market position and support growth across Australia’s government, defence, education, healthcare, and commercial sectors. The position serves as the primary advisor to HP ANZ leadership team on Australia’s evolving political, regulatory, and public-sector landscape, with particular focus on technology policy, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, privacy, sustainability, workforce capability, trade, and public procurement.

Working closely with business, sales, legal, compliance, and regional GA&PP teams, the Head of Australia GA&PP identifies opportunities and risks arising from legislative, regulatory, and policy developments, shapes external engagement strategies, and helps position HP as a trusted technology partner to government. The role also supports public-sector market access by building relationships with key government decision-makers, influencing policy and procurement frameworks, and aligning advocacy efforts with HP’s commercial priorities and long-term growth objectives in Australia.

Key Responsibilities

Policy & Regulatory Strategy (Australia)

  • Develop and execute GA&PP strategies specific to Australia, aligned with global and Greater Asia priorities.
  • Monitor, analyse, and influence legislative, regulatory, and policy developments across relevant ministries, agencies, and local governments.
  • Anticipate policy, regulatory, and geopolitical risks in Australia and advise senior leadership on business implications.

Government & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key Australian Government departments and agencies, including but not limited to the Department of Finance, Department of Industry, Science and Resources, Department of Home Affairs, Department of Defence, Digital Transformation Agency (DTA), Austrade, state and territory governments, and relevant regulators.
  • Develop and execute strategic engagement plans with ministers, ministerial offices, parliamentarians, senior public servants, regulators, and policy influencers.
  • Represent HP in government consultations, industry roundtables, advisory groups, and public policy forums.
  • Partner with industry associations, chambers of commerce, technology councils, and think tanks to advance policy positions aligned with HP's business interests and technology leadership.

Public-Sector Market Access & Procurement Engagement

  • Support public-sector market access by aligning policy advocacy with public procurement priorities and frameworks in Australia.
  • Engage with procurement authorities and policy owners to improve understanding of government buying processes, digital transformation initiatives, and technology adoption priorities.
  • Partner with sales, legal, and compliance teams to ensure government engagement strategies support public-sector opportunities while maintaining strict compliance.

Internal Advisory & Coordination

  • Act as a trusted advisor to Australia leadership and regional/global stakeholders on public policy and government engagement matters.
  • Translate complex policy and procurement developments into clear, actionable business impact assessments.
  • Ensure alignment between Australia-specific positions and global corporate policy stances.

Advocacy & Positioning

  • Develop policy positions, briefing materials, and government submissions tailored to the Australian context.
  • Support executive-level engagement with senior government officials.
  • Position the company as a credible, long-term partner to the Government of Australia.

Advocacy, Positioning & Risk Management

  • Develop policy positions, briefing materials, and government submissions tailored to the Australian context.
  • Support executive-level engagement with senior government officials. Identify and manage regulatory, reputational, and compliance risks related to government engagement and public procurement.
  • Support crisis response related to government, regulatory, or public-sector issues in Australia.

Team & Program Management (as applicable)

  • Lead or matrix-manage GA&PP resources and external advisors supporting Australia.
  • Manage public policy programs, consultants, and trade association participation.
  • Contribute to capability building across APJ GA&PP, particularly on Australia public-sector engagement.

Additional Requirement: Public-Sector Procurement Experience & Networks (Australia)

Candidates must demonstrate strong experience and credibility in Australia’s public-sector procurement ecosystem, including:

  • Proven experience engaging with Australian public-sector procurement bodies and policy owners at national and/or local government levels, including but not limited to defence and education.
  • Deep understanding of Australia’s government procurement frameworks, rules, and processes, including large-scale IT, digital, and services procurement.
  • Established professional networks and relationships within relevant ministries, agencies, and affiliated public institutions.
  • Experience shaping or influencing procurement-related policy discussions (e.g., digital government, cloud adoption, data, cybersecurity, ESG or sustainability criteria).
  • Ability to navigate Australia’s consensus-driven decision-making environment and align long-term relationship building with commercial and policy objectives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Law, Public Policy, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
  • 10–12+ years’ experience in government affairs, public policy, regulatory affairs, public-sector procurement, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Australia’s political, regulatory, and public procurement systems.
  • Track record of senior-level engagement with government officials and public-sector stakeholders in Australia.
  • Strong political acumen, judgment, and ability to operate in a complex, matrixed multinational organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English required.

Preferred Background

  • Prior experience in technology, digital services, or other regulated industries.
  • Previous roles in government, regulatory agencies, public-sector procurement bodies, or policy advisory organizations in Australia.
  • Experience coordinating Australia public policy positions within a regional (APJ) or global framework.

Knowledge, Skills & AI Acumen

  • Government affairs, public policy, regulatory and legislative processes, lobbying, and public‑sector procurement.
  • Strong understanding of business strategy, economics, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Policy analysis and development, regulatory affairs, public affairs, and thought leadership.
  • AI acumen: working knowledge of artificial intelligence and data‑driven technologies, including AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, cybersecurity, and emerging global and Australia‑specific AI regulatory and policy frameworks; ability to translate AI policy developments into clear business and government engagement strategies.
  • Program and project management capability in complex, cross‑functional environments.

Cross‑Organizational Capabilities

  • Effective and persuasive communication with senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Results orientation with strong judgment and learning agility.
  • Digital fluency and customer‑centric mindset.

Impact & Complexity

The role impacts large functions and leads complex, cross-division initiatives involving senior leadership and external stakeholders, requiring innovative and pragmatic solutions within established corporate and public-sector frameworks.

title: Water Resources Consultant
description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

As the premier design, engineering and environmental consultancy in Aotearoa New Zealand, WSP exists to future-proof our cities and environment. We are proud to have the blueprint of Aotearoa New Zealand in our DNA and our 2,500 expert professionals in 35 offices are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve.

Water Resources Consultant - Auckland

We have an exciting opportunity for a Water Resources Consultant to join our Auckland Water team. In this role, you will assist in the delivery of safe, high-quality outcomes for our clients, while contributing strongly to technical delivery across water infrastructure projects.

You will be part of a high-performance, inclusive team culture aligned to the Water Sector strategy and WSP’s Guiding Principles.

This is a full time role 40 hours per week Monday – Friday.

Salary - $95,000 - $105,000

About you:

  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in water resource engineering projects
  • Strong technical delivery and assurance experience across water infrastructure projects.
  • Commercial acumen, client focus, and the ability to contribute to project financial health, resourcing and utilisation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder relationship skills.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

WSP NZ has proudly earned its place among the top five employers to work for in Aotearoa New Zealand, as recognised in Randstad's latest employer survey. In addition, WSP has been listed as one of TIME’s 2023 top 100 companies globally for employees.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

We will review applications as they come in, so if this opportunity sounds like you, don’t wait to apply!

title: Ajoneuvoasentaja
location: Akaa, Hämeenkyrö, Kangasala, Nokia, Parkano, Pirkkala, Sastamala, Tampere, Ylöjärvi, Finland
description:
Etsitkö vakituista työtä ajoneuvoasentajana Tampereella, jossa pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi monipuolisesti?
Etsimme Tampereelle kokenutta ajoneuvoasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työnkuvaasi kuuluvat mm. Monipuoliset ajoneuvojen asennus ja huoltotyöt, kuten määräaikaishuollot, jarru ja alustatyöt, jakopään vaihtotyöt sekä vikadiagnostiikka. Työskentelet itsenäisesti, mutta sinulla on rinnalla osaava ja tukeva työporukka. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää aiempaa työkokemusta alalta, sillä työssä tarvitaan varmuutta ja oma-aloitteista otetta. Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.
Palkkaus osaamisen mukaan 15-19€/h
Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:
* Aiempaa työkokemusta ajoneuvoasentajan tehtävistä
* Osaamista huolto, jarru, jakopäät ja alustatöistä sekä vikadiagnostiikasta
* Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti
* Hyvä asenne ja motivaatio tehdä työ huolellisesti loppuun asti
Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:
* Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan.
* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa.
* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen.
Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!
Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.
Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.
Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä joonas.lahteenmaki@worker.fi
Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Assistant Director of Food & Beverage (Royal Orchid Sheraton Riverside Hotel Bangkok)
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Assists in leading the property’s food and beverage/culinary operation, including Restaurants/Bars, Room Service, and Banquets/Catering, where applicable. Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures the food and beverage/culinary operation meets the brand’s target customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department. Delivers products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Developing and Executing Food and Beverage Strategy and Goals

• Works with direct reports to develop and implement promotions, food and wine pairings, menu items and presentations.

• Develops a food and beverage operating strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.

• Ensures integration of departmental goals in game plans.

Leading Food and Beverage Teams

• Ensures that regular, on-going communication occurs in all areas of food and beverage (e.g., pre-meal briefings, staff meetings, culinary team).

• Works with direct reports to review business in house and potential business in surrounding area and troubleshoot potential challenges/conflicts.

• Ensures that regular, on-going communication occurs in all areas of food and beverage (e.g., pre-meal briefings and staff meetings).

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service and operational needs are met.

• Sets expectations and holds food and beverage leadership team accountable for demonstrating desired service behaviors.

• Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.

• Utilizes employee feedback and an “open door” policy to identify and address employee problems or concerns in a timely manner.

• Communicates critical information gained from pre- and post-convention meetings to areas of responsibility.

• Estimate food, liquor, wine, and other beverage consumption in order to anticipate amounts to be purchased or requisitioned.

• Order and purchase equipment and supplies.

Maximizing Food and Beverage Revenue

• Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Food and Beverage is performing against budget.

• Ensures cash control and liquor control policies are in place in food & beverage areas and followed by all related employees.

• Encourages calculated risk-taking to generate incremental revenue and deliver Savvy Service.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Creates an atmosphere in all food and beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Strives to improve service performance.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

• Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

• Communicates and executes departmental and property emergency procedures.

• Hires food & beverage leadership team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.

• Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program and receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

• Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.

• Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Pensionsrådgiver søges til rådgivning, sagsbehandling og projektarbejde - Lægernes Pension & Bank
description:
Pensionsrådgiver søges til rådgivning, sagsbehandling og projektarbejde - Lægernes Pension & Bank
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		

		
	
	
		
		
		
		
			

				

					


					

						
						
						


						
							
						
					

				

			

			
			

				

					
				

			

			
		
		

			

				

					Pensionsrådgiver søges til rådgivning, sagsbehandling og projektarbejde
					
Lægernes Pension søger en engageret pensionsrådgiver til en spændende stilling med både rådgivnings-, sagsbehandlings- og projektopgaver. Stillingen henvender sig til kandidater med erfaring fra finansbranchen.

					
Vi er en mindre afdeling med høj faglighed. Det betyder, at du kan få ansvar, variation og mulighed for at påvirke mange forskellige opgaver og løsninger.

					Jobbet
					
Opgaverne i Pensionsafdelingen kan i hovedtræk beskrives således:

					
						
Rådgivning af medlemmer om pensionsprodukter via telefon og skriftlig kommunikation.

						
Sagsbehandling af pensionsforløb fra optagelse til udbetaling, herunder ved pensionering, kritisk sygdom, dækning ved tab af erhvervsevne og dødsfald.

						
Vi udvikler løbende vores medlemssystem, hvilket giver os opgaver med at designe løsninger, teste dem og optimere arbejdsgange.

						
Foretage analyser og bidrage til optimering af produkter og services.

					
					
Ikke alle arbejder med alle ovenstående opgaver, men vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af ansvars- og opgaveområder. Hvis du holder af afveksling i hverdagen, er fagligt dygtig og engageret, er vi det rette sted for dig.

					
					Dine kvalifikationer
					
Vi forventer, at du:

					
						
Har en uddannelsesbaggrund som finansøkonom, finansbachelor, finanselev eller fra Forsikringsakademiet. Du er eller har ambition om at blive IDD-certificeret på niveau 5.

						
Har en analytisk og struktureret tilgang til opgaveløsning.

						
Er en holdspiller, der hjælper dine kolleger, når der er brug for det.

						
Har gode kommunikationsevner og kan formidle komplekse emner på en forståelig måde

						
Har lyst til at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø med mange forskellige opgaver.

						
Har erfaring med pensionsområdet. Interesse for skattereglerne er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

						
Interesse for udvikling af nye løsninger til gavn for vores medlemmer.

					
					
					
					Det får du glæde af
					
						
En stilling med mulighed for både rådgivning, sagsbehandling og udviklingsopgaver.

						
Fleksible arbejdstider, attraktiv løn, pensionsordning og syv ugers ferie.

						
Et professionelt og fagligt stærkt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige kolleger.

						
Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse.

						
En centralt beliggende arbejdsplads med let adgang til offentlig transport. 


					
					



					
					
					
					
				

				

					


					

						
						
					
					

						Sådan søger du jobbet 
						
Send din ansøgning vedlagt CV, eksamenspapirer og andre relevante bilag. Vælg "pensionsrådgiver" i emnefeltet.

						
Klik her

						
Ansøgningsfristen er d. 30. september 2026. Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send din ansøgning så snart du kan, hvis du finder stillingen interessant.

						
Lægernes Pension & Bank ønsker at skabe en arbejdsplads, der afspejler samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, funktionsnedsættelse, seksuel orientering og etnisk baggrund til at søge vores ledige stillinger.

					

					

						Vil du høre mere om jobbet
						
Er du velkommen til at kontakte medlemschef Vibeke Aagaard på 71 91 92 42 eller vta@lpb.dk.

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.


Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00. 

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.

title: Medarbejder til 10.erhvervsklasse
description:
Se her!

Brændkjærskolen i Kolding søger medarbejder til 10.erhvervsklasse

Vi søger en dygtig medarbejder, der kan følge eleverne, både når de er på skolen og når de er i brobygning på ungdomsuddannelserne. Der kan være mindre undervisningsopgaver forbundet med stillingen, herunder co-teaching- og holddelingstimer.

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til udgangen af juni 2027 og på fuld tid.

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Du har en uddannelse som enten lærer eller pædagog eller tilsvarende kvalifikationer

  • Du er anerkendende i din tilgang til andre

  • Du er tydelig og god til klasserumsledelse og kan skabe gode relationer

  • Du trives i teamsamarbejdet

  • Du kan lide at planlægge og udføre spændende og inspirerende forløb – alene og sammen med andre – og reflektere over egen praksis.

  • Du har fokus på at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle elever

  • Du skaber trivsel for alle unge, så de er glade for at gå i skole og har lyst til at lære

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst, stabil, fleksibel og interesseret i faglig udvikling

  • Du har humor

Vi tilbyder:

  • De skønneste elever og forældre, der bakker op om skolen og et stærkt lokalsamfund

  • Engagerede og dygtige kolleger, der står parat med hjælp og sparring

  • Mentorordning for alle nyansatte

  • En arbejdsplads med rum for at afprøve nye ideer og udvikle spændende læringstilgange

Hvem er vi?

Brændkjærskolen er en folkeskole beliggende i Koldings sydlige bydel i dejlige, grønne omgivelser. Vi har gode bygningsmæssige forhold og ca. 850 elever fordelt på grundskole fra 0.-9. klasse, Kolding Kommunes 10. klassecenter, og Team Danmark Sportsklasser.

Du kan se mere på skolens hjemmeside Brændkjær

På Brændkjærskolen møder vi hinanden i øjenhøjde, og du vil hurtigt mærke den særlige ”Brændkjærånd”, der er på skolen og ikke mindst i lokalsamfundet, hvor der er stor opbakning til skolen og til den generelle udvikling af Brændkjær som bydel.

Når vi efter et stykke tid spørger nye kolleger, hvad de er særligt glade for ved opstarten, fremhæver de ofte kollegernes modtagelse af dem og den hjælp, der altid er klar.

Ansøgningsfrist d.27.august 2026

Samtaler afholdes d.31.august 2026

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås hos skoleleder Ulla Rasmussen, tlf.24645326 eller på ulras@kolding.dk


Løn: Efter gældende overenskomst

Ansøgning sendes elektronisk via knappen "Søg stillingen".

Arbejdssted: Brændkjærskolen

Arbejdstid: Fuld tid

Ansættelsestidspunkt: 1.oktober 2026, eller hurtigst muligt.

Alle stillinger er fuldtidsstillinger medmindre andet er angivet. Kolding Kommune opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen. Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.

title: Water Resource Engineer
description:
Water Resource Engineer

Location: Waterbury, Vermont, USA

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

We are SLR International, a 1,000+ North American team of advisory, environmental/engineering, and regulatory professionals. We deliver environmental and sustainability services to our clients through the integration of over 30 advisory, technical environmental, and engineering disciplines to help clients address some of their most complex challenges around sustainability. We are Making Sustainability Happen.

SLR Consulting is seeking an entry- to mid-level Water Resources Engineer to work in its Water Resource Engineering group located in Richmond, Vermont. Richmond is a vibrant historic village that sits on the Winooski River between Montpelier and Burlington. This job offers candidates the opportunity to work on a wide range of water resource projects such as dam removal, floodplain restoration, flood mitigation, stormwater management, and bridge/culvert design. This permanent position is an excellent opportunity to learn and do important work for communities, while collaborating with a diverse team on a variety of projects.

The ideal candidate will have familiarity with hydrology and hydraulic calculations and modeling, GIS mapping, and CAD drafting. The work will include periodic field trips to complete a variety of assessment and data collection tasks that will involve work in and around rivers or roads.

Responsibilities

  • Provide engineering design and develop technical drawings using GIS and AutoCAD for water resource projects
  • Perform hydrologic and hydraulic calculations and modeling
  • Collect monitoring data and perform field observations in rivers and floodplains
  • Provide technical support for engineering analysis and design of water resources projects
  • Prepare technical documents and reports
  • Prepare maps and conduct analysis using GIS
  • Participate on our team with a positive attitude
  • Manage and develop projects, for those with more experience

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Occasional extended work hours may be required to meet deadlines or conduct long field trips
  • Work outdoors in environmental conditions that include heat, rain, snow, humidity, and cold
  • During field visits, stand for long periods, climb hills, and walk through riparian corridors, forests, and undeveloped terrain, on uneven ground, and conduct work within a stream channel
  • Endure exposure to insects and wildlife
  • Occasionally lift and move up to 40 pounds
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Basic to advanced computer skills required

Working @ SLR

We want to be a place where you can experience career growth and satisfaction for many years. We care about investing in our employees for the long-run. We offer a vibrant working culture that nurtures learning and professional growth through mentorship and daily collaboration on projects.

Here’s what else you’ll enjoy as part of our team

  • Competitive compensation package including medical, dental, orthodontia, vision, FSA/HSA, 10 paid holidays, PTO accrual, 401(k) retirement account with company matching program, company paid life insurance, short & long term disability insurance, and employee assistance program.
  • The salary range for this position is $50,000 - $80,000. Final agreed upon compensation will be commensurate with individual education, professional designation, experience, internal parity, and location.

Qualifications/Education/Memberships:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering
  • 0 to 6 years' experience in water resource design
  • Experience applying modeling (e.g., HEC RAS, HEC HMS, and others)
  • Engineer in Training (EIT) or Professional Engineer (PE) certification preferred
  • Consulting experience a plus
  • Working knowledge of ArcPro GIS
  • Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D
  • Technical writing proficiency
  • Interest in helping the community
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Passion to meet deadlines and learn

Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) are at the core of who we are

SLR is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, civil union status, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or veteran status.

At SLR, we embrace diverse cultures, perspectives, skills, and experiences within and outside our organization. We respect and celebrate differences and want to ensure that we continuously strive to build a place where everyone feels included and is encouraged to be their authentic self.

We are committed to these values, and our SLR Culture & Diversity Team works to actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion across our people and talent processes, operations, and client work around the world. If you have a disability and need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please contact us at careers-us@slrconsulting.com.

title: Category Specialist - Australia Infrastructure
description:

About Us

Chevron is a leading multinational energy company with operations in over 180 countries. Founded in 1879, Chevron has a rich history of innovation and growth, making significant contributions to the global energy landscape.


Chevron has been present in Australia for over 70 years. Chevron Australia Downstream, an Australian subsidiary of the Chevron Corporation, delivers quality fuel and lubricant products and services, including via its national network of Caltex service stations. Caltex customers receive a warm and friendly service and take advantage of the specially formulated fuel system-cleaning ingredient Techron®, available in all grades of fuel at the Caltex service stations.

Chevron Australia Downstream also owns and operates three product import terminals. We deliver products and services to a range of industries including mining, resources, agriculture, transport, marine and aviation. We offer services such as bulk fuel supply, oils and lubricants, fuel equipment solutions, customised fleet fuel card solutions and expert advice on fuel management and health and safety.


At Chevron, we believe humanity can solve any challenge – including meeting the world’s energy needs of today, while advancing a cleaner energy tomorrow.

About the Role

The Category Specialist is responsible for managing the full spectrum of the Procurement processes and activities, providing category management leadership, functional guidance, and coordination for all aspects of procurement to the International Fuel & Lubricants business in Australia. The scope of the Procurement categories includes both direct and indirect Procurement, covering tank terminals maintenance, engineering works, capital projects, logistics, professional services, packaging, and others general services.

The role will require close collaboration and positive relationship building with management, business stakeholders, regional/local Procurement team and external vendors to deliver commercial value in support of Chevron’s business objectives.

The ideal candidate thinks strategically and collaborative but also work with significant autonomy; a strong individual who can drive category strategies and has proven track record of managing multiple initiatives and driving them to completion to meet business objectives; communicates effectively and strong ability to influence business stakeholders and suppliers at all levels and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement.

This role will be based in Brisbane.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Manage a portfolio of assigned categories, which includes:

    • Category analysis – conducts supply market analysis and market benchmarking

    • Develop country annual contracting plan to align with business plan objectives. Regular engagement with stakeholders to review and prioritize projects

    • Develop procurement strategies to execute sustainable cost savings for the business. Ensure that strategic sourcing principles are consistently used to drive best practices

    • Sourcing and negotiation - utilizes strategic sourcing process and techniques to ensure competitive advantage. Leads negotiations or assists the lead negotiator in developing and applying appropriate negotiation strategies and tactics

    • Write contracts. Implementation of agreements and integration of key suppliers - develops transition plans and oversees implementation of new agreements in conjunction with relevant business experts

    • Supplier performance monitoring. Develop mechanism and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery

    • Ongoing supplier and contract management - develops supplier relationships to ensure that cost reduction and value creation are ongoing activities. Utilizes strategic cost management tools and trend forecasts to assist in maximizing value of supplier relationships and contracts

  • Provides functional guidance to the business stakeholders and drives Procure-to-Pay (P2P) compliance

    • Executing end-to-end procurement process in alignment and compliant with the company policies and procedures

    • Acts as a procurement advisor providing category guidance and implementation of global/regional initiatives at a local level.

    • Provide advice and consultation to business stakeholders on procurement and contract management policies.

    • Provide P2P training and work closely with stakeholders to increase P2P fluency.

  • Support Regional Category Managers in driving cost management opportunities and special projects for the business

    • Work collaboratively as a business partner to explore and implement any cost savings and/or efficiency management opportunities

    • Regularly communicates plans and progress to ensure alignment and influence the broad adoption of cost reduction strategies.

    • Leverage technologies or data analytical platforms to enhance procurement performance and process efficiency.

    • Drive synergy and enterprise sourcing initiatives.

    • Support special projects, i.e., sustainability programs

About You

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.

Knowledge, skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, supply chain or related fields.

  • At least 5 years of Procurement experience. Procurement experience in terminal and/or blend plant environment would be a plus.

  • Experience with category management covering category planning, contract management, supplier management and possess strong negotiation skills.

  • Experience in developing / applying total cost ownership (TCO), should cost modeling and other category management techniques in strategic sourcing.

  • Knowledge in commercial and financial analysis associated with procurement activities.

  • Strong analytical and project management skills

  • Good team player and strong drive for performance and results

  • Excellent written, verbal communication and presentation skills.

  • E-Procurement knowledge - SAP capability is a plus.


Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way (https://www.chevron.com/about/the-chevron-way). At the heart of The Chevron Way is our vision to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnership, and performance.

Participate in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing workplace.

The successful candidate may be entitled to the following benefits (eligibility criteria applies):

  • Optional hybrid working model, including working from home on Fridays (where applicable and in line with business requirements)

  • Paid parental leave – 14 weeks full pay for primary carer and two weeks full pay for secondary carer

  • Above superannuation guarantee legislation contributions

  • Additional 40 hours of annual leave per annum

  • Health and wellness offerings including fitness membership reimbursement and employee assistance program (counselling service)

  • Education assistance and 24 hours study leave per annum

  • Additional leave entitlements for compassionate leave, family and domestic violence leave, defense reserve leave and community service

  • Annual bonus program (performance-based)

  • Long service awards and recognition program

  • Fuel discount available after probation

  • Vehicle allowance and novated leave options (applicable only for designated roles)

  • Recreation club and various social events (i.e. Melbourne Cup lunch, yearend celebration, fun runs, trivia nights etc.)

  • The opportunity to collaborate with people outside of your workgroups by joining one of our employee networks. Employee Networks are groups of employees focused on the following dimensions of diversity: gender, race, sexual orientation, age, disability, military service and nationality


Chevron Australia values inclusivity and promotes a workplace that actively seeks to welcome contributions from all people. We encourage people of all abilities, genders, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, diverse cultures, and backgrounds, LGBTIQ+ identities, and all age groups to apply.


Chevron is committed to building a safe and respectful workplace where everyone is valued for their contribution to our energy future. title: Hanketyöntekijä
description:
Haemme joukkoomme hanketyöntekijää

Savukosken kunta julistaa haettavaksi määräaikaisen hanketyöntekijän (50 % työaika) tehtävän Savukosken turvalliset kylät -hankkeeseen.

Haemme hanketyöntekijää toteuttamaan kyläturvallisuuden ja varautumisen kehittämishanketta yhteistyössä kuntalaisten, kylien, yhdistysten, viranomaisten ja muiden yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Hankkeen tavoitteena on vahvistaa kuntalaisten varautumista häiriö- ja kriisitilanteisiin sekä kehittää Savukosken kylien turvallisuutta ja valmiutta.

Hanketyöntekijä vastaa hankkeen käytännön toteutuksesta. Tehtäviin kuuluvat hankkeen toimenpiteiden suunnittelu ja toteutus, aikataulutus, viestintä, yhteistyö kylien, yhdistysten ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa, hankkeen tilaisuuksien järjestäminen, asiantuntijatyöryhmän valmistelu ja tukeminen, hankkeen seuranta, raportointi sekä maksatuksen hakeminen. Työssä tehdään tiivistä yhteistyötä kunnanjohtajan kanssa, joka toimii hankkeen vastuuhenkilönä.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus.

Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen hanketyöstä, turvallisuus- tai varautumistehtävistä, yhdistys- ja verkostoyhteistyöstä sekä julkisesta hallinnosta. Arvostamme omaaloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja, organisointikykyä sekä sujuvaa kirjallista ilmaisua.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka määräytyy KVTES mukaisesti. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kahden (2) kuukauden koeaikaa. Tehtävään valitun on ennen työn aloittamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan.

Työsuhde on määräaikainen ajalle 1.10.2026-31.3.2027. Työaika on 50 % täydestä työajasta. Tehtävä täytetään edellyttäen, että Lapin Elinvoimakeskus tekee hankkeelle myönteisen rahoituspäätöksen.

Kunnassa on liukuva työaika ja mahdollisuus tehdä etätyötä kunnan etätyöohjeen mukaisesti.

Olemme savuton työnantaja.

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme hyvät henkilöstöedut (mm. Epassi tai EpassiBIKE, kunnan kuntosalin maksuton käyttöoikeus sekä apua vuokra-asunnon etsimisessä).

Hakemus ja ansioluettelo tulee jättää Kuntarekry -palvelun kautta (www.kuntarekry.fi). Hakuaika päättyy 10.09.2026 klo 23.59. Haastattelut järjestetään 15.9.2026 Savukosken kunnanvirastolla tai Teamsilla.

title: Kylmälaiteasentaja, Keski-Suomi
description:

Kylmälaiteasentajana vastaat kylmäjärjestelmien ja -laitteiden toimivuudesta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä. Työ sisältää mm:

* kaupallisten kylmälaitteiden asennusta

* kylmä- ja ilmastointijärjestelmien huoltoa, vianetsintää ja korjauksia

* asiakaskohteissa tapahtuvaa itsenäistä työskentelyä

* raportointia ja dokumentointia työjärjestelmiin

Työ on vaihtelevaa, itsenäistä ja edellyttää asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Y3 / A1 - Pätevyys
* Talotekniikka-alan koulutus - työ on vastuullista ja peruskoulutuksen pitää olla kunnossa.

* Useamman vuoden kokemus kylmätekniikasta - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa.

* Valmiutta tehdä myös reissutöitä - osa asiakkaan kohteista sijaitsee Keksi-Suomen ulkopuolella.

* Voimassa olevat kortit (Työturvallisuus, B-ajokortti) - jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
* Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.

* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan TES
* Pitkäaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen 37,5h/vko
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Perehdytyksen työhön.
* Jokaiseen tyotehtavaan soveltuvat tyovarusteet.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen ari.ahonen(at)visiohr.fi. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Keski-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Jyväskylästä käsin Ari ja Mikko-Matti.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Päijät-Häme on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Head of Embodied AI
description:
Head of Embodied AI, Data Foundry

Location: Remote, United States, HQ - Atlanta, GA

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord operates one of the largest independent e-commerce fulfillment networks in the U.S., with 20+ fulfillment centers, 4,000+ warehouse associates, and nearly 100 million packages shipped annually. We’re now building a new business line that transforms this real-world operational infrastructure into high-value training data for the next generation of physical AI.

We’re looking for an early leader to help build this business from the ground up—shaping the strategy, defining the operating model, and turning Stord’s physical network into a differentiated data asset for the future of AI.

Why This Role:

This is a rare opportunity to build a new AI business from zero, backed by the physical infrastructure, operational footprint, and resources to give it a meaningful head start.

You will have:

  • A structural data advantage. Direct access to one of the largest independent e-commerce fulfillment networks in the U.S.—an operational environment that would be extremely difficult for a startup to replicate.

  • Direct access to a rapidly growing buyer market. Work directly with the robotics companies, AI labs, and physical AI teams building the next generation of intelligent machines.

  • A direct line to the founders. Partner closely with the CTO and Co-Founder, who will join initial customer conversations, help shape the business, and remove internal obstacles.

  • True ownership. You won’t be inheriting an established business. You’ll define the strategy, win the first customers, build the product and operation, hire the team, and ultimately own the P&L.

This is an opportunity to build the company that turns real-world operations into the data infrastructure for embodied AI.

What You'll Do:

You will be the first dedicated hire for this initiative, reporting directly to the CTO and Co-Founder. You will have end-to-end ownership of the early Embodied AI business—including the product, customers, data capture program, data operations, team, and P&L.

This is a true builder-operator role. You will:

  • Win the first customers. Lead customer discovery and close initial pilots with humanoid robotics companies, AI labs, and physical AI companies. You’ll engage directly with VPs of AI, Heads of Data, and technical leaders to understand their training requirements and translate those needs into products Stord can deliver.

  • Define and build the product. Own the data product roadmap across quality tiers—from RGB egocentric video to depth-enhanced and full multimodal datasets with hand pose, annotations, and other metadata. You’ll prioritize what gets built based on customer demand and willingness to pay, while setting and maintaining a high bar for data quality.

  • Build and run the capture operation. Stand up the warehouse-based data capture program, including camera and rig selection, participant enrollment, edge processing, data pipelines, and dataset packaging. You’ll coordinate across warehouse operations, engineering, and customers to deliver datasets on spec and on schedule.

  • Build the team. Hire and lead a small, highly senior team, scaling it as the business grows. You’ll set the technical direction and quality bar, make architecture and tradeoff decisions, and ensure the team builds the right systems. You don’t need to write every line of code—you need to know what good looks like and make sure it gets built.

Basic Qualifications:

  • End-to-end data operations experience. You’ve built or operated a data operation or data product within robotics, AI, or a related technical environment. You understand the full lifecycle—from defining what data to collect and deploying capture hardware, through annotation and quality control, to delivering production-ready datasets to ML teams.

  • Technical depth with strong execution. You’re technical enough to lead engineers and make sound architecture decisions, but your greatest strength is getting complex initiatives across the finish line. You can evaluate a pipeline design, understand computer vision and ML data formats, and communicate credibly with both engineers and customers. You don’t need to be the person writing the pipeline—you need to ensure the right pipeline gets built.

  • Commercial instinct. You’ve either sold data products to robotics or AI companies, or you’ve been the ML customer buying data and understand what makes a dataset genuinely valuable. You can lead discovery, translate customer requirements into a product specification, and carry an opportunity from first conversation through pilot and close.

  • Exceptional operating range. You’re comfortable moving between strategy and execution—negotiating pilot terms in the morning, reviewing an annotation quality report at noon, and briefing a warehouse GM on a deployment that afternoon. You thrive at the intersection of product, commercial, operations, and engineering.

  • Deep understanding of physical AI. You understand the physical AI landscape, the needs of humanoid robotics companies and AI labs, and the role that high-quality real-world data plays in training vision-language-action models and deploying robots in production. You understand why egocentric demonstration data is one of the critical bottlenecks to scaling embodied intelligence.

title: OT Engineer - Windows Deployment & Migration
description:
Är du en tekniskt skicklig IT-specialist med erfarenhet av Windows-migreringar och endpoint-hantering? Trivs du i industriella miljöer där stabilitet, säkerhet och minimala driftstopp är avgörande? Då kan rollen som OT Engineer vara något för dig.

Om rollen

Som OT Engineer ansvarar du för planering och genomförande av Windows-imagering, utrullning och migreringsaktiviteter inom OT- och produktionsmiljöer. Rollen fokuserar på enhetsutbyte, operativsystemsinstallationer, applikationsdistribution, konfiguration av klienter samt support i samband med migreringar.

Du kommer att arbeta nära IT-, OT- och verksamhetsteam för att säkerställa en smidig övergång med minimal påverkan på produktionen. Erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustri, produktionsanläggningar eller andra industriella miljöer är meriterande.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Genomföra Windows 10- och Windows 11-installationer samt utrullningar med hjälp av MECM/SCCM och Task Sequences.
  • Utföra uppgraderingar och migreringar av klientdatorer, inklusive utbyte av hårdvara, ominstallationer och in-place-upgraderingar.
  • Säkerställa kompatibilitet mellan hårdvara, operativsystem och applikationer inför migreringar.
  • Installera och konfigurera operativsystem, drivrutiner, affärskritiska applikationer och säkerhetsinställningar.
  • Hantera migrering av användarprofiler och data med lämpliga verktyg och metoder.
  • Utföra domänanslutningar i Active Directory, verifiera GPO-inställningar, aktivera BitLocker samt genomföra efterlevnads- och säkerhetskontroller.
  • Koordinera migreringsaktiviteter tillsammans med IT-, OT-, site- och verksamhetsteam.
  • Felsöka problem relaterade till installationer, applikationer, utrullningar och endpoint-hantering.
  • Ge support på plats under migreringar, genomföra cutover-aktiviteter samt erbjuda förstärkt support efter genomförd migrering.
  • Dokumentera processer, rutiner, implementationer och kunskapsartiklar.
  • Säkerställa att förändringshantering, säkerhetskrav och operativa standarder följs genom hela migreringsprocessen.

Kvalifikationer

Tekniska krav

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av:

  • Windows 10 och Windows 11 Deployment & Migration
  • Operating System Deployment (OSD)
  • Applikationsdistribution och paketering
  • BitLocker-administration
  • Felsökning och support av klientmiljöer
  • Asset Management, compliance och rapportering
  • Incident- och Change Management i ServiceNow

Meriterande erfarenhet

  • 2-3 års erfarenhet av endpoint management och Windows-migreringsprojekt.
  • Erfarenhet av klienthantering i industri-, produktions- eller shop floor-miljöer.
  • Kunskap om migreringsanalyser, kompatibilitetstester för applikationer och automationslösningar för deployment.
  • Förståelse för de krav och begränsningar som gäller i OT- och tillverkningsmiljöer.

Språkkrav

  • Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi söker dig som

  • Är strukturerad och noggrann i ditt arbetssätt.
  • Har god problemlösningsförmåga och trivs med teknisk felsökning.
  • Kan samarbeta effektivt med både tekniska team och verksamhetsrepresentanter.
  • Är flexibel och bekväm med att arbeta i verksamhetskritiska miljöer där produktionen alltid står i fokus.

title: Software Engineer Principal ( Sr DevOps Engineer)
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Software Engineering Principal within PNC's Technology organization, you will be based in Dallas, TX or Pittsburgh, PA.

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support enterprise DevOps capabilities across a portfolio of mission-critical applications and platforms. This individual will be responsible for building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure automation, deployment tooling, observability solutions, and platform engineering capabilities that enable development teams to deliver software securely, reliably, and efficiently.

The ideal candidate possesses strong Linux administration skills, deep
expertise in automation and release engineering, and hands-on experience with container platforms, infrastructure as code, monitoring, DevSecOps, and production support. This role will partner closely with application development, infrastructure, architecture, security, and operations teams to drive automation, standardization, reliability, and operational excellence.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain enterprise CI/CD pipelines and release automation frameworks.
• Automate application deployment, environment promotion, and rollback processes across development, test, staging, and production environments.
• Lead the automation of Pega deployment and promotion activities while establishing repeatable deployment patterns for other application platforms.
• Support production turnovers, releases, and maintenance activities, including direct execution of deployments when required.
• Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to automate provisioning, configuration, and platform management.
• Build and maintain automation using Ansible, Jenkins, scripting languages, and other DevOps tooling.
• Engineer containerized deployment solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
• Implement and support monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms to improve system reliability and operational visibility.
• Partner with security teams to integrate vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, secrets management, and DevSecOps controls into delivery pipelines.
• Develop operational standards, deployment procedures, runbooks, and disaster recovery processes.
• Support root cause analysis, incident management, problem management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Evaluate emerging DevOps technologies and recommend solutions that improve automation, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for DevOps practices, release engineering, platform management, and operational excellence.
Required Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering, Release Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or Systems Engineering.
• Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience in enterprise environments.
• Extensive experience with Jenkins pipeline development and administration.
• Strong experience with Ansible and configuration management automation.
• Hands-on experience with container technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
• Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, Ansible, or comparable technologies.
• Experience supporting enterprise source control and repository platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar tools.
• Strong scripting and automation skills using Bash, Python, PowerShell, Groovy, or equivalent scripting languages.
• Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and release automation solutions.
• Experience supporting highly available production environments and mission-critical applications.
• Strong understanding of networking, security, operating systems, and enterprise infrastructure concepts.
• Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Aligns business strategy with software solutions.
  • Proposes, designs & codes software solutions to address complex business needs. Oversees technical and procedural documentation required.
  • Leads complex problem solving.
  • Provides technical guidance and support to colleagues and solution development.
  • Displays an innovative approach to apply modern principles, methodologies and tools to advance business initiatives and capabilities.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Application Development, Business Management, Customer Solutions, Design, Group Problem Solving, Pega Platform, Process Improvements, Release Management, Software Solutions, User Experience (UX) Design

Competencies

Application Design, Architecture, Packaged Application Integration, Product and Vendor Evaluation, Software Process Improvement (SPI), System Development Life Cycle, Technical Troubleshooting

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 5+ years of industry-relevant experience. Specific certifications are often required. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

No Required License(s)

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit .

Disability Accommodations Statement

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.


At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)


PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history.

California Residents

Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

   Data Scientist 
 
 Do you have a strategic and analytical mindset? Do you possess a proactive attitude and thrive in a data-driven decision making environment? Do you fancy a career as a data scientist in Denmark’s largest retailer?
 Then you might be our new colleague
 We are looking for a business minded data scientist to be part of our Business Analysis team in Netto Finance, located at Netto HQ in Køge.  

 You and the team have the responsibility of driving strategic projects across business units utilizing and processing the huge amount of data available in Salling Group leading to insights that enable more informed business decision-making creating a difference for our customers. 

 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 
 Through data analyses create insights to support core retail and finance processes 

 Together with the team, design, develop and implement tools and models that utilize the data to create business impact in new ways 

 Ensure efficient data availability including tailor-build tools 

 Support the general data-driven transformation in Salling Group 
 
 Your skills and background 

 You have a Master’s degree within economics, IT or engineering (e.g. cand.scient, cand.oecon, cand.merc). Preferably, you have a couple of years’ of experience as a data scientist or in a similar role, where you have acquired the necessary skills to succeed as a data scientist. 

 Alternatively, you compensate for your lack of experience by being a top-performer and by having relevant experience in a student job during your studies. You have a natural interest in data and how it can be utilized to create business impact. Beside your passion for data, you have a strong business acumen enabling you to utilize the right data and making the best analysis for the problem at hand. 

 You have an analytical mindset, a structured way of working and is a real problem-solver. You have experience with extracting, cleaning and transforming data as well as data modelling creating measures and reports that fuel solid business decisions across Salling Group. 

 You have experience with programming/scripting languages such as R, Python, DAX and SQL. 

 As a person you are curious of nature and have an eagerness to take on a very steep learning-curve. You are proactive and have a ‘self-starter attitude’ and can independently focus, see opportunities and invite yourself to the table. 

 Fluency in Danish is an advantage.  

 We offer 
 
 An exciting career with a steep learning curve in an international company in continued growth, giving you extensive opportunity for both personal and professional growth 

 A diversified job with impact and responsibilities 

 Being part of a highly professional team in a dynamic environment offering you deep insights in retail 

 Competitive salary package and benefits 
 
 Are you the person for the job?  

 Send your application, resume and copy of your grades as soon as possible - and no later than August 14th 2026.
 Please note that applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis and therefore the job application may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have proceeded with candidates to the screening or interview phase

title: [쿠팡] 광고사업부 아웃바운드 마케팅 컨설턴트 (계약직, 전환가능)
location: 서울 광진구 아차산로 412, 이스트폴 타워 A, EP Tower (East Pole Tower)
description:
About

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.



조직 소개

Coupang Ads는 세계 최고 수준의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향합니다. Coupang Ads는 광고주가 매출 증대, 시장 점유율 증가, 신규 고객 확보 및 브랜드 자산 구축과 같은 마케팅 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 우리의 솔루션은 광고주의 니즈를 반영하며, 광고주의 규모와는 상관없이 그들의 비즈니스 성장을 돕기 위해 기획합니다. Coupang Ads는 Sales, Marketing, Video Product, Operations, Product, Engineering 팀과 같은 다기능적이고 협업적인 팀들로 구성되어 있습니다.

우리는 각자의 분야에서 전문가이며 항상 광고주를 우리가 하는 모든 일의 중심에 둡니다. 우리는 제품과 서비스에 열정을 가지고 있으며 이는 우리가 하는 일의 가치를 높여 줍니다. Coupang Ads 구성원들은 Coupang Ads를 일하기 좋은 곳으로 만드는데 큰 역할을 하며, 우리는 빠르게 변화하는 역동적인 환경에서 일하고 싶어하는 다양한 배경을 가진 사람들을 고용하고 개발하며, 각 직원이 존중과 권한을 부여 받고 지원받는다고 느낄 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다. 이런 환경과 사람들은 광고주를 대신하여 혁신적인 관점을 제공할 수 있습니다. 우리는 고객중심의 생각, 끈기, 사려 깊음, 그리고 신속한 행동을 직접 보여줄 수 있는 자질을 중요하게 생각합니다.

우리의 목표는 세계 최고의 광고 팀에서 일하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 만드는 것입니다. 혁신적이고 역동적인 환경에서 업계를 선도하고, 팀과 함께 성장을 달성하고자 하는 열정적인 분이라면 Coupang Ads와 함께하세요.
Coupang Ads에서 여러분은 세계에서 가장 가치 있고 가장 빠르게 성장하는 광고 솔루션 중 하나를 제공하게 될 것입니다.

Responsibilities

쿠팡애즈 (광고사업부) 아웃바운드 마케팅
쿠팡 광고를 사용 중인 광고주 인큐베이션 (광고영업 및 최적화 가이드)
쿠팡 광고를 사용 중이지 않은 판매자 광고 컨설팅 및 문의지원

Requirements

학사 이상의 학위를 보유하신 분
전문지식을 기반으로 한 설득 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
능동적 아웃바운드 전화 업무에 익숙하신 분
이커머스/디지털 광고에 대한 이해도가 있으신 분
중급 이상 스킬의 엑셀을 활용한 업무 경험이 있으신 분

Preferred

세일즈 직무 경험이 있으신 분
텔레마케팅 관련 직무 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

• 주 5일 유연근무제
• 열린 문화, 배움을 장려하는 문화
- 직책과 위계질서 대신 다양성이 공존하는 문화
- 배움 있는 삶, 사내 기술공유를 통한 스터디 활성화
- 외국어 및 기타 업무스킬관련 교육 무제한 지원
• 임직원 단체 상해보험
- 직계가족 대상 실손보험 지원

• 자유로운 휴가 만끽, 사유없는 연차사용

title: CNC-koneistaja
description:
Etsimme hyvämaineiselle ja arvostetulle metallialan asiakasyrityksellemme Pirkkalaan CNC-SORVAAJAA. Työtä tehdään Fanuc-ohjatulla CNC-sorvilla, tarkemmin kone valikoituu valitun tekijän vahvuuksien mukaan.

Tehtävässä valmistetaan pienehköjä ja vaihtelevia kappaleita. Kyseessä on melko monipuolinen tehtävä, jossa ohjelmointiosaaminen WinCAM:lla katsotaan eduksi.

Työtä tehdään 2-vuorossa ma - pe ja haussa on vakituinen työntekijä.

Tarjolla on siis mielenkiintoinen, vaihteleva ja pitkäaikainen työ hyvässä talossa ja työyhteisössä. Reilu palkkaus määräytyy hakijan ammattitaidon mukaan.

Työt alkavat heti sopivan tekijän löydyttyä, joten laita hakemusta pikaisesti!

Hakijoilta toivomme:

  • aiempaa kokemusta Fanuc-ohjatuista CNC-sorveista
  • huolellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta
  • joustavaa asennetta ja halua oppia uutta.

Tarjoamme kaikille Apuvoiman työntekijöille aina:

  • laajennetun työterveyshuollon
  • luotettavan ja laadukkaan palkanmaksun
  • oman yhteyshenkilön työsuhdeasioidesi hoitoon.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, valitse seuraavista sinulle sopivin lähestymistapa:

  • Hae paikkaa linkin kautta .
  • Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: teemu.aalto@apuvoima.com.
  • Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä Teemuun soittamalla, viestillä tai WhatsAppilla numeroon 050 525 4627.

APUVOIMA ON REKRYTOINNIN AMMATTILAINEN

Yhdistämme osaavat tekijät ja työnantajat eri aloilla ympäri Suomen.

Tarjoamme monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin – olitpa sitten etsimässä seuraavaa askelta urallasi tai joustavaa työtä muun arjen rinnalle.

Meille on tärkeää, että työnteko on sujuvaa ja mutkatonta.

Meillä arki toimii ja Apuvoima on lähellä silloin kun sitä tarvitset.

 Bliv en central del af vores vedligeholdelsesafdeling, hvor din tekniske indsigt er med til at sikre høj driftssikkerhed og effektive anlæg. 

 En central rolle med teknisk overblik 

 Som teknisk vedligeholdelsesspecialist får du en nøglerolle i at understøtte vores vedligeholdelsesteams og sikre struktur, kvalitet og fremdrift i arbejdet. Du arbejder tæt sammen med teknikere og bidrager til både den daglige drift og større revisioner og projekter. 

 Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at: 
 
 Arbejde med optimering af tekniske anlæg 

 Følge op på arbejdsordrer, ved hjælp af diverse fejlsøgnings værktøjer.  

 Yde teknisk sparring til teknikere i forbindelse med revisionsplanlægning  

 Udarbejde vedligeholdsplaner i samarbejde med vedligeholdelsesteknikere  

 Bidrage til gennemførelse af anlægsprojekter  
 
 Faglige krav og ønsker til kandidaten 

 Du har en solid teknisk baggrund - f.eks. som maskinmester, ingeniør eller lignende med erfaring fra et kraftværk eller procesindustrien. Du trives med at skabe struktur og overblik i komplekse systemer og motiveres af at dykke ned i tekniske data og analyser. Samtidig forstår du vigtigheden af det brede samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper for at finde de bedste løsninger. 

 Du er en rutineret it-bruger og har erfaring med EAM- eller ERP-systemer til styring af vedligehold. Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har kendskab til teknisk dokumentation samt erfaring med systematiske værktøjer til fejlfinding som RCA (Root Cause Analysis) eller FMEA. Da vi arbejder i et internationalt orienteret teknisk miljø behersker du både dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale. 

 Velkommen til Teknisk Support 

 Du bliver en del af Teknisk Support, som er et nyoprettet team der er forankret i vores vedligeholdelsesafdeling. Da vi er et helt nyoprettet team, får du en unik mulighed for at være med til at udvikle teamet og forme vores kernefunktioner inden for vedligeholdsoptimering, dokumentation og teknisk koordinering. 

 Målet for Teknisk Support er at løfte niveauet for vores vedligehold og skabe de bedste forudsætninger for de øvrige teams, så vores teknikere er klædt på til at løse opgaverne effektivt og sikkert.  

 Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til Fortrolig og kan opretholde godkendelsen gennem hele ansættelsen.  

 Vi tilbyder en lønpakke svarende til dine kvalifikationer samt en attraktiv pensionsordning. Derudover har vi en god kantine, aktiv personaleforening, idrætsforening og træningsfaciliteter.  

 Er du interesseret? 

 Send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV senest d. 16. august 2026 - og gerne før, da vi løbende indkalder til samtaler.  

 Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Henrik Trolle Munk på HMUN@vestfor.dk eller 29 17 44 12.   

 Vestforbrænding giver god energi videre.
