title: Intern, Data Engineering
description:
Job Description:

Rakuten International oversees 7 businesses with over 4,000 employees globally. The brand is recognized for its leadership and innovation in e-commerce, digital content, advertising, entertainment and communications, bringing the joy of discovery and access to more than 1 billion members across the world. Our teams deliver on the company’s mission to delight merchants and customers through innovation, optimism, and teamwork.

Rakuten Viki is a global entertainment streaming platform that specializes in Asian content. Our platform enables millions of viewers to discover and enjoy primetime shows and movies, subtitled in over 150 languages. Headquartered in San Mateo, California, we also have offices in Singapore, Seoul, and Shanghai, ensuring a strong global presence and a deep connection to the heart of Asian entertainment. Our platform is home to a large and loyal community of fans who share a passion for Asian culture and entertainment. Join us in our mission to bridge cultures and connect the world to Asian entertainment. At Rakuten Viki, we offer a chance to be part of a global community that celebrates culture, creativity, and connection.

Requirements:

  • Undergraduates who are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent fields

  • Any prior part-time, internship or personal project experience in software engineering will be a plus

  • Passionate about learning new technologies and solving engineering problems

  • Able to work for at least 12 weeks on a full-time basis, with immediate start

The Data Engineering Team is responsible for enabling business to gain insights and find business opportunities from all its data. We build highly reliable systems and data pipelines that daily ingest terabytes of data from disparate data sources which is then checked for quality, cleaned, standardized, enriched, transformed and modeled to measure the effectiveness and performance of our organization's business processes. We are also responsible for enabling real-time data flows for User Behavior Analytics, CRM, advanced analytics, AI and ML with high uptimes.

Rakuten provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Rakuten considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, provincial or local laws.

Five Principles for Success
Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

Always improve, Always Advance - Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen
Passionately Professional - Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best
Hypothesize - Practice - Validate – Shikumika - Use the Rakuten Cycle to succeed in unknown territory
Maximize Customer Satisfaction - The greatest satisfaction for our teams is seeing their customers smile
Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! - Always be conscious of time - take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team

title: Director, Corporate and Foundation Relations
description:
Job Description

Reporting to the Associate Vice President for Development, the Director of Corporate and Foundation Relations (CFR) is responsible for developing, managing and advancing philanthropic relationships with corporations, corporate foundations, private foundations and family foundations in support of Stevens Institute of Technology’s institutional priorities.

The Director will identify, cultivate, solicit and steward CFR prospects and partners, with a focus on securing philanthropic support for research, student success, workforce development, sustainability, innovation, scholarships, experiential learning and faculty excellence.

The Director serves as a strategic relationship manager, proposal strategist and institutional connector, working closely with faculty, academic leaders, Advancement colleagues, the Office of Sponsored Research Administration, Donor Relations and Stewardship, Finance and other campus partners. This role requires strong independent judgment, comfort operating in ambiguity and the ability to assess which opportunities Stevens should pursue, refine, defer or decline based on funder fit, institutional priorities, faculty or program readiness, timing, capacity and likelihood of success.

CFR Fundraising

  • Identify, cultivate, solicit and steward CFR prospects and partners.
  • Develop and manage a portfolio of CFR relationships aligned with Stevens’ institutional priorities.
  • Build awareness of Stevens among funders and create engagement strategies that increase philanthropic support.
  • Position Stevens for proposals, renewals, invitations and expanded partnerships.

Relationship Management and Strategic Engagement

  • Serve as relationship manager for assigned CFR prospects.
  • Build relationships with foundation staff, corporate foundation representatives, corporate social responsibility leaders and other external decision-makers.
  • Identify engagement pathways through faculty, academic leaders, alumni, trustees, industry contacts and institutional connections.
  • Prepare faculty, academic leaders and university leadership for funder meetings, site visits and engagement opportunities.

Opportunity Assessment and Pipeline Development

  • Identify funding opportunities through prospecting tools, funder research, referrals, networks, faculty leads, sponsored research referrals and existing relationships.
  • Evaluate opportunities for funder fit, strategic alignment, faculty or program capacity, timing, award potential and likelihood of success.
  • Determine whether opportunities should be pursued, refined, deferred or declined.
  • Maintain an active CFR pipeline and document strategies, actions and outcomes in institutional systems.

Proposal Strategy and Development

  • Lead or coordinate development of letters of inquiry, proposals, concept papers, executive summaries, reports and related materials.
  • Translate complex research, faculty or programmatic concepts into clear, compelling language for CFR audiences.
  • Ensure proposals align with funder priorities, Stevens’ strategy and philanthropic best practices.
  • Manage proposal timelines, required attachments, internal reviews and submissions in partnership with faculty, program staff, academic leadership, Finance, sponsored research administration, Donor Relations and Stewardship, external writers and Advancement leadership.

Faculty and Academic Partner Engagement

  • Partner with faculty, deans, department chairs and research leaders to identify fundable projects and match expertise with appropriate funding opportunities.
  • Support faculty and program leaders in understanding funder expectations, proposal requirements and the philanthropic funding landscape.
  • Coach faculty and program leaders on funder-facing communications, concept framing and proposal strategy.
  • Support faculty reputation-building opportunities, awards, fellowships and nominations in collaboration with academic and research leadership.

Stewardship, Compliance and Portfolio Management

  • Partner with Donor Relations and Stewardship to ensure major CFR funders receive timely, meaningful and strategic stewardship.
  • Align stewardship and impact reporting with future renewal or expansion opportunities.
  • Coordinate with Advancement Operations on gift booking, fund creation and required documentation.
  • Partner with sponsored research administration to assess philanthropic research opportunities and determine appropriate routing, accounting and reporting.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation in Raiser’s Edge NXT, SharePoint, PaperSave and other institutional systems.
  • Use dashboards, reports and portfolio tools to manage priorities, deadlines and activity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 7-10 years of relevant experience in fundraising, foundation relations, corporate philanthropy, nonprofit development, higher education advancement, corporate social responsibility, grantmaking, strategic partnerships or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage external relationships.
  • Strong ability to assess funding opportunities and determine strategic fit.
  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.
  • Experience developing proposals, letters of inquiry, concept papers, reports or funder communications.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholder engagement independently.
  • Strong judgment, discretion and professionalism.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with faculty, academic leaders, funders and internal partners.
  • Proficiency with CRM or donor database systems; experience with Raiser’s Edge NXT preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CFR fundraising.
  • Experience working with foundations, corporate foundations, corporate social responsibility teams or grantmaking organizations.
  • Experience in higher education, research institutions, STEM organizations, healthcare, museums, foundations or mission-driven nonprofits.
  • Familiarity with proposal development for research, student success, workforce development, STEM education or sustainability initiatives.
  • Experience using prospecting tools such as Instrumentl, Candid/GuideStar or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of distinctions among philanthropic gifts, restricted gifts, charitable research awards and sponsored research.
  • Experience preparing faculty, executives or institutional leaders for funder meetings.
  • Experience managing stewardship or renewal strategies for major funders.

Key Competencies

  • Relationship building: Builds trust with funders, faculty and internal partners; creates opportunities through cultivation and strategic engagement.
  • Strategic judgment: Knows which opportunities to pursue, refine, defer or decline; balances institutional enthusiasm with funder fit and likelihood of success.
  • Independent work: Operates effectively with limited direction; manages ambiguity and competing priorities; brings solutions, not just problems.
  • Communication and translation: Translates technical or academic concepts into accessible, funder-facing language; adapts tone for foundations, corporations, faculty, leadership and internal audiences.
  • Portfolio management: Tracks opportunities, actions and stewardship obligations; prioritizes work based on deadlines, relationship risk, strategic value and renewal potential.

title: Lähihoitaja, seniorikeskus
description:
Pidätkö työstä, jossa arjen kohtaamiset ja aito yhdessäolo ovat osa jokaista päivää?

Etsimme ruotsinkielentaitoista lähihoitajaa vakinaiseen tehtävään Koskelan seniorikeskuksen Ilmatar-yksikköön, johon kuuluu kaksi kodinomaista 17-paikkaista hoivayksikköä. Sinua odottaa mukava, toisiaan tukeva työporukka.

Me haluamme tehdä seniorikeskuksemme asukkaiden arjesta toimivaa ja onnellista. Perustehtävämme on tuottaa hoitoa ja hoivaa niin, että asukkaamme voivat kokea elämänsä merkitykselliseksi ja arvokkaaksi. Pidämme tärkeänä, että asukkaamme voivat osallistua mielekkääseen toimintakykyä edistävään ja ylläpitävään toimintaan. Henkilökuntamme on innostunutta, osaavaa ja meillä on hyvä ilmapiiri. Työskentelemme asukkaiden kotona ja käytämme kodinomaisia vaatteita. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä. Toteutamme terveet työajat-periaatetta.

Lähihoitajana toimit vastuuhoitajana moniammatillisessa tiimissä ja tehtäväsi on asiakkaan hoidon suunnittelu, toteutus ja arviointi. Meillä on keskeistä hoitotyössä asukkaan toimintakyvyn ja voimavarojen tukeminen, yksilöllinen ja yhteisöllinen toimintatapa sekä yhteistyö omaisten kanssa. Noudatamme asiakkaiden kanssa kinestetiikan mukaista tapaa toimia ja koulutamme henkilökuntamme kinestetiikkaan. Päivittäiskirjaamisessa käytössä on APOTTI-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä sekä RAI-järjestelmä.

Lähihoitajana olet motivoitunut, rohkea ja luova. Sinun on helppo tehdä tiimityötä ja omaat hyvät yhteistyötaidot. Pidät haasteista ja sinulla on hyvä huumorintaju ja vuorovaikutustaidot.

Koskelan seniorikeskuksessa puhaltavat uudet tuulet. Naapuritontilla rakennetaan meille tällä hetkellä uudisrakennusta ja koko seniorikeskuksemme pääseekin muuttamaan uusiin valmistuviin tiloihin syksyllä 2027. Henkilökuntamme on innokkaana mukana toiminnan suunnittelussa.

Odotamme sinulta:

lähihoitajan tutkintoa
hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa
ymmärrystä itsemääräämisoikeuden kunnioittamisesta
hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
kiinnostusta oman osaamisen kehittämiseen

Tarjoamme sinulle:

merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn Helsingin kaupungilla
kattavan perehdytyksen
hyvät koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet
monipuoliset henkilöstöedut (mm. lounasetu ja Epassi Flex, enintään 550 €/vuosi, kaupunkipyöräetu)
mahdollisuuden hakea Auroranlinnan vuokra-asuntoa henkilöstölle edullisin ehdoin

Työt voit aloittaa 31.8.26 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä, kysy lisää ja laita hakemus tulemaan.

Kelpoisuusehto:

Lähihoitajan tutkinto ja rekisteröityminen Lupa- ja valvontaviraston ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin (ent. Valvira)

Suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä ruotsinkielen hyvä suullinen ja tyydyttävä kirjallinen taito.

Ennen valintapäätöstä hakijan on esitettävä työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä ja huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus. Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa tartuntatautilain sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään LOP/LOVe LOP-lääkeluvan hyväksytty suorittaminen viimeistään koeajan kuluessa.

Valitun henkilön on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on Suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä ruotsinkielen hyvä suullinen ja tyydyttävä kirjallinen taito.

Luemme eduksi työkokemuksen ikääntyneiden parissa työskentelystä, RAI-arviointijärjestelmän ja Apotti-potilastietojärjestelmän käytön osaamisen sekä voimassa olevat LOVE-lääkeluvat.

Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Tage imod chauffør med henblik på administrativ behandling af følgesedler/fragtbreve

Kan du tale et eller flere østeuropæiske sprog er det en klar fordel. Du er en selvstarter med løsningsorienteret mentalitet, da der dagligt opstår udfordringer som kræver netop dig, for at det bliver løst. Du arbejder godt sammen i teams, da du dagligt skal kommunikere med mange mennesker både på kontoret med de andre logistikassistenter, men også et tæt samarbejde mellem flere afdelinger på lageret.  

 

Derudover forventer vi at du:  

 


Medvirker positivt til et team af hhv. lagermedarbejdere (operative) og dine kollegaer på kontoret (proces), så I sammen kan udvikle jer selv og jobbet og udnytte hinandens styrker

title: Vuorenmaa Yhtiöt Oy: Kenttämyyjä (Vaasa)
description:
Työsopimuksen tyyppi: vakituinen

Sijainti: Kiillekuja 3, 65300 Vaasa

Hakuaika päättyy: 25.8.2026

Haluatko rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja kasvattaa liiketoimintaa vakaassa, 80-vuotiaassa perheyrityksessä? Tule mukaan kehittämään Vuorenmaan kasvua Pohjanmaan alueella.

Mitä tulet tekemään?

Kenttämyyjänä vastaat olemassa olevien asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä uusien asiakkuuksien hankinnasta Pohjanmaan alueella. Saat vastuullesi valmiin asiakaskannan, jota pääset kasvattamaan pitkäjänteisesti, ja lisäksi pääset avaamaan uusia asiakkuuksia erityisesti alueen teollisuuden ja kunnossapidon toimijoiden parissa. Työssä uusasiakashankinta on tavoitteellista, mutta sitä tukee laaja aiemmin asioineiden asiakkaiden joukko ja toimialueelta saatavat tarjouspyynnöt – kyse ei siis ole jatkuvasta kylmäsoittamisesta.

Arkeesi kuuluu asiakastapaamisia kentällä, tarjousten laatimista ja tilausten käsittelyä, asiakkuuksien kehittämistä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä Vaasan toimipisteen, tuoteryhmäasiantuntijoiden ja valtakunnallisen kenttämyyntitiimin kanssa. Käytät työssäsi HubSpot CRM:ää, ERP-järjestelmää sekä Exceliä. Lisäksi osallistut tarvittaessa Vaasan toimipisteen asiakaspalveluun esimerkiksi lomien aikana. Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea myynnistä innostuvaa ja tavoitteellista tekijää, joka haluaa rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja kehittyä teknisen tukkukaupan ammattilaiseksi. Persoonasi ja asenteesi ratkaisevat paljon – arvostamme rohkeaa, oma-aloitteista ja eteenpäin katsovaa työotetta.

Sinulla on jo hieman kokemusta B2B-myynnistä tai pidemmän myyntisyklin myyntityöstä, ja haluat ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallasi. Teknisen alan tuntemus auttaa tehtävässä, mutta tärkeintä on kiinnostus oppia tuotteet ja asiakkaiden liiketoiminta.

Hakijalta odotetaan:

  • Vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta B2B-myynnistä tai vastaavasta tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä

  • Kykyä kehittää olemassa olevia asiakkuuksia sekä hankkia uusia asiakkaita

  • Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja

  • Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

  • Ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta

  • Perustason Excel-osaamista sekä valmiutta omaksua uusia järjestelmiä

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Kokemus teknisestä myynnistä tai teknisestä tukkukaupasta

  • Kokemus teollisuuden, kunnossapidon, sähkötuotteiden, voimansiirron tai muiden teknisten tuotteiden parista

  • Hyvä ruotsin kielen taito

  • Kokemus CRM- ja ERP-järjestelmien käytöstä

  • Tekninen kiinnostus ja halu syventää osaamista

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Mahdollisuuden päästä rakentamaan kasvua valmiin asiakaskannan pohjalta ja vaikuttamaan oman alueesi menestykseen.

  • Osaamisesi kehittämistä kokeneiden myynnin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden tukemana.

  • Paikan rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa yrityksessä, jossa avautuu mahdollisuuksia esimerkiksi tuotepäällikön tehtäviin.

  • Vakaan perheyrityksen työympäristön, jossa henkilöstöstä pidetään huolta myös haastavina aikoina.

  • Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten ePassin, laajan työterveyshuollon ja koulutusmahdollisuudet.

Käytännön asiat:

Kyseessä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen tehtävä, jossa työllistyt suoraan Vuorenmaa Yhtiöt Oy:n palvelukseen. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Vaasassa, ja työssä noudatetaan joustavaa hybridimallia, jossa etätyötä on mahdollista tehdä noin kaksi päivää viikossa työn luonteen huomioiden. Aloitus tehtävässä on mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa! Lähetä ansioluettelosi ja hakemuksesi PDF-muodossa viimeistään 25.8.2026 aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta osoitteessa: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/375321/create/. Voit kertoa hakemuksessasi myös palkkatoiveesi sekä aikaisimman mahdollisen aloitusajankohtasi.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä, joten suosittelemme hakemaan mahdollisimman pian. Huomaathan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta.

Lisätietoja Vuorenmaasta löydät osoitteesta www.vuorenmaa.fi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa HR & Recruitment Consultant Paavo Pikkarainen (+358 50 406 1111, paavo.pikkarainen@atalent.fi).

title: Bilmekaniker sökes omgående till Uppsala
description:
Vi söker nu en driven och nyfiken mekaniker till vår verkstad. Vi tror att du som söker är tekniskt kunnig, kommunikativ och du är självfallet stolt i ditt yrkesutövande. När du arbetar som bilmekaniker hos oss ska du ha ett gott sinne för affärer och förstå vikten av att sätta kunden och service i första rummet. Du kommer att jobba nära kunden och behöver därför ha förmågan att skapa långsiktiga kundrelationer. Tjänsten innebär service, reparationer och felsökningar på personbilar, lätta lastbilar av de flesta märkena.

För att vara aktuell för rollen ser vi att du har:

• Ett brinnande teknik- och fordonsmekaniskt intresse

• Dokumenterad relevant utbildning

• Dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete som fordonsmekaniker

• God administrativ förmåga och datorvana

• Goda kommunikativa egenskaper

• Ett gott kundbemötande

Du är flexibel och strukturerad i ditt arbete samtidigt som du är ansvarsfull och ser utmaningar som ett naturligt steg i karriären. Du är socialt utåtriktad, har samarbetsförmåga och kan även arbeta under tidspress. Du har lätt för att ta till dig nya instruktioner och vi ser det som en självklarhet att du har ett starkt bilintresse och har känsla för service. Minst B körkort är ett krav.

Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning och därefter tillsvidareanställning samt individuell lönesättning. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Personuppgiftshantering Meko Sweden AB. nr.556724–9254, är personuppgiftsansvarig för behandlingen av dina personuppgifter i samband med denna rekrytering. Läs vår policy om hur vi behandlar dina personuppgifter:

Integritetspolicy | MEKO Sverige

Personlighet är viktigt för oss! Därför ber vi alla som söker jobb hos oss att svara på ett kort personlighetstest. Det ger oss möjlighet att få en mer objektiv bild av dig som person och kommer att användas som en del av beslutsunderlaget i urvalet. Länken till testet skickas ut i ett separat mail dagen efter att du skickat in din ansökan och vi vill be dig svara på testet så snart du kan.Vill du veta mer om oss?Kolla in vår karriärsida och upptäck hur det är att jobba hos MEKO – och vilka möjligheter som väntar just nu.

Mekonomen gör billivet enklare genom att erbjuda ett brett och lättillgängligt utbud av prisvärda, innovativa lösningar och produkter för konsumenter och företag. Vi är Nordens ledande bildelskedja med egen grossistverksamhet, butiker och verkstäder. Genom rikstäckande butiks- och verkstadsnät har Mekonomen den bästa tillgängligheten i branschen under varumärkena Mekonomen Bilverkstad och MekoPartner. Vårt kundlöfte är Ett enkare billiv som grundar sig i våra värderingar; kundorientering, flexibilitet, kompetens, ansvar och affärsmässighet.

Vi værdsætter vores medarbejderes mangfoldighed og fremmer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor hver enkelt føler sig velkommen og respekteret. Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.

Tarphagevej 11

6710 Esbjerg V









Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.








Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.













Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.













Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.













Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.













Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.













Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

title: Business Controller, Tender & Projects
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Finance business partner supporting commercial and project decisions

Join NKT as a Business Controller in Grid Solutions business line and work close to sales and project teams to support commercial and project decisions across tenders and project execution. In this role, finance is an active discussion partner, contributing financial insights, scenarios, and transparency to support profitability and informed decisions. You will work in an international environment within the energy sector, supporting projects that contribute to the green transition. Do you want a role where finance is part of the dialogue, not just the numbers?

Secure financial transparency across tenders and project execution

As Business Controller, you work closely with sales managers, project managers and other stakeholders, supporting both bidding and project phases with financial perspectives. You combine financial data with business understanding to highlight risks, opportunities and alternatives. The role combines financial analysis and ownership of reporting with focus on dialogue, collaboration and supporting decisions in an international project environment. The position is based in Karlskrona, Sweden.

Your responsibility will be to:

  • Act as finance business partner to sales and project teams during tenders and project execution
  • Support project forecasting based on business needs and structured data analysis
  • Follow up on project performance, costs, margins and financial risks
  • Ensure accurate financial data and reporting in ERP systems
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of financial processes and ways of working

You will be part of a finance team working close to commercial and project organizations across the company. The role is based in Sweden, with collaboration across international locations and limited travel depending on project needs.

Structured and collaborative finance professional

You are curious about business performance and enjoy working close to the business, engaging in dialogue with different stakeholders. You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions constructively and translating financial perspectives into practical input. You are structured and organized and are used to work independently while staying aligned with shared financial objectives. You take ownership of tasks, communicate clearly, and contribute to a collaborative and respectful team environment.

You also have:

  • A university degree in economics, finance or a related field
  • At least 3 years of experience in controlling in an international company
  • Experience working with SAP or another major ERP system
  • Advanced skills in MS Excel and MS Office
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Contributing to a more sustainable energy future

NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We have a clear goal of establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.

This role offers close collaboration with sales and project teams, exposure to international projects, and the opportunity to develop both financial and commercial understanding. You become part of a finance community where dialogue, cooperation, and shared responsibility are central.

Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!

Contact and application

We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 10 August 2026. Be aware that an extract from the criminal record, alcohol and drug tests, along with personality and capacity tests, might be part of our recruitment process.

Due to the holiday season, we kindly ask for your understanding that our response times may be slightly longer than usual.

We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.

title: Loss Prevention Detective
description:
Marshalls

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Completes the daily tasks required for Store Loss Prevention and safety programs. Maintains positive relationships with Store Management. Conducts apprehensions within established policies and guidelines. Communicates with store Associates on damage and shrink initiatives. Identifies and resolves internal and external theft.

  • Adheres to established shoplifter guidelines and policies
  • Provides timely, courteous and knowledgeable service to customers
  • Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
  • Observes, apprehends, and/or deters any acts of dishonesty from outside sources
  • Participates in investigations and surveillance as assigned
  • Ensures apprehensions are consistent with store theft activity
  • Completes and distributes paperwork in an accurate and timely manner
  • Maintains appropriate evidence, demonstrates understanding of law enforcement procedures and professionally participates in legal activities as needed (e.g., police calls, etc.)
  • Coordinates and complete shrink related activities in partnership with Store Management
  • Adheres to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
  • Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
  • Encourages Associate use of shrink reduction resources
  • Promotes safety awareness and supports maintenance of a safe environment

Who We’re Looking For: You.

  • Excellent communication skills and sound judgment
  • Basic computer skills
  • Basic time management skills
  • Investigative / analytical skills
  • Ability to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
  • Standout colleague, working effectively with peers and supervisors to accomplish tasks
  • Able to work a flexible schedule to support business needs
  • 0-2 years retail or security experience

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

This position has a starting pay range of $15.00 to $20.40 per hour. Actual starting pay is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, qualifications, and experience.

This role opens tickets / cases and answers HR customer questions through the assistance of standard screens, scripts, and developed procedures for inquiry resolution.

Responsibilities

2. Leverages procedures, policy manuals, knowledge databases, other reference materials, etc. to answer employee and manager inquiries and resolving employee and manager HR transactions
3. Guides HR Employee Self-Service and Manager Self-Service transactions

8. Participates in continuous improvement workshops and projects as requested
9. Participates in ad hoc projects as required

1. High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.

Field of interest: Audit & Assurance

Level of hire: Experienced hire







Firmabeskrivelse


Med vores mere end 2700 ansatte er Deloitte et af Danmarks største revisions- og rådgivningshus. Vi skræddersyer løsninger på tværs af revision, skat, finansiel rådgivning, enterprise risk services, teknologi og transformationer.

I Deloitte Aarhus er vi omkring 350 medarbejdere på tværs af vores forretningsområder, der sammen skaber værdi for en bred vifte af kunder. Vi har før sommerferien meldt ud, at vi ønsker at skærpe vores forretningsmæssige fokus og fokusere kunder i spektret fra de ambitiøse mellemstore virksomheder til store internationale koncerner. Her ser vi at dyb indsigt i industrier, specialisering, teknologiske løsninger og internationalt perspektiv i stadig større grad er med til at skabe værdi for vores kunder.

Vi vil fra 1. september være ca. 85 medarbejdere i Audit og Assurance i Aarhus, som tror på, at stærke relationer og et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø er vores nøgle til succes, og derfor prioriterer vi sociale aktiviteter og samarbejde højt. Her kan du være dig selv, udvikle dine kompetencer og arbejde i teams, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores arbejde foregår i et højt specialiseret og fokuseret miljø på tværs af Deloitte. I Aarhus fordeler vi videst muligt opgaverne ud fra den enkeltes interesse for kundetyper, men arbejder selvfølgelig på kryds og tværs, og lægger vægt på at vi hjælper hinanden.

Om teamet 

I Deloitte opererer vi med OneAudit med fokus på lokalt og nationalt samarbejde samt stor faglig sparring. Vores strategiske Vi har på tværs af afdelingerne et stort fælles fagligt fundament, hvor alverdens problemstillinger kan løses. I Aarhus vil du blive en del af vores kontor i City Tower, hvor byen flotteste udsigt danner rammer for din videre læringsrejse. Vores kontor afspejler byens innovative og inspirerende miljø, og du vil få muligheden for at lære af nogle af landets dygtigste revisorer, når vi sammen leverer værdiskabende løsninger til vores kunder.




Stillingsbeskrivelse


Vi søger dig, der ønsker at gøre en forskel og vokse i en kultur funderet på samarbejde, nysgerrighed, faglighed og høje ambitioner. Du kommer til at indgå i betjeningen af en bred vifte af virksomheder - primært fra det større SME-segment og op. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil ud over revisionsopgaver også inkludere rådgivning og support i forskellige forretningsområder. Du kommer til at indgå i teams med dygtige kollegaer, som sammen med den people leader, du får tildelt, vil støtte dig i opstartsfasen og sidenhen vil sikre, at du bliver udfordret i takt med udviklingen af dine kvalifikationer og ambitioner.

Sæt dit aftryk på opgaver som:

Gennemførelse af revisioner af årsrapporter for spændende større virksomheder

Rådgivning af kunder om regnskabsregler og compliance - altid med fokus på deres forretning

At være en aktiv del af planlægning og gennemførelse af revision i samarbejde med dit team

Hjælp til udvikling af nye metoder, der gør revisionsarbejdet endnu bedre




Kvalifikationer


Du bringer 7-10 års erfaring som revisor og er statsautoriseret revisor med solidt kendskab til IFRS, ISA-standarder og relevant lovgivning. Du har proven track record i at håndtere større kundeporteføljer og komplekse regnskabsmæssige problemstillinger, og du er dygtig til at kommunikere med både interne og eksterne stakeholders.

Du bidrager med følgende til teamet:

Stærkt fagligt niveau og en solid teoretisk værktøjskasse

En naturlig struktureret tilgang til din opgaveløsning

En teamplayer med en positiv indstilling

Tager det selvstændige ansvar som stillingen kræver

En interesse i teknologi og digitalisering

Fokus på forretningsmæssig rådgivning ud fra et økonomisk fundament

Hos Deloitte værdsætter vi forskellige kompetencer, perspektiver og erfaringer, da det gør os i stand til effektivt at løse komplekse udfordringer for vores kunder. Selv hvis du ikke umiddelbart genkender dig selv i alle de beskrevne kvalifikationer, ønsker vi stadig at opfordre dig til at ansøge om stillingen, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage positivt til vores team.




Yderligere informationer


Vil du være en del af vores team?

Klik på knappen "jeg er interesseret" ovenfor, hvis du er klar til at blive en del af vores team.

Send venligst dit CV.

Vi behandler ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende, så vi anbefaler dig at søge hurtigst muligt.

Forventede startdato: Efteråret 2026

Tøv ikke med at kontakte partner Marie Louise Vester Sørensen på masoerensen@deloitte.dk eller 60 46 71 91, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Vi opfordrer alle kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset alder, køn (kønsidentitet eller kønsudtryk), seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, nationalitet eller handicap.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!



In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths - because that is how we can make a difference.

title: Account Director
description:
Who are Benifex? 💚💜

We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀

Why should you apply? 🌟

  • Take ownership of a portfolio of strategic customers, driving both retention and revenue growth through renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Partner with senior HR leaders, executives and key decision-makers, acting as a trusted commercial advisor and influencing long-term business outcomes.

  • Join a highly collaborative environment where you will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support and Leadership teams to deliver exceptional customer value.

  • Lead complex commercial engagements, negotiations and strategic account plans while helping shape the future growth of a market-leading SaaS platform.

  • Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space.

Great benefits:

⚖️ A hybrid working model.

🧠 ITP1 pension.

❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.

📝 Collective agreement.

💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.

🤸 Generous wellness allowance.

✈️ 30 vacation days / year.

💰 Referral bonuses.

🌟 Enhanced parental pay.

🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.

Role Overview 🚀

As an Account Director, you will be responsible for retaining and growing revenue across an assigned portfolio of existing customers. Owning the full commercial relationship, you will lead renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities while acting as the primary growth driver within your accounts. Working in close partnership with Customer Success Managers, you will ensure customers achieve value from the platform while identifying strategic opportunities to expand their use of Benifex solutions. You will build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, develop long-term account strategies and deliver predictable revenue growth. Please note that this is an individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities. Success in this position comes through commercial leadership, strategic customer engagement and cross-functional collaboration.

Responsibilities 🤘

  • Lead the end-to-end commercial sales cycle for renewals and expansions, including discovery, business case development, solution design, pricing, proposal creation, ROI cases, negotiations and contract closure.

  • Manage commercial activities including pricing, contract scope, commercial terms, invoicing accuracy and pipeline forecasting to support revenue growth and predictable performance.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior HR leaders, executive sponsors, finance teams and procurement stakeholders. Lead Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value delivered and identify future growth opportunities.

  • Develop and execute strategic account growth plans, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities by understanding customer HR strategies, business objectives and workforce challenges.

  • Lead account planning sessions and internal commercial reviews, aligning stakeholders around opportunities, risks and priorities while ensuring effective collaboration across teams.

  • Use a consultative sales approach, including the MEDDIC methodology, to drive commercial success and position Benifex as a strategic long-term partner.

  • Share customer and market insights internally, support continuous improvement initiatives and ensure effective commercial handovers for new customers entering the portfolio.

What are we looking for? 🔎

  • Proven experience in B2B sales, account management or business development with a strong track record of retaining customers and driving revenue growth.

  • Demonstrated success delivering renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing customer portfolios.

  • Ability to manage complex buying journeys involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles and high-value contracts.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in forecasting, pipeline management, pricing and contract negotiations.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluency in both Swedish and English, with the ability to clearly communicate business value and ROI to senior audiences.

  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Strategic and solution-focused thinking, with the ability to connect customer challenges to business outcomes.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience within HR technology or Compensation & Benefits.

  • Experience within SaaS or other subscription-based business models.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and managing large, long-term commercial relationships.

We want to make the application process as simple and fair as possible. That’s why we don’t ask for a cover letter for this role. Instead, you’ll find a few short questions in the application form. Your answers will help us understand your experience and skills in a more direct and relevant way.

Ready to make an impact? We’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments for interviews by replying to the email you will receive after you apply.

title: Software Test Development Engineer (Remote)
description:
SW Test Development Engineer 1

Location: Remote - United States

Remote Type: Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

Dexcom is a high-growth, fast-paced environment where you work with a leading-edge data platform test team to contribute to the full life cycle of software in a fast-growing organization. You will work alongside highly skilled and passionate test engineering professionals who know how to deliver exceptional results while also having some fun along the way. For this role, you would be joining Dexcom’s Software R&D, Data Platform Test Engineering team.

Where you come in:

  • You will participate in building quality into backend services by designing automated tests, maintaining test coverage, and performing exploratory testing throughout the development lifecycle.

  • You will collaborate with engineering teams during requirements and design discussions to drive testability and quality from the start.

  • You will design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites—focusing primarily on backend APIs, cloud services, and distributed systems.

  • You will create and maintain test plans, test reports, traceability documentation, and other verification/validation artifacts.

  • You will record, triage, and track issues in defect-tracking systems, ensuring clear reproduction steps and test evidence.

  • You will analyze test failures, identify root causes, and work closely with development teams to drive resolution.

  • You will contribute to improvements in release processes, automation pipelines, and overall quality engineering practices.

  • You will provide technical mentorship, guidance, and best practices to junior engineers and peers.

What makes you successful:

  • You have hands-on experience in software engineering or test development using Python, Java, or another object-oriented language.

  • You have experience working with major cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.

  • You have strong experience using AI-powered development and testing tools to improve efficiency, generate testing, enhance debugging, and expand test coverage

  • You have hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.

  • You have knowledge of data processing or workflow orchestration tools (e.g., CloudRun, Airflow, Dataflow) is a plus.

  • You have practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL data stores.

  • You have strong experience developing automated tests for RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend components.

  • You are familiar with a variety of test automation frameworks (e.g., pytest, Robot Framework, JUnit, or similar).

  • You have solid understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, and backend service interactions in cloud environments.

  • You have experience with automated UI testing is beneficial but not required.

  • You have knowledge of distributed streaming platforms such as Kafka or PubSub is helpful.

  • You have experience with performance or load testing tools is a plus.

  • You have strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • You have experience with CI/CD systems and cloud-based deployment pipelines.

  • You have experience working in Agile software development and test environments.

  • You have the ability to work cross-functionally with developers, DevOps, product teams, and leadership to ensure product quality, performance, reliability, and security.

  • You are a self-starter with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal guidance.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 15-25%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 0-2 years related experience

Senior R&D Engineer, Sports Medicine

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.

Join our Global R&D team in Mansfield, Massachusetts, where you will play a key role in sustaining and advancing innovative medical devices that help patients regain mobility and improve quality of life. Working across some of our fastest growing product portfolios, you will combine technical expertise, collaboration, and leadership to shape products used in shoulder, hip, and knee repair procedures.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and execute sustaining engineering and product support activities for Sports Medicine medical devices.

  • Analyze product designs and physical systems using empirical, numerical, and experimental engineering methods.

  • Identify and mitigate design and product risks while ensuring compliance with applicable medical device regulations and design controls.

  • Develop test methods, perform testing of complex mechanical systems, and support preclinical and clinical evaluations.

  • Investigate technical issues, determine root causes, and implement effective solutions to improve product performance and reliability.

  • Lead medium scale projects and collaborate with cross functional teams to support product development, transfers, and manufacturing readiness activities.

  • Contribute to innovation through product design, prototype development, intellectual property support, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Build strong partnerships across the organization and communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels.

What will you need to be successful?

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree in Engineering with at least 3 years of relevant experience.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience within the medical device industry.

  • Knowledge and practical application of medical device regulations and design controls, including ISO, GMP, FDA, and CE requirements.

  • Strong mechanical design expertise with CAD proficiency. Finite Element Analysis experience is a plus.

  • Experience leading projects or engineering initiatives with the ability to influence and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Excellent problem solving, analytical thinking, and communication skills.

title: Senior Software Engineering Program Manager, Consumer Notebooks
description:
Senior Software Engineering Program Manager, Consumer Notebooks

Description -

Location Requirement

Candidates must perform the job in the posting location and be authorized to work in the designated country.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineering Program Manager to lead end-to-end software and system development programs for consumer computing products, including notebooks and desktop platforms. This role will drive cross-functional execution across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to deliver high-quality products from concept through launch. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in consumer device development, strong program leadership skills, and the ability to manage complex global stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across engineering, product management, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and external partners to achieve program objectives.

• Coordinate build readiness, prototype planning, and component logistics while monitoring program progress and resolving execution challenges.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 12+ years of experience in software engineering program management, technical program management, or related roles.

• Strong knowledge of software development methodologies, Agile/Scrum practices, project planning, risk management, and cross-functional program execution.

• Experience working with global engineering teams and external development partners.

		    Kunderådgiver til kundecenteret
				


			

Brænder du for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og gøre en reel forskel for kunder hver dag?

Hos JFM i Odense søger vi lige nu to nye kolleger til vores BtC-kundeservice. Vi søger én medarbejder på fuldtid og én på deltid. 

Du bliver en del af kundecenteret for nogle af Danmarks stærkeste lokale og regionale aviser. Hver dag hjælper og rådgiver vi vores læsere med blandt andet abonnementer, levering og brugen af vores digitale produkter. Din indsats er derfor med til at sikre, at vores læsere får en god oplevelse, både med den trykte avis og vores digitale læsestof.
 
Om stillingen
Som en del af BtC-kundeservice du får en vigtig rolle i abonnenternes oplevelse af JFM og vores aviser. Du arbejder primært med telefonisk og skriftlig kundeservice, og sikrer, at alle henvendelser bliver mødt med venlighed, behandlet professionelt, effektivt og med fokus på en god serviceoplevelse. Du vil primært arbejde med abonnementsspørgsmål, kundeaftaler og forskellige ad hoc-opgaver. 

Derudover bliver du en del af en afdeling, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og løfter i flok. I rollen får man en hverdag med både faste rutiner og varierende opgaver, hvor det er vigtigt, at du trives i at arbejde selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.
 
Hvem er du?
Vi forventer ikke en specifik uddannelsesbaggrund, men erfaring fra kundeservice eller kundesupport vil være en fordel. Det vigtigste er, at du er serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at skabe gode kundeoplevelse.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

Er mødestabil og arbejder struktureret med dine opgaver

Tager ansvar og kan arbejde selvstændigt

Kommunikerer klart, professionelt og imødekommende, både mundtligt og skriftligt

Trives i en hverdag med både faste rutiner og varierende opgaver

Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og det gode arbejdsmiljø i teamet

For deltidsstillingen er det vigtigt, at du har mulighed for at arbejde om mandagen
 
Hvorfor vælge JFM?
Hos JFM bliver du en del af et af Danmarks største mediehuse, hvor vi har fokus på trivsel, samarbejde og udvikling. Du træder ind i et team med hjælpsomme kolleger, en uformel omgangstone og rig mulighed for løbende at styrke dine kompetencer gennem sparring og træning. 

Derudover tilbyder vi:

En fastansættelse på 37 timer ugentligt i fuldtidsstillingen eller en deltidsansættelse på minimum 15 timer om ugen i deltidsstillingen

Et engageret team med et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi afholder fælles arrangementer og konkurrencer

Gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling - bl.a. træning i service og kommunikation

Ansættelse efter HK-overenskomst inkl. Pension, fritvalgskonto og sundhedsforsikring

Et stærkt arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og godt kollegaskab på tværs af afdelinger

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning allerede i dag. 
 
Ansøgning
Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende. Søg stillingen via "Ansøg nu" knappen - du bedes angive, om du søger stillingen på fuldtid eller deltid. Begge stillinger er med opstart hurtigst muligt. 

Din dagligdag vil være på kontoret i hjertet af Odense lige overfor banegården.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen som kunderådgiver er du velkommen til at kontakte Kundeservicechef Mette Kjær Nikolajsen på mekni@jfm.dk eller til afdelingsleder Ømer Søylemez på  omsoy@jfm.dk eller tlf. nr. 65 45 50 69

Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig. 
 
Om JFM 
Vi er Danmarks næststørste privatejede mediekoncern. Vi lever af at formidle og når ud til 2.9 mio. danskere hver uge. Vi står bag 15 dagblade, 38 ugeaviser, 5 kommercielle radiostationer, en landsdækkende taleradio, en stribe digitale radiokanaler samt en lang række nyhedssites. Vi har virksomheder, der skaber kommunikation mellem mennesker. Trykkerier og dealsites, et kommunikationsbureau og distributionsfirmaer, der leverer breve, aviser og pakker til alle adresser 365 dage om året. På alle platforme informerer og inspirerer vi hver eneste dag med vores historier fra der, hvor livet leves. Vi dækker hele Danmark. Vi er en levende organisation med over 1300 engagerede medarbejdere med arbejdssteder fra Holstebro til Hovedstaden. Medarbejdere, der hver dag lægger al deres energi, viden og kunnen i at informere, inspirere, kommunikere og underholde.

title: Vice President
description:
Job Title:

Vice President

Work Type:

Permanent

Location:

DLF Downtown, Sector 25A Phase 3, Block 3

It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

Essential capabilities

•Colleague centricity – appreciates the importance to enable Colleagues to grow, the UX and ensuring the digital system enables that the right skills and development interventions are supported.
•Cross-Functional collaboration – able to work with Functional Learning and Talent SMEs to document and prioritise outcomes to deliver transparent integrated backlog.
•Technical and data, internal consistency – ensure that the prioritised features integrate with implemented processes and solutions, which includes working with T&EO specialists and Business specialists
•Strategic mindset – Can identify the future potential for products, able to influence decision makers as required.
•Risk management & compliance – understanding the risk landscape and how to manage a product within frameworks and obligations (Products@NAB).
•Problem solving – able to respond to customer queries and troubleshooting.
•Planning and alignment – Ability to prioritise activities, understanding the detail required to deliver work and meet obligations.
•Data and analytics – Understands how to present information to generate insights and as input into recommendations.

Other capabilities

•Adapting approach and demeanour in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations and changes in priorities.
•High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
•Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Qualification Requirements

•Tertiary qualified with a Degree in Business and preference to post graduate qualifications
•Agile Certifications desirable
•P&C Workday Certifications desirable

Experience

•Minimum 12+ years’ experience in a Business Analyst role, preferably in Learning and Talent focused projects (preferably Workday, Eightfold or any other equivalent platforms)
•Demonstrated experience working with data engineering teams and translating business requirements into technical specifications.
•Experience working with AI or machine learning initiatives is highly desirable.
• Creativity and simplifying complex processes and issues, problem solving and analysis
•Background in facilitating workshops and stakeholder interviews to elicit and validate requirements.
•Exposure to agile delivery methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira,rally, Confluence).
•Extensive experience working in an agile environment
•Ability to innovate, adapt and grasp new skills and content
•Ability to work closely with key stakeholders and build collaborative partnerships
•Proven analytical skills and evidence-based decision making

Key Accountabilities

•Responsible for capturing and grooming requirements into epics, features, user stories and dependencies in collaboration with the squads that aligns with business requirements.
•Perform analysis (scenario, policy, customer, data, gap, change, etc) in order to articulate business need and solution requirements.
•Produce As Is and To Be Process Models
•Develop process models, data models, business rules, target operating models, workflows, reporting and other required outputs
•Ensure the Delivery and Development teams understand the value of each user story that is being delivered at the right time
•Works with the Product Owner to understand, elicit, analyse, document and communicate business requirements and articulate product vision with a strong focus on value delivery
•Assists the Product Owner to define and own the value definition of Stories, including facilitating and influencing the prioritisation of the backlog
•Expert in translating end user / customer insights into Epics and Stories complete with Acceptance Criteria, which can easily be understood by the development Team and Traceable
•Participates in and/or leads workshops.
•Analyse the impact of proposed solutions holistically in order to produce Business Impact Assessments.

A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

More focus on you:

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. title: Business Analytics Consultant
description:
About the Role

At Protecht, we're redefining how the world thinks about risk. Our cloud based SaaS platform, Protecht ERM, is one of the most comprehensive and dynamic risk management solutions on the market. With offices across APAC, the USA, and Europe, we help organisations turn risk into opportunity through smarter, more agile decision making.

The Business Analytics Consultant leads the design and delivery of high-impact business intelligence solutions for Protecht's customers and internal teams across the North American region, working closely with customers, advisors, and implementation teams to deliver tailored dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Power BI, and InetSoft.

In this client-facing role, you'll liaise with stakeholders to discuss, document, and implement business requirements, manage delivery schedules, and communicate progress, while also supporting pre-sales efforts, contributing to internal improvements, and mentoring junior team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build high quality Risk dashboards and reports using Protecht’s inetsoft business intelligence software.
  • Meet with customers remotely or in person, to identify and interpret their dashboard and reporting requirements and capture these in a consistent, standardised format.
  • Manage the analytics implementation lifecycle, from scoping through to UAT and deployment, guiding customers on best practice and maintaining an excellent audit trail.
  • Offer expert guidance, constructive feedback, and engage in challenging discussions with customers throughout their Protecht journey.
  • Support the pre-sales and marketing teams when required.

About You

  • Strong demonstrated experience in SQL-based data manipulation
  • Strong Demonstrated experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, InetSoft)
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, Agile environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience
  • Eligibility to work in North America (US citizen or permanent resident)

Desirable Skills

  • Risk Management experience
  • Coding in JavaScript or SQL or similar
  • Experience in Inetsoft Style Intelligence BI
  • SaaS experience

Why Join Protecht?

  • Work with a collaborative, values-driven team
  • Be part of a company that’s shaping the future of enterprise risk management
  • Clear progression path into leadership for high performers
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment

Apply now to make your mark in a role where data meets strategy and innovation drives success.

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.


Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

title: Senior Architect
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Architect will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the overall architecture of our IT systems to support the organization's current and future needs. The Senior Architect will have a strong background in IT infrastructure, systems integration, and software development, with the ability to analyze complex problems and design innovative solutions. He/she will be responsible for providing strategic direction, designing complex IT solutions, and mentoring junior architects. This architect will be responsible for designing enterprise data models, defining metadata and governance standards, analyzing data quality issues, implementing MDM matching and survivorship strategies, evaluating emerging technologies, and enabling AI-driven automation across the enterprise data ecosystem. Working closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Stewards, and Business SMEs, the architect will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions that improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and business value.

    Summary of Responsibilities:

    • Develop and maintain the organization's IT architecture framework, ensuring alignment with business objectives, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.
    • Serve as the hands-on technical architect and subject matter expert for Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Catalog, and AI-enabled data management platforms.
    • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise data architecture standards, canonical data models, metadata frameworks, and governance practices that promote trusted, discoverable, and reusable data assets.
    • Lead technical design and configuration of MDM solutions, including data modeling, matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, and integration patterns across critical business domains.
    • Analyze enterprise data quality issues through data profiling, root cause analysis, quality assessments, and measurement frameworks; define remediation strategies and business rules to improve data reliability and compliance.
    • Architect and optimize enterprise Data Catalog and Metadata Management capabilities, including business glossary, lineage, classification, stewardship, and metadata enrichment processes.
    • Identify and implement AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities to enhance data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, entity resolution, stewardship workflows, and governance operations.
    • Provide technical leadership and guidance to architecture and development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements.
    • Design end-to-end IT solutions, including infrastructure, applications, data, and security components, to support business processes and workflows.
    • Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance the organization's IT capabilities and drive innovation.
    • Lead architectural reviews and provide guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
    • Identify and mitigate architectural risks and issues through proactive planning and effective communication with stakeholders.
    • Define and maintain documentation related to IT architecture, including diagrams, standards, policies, and procedures.
    • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IT architecture, and apply knowledge to drive continuous improvement.
    • Measurably impact company performance by delivering high quality, scalable data products.
    • And all other duties as needed or assigned.

    Qualifications (Minimum Required):

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
    • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

    Experience (Minimum Required):

    • 6 years of experience in Enterprise, Business, Information, Systems and Application, Solution Architectures.
    • Strong expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-scale IT solutions across multiple platforms and technologies.
    • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data architecture, Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Catalog, MDM, or related data management solutions.
    • Must have experience implementing data solutions in Microsoft Azure
    • In-depth knowledge of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their services.
    • Proficiency in system integration techniques, including API design, microservices architecture, and message queuing protocols.
    • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet.
    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

    Preferred Qualifications Include:

    • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
    • Experience in pharmaceutical R and D, clinical development and/or healthcare IT.
