title: Wealth Advisor - PNC Wealth Management
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Wealth Advisor within PNC's Wealth Management organization, you will be based in the Greater Philadelphia Area.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Consults on investment and insurance strategies, as well as the development of financial plans for clients. Grows and retains an investment and insurance book of business. Owns the client experience, efficiently handling sales and service, identifying sales and/or executing opportunities and making referrals to internal business partners as appropriate.
  • Acquires, expands and maintains client relationships through business development and client networking. Grows client loyalty and share of wallet through an exceptional client experience. Applies product and procedural knowledge to solve client problems appropriately and efficiently.
  • Develops and implements investment and insurance strategies for clients. Determines the best products to support such strategies. Presents sound financial recommendations and guidance to clients. Establishes individual financial plans based on client financial needs and objectives. Monitors financial plans and recommends changes as needed.
  • Actively and regularly coaches and educates internal business partners to identify investment opportunities. Drives investment education and visibility among internal business partners. Shows urgency with activities and leads by example. Has regular and effective communication with internal and external partners to build strong relationships that drive referral activity.
  • Regularly meets with internal business partners to communicate and review business results and pipeline management. Meets service level agreements on lead and referral follow up. Adheres to all applicable laws, regulations, policies and guidelines.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Client Prospecting, Client Relationship Building, Credit Risk Analysis, Customer Engagement, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Investment Banking, Public Speaking, Relationship Building, Relationship Management

Competencies

Coaching Others, Customer Experience Management., Customer Retention, Effective Communications, Interpersonal Relationships, Managing Multiple Priorities, Prospecting., Sales Tasks And Activities, Selling.

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

FINRA Series 7 and 66 (or 63,65) required. Life and Health Insurance required.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

title: social og sundhedsassistent til fast stilling
description:
Planlægger til privat hjemmepleje

Brænder du for en hverdag med spændene og udfordrende arbejdsopgaver? Er du samtidig fagligt velfunderet og mødestabil, så er det måske dig, vi søger som planlægger.

Frit Valg Svane Pleje er godkendt af Aalborg Kommune til pleje og praktisk hjælp til visiterede borgere.

Som planlægger træffer du dagligt valg, som påvirker kvaliteten i kerneopgaven og dine kollegers trivsel.
Funktionen som planlægger kan være konfliktfyldt, da opgaverne indebærer ledelse af opgaver. Med et ufravigeligt fokus på kvaliteten i kerneopgaven skal du derfor kunne balancere i feltet af mange – og ofte modsatrettede – krav og ønsker fra borgere, pårørende, kolleger og organisation.
En omskiftelig hverdag stiller store krav til lynhurtig omstilling, ændring af planer og et stort overblik.

Vores største opgave er at yde den højest mulige service indenfor de visiterede rammer. For at kunne sikre dette, kræver det høj faglighed. Vi forventer, at du er god til at kommunikere, da meget af dagen går med samtaler med personalet, tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere samt borgerne og deres pårørende. Vi er en arbejdsplads med ca. 185 ansatte fordelt på SSA, SSH, ufaglærte, én ergoterapeut og én fysioterapeut som begge er forløbsansvarlig terapeuter og én sygeplejerske som faglig leder. Svane pleje har afdelinger i 14 kommuner, og har mere end 20 års erfaring med privat hjemmepleje og praktisk hjælp.

Du skal være:

  • Uddannet SSA.

  • Have erfaring med udekørende hjemmepleje

  • Have erfaring med planlægning i plejen

  • Være god til at kommunikere med alle, også på skrift

  • Have stort overblik og indre ro og kunne rumme pressede perioder, uden at miste overblikket

  • Er bevidst om, at dine valg har stor betydning for økonomien og derfor har stort fokus på optimal anvendelse af ressourcer.

  • Er struktureret, robust og god til at bevare overblikket – også i pressede situationer

  • Godt kendskab til CURA samt FMK og har flair for IT.

  • Have kørekort

  • Være indstillet på at hjælpe i plejen.

  • Være indstillet på bagvagt hver 4. weekend

Vi tilbyder:

  • Fuldtidsjob som funktionæransat i en hurtig voksende virksomhed, med masser af udfordringer og borgeren i fokus.

  • En arbejdsplads med en uformel omgangstone og godt humør

  • Mulighed for stor indflydelse på egen arbejdsopgaver, samt løsningen heraf

  • Et yngre spændende arbejdsklima, med masser af udfordringer i dagligdagen

  • Sparring med erfarne planlæggere og teamkoordinatorer.

  • Grundig oplæring og støtte fra engagerede kolleger

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

Lyder denne stilling interessant for dig? Så skriv endelig en ansøgning med CV og billede til aalborg@svanepleje.dk

Hvis du har brug for flere oplysninger, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte direktør Tina Jørgensen på 41402010.

Vi glæder os til at hører fra dig. Samtalerne holdes løbende.

description:
Karosseritekniker/Mekaniker søges til Rube Karrosseri i Sønderborg og Haderslev  
         

     

 

 
 

 
    
 

        
 

             
            
 
                
 
                    
 
                        
 
                                
  
 
 
 
                         

                        
 
                                     fuldtid 
                         

                        
 
                             Karosseritekniker/Mekaniker søges til Rube Karrosseri i Sønderborg og Haderslev  
                             
                                
 
                                         Rube Karrosseri ApS
                                 

                                
  
    Sønderborg og Haderslev 

                             
                         

                     

                    
 
                        
 Er du en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst karosseritekniker eller mekaniker - eller har du hænderne godt skruet på og lyst til at lære? Så har du nu muligheden for at blive en vigtig del af Rube Karrosseri, hvor vi tilbyder et godt arbejdsmiljø og spændende arbejdsopgaver i moderne faciliteter. 

 Vi søger nye kolleger til vores afdelinger i Sønderborg og Haderslev, som kan bidrage til vores høje standard og teamwork. 

 Om jobbet: 

 Som karosseritekniker/mekaniker hos Rube Karrosseri vil dine arbejdsopgaver omfatte reparation og vedligeholdelse af biler og karrosserier. Vi arbejder med en bred vifte af opgaver, hvilket betyder, at du får mulighed for at udvikle dine tekniske kompetencer. Du vil indgå i et team, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, detaljeorientering og effektivitet, og hvor samarbejde vægtes højt. 

 Hvem er du? 

 Vi søger dig, som måske er uddannet karosseritekniker, mekaniker eller lignende, men vi vægter lige så meget din praktiske kunnen og din vilje til at lære - erfaring er et plus, men ikke et krav. Du er kvalitetsbevidst, har sans for detaljerne og arbejder selvstændigt. Dit engagement og din positive indstilling vil være afgørende for at kunne bidrage til vores holdånd og høje serviceniveau. 

 Vi kan tilbyde dig en spændende hverdag med godt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger. Du får variation i arbejdsopgaver, og derudover tilbyder vi: 
 
 
 Moderne faciliteter med godt udstyr, der understøtter dit arbejde 
 

 
 Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår i en stabil virksomhed 
 

 
 Mulighed for ansættelse i enten Haderslev eller Sønderborg 
 

 
 Et team, hvor din indsats bliver værdsat og hvor der er plads til udvikling 
 
 
 Stillingen er på fuldtid, og vi forventer, at du kan tiltræde hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet kan være i vores afdeling i Haderslev eller Sønderborg, afhængigt af hvad der passer dig bedst. 

 Sådan søger du: 

 Har du spørgsmål eller vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til Rune på telefon 29 21 07 09 for en uforpligtende snak. Send din ansøgning og CV på e-mail til rune@rubekarrosseri.dk. 

 Bliv en del af Rube Karrosseri, og vær med til at skabe kvalitet og tryghed for vores kunder - vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.


Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

 

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

Klik på "Søg nu"

Udfyld formularen

Vedhæft dit motiverede CV

 

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00. 

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. title: Information Security Associate
description:
As a member of the Information Security Team at Glomopay, you will own the entire information security

function — from policy and governance to hands-on implementation and regulatory compliance. Reporting

directly to the Head of Information Security, this is a strategic role for a security practitioner who can single-handedly stand up a mature InfoSec program for Glomo

Key Responsibilities

Security Governance & Compliance

  • Own the Information Security Management System (ISMS) — policy framework, risk assessments and control implementation aligned with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and IFSCA Cyber Security and

  • Cyber Resilience Framework

  • Lead compliance with RBI outsourcing directions, IFSCA circulars, DPSC guidelines, and PCI SSF requirements applicable to payment service providers

  • Own third-party risk management — conduct due diligence audits on all technology partners and maintain records per regulatory requirements

  • Drive the internal IT audit program — plan, execute, engage external audit vendors, and track findings to closure

  • Establish the Information Classification framework, embedding it into DLP rules, employee training, and daily operations

Security Operations & Architecture (Hands-On)

  • Build and manage the SOC function — starting with MDR-augmented operations (CrowdStrike), progressively maturing toward hybrid capability

  • Own the SIEM strategy: integrate and monitor all critical log sources (application, infrastructure, database, identity, PAM) and build detection use-cases

  • Conduct threat modelling Manage Privileged Access Management (PAM) — session monitoring, password rotation,break-glass procedures, periodic user access reviews

  • Implement and manage DLP controls across endpoints, email, and cloud storage (Google Workspace DLP, CrowdStrike Device Control)

  • Own endpoint security — hardening SOPs against CIS benchmarks, approved software lists, full disk encryption

  • Drive network security posture — geo-fencing, firewall rule reviews, Cloud IDS tuning across GCP infrastructure

  • Oversee application security — integrate SAST/DAST into CI/CD pipelines, define security review thresholds, manage OWASP compliance

Incident Management & Business Continuity

  • Own the incident management lifecycle — severity classifications, closure SLAs, escalation

  • procedures, post-incident reviews

  • Establish a dedicated security incident reporting channel and ensure organization-wide awareness

  • Maintain and test the Business Continuity Plan covering office unavailability, power failure,

  • pandemic, and cloud provider disruption scenarios

  • Ensure DR drills meet RTO thresholds with proper segregation of duties

  • Serve as the primary point of contact during security incidents, coordinating response with banking partners and regulators per notification SLAs

Regulatory & Partner Interface

  • Serve as the primary security interface with banking partners, managing their Third Party Service provider Risk Assessments

  • Build the “Managed Security Transparency” program — scoped security reports, alert forwarding, incident summaries, and independent attestation for regulated entity partners

  • Coordinate with IFSCA, external auditors, and banking partner audit teams during inspections and certifications

  • Drive the SOC 2 Type II certification journey and maintain independent attestations (ISO 27001, PCI DSS)

  • Build and maintain a compliance resource center — audit reports, certifications, security

  • documentation available for partner due diligence on demand

What We're Looking For

Experience: 4 years in information security with at least 3 years in a hands-on security role, preferably in regulated financial services (fintech, banking, NBFC, payment processors)

Core Expertise:

  • Be part of the InfoSec program from the early stage, understand the GRC as well as the Security Function.

  • Deep working knowledge of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and Indian financial regulatory frameworks (RBI, IFSCA)

  • Hands-on with experience with cloud security on GCP (strongly preferred) or AWS/Azure

  • Experience on both sides of third-party security assessments — being audited and auditing vendors

  • Practical expertise in PAM, SIEM, DLP, endpoint hardening, and network security.

The Right Person For This Role:

  • You should be able to make sense of SIEM detection rules and alerts and configure the same as well

  • Translates regulatory requirements into practical controls without over-engineering

  • Holds firm on security non-negotiables while being pragmatic with business constraints

  • Writes clean policy documents, audit responses, and regulatory submissions

  • Thrives solo in a fast-paced startup where compliance is a competitive advantage, not overhead

  • High integrity — this role has access to the most sensitive systems, data, and partner relationships

  • Ability to handle audits and provide right and logical justifications where appropriate.

Why Join Glomopay?

  • Direct Impact: Report directly to the Head of Information Security. Shape the security foundation of India's first IFSCA-authorized PSP, your actions and decisions define the ecosystem.

  • Full Ownership: You will be instrumental in building the entire security program and be a part of the team from scratch. No inherited mess, no bureaucracy — This gives you an opportunity to define the culture from scratch.

  • Regulatory Pioneer: You will help define the InfoSec playbook at the intersection of IFSCA, RBI, and global card network requirements.

  • Modern Stack: GCP, Terraform IaC, CrowdStrike, Teleport PAM — cloud-native infrastructure, not legacy systems.

  • Strategic Moat: Your security program becomes the reason banking partners choose Glomopay. Security here is a revenue enabler, not a cost center.

title: Taloussihteeri / Vaasan Vesi
description:
Vaasan Vesi on Vaasan kaupungin liikelaitos, osoite: Valimontie 2 B. Vaasan Vesi tuottaa vesihuoltopalveluita Vaasan seudulla, joista keskeisimmät ovat hyvänlaatuinen talousvesi ja sen jakelu sekä jätevesien viemäröinti ja puhdistus. Vesihuoltopalveluihin liittyy monipuolisia oheispalveluita, jotka hoidetaan hallinnollisena tukipalvelutyönä. Näitä ovat esimerkiksi henkilöstöhallinto, ostolaskut, vesihuollon myyntilaskutus ja maksunvalvonta/perintä, asiakaspalvelu sekä viestintä.

Vaasan kaupungin sihteeripalvelut hoidetaan keskitetysti Konsernihallinnon alaisena tukipalvelutyönä lähipalveluissa. Sihteeripalvelut-palvelualue tukee kaupungin ydintoimintoja ja johdon työskentelyä, koordinoi hallinnollisia prosesseja ja kehittää työ- ja toimintatapoja.

Tehtävään kuuluvat monipuoliset talouteen ja yleishallintoon liittyvät tehtävät, joiden keskeisimmät tehtäväalueet ovat:
- tilaajavastuulain/verottajan vaatimat tehtävät, kuten projektiseuranta, työmaa- ja henkilöstöselvitys sekä työmaiden avaus
- ostolaskujen käsittely
- viranhaltijapäätösten valmistelu ja tiedoksianto (Tweb, Valmu)
- vesihuollon myyntilaskutukseen sekä maksunvalvontaan ja perintään liittyvät tehtävät
- erilaiset seuranta-, selvitys- ja raportointitehtävät
- sisäinen ja ulkoinen asiakaspalvelu

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva ammatillinen perustutkinto.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä suomen ja tyydyttävä ruotsin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.
Englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme
- oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista otetta työhön
- palveluhenkisyyttä
- talousosaamista
- kykyä suoriutua itsenäisesti omasta tehtäväalueesta

Arvostamme:
- kokemusta julkishallinnon tehtävistä sekä Vaasan kaupungin organisaation tuntemusta
- työkokemusta monipuolisista toimistotehtävistä
- hyvää Office 365 ohjelmiston hallitsemista
- erinomaista organisointikykyä, ennakointia ja kokonaisuuksien hallintaa
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja
- yhteistyökykyä ja vastuullisuutta
- joustavuutta

Tarjoamme monipuoliset ja mielenkiintoiset tehtävät kehittyvässä työyhteisössä ja asiantuntevassa tiimissä. Tarjoamme lisäksi hyvät kehittymismahdollisuudet: tuemme omaehtoista kouluttautumista sekä tarjoamme koulutuksia ja valmennusohjelmia.

Lisäksi tarjoamme etuja kaupungin palveluihin, työsuhdepyöräedun sekä e-passin liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaedun.

Meillä työtä tehdään joustavasti kaupungin hybridimallin mukaisesti, mutta pääsääntöisesti lähityössä ja liukuvan työajan puitteissa, työtehtävät huomioiden.

Palkka tässä tehtävässä on 2700,65 €/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan mahdolliset KVTES:in mukaiset lisät.
Palkka määräytyy KVTES:n tasopalkkajärjestelmän mukaisesti.

Koeaika on kolme kuukautta.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, jätäthän hakemuksesi siis mahdollisimman pian!
Haastatteluun kutsutut ottavat mukaansa alkuperäiset tutkinto- ja työtodistukset.

title: Detection & Investigation Analyst Lead - Outbound Zelle Fraud: Monday - Friday: 12:30 - 9:00 pm ET
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success.

As a Detection & Investigation Analyst Lead within PNC's FDO Zelle Fraud organization, you will be based in Phoenix, AZ.

*Outbound Zelle Team*

*PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.*

Monday - Friday: 12:30 - 9:00 pm ET

*In Office*

Are you curious? If you are given enough data, are you able to extrapolate what future data would likely indicate? Are you comfortable with new technology, and willing to continually learn? If you are watching a mystery movie, are you bothered when the criminals get away with their crime? If so, this may be the position for you!

Responsibilities of this position includes:
• Outbound Zelle fraud support
• Analyzing cases generated from the enterprise fraud detection systems
• Talking with customers whose transactions are suspicious of potential fraud.
• Card Free ATM fraud support

Job Description

  • Reviews and investigates customer cases, reports and work for potential and actual loss. Minimizes fraud, Anti-Money Laundering and/or organizational risk. Performs early detection of suspicious activity. Controls and prevents losses. May lead the work of and/or train detection and investigation staff.
  • Researches and analyzes bank activities and reports to detect and prevent possible fraudulent and suspicious activities. Recommends disposition. Identifies gaps and control enhancements.
  • Uses defined research procedures to identify and resolve issues. Identifies trends and escalates as appropriate.
  • Follows standards and practices to mitigate fraud, Anti-Money Laundering and other risk exposure and loss. Shares best practices among the team and/or service partners.
  • Prepares and maintains appropriate documentation of analysis performed and coordinates with internal or external stakeholders as appropriate.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

title: Corporate Development Analyst
description:
At we are building the most reliable, friendly, and efficient robot platform that allows every person or business to offer and receive an affordable and safe delivery service. We are the leading robotic platform with traction of more than 150,000 successful deliveries in multiple locations in the USA. We are on our way to be a moonshot and to get there, we need to build an amazing team.

The role:

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Development, Robot.com is seeking a Corporate Development Analyst to join our Corporate Development team. This role is ideal for an individual with strong analytical, financial, and business intelligence (BI) skills, along with an interest in corporate strategy. The Corporate Development Analyst will be responsible for supporting the execution of mergers and acquisitions (M&A), strategic partnerships, and other key business development initiatives. You will work closely with senior management to identify opportunities for growth, assess the strategic impact of potential transactions, and leverage BI tools to inform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

  • M&A Support and Execution:

    • Assist in identifying, evaluating, and executing mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.

    • Build and maintain financial models (e.g., discounted cash flow, comparable company analysis, precedent transactions) to assess the financial impact of acquisitions and other transactions.

    • Support the due diligence process by gathering, analyzing, and presenting financial, operational, and market data.

  • Strategic Planning and Analysis:

    • Conduct industry, market, and competitive research to identify emerging trends and growth opportunities.

    • Provide analytical support in the development of strategic initiatives, new business opportunities, and long-term planning.

    • Evaluate and model the financial impact of potential strategic initiatives and investments.

    • Utilize BI tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) to create data-driven insights and dashboards that support strategic decision-making.

  • Financial Analysis and Reporting:

    • Perform detailed financial analysis, including valuation, forecasting, and scenario modeling, to evaluate business opportunities.

    • Prepare investment memoranda, reports, and presentations for senior management and stakeholders.

    • Use BI tools to automate reporting processes, visualize key performance metrics, and track business performance against strategic goals.

  • Business Intelligence and Data Analytics:

    • Develop and maintain dashboards and data visualizations to track financial and operational performance.

    • Use BI tools to collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets, identifying trends and insights to inform strategic decisions.

    • Provide actionable insights based on data analysis to optimize business performance and identify growth opportunities.

  • Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams:

    • Work closely with internal teams (e.g., finance, legal, operations) to support the execution of corporate transactions and strategic initiatives.

    • Help prepare materials for board meetings and senior management to support decision-making processes.

  • Transaction and Project Management:

    • Assist in managing multiple ongoing transactions, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met.

    • Maintain project documentation and ensure efficient communication across teams involved in corporate development initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • Education:
    Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Experience:

    • 1-3 years of experience in corporate development, investment banking, management consulting, private equity, or a similar field.

    • Familiarity with financial modeling, valuation techniques, and financial statement analysis.

    • Exposure to M&A transactions, business development, or strategic planning is a plus.

    • Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, etc.) is highly desirable.

  • Skills:

    • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (presentation preparation).

    • Proficiency in BI tools for data visualization, reporting, and analysis.

    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate complex financial and business concepts clearly.

    • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

    • Experience in the technology, manufacturing, robotics, or autonomous vehicle industries.


  • Attributes:

    • Self-motivated and detail-oriented with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

    • Strong business acumen and understanding of corporate finance, strategy, and business intelligence.

    • Eagerness to contribute to high-level corporate strategy and development initiatives.

Why Robot.com?

  • Innovative Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking company that is transforming last-mile delivery.

  • Growth Opportunities: As a public company, we offer significant opportunities for career growth and advancement.

  • Dynamic Work Environment: Collaborate with a talented and passionate team in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial setting.

  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Robot.com is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Kids Club Supervisor
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Personally contribute to the youth program’s team goal of providing fun, educational and caring services to the children of members and guests, in a warm and welcoming environment. Build rapport with and take a genuine interest in all children and parents utilizing the club’s child activity services. Supervise on-floor operations and staff during shift. Act as a roving attendant at various kid activity stations when needed. Offer a full, varied, innovative, and targeted calendar of activities and events for boys and girls who visit. Assist the Manager with special projects, events, specialty classes and party planning for the youth program. Participate in everyday activities such as organizing arts and crafts time, leading games, reading stories and singing songs. Promote the club’s youth programs and activities. Assist parents in program registration and discuss any behavioral issues of child. To help keep facilities and equipment clean, neat and well maintained.

Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

title: Visual Merchandising Intern
description:
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

We are looking for an open-minded and enthusiastic intern to join our regional merchandising team. During this internship, you’ll be work with the VM Manager on the management of all visual merchandising, retail excellence and delegated store design activity associated with the delivery of the VM strategy and new store openings. Responsible for guaranteeing maximum qualitative visual impact of the brand at each point of sale in line with brand DNA and local strategy. Creation and implementation of launch and permanent merchandising tools and guidelines, consistently executed across both Travel Retail and Local Market in APAC.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the Visual Merchandising team on daily administrative tasks and specific projects

  • Assist with in-store visual merchandising such as developing key launch concepts, researching materials, and preparing APAC display designs

  • Work closely with Retail Design, Brand Marketing teams, Design Agencies, Contractors, and Vendors to enhance POS retail excellence

  • Responsible for creating and tracking purchase orders, as well as ensuring timely deliveries of regional productions

  • Coordinate with vendors regarding material samples, as well as overseeing the picking, packing, and sending of samples back and forth

  • Occasional need to liaise with HQ for specificity on materials and finishing samples from France for regional production or specific delivery for market needs

MAIN MISSION

1. Product Launch

  • Ensure weekly all central guidelines and technical details are maintained and that specific markets folders are always up to speed with the latest information

  • Support technical adaptation of central visual merchandising guidelines across the regional (3 axis: Fragrance, Make-up and Skincare)

  • Maintain Soft Merchandising 3D Assets based on campaign cadence in the regional

  • Depending on sketch-up skills, to support in designing of regionally product POSM based on monthly launches.

  • Support in artwork updates and changes based on campaign drops depending on adobe illustrator or in-design skills

Animations/Events

  • Design support on SPP or small podiums on sketch-up, depending on skills sets

  • Join-in trade plan brainstorming plans/sessions for retailtainment activities by collaborating with marketing and commercial teams

  • Organised internal visit to competitor’s pop-ups in Singapore

  • Post-campaign process support for photo/video execution to be maintained and submitted by market

3. Visual Merchandising Operation

  • Support VM Manager in briefing / managing regional productions to both market and external vendor

  • Support on the POSM shipment, cost tracking, and PO creation.

  • Coordinate timely delivery of merchandising produced regionally

  • Worked with vendors/contractors on brand’s POSM guide that will affect dimensions, cropping, and review for production & installation

4. Administrative

  • Monthly merchandising’s Meeting Agenda to be shared across all regions

  • To follow-up with meeting minutes during merchandising monthly meetings

  • Launch merchandising surveys across regions

  • Key point of tracking status and organising inventory count of office POS and display configuration

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Internship durations: Aug 2026 – Dec 2026 on full time basis

  • Genuine interest in the beauty industry

  • Demonstrate strong communication skills with different functional teams.

  • Showcase problem-solving and project management skills, attention to detail.

  • Strong accountability and ability to work independently when required.

  • High proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, MS Office PowerPoint, and basic proficiency in MS Office Excel. Proficiency with Sketchup will be preferred.

  • 3D design knowledge will be a plus.

Brænder du for IT og drømmer du om en uddannelse som IT-supporter? Hos Dansk Industri (DI) får du mulighed for at kombinere uddannelse og praktik i en spændende organisation med fokus på digitalisering, samarbejde og udvikling.

Som IT-supporterelev hos DI får du:


En målrettet og professionel 2-årig uddannelse inden for IT-support.



En spændende arbejdsplads med stor variation i opgaverne.



Et stærkt fællesskab i et hjælpsomt og engageret IT-helpdeskteam.



En grundig introduktion til mange forskellige IT-opgaver og teknologier.


Om elevpladsen
Du bliver en del af IT-helpdesk-teamet, hvor du får 10 dygtige og engagerede kollegaer - herunder også to andre IT-supporterelever.

Vi tilbyder:


En spændende og udfordrende elevplads i en dynamisk organisation med fokus på digital udvikling.



Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med god sparring og balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.



Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.



Tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af IT-afdelingen.


Når du starter, udarbejder vi sammen en uddannelsesplan, og du får tilknyttet en elevvært, som følger dig gennem hele forløbet og støtter dig i din udvikling.

Du bliver samtidig en del af DI’s elevnetværk og får mulighed for at deltage i personale- og sportsforeninger.

Hos DI lægger vi stor vægt på både faglighed og trivsel. Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen til en organisation, hvor innovation, samarbejde og udvikling er i centrum.

Hvad kan du forvente at lære hos os?
I løbet af din elevtid forventer vi blandt andet, at du bliver i stand til at:


Bidrage til bedre opgaveløsning og dokumentation.



Tage ansvar og arbejde mere selvstændigt.



Supportere brugere og konfigurere udstyr på egen hånd.



Opbygge stærke IT-kompetencer gennem praktisk erfaring.


Hvem er du?
Du er nysgerrig på IT, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære. Vi lægger vægt på, at du:


Er engageret og initiativrig.



Har lyst til at samarbejde med andre.



Yder god service og møder andre med en positiv indstilling.



Tager din uddannelse seriøst og bidrager aktivt i hverdagen.


Ansøgning og kontakt
Du kan læse mere om Dansk Industri på DI’s hjemmeside

Send dit CV og besvar spørgsmålene hurtigst muligt og senest den 30. august 2026.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Det er en forudsætning, at du har gode danskkundskaber - både mundtligt og skriftligt. Bemærk derfor, at kun ansøgninger skrevet på dansk vil blive taget i betragtning.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at række ud til Lennie Aakjær Hansen på leha@di.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

    Om Dansk Industri

    

Vi er Danmarks største erhvervsorganisation, og hver dag arbejder vi for at gøre dansk erhvervsliv til det bedste i verden!

Som medarbejder i DI er du en del af et unikt, værdiskabende fællesskab, der er større end de enkelte dele - sammen gør vi en verden til forskel for vores 20.000 medlemsvirksomheder. Vi tager vores rolle som samfundsaktør seriøst - derfor gør vi os umage med at levere høj service og faglighed til vores medlemsvirksomheder - og være på forkant med samfundsudviklingen - hvad enten vi påvirker den politiske dagsorden i erhvervslivets interesse eller leverer personalejuridisk rådgivning, uddannelser, netværk og arrangementer til de mange forskellige virksomheder i vores medlemskreds.

En værdiskabende karriere og et meningsfyldt arbejdsliv
I DI vil vi have de bedste rammer for et godt og meningsfyldt arbejdsliv. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe en arbejdsplads med høj medarbejdertrivsel, fleksibilitet og muligheder for, at du som medarbejder kan udvikle dit fulde potentiale. Vi ved, at vi opnår de bedste resultater i fællesskab. Det betyder, at vi altid er imødekommende og nysgerrige over for vores kollegers idéer og aldrig er bange for at bidrage til hinandens succeser. En god DI-kollega er karakteriseret ved at bringe mod, styrke og hjerte til bordet i sin adfærd, sine relationer og i sine beslutninger. Dét skaber sammenhold, samhørighed og resultater.

Indflydelse - nationalt og internationalt
DI har hovedkontor i Industriens Hus på Rådhuspladsen i København. Vi er også til stede regionalt, europæisk og globalt - med kontorer og projekter rundt om i verden for at hjælpe vores medlemmer med at erobre nye markeder.

title: UI Architect
description:
UI Architect - Assistant Vice President

Location: Bangalore, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job Title

UI Architect

Role Summary

&

Role Description

We are seeking a highly experienced UI Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, enterprise-grade user interface architectures across our application portfolio. This role will be responsible for defining UI standards, design systems, front-end architecture patterns, and development best practices that enable the delivery of consistent, secure, accessible, and high-performing digital experiences.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Owners, UX Designers, Solution Architects, and Engineering teams to establish architectural direction and drive adoption of modern front-end technologies and frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

  • Define and govern UI architecture standards, frameworks, and design patterns.
  • Design scalable, maintainable, and reusable front-end architectures for web and mobile applications.
  • Establish standards for component-based architectures, state management, routing, and micro-frontends.
  • Develop reference architectures and reusable frameworks to accelerate delivery.

User Experience & Design Systems

  • Lead the architecture and governance of enterprise design systems and UI component libraries.
  • Partner with UX teams to ensure consistency across products and platforms.
  • Champion accessibility, usability, and responsive design standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across multiple delivery teams.
  • Conduct design reviews, architecture reviews, and code quality assessments.
  • Mentor engineers and establish front-end engineering best practices.
  • Drive adoption of reusable components and shared technology assets.

Performance, Security & Governance

  • Define standards for performance optimisation, scalability, observability, and resilience.
  • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish secure front-end development practices and governance controls.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security teams to align solutions with organisational standards.

Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging front-end frameworks, tools, and technologies.
  • Recommend modern approaches to enhance user experience and developer productivity.
  • Promote continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Core/Must have skills

14+ years of software development experience.

5+ years in UI Architecture, Front-End Architecture, or related technical leadership roles.

Extensive experience designing enterprise-scale web applications.

Strong knowledge of software architecture principles and modern front-end development practices.

Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

Required Technical Skills

  • JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript
  • React, Angular, Vue.js, or comparable modern UI frameworks
  • HTML5, CSS3, SCSS
  • Responsive and mobile-first design
  • Design Systems and Component Libraries
  • REST APIs and API Integration
  • State Management Frameworks (Redux, NgRx, etc.)
  • CI/CD and DevOps Practices
  • Front-End Security Best Practices
  • Performance Optimisation

Good to have skills

Experience in Financial Services, Asset Management, Custody, or FinTech domains.

Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud

Experience with Micro-Frontend architecture.

Familiarity with Figma and modern design collaboration tools.

Knowledge of AI-enabled user experiences and conversational interfaces.

Work Schedule

Hybrid

Keywords (If any)

UI Architect.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Business Data Analyst (5년 이상)
description:
About

=====

글로벌 콘텐츠 ​플랫폼 ​기업, ​SpoonLabs와 함께 ​하실
Senior Business Data Analyst를 지금 찾고 ​있어요

=====

[Business Intelligence 팀을 ​소개합니다]

Business Intelligence ​팀은 ​이런 일을 ​해요!

비즈니스 ​성과 ​창출을 위해 데이터 ​기반의 ​의사결정 프로세스를 설계하고 ​실행합니다.
• 데이터 ​기반 ​고객 이해: 고객 ​행동과 니즈를 ​데이터로 ​분석하고, 핵심 ​인사이트를 전사에 ​공유합니다.
• 과제 ​발굴: 기대값이 높은 ​과제를 데이터로 ​발굴하고 명확한 목표를 설정합니다.
• 성과 측정 및 검증: 실제 비즈니스 성과로 이어진 과제를 판별하고 기여도를 정량적으로 측정합니다.

BI 팀은 글로벌 콘텐츠 플랫폼에서 발생하는 방대한 데이터를 기반으로, 비즈니스 임팩트를 만들어내는 분석을 수행합니다. 국가별·문화별로 다른 사용자 행동 데이터를 다루며, 정량적 지표와 함께 사용자 맥락을 해석하는 정성적 인사이트를 결합해 문제의 본질을 정의합니다. 우리는 “분석이 맞았는가”보다 “이 분석이 실제 의사결정과 성과로 이어졌는가”를 더 중요하게 생각하며, 데이터를 비즈니스 언어로 연결하는 역할을 합니다.

스푼랩스가 만드는 글로벌 콘텐츠 플랫폼 Spoon & Vigloo!
• 오디오부터 비디오까지, 스푼랩스는 전 세계 사람들의 일상을 재밌는 콘텐츠로 가득 채우고 있습니다.
• 실시간 라이브부터 귀로 듣는 팟노블까지 글로벌 오디오 플랫폼, Spoon - https://www.spooncast.net/kr
• 2분의 몰입을 선사하는 숏드라마 플랫폼, Vigloo - https://www.vigloo.com/ko

Responsibilities

• 성과 측정 및 분석
• 신규 서비스/기능 성과 측정용 지표 정의 및 트래킹 설계
• 사용자 행동 분석(코호트, 퍼널)을 통한 전환율 개선 포인트 발굴
• 전사 및 주요 서비스의 성과 지표 기획 및 모니터링 체계 구축

• 실험 설계 및 해석
• 비즈니스 가설 검증을 위한 A/B 테스트 설계, 실행, 결과 분석
• 통계적 검정 및 고급 분석 기법을 활용한 인사이트 도출

• 비즈니스 의사결정을 위한 인사이트 발굴
• 경영진 및 각 부서의 의사결정을 위한 데이터 기반 리포트 작성
• KPI 모니터링 및 원인 분석

• 데이터 품질 관리 및 거버넌스 체계 구축
• 이벤트 로깅 체계(Taxonomy) 설계 및 관리
• 데이터 정합성 검증

Requirements

• 5년 이상의 데이터 분석 실무 경험 혹은 그에 준하는 역량을 보유하신 분
• SQL을 활용한 고급 데이터 추출 및 가공 전문가이신 분
• 복잡한 쿼리(Window Function, CTE, Subquery, 성능 최적화 등)에 능숙하신 분
• 비즈니스 가설을 설정하고 데이터로 검증해 본 경험이 풍부하신 분
• Python, R, Excel 중 하나 이상을 활용한 데이터 분석 및 시각화 전문가이신 분
• 통계적 검정, 모델링, 고급 시각화 구현이 가능하신 분

Preferred

• 콘텐츠 데이터 분석 경험을 보유하신 분
• 데이터 마트 구축 및 관리 경험을 보유하신 분

Benefits

[스푼랩스는 어떻게 일하나요? 여기에 답이 있어요]

Work Hard. Win Together.
밤낮을 넘어 치열히, 원팀으로 끝까지.

완벽보다 속도, 고민보다 실행.
스푼랩스는 빠르게 시도하고, 실패는 안고 다시 달립니다.
결국 답에 닿을 때까지 몰입합니다.

밤낮을 넘는 긴 몰입의 시간,
끝없는 시도와 수정으로 답에 다가섭니다.
속도는 빠르고, 기준은 높고, 불확실성은 큽니다.

Job Title

In today’s hyper-competitive travel industry, Loyalty is no longer just a program, it is the engine that drives customer engagement, retention, and revenue growth. From shaping personalized experiences to unlocking new commercial opportunities, it blends innovation, engineering excellence, and customer-centric thinking to create real business value.

Join our innovative Loyalty team at and work with cutting-edge technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, and Kubernetes. title: Software Development Engineer 2, Amazon Kids, Amazon Kids
description:
Come join the Amazon Kids team in Toronto! Amazon Kids gives children the content that they love and devices built just for them. We also give parents the oversight and controls they need to feel safe. Our team builds the Amazon Kids Store and Subscription experiences — where kids discover and request the content they want, and parents stay in control by approving what their kids can access.

Do you want to create and deliver innovative consumer products for millions of customers? We're looking for a talented, experienced Software Development Engineer with a track record of building and shipping innovative software to help shape our team, influence the team culture, and help develop the team. Our goal is to create a revolutionary experience for parents and kids to enjoy on our Amazon family of devices.

You will work with the team to quickly and iteratively deliver high quality software features. Your team's work spans the backend services that power content discovery, ordering, and parental approvals, as well as the web/app experiences parents see — and you'll work across the full software stack as needed.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be responsible for owning and driving customer facing features for the Kids experience across multiple platform such as Tablet, Kindle and Fire TV. You will own software systems from inception to delivery and beyond. You will have an opportunity to design, architect and build innovative consumer products used every day by people you know.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll leverage your experience as a Software Engineer to solve difficult technical problems. You'll invent, design and build software that solves the challenges that kids and their parents face day-to-day. You'll work closely with your leadership and product management stakeholders to design simple solutions. You'll help to maintain our production software in the field and you'll identify our pain points and drive your team to solve them. You'll help make your team better, more efficient, and a more enjoyable place to work.

About the team
Amazon Kids+ brings together all types of content that kids and parents love, including books, Audible books, movies, TV shows, educational apps and games, plus a child-friendly Alexa experience. It provides peace of mind for parents with award-winning parental controls and monitoring through Parent Dashboard, and a world of fun for kids where they can choose from thousands of the most popular titles and age-appropriate content. Amazon Kids is available on Fire Tablets, Fire TV, Kindle e-readers, compatible Android and iOS mobile devices, and compatible Alexa devices. Here's more information: http://www.amazon.com/kids.

title: Lending Services Analyst
description:
• Work in a hybrid environment - 2 days in the office
  • Permanent role based in Sydney

We're REA

With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named in Australia’s “Top 5” Best Workplaces two years in a row, as well as being recognised as a Best Workplace for Women.

Where the team fits in

Within Financial Services, the Lending Services team plays a critical role in supporting brokers with the information, systems and guidance they need to assess lending scenarios, recommend suitable lenders and products, and submit quality loan applications that meet regulatory requirements.

The team acts as a trusted support function for the broker network, helping translate lender information into practical system outcomes, improving broker capability, and enabling strong customer and franchisee outcomes.

The Lending Services Team plays a vital role in supporting brokers to efficiently obtain the information they need to assess lending scenarios, recommend suitable lenders and products to clients, and submit loan applications in a way that meets regulatory requirements.

The team supports the network by:

  • Receiving, clarifying and interpreting lender product, process, policy and qualification criteria
  • Working with third-party provider Simpology to have product changes implemented and maintained in the relevant broker systems
  • Providing one-on-one support to brokers on lender products, policy, qualifications, scenario setup and application packaging within Mortgage Choice systems
  • Developing resources to support credit application support in systems and the franchise network.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues relating to lender policy, qualification and products
  • Delivering credit coaching to help build broker capability and improve understanding of lending policy, credit scenarios and deal structuring

We aim to be an expert, trusted source of support and information for the network, leveraging strong lender relationships and effective third-party partnerships to deliver the best outcomes for franchisees.

What the role is all about

  • Interpreting and clarifying product changes, and working with Simpology to coordinate implementation into the relevant broker systems and product catalogue
  • Interpreting, clarifying and implementing policy changes in the lender policy database
  • Interpreting, clarifying, implementing and testing serviceability and qualification criteria changes in the lender qualification system
  • Maintaining lender qualification criteria specifications
  • Onboarding new lender product, policy and qualification criteria, including documenting and testing before implementation, and coordinating product-related changes through to release into Mortgage Choice systems
  • Supporting the broker network via email, telephone and Lending Advice Forum, responding to enquiries regarding the effective use of broker systems
  • Providing SME advice and support to brokers in understanding policy, complex scenarios and deal structuring
  • Providing credit coaching to support broker capability uplift and stronger application quality
  • Troubleshooting product, policy and qualification issues as they arise, including working with NexGen/Simpology on product-related system issues
  • Developing reference resources to help brokers understand and follow best practice processes
  • Engaging with the network to promote understanding of the lending process and best practice
  • Documenting internal processes as new ones are developed and existing processes change
  • Building and maintaining effective relationships with lender representatives and NexGen/Simpology as sources of information, clarification and issue resolution, including periodic review meetings
  • Implementing lender responses to audits of information in broker systems

Who we’re looking for

  • Well-developed troubleshooting, data analysis and interpretation skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with people at different levels and with varying levels of technical knowledge and capability
  • Very high attention to detail
  • Well-developed prioritisation skills, with the agility to rapidly switch from one task to another
  • Ability to work autonomously as well as collaboratively in a team
  • Strong achievement and results focus, with the ability to anticipate, prioritise and address issues proactively and decisively to ensure work is completed within agreed timeframes
  • Accountability for outcomes and a willingness to take ownership
  • Good working knowledge of Excel
  • 5+ years of experience in residential lending, preferably across multiple lenders
  • Prior knowledge of ApplyOnline and/or LoanApp is preferred

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.

Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Join our Talent Neighbourhood

Keen to be part of REA but didn't find a perfect match with this opportunity? Perhaps the timing isn't right? You should join our Talent Neighbourhood!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer - Assistant Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Officer – Full Stack Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in enterprise application development, low-latency services, and cloud-native product engineering. The ideal candidate combines hands-on coding ability across backend and frontend technologies with the ability to independently deliver high-quality modules from design through production release.

As an Officer, you will own end-to-end delivery of full-stack components and services, working closely with product owners, architects, QA, and engineering peers to translate business requirements into scalable, resilient, and secure solutions. This role is suited for an engineer who can operate independently, make sound technical decisions at the component level, and mentor junior team members while contributing to pod-level engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently design, build, test, and deploy full-stack modules and application features end-to-end.
  • Own component-level technical design, including backend services, frontend interactions, API contracts, data models, and integration points.
  • Develop and maintain backend services in Python and/or Java and frontend applications using React and/or Angular.
  • Build and enhance RESTful APIs, service integrations, and business logic layers supporting platform and product capabilities.
  • Deliver responsive, reusable, and maintainable frontend components aligned with UX, accessibility, and design standards.
  • Drive adoption of engineering best practices within the pod, including testing, code quality, CI/CD, documentation, secure coding, and release readiness.
  • Deploy and support applications on cloud-native platforms, including AWS and/or Azure.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across application, API, integration, and infrastructure layers; contribute to root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams to refine requirements, estimate technical effort, and propose implementation options.
  • Mentor Senior Associates through code reviews, technical guidance, and day-to-day support on design and delivery.
  • Contribute to improvements in performance, observability, maintainability, scalability, and developer experience across the pod.
  • Support application monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational practices to maintain service reliability.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies, design sessions, and engineering reviews, helping raise technical quality across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5–10 years of experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and/or Python for backend engineering.
  • Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
  • Solid understanding of API design, microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience designing and supporting production-grade applications with ownership of performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, cloud-native deployment models, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Docker, and working knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance-aware query design.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across frontend, backend, and deployment layers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to event-driven architecture, Kafka, or asynchronous messaging patterns.
  • Experience with GraphQL, API gateways, and integration middleware.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting platforms.
  • Exposure to low-latency systems or high-throughput enterprise platforms.
  • Experience in financial services, capital markets, or other regulated industries.
  • Exposure to GenAI/LLM-enabled product features is a plus.
  • Cloud certifications in AWS and/or Azure are a plus.

Work Schedule

On-premise

Keywords

Full Stack Engineering, Java, Python, React, Angular, Cloud-Native, AWS, Azure, CI/CD, Microservices, REST APIs, Frontend Development, Backend Development, Distributed Systems, Enterprise Applications, Docker, Kubernetes, Production Support, Scalable Systems, Agile Delivery, API Integration
